jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: Location:Remote **Who We Are** All Star Healthcare Solutions is one of the nation's fastest\-growing locum tenens healthcare staffing firms, proudly serving Providers, Clients, and the Community with excellence. Headquartered in Boca Raton, FL, we offer a professional, fast\-paced environment that is collaborative, innovative, and never overly corporate. We recruit, credential, license and place physicians and advanced practice providers with hospitals and health systems in every state, an we support the full lifecycle of that relationship. As a Sun\-Sentinel Top Places to Work recipient, we invest in our people—their personal, professional, and financial goals—while fostering a culture built on teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement. If you're looking for the opportunity to influence executive strategy, lead transformational initiatives, and help shape the future of a growing organization, All Star is the place to build your career. **What You Will Do** All Star Healthcare Solutions is seeking an experienced **AI Engineer** to design, build, and deploy AI capabilities across the enterprise. This position reports to the Chief Information Officer and works alongside the Salesforce Architect and Platform Owner, Salesforce Engineers, Salesforce Administrator, Analytics Engineer, and the Project Manager/Business Analyst on a single flat technology team. This position builds production AI solutions — agents, automations, and model\-backed features — on the Salesforce Platform, on Microsoft 365, and against the enterprise data warehouse, This role also defines the guardrails those solutions operate within. This position combines hands\-on engineering with the judgment to say when a use case is not ready to automate. **Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities** **You Will Own the Following:** * Design, build, test, and deploy AI solutions end to end — agents, assistants, retrieval pipelines, classification and extraction services, and model\-backed automations * Build Agentforce agents on the Salesforce Platform — topic and action design, grounding, prompt templates, testing, and release * Build and support AI capabilities on Microsoft 365 and Claude Enterprise, including custom integrations, MCP servers, and internal tooling * Engineer the retrieval and grounding layer against enterprise data — source selection, chunking, embedding, indexing, and relevance evaluation * Define and implement AI guardrails — data access scoping, encryption, PII and PHI handling, prompt injection defense, human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints, and audit logging * Build evaluation harnesses and regression suites for AI features; measure accuracy, latency, cost per task, and failure modes before and after release * Instrument deployed AI in production — usage, cost, error, and quality monitoring — and act on what the telemetry shows * Document solution design, data flows, model and tool selection, and operating procedures for every deployed capability * Support adoption — enablement material, office hours, and feedback loops with the business users of deployed AI * Track the AI and platform vendor roadmaps and evaluate new capability against what has already been built **Required Education and Experience** * 6\+ years of software or data engineering experience, including 2\+ years building and shipping production AI or LLM\-backed applications * Hands\-on experience with LLM application patterns — retrieval\-augmented generation, tool and function calling, agent orchestration, structured output, and prompt engineering * Proficiency in Python and JavaScript/TypeScript, and fluency with REST APIs, webhooks, and event\-driven integration * Experience building on at least one major model platform (Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Google) and familiarity with the Model Context Protocol * Experience deploying AI capability inside an enterprise SaaS platform — Agentforce, Einstein, Copilot, or equivalent * Strong data engineering fundamentals — SQL, data modeling, ELT pipelines, and working with a cloud data warehouse * Demonstrated ownership of AI evaluation and testing — defining success criteria, building eval sets, and measuring accuracy and regression * Working knowledge of AI security and governance — access scoping, data residency, PII and PHI handling, and auditability * Advanced understanding of CI/CD concepts, source control, unit testing principles, and release management * Advanced understanding of Agile software development methodologies, values, and procedures (Scrum, Kanban) * Strong presentation and documentation/technical writing skills Experience in owning end\-to\-end engineering initiatives **Why You'll Love Working Here** At All Star Healthcare Solutions, we believe our employees are our greatest investment. We offer a competitive total rewards package designed to support your career growth, well\-being, and work\-life balance. **Perks \& Benefits** * Competitive base salary with an annual discretionary bonus opportunity * Remote work model that supports flexibility while fostering collaboration and connection * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance * 401(k) with company match to help you plan for the future * Three weeks of paid time off, plus 10 paid holidays * Paid parental leave * Ongoing professional development and leadership growth opportunities * Opportunity to help shape the financial strategy of one of the nation's fastest\-growing healthcare staffing organizations * A collaborative, people\-first culture where your ideas are valued and innovation is encouraged **Location** This position offers the flexibility to work remotely, allowing you to contribute, collaborate, and stay connected with the team from your home workspace. We’re looking for someone who thrives in a remote environment and can communicate and collaborate effectively across teams. The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this job. They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified. All personnel may be required to perform duties outside of their normal responsibilities from time to time, as needed. All Star Healthcare Solutions reserves the right to amend and change responsibilities to meet business and organizational needs as necessary. This job description is NOT a contract for employment and does not modify or circumvent the employee’s ‘at\-will’ employment relationship with the company. *All Star Recruiting Locums, LLC and affiliates are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to status as a protected veteran or a qualified individual with a disability, or other protected status, such as race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age or any other category protected by law.*

jobs.title: AI Research Scientist, Energy-Based Models
jobs.description: **Who We are** At Logical Intelligence, our mission is to accelerate the discovery of materials that make the next generation of technology possible, from light emitters and semiconductors to batteries, electric vehicles, and the chips behind AI and robotics. Large language models alone are not enough to get there. Discovering new materials requires an understanding of chemistry and physics to guide the search, and energy\-based models let us build that understanding directly into our discovery loop. We work closely with industry and lab partners to shorten the path from research to real products. **About the Role** As an **AI Research Scientist**, you'll join an interdisciplinary team of quantum chemists, physicists, ML scientists, and engineers. You will develop new energy\-based methods for molecules, building on the reasoning approach behind our Kona models, to create models that encode physical and chemical constraints and make predictions that respect them. **What You’ll Do** * Develop energy\-based models that reason about molecular structure and properties. * Design energy functions, training methods, and inference methods that keep predictions physically and chemically valid. * Own model evaluation, including benchmarks on held\-out chemical families, accuracy against quantum\-chemistry calculations and experiment, calibration of uncertainty, and tracking across model versions. * Investigate where the model fails, and turn what you learn into concrete changes, working closely with chemists, ML scientists, and engineers. **You'll Thrive in This Role If You Have** * A PhD in machine learning or a related field, or a Master's or Bachelor's with equivalent experience. * Hands\-on research experience with energy\-based models, or with closely related approaches such as score\-based models. * Knowledge of chemistry, or a genuine interest in learning it. * Excellent scientific writing and communication, and comfort working in an interdisciplinary team. **Especially Strong Candidates May Also Have** * Experience with molecular machine learning, such as quantum\-chemistry workflows (e.g., DFT). * A strong record of impactful research, shown through publications or open\-source software. logicalintelligence.com

jobs.title: AI Research Scientist: Materials Discovery
jobs.description: **Who We are** At Logical Intelligence, our mission is to accelerate the discovery of materials that make the next generation of technology possible, from light emitters and semiconductors to batteries, electric vehicles, and the chips behind AI and robotics. Large language models alone are not enough to get there. Discovering new materials requires an understanding of chemistry and physics to guide the search, and energy\-based models let us build that understanding directly into our discovery loop. We work closely with industry and lab partners to shorten the path from research to real products. **About the Role** As a **Research Scientist**, you will join an interdisciplinary team of quantum chemists, physicists, ML scientists, and engineers, where the biggest impact comes from working together. You'll develop the AI models that drive our discovery loop, proposing novel molecules that are then synthesized and tested in our partner labs, and you'll see your predictions confronted with real measurements. **What You’ll Do** * Tackle the core research problems in our discovery loop: how to generate promising candidates, screen them reliably, and decide which molecules are worth testing next. * Develop energy\-based models that combine learned representations with physical and chemical knowledge to search chemical space more efficiently. * Develop energy\-based models for key parts of the loop, combining learned representations with physical and chemical knowledge to search chemical space more efficiently. * Own model evaluation, including benchmarks on held\-out chemical families, accuracy against both quantum\-chemistry calculations and experiment, calibration of uncertainty estimates, prospective tests where the model predicts before the lab measures, and tracking across model versions. * Compare AI predictions with measurements, investigate disagreements, and turn what you learn into concrete model changes, in collaboration with chemists, AI researchers and engineers. * Design experiments with our partner labs so that each round of synthesis and testing is as informative as possible. **You Will Thrive in This Role If You Have** * A PhD in machine learning or a Master’s or Bachelor’s with relevant industry experience * Working knowledge in energy\-based models, diffusion or score\-based models, or similar generative approaches, and an interest in going deeper * Knowledge of chemistry, or a genuine interest in learning it alongside our chemists. * Experience designing evaluations and experiments that correlate with downstream performance * A strong record of impactful research, shown through publications, open\-source software * Excellent scientific writing and communication, and comfort working in an interdisciplinary team. **Especially Strong Candidates May Also Have** * Hands\-on research experience with energy\-based models, or with methods that combine learning with search and optimization. * Experience with molecular ML, such as property prediction, generative molecular design, ML interatomic potentials, or quantum\-chemistry workflows (e.g. DFT). * Experience with closed\-loop design using real lab feedback logicalintelligence.com

jobs.title: Biomedical Engineer
jobs.description: **Virolock Technologies LLC** Position Title: Senior Bioengineering Scientist (Senior Personnel) Location: State College, PA (Innovation Park / Penn State Ecosystem / Happy Valley) — On\-Site Only Position Type: Full\-Time \| Research \& Development Compensation: 70,000–82,000 base salary range (commensurate with experience) plus health insurance benefits and professional development opportunities. Work Authorization: Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States full\-time; the company does not sponsor work visa applicants. **Position Overview** Virolock Technologies LLC is commercializing proprietary technology that integrates carbon nanotube (VANTA) arrays into microfluidic architectures for label\-free, size\-based pathogen enrichment and molecular diagnostics. Headquartered in State College, PA—adjacent to the Pennsylvania State University research ecosystem—and supported by a National Science Foundation (NSF), Virolock is seeking an exceptional Senior Bioengineering Scientist to serve as a key Senior Personnel member. Working closely with executive leadership, this role demands high research autonomy, intellectual leadership, and a proactive "can\-do" attitude to build strategic R\&D processes and operational infrastructure. The successful candidate will lead the engineering optimization of microfluidic consumables, streamline automated sample processing units, supervise daily laboratory workflows, interface with cleanroom fabrication facilities, and validate pathogen recovery using qPCR and next\-generation sequencing (NGS). **Key Responsibilities** * Microfluidic Engineering: Lead the transition from elastomeric prototypes to monolithic, injection\-molded or laser\-machined single\-use cartridges using rigid thermoplastic bonding (acrylic, PMMA, PCL, polyimides). * Assay Development: Conceive, design, and independently execute experimental protocols evaluating viral retention, filtration efficiency, and recovery from clinical swabs, tissues, and wastewater. * Fluidic Automation: Direct the development and testing of automated sample processing units operating at 1–50 µL/min with computer vision feedback and pressure\-regulated fluidics. * Molecular Validation: Standardize quantitative quality control assays, including fluorescence spectroscopy, dPCR, qPCR, and sample preparation for metagenomic NGS workflows. * Sterile Compliance: Support the implementation of positive\-pressure sterile manufacturing workstations (ISO Class 7 standards) and post\-assembly sterilization protocols. * Shelf\-Life Studies: Design and execute real\-time and accelerated shelf\-life studies under ASTM F1980, testing high\-barrier packaging (HDPE, PP, PETG) under vacuum conditions. * Workforce Management: Plan, direct, and supervise R\&D staff and technicians through task delegation, training, reporting procedures, and project management software. * Lab Operations: Develop and maintain laboratory inventory, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and safety guidelines to ensure uninterrupted research and team health. * Quality Inspections: Conduct routine quality control assessments on in\-process projects to ensure full compliance with technical plans, industry standards, and grant contracts. * Technical Reporting: Author SOPs and assemble statistical datasets for internal, investor, and government (NSF) milestone reports, engaging directly with institutional and corporate partners. * Data Management: Record, transcribe, and maintain experimental and commercial datasets in secure electronic formats across local and cloud\-based servers. **Required Qualifications** * Education: Ph.D. or equivalent in Bioengineering, Biomedical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Biophysics, Materials Science \& Engineering, or a closely related field. * Experience Benchmarks: At least 5 years of hands\-on laboratory experience in bioengineering or molecular diagnostics, plus 2\+ years of laboratory and project management experience. * Research Autonomy: Demonstrated ability to formulate hypotheses, troubleshoot engineering bottlenecks with limited supervision, and deliver validated prototypes. * Device Fabrication: Hands\-on expertise in microfluidic device architecture, manifold design, polymer surface functionalization, solvent/thermal bonding, or soft lithography. * Molecular Toolset: Practical proficiency in nucleic acid extraction, qPCR/RT\-qPCR, dPCR, assay design, optical microscopy, and quantitative fluorometry. * Computational Proficiency: Strong competence in statistical data analysis, experimental design (DoE), fluid transport modeling, and programming platforms such as Python, R, or MATLAB. * Business Acumen: High\-level critical thinking and interpersonal leadership to foster trust among team members, collaborators, investors, vendors, and suppliers. * Communication Skills: Persuasive written and oral communication skills suitable for grant deliverables, regulatory filings, and investor presentations. **Preferred Qualifications** * IP Record: Co\-inventorship on filed or granted patents, first\-author peer\-reviewed publications, and experience authoring independent grant applications. * Nanotechnology Integration: Hands\-on familiarity with carbon nanomaterials (carbon nanotubes, graphene) or porous filtration media integrated into fluidic channels. * Advanced Genomics: Practical background with NGS library preparation, Illumina platforms, and bioinformatic pipelines (e.g., Kraken, taxonomic classification). * Quality Systems: Experience with cleanroom fabrication (lithography, thin\-film deposition), ISO cleanroom standards, and regulated diagnostic frameworks (FDA/USDA). * Operational Systems: Familiarity with ERP software, metric\-driven performance tracking, financial statements, and accounting/project tools such as QuickBooks. **General Operational Requirements** * Pre\-Employment Checks: Candidates may undergo background and investigative checks, including criminal, motor vehicle, employment, reference, and credit verifications. * Travel Requirements: Ability to travel locally, regionally, nationally, or internationally by car, train, or air for conferences, partner meetings, and industry events. * Schedule Flexibility: Willingness to work flexible or extended hours as needed to meet critical research milestones and grant objectives. **Working Conditions \& Physical Demands** Work is performed primarily in an integrated office, cleanroom, and controlled laboratory/manufacturing environment. Personnel entering laboratory zones must adhere to all company SOPs and wear required personal protective equipment (PPE). The company provides safety glasses, gloves, and lab coats; employees must wear closed\-toe shoes and long pants, and contact lenses may be restricted in designated areas. The role requires speaking, hearing, and prolonged periods of sitting or standing while operating computers and laboratory instrumentation. Duties require frequent manual dexterity and occasional reaching, bending, stooping, kneeling, crouching, and lifting, carrying, pushing, or pulling up to 50 pounds. Specific vision requirements include close, color, peripheral, and depth perception, with the ability to adjust focus. The position involves working around fabrication machinery, moving parts, electrical currents, varying noise levels, vibrations, fumes, gases, nanomaterials, solvents, and chemical compounds. **How to Apply** Interested candidates should submit a comprehensive Curriculum Vitae (CV), a cover letter outlining specific research and operational accomplishments in bioengineering and microfluidics, a complete list of publications and patents, and contact information for three professional references to careers@virolock.com. Applicants invited to interview will receive a comprehensive technical job description. **Equal Opportunity \& Accommodations** Virolock Technologies LLC is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are based solely on merit and professional qualifications without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, family or marital status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other legally protected status. Virolock Technologies LLC is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities during the application process and to perform essential job functions; to request an accommodation, please contact careers@virolock.com with your contact details and the nature of your request. Pay: $70,000\.00 \- $80,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Health insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Location:** Dallas, TX \| **Category:** Information Technology **Position Summary** The **Data Engineer** is a hands\-on technical leader responsible for the organization’s data warehouse and business intelligence ecosystem. As part of a small team, this role spans architecture, data engineering, dimensional and semantic modeling, integrations, platform support, data quality, and governance. The Data Engineer partners with business stakeholders to deliver secure, scalable data solutions; owns production reliability and technical standards; mentors engineers, analysts, and power users; and helps modernize legacy platforms using Azure and Microsoft Fabric. Key Responsibilities * Define, design, develop, document, and maintain dimensional data models and data warehouse architecture, including fact and dimension tables, star schemas, grain definitions, surrogate keys, slowly changing dimensions, conformed dimensions, and source\-to\-target mappings. * Design, build, deploy, and support resilient ETL/ELT pipelines and integrations across structured and unstructured sources, including incremental loads, historical\-data handling, validation, reconciliation, error handling, and load\-order dependencies. * Build and maintain SSAS Tabular and Power BI semantic models, including DAX measures, hierarchies, refresh orchestration, and row\-level security. * Own production reliability by monitoring data pipelines and model\-processing runs; implementing audit, logging, alerting, and data\-quality frameworks; investigating failures; documenting root causes; and implementing corrective actions. * Develop and optimize advanced T\-SQL solutions, including complex queries, stored procedures, views, functions, indexes, execution\-plan analysis, and performance tuning against large data sets. * Work across SQL Server, Dataverse, Excel, Azure SQL, SharePoint, APIs, unstructured data, data lakes, warehouses, and lakehouse platforms. * Lead migration of legacy SQL Server solutions to Azure SQL Managed Instance and Microsoft Fabric while maintaining business continuity and solution quality. * Partner directly with business subject\-matter experts to clarify requirements, balance competing objectives, and translate business needs into practical reporting, analytics, and data solutions. * Maintain security, privacy, governance, metadata, lineage, retention, role\-based access, architectural, usability, coding, testing, source\-control, CI/CD, release\-management, and documentation standards. * Provide technical and architectural guidance, lead design and code reviews, mentor engineers, analysts, and power users, and promote reusable practices and continuous improvement. * Evaluate platform capabilities and recommend improvements to performance, reliability, maintainability, security, user experience, data democratization, and cost efficiency. * Maintain technical documentation, operational runbooks, support procedures, ETL /ELT specifications, job dependencies, deployment notes, and data\-quality metrics; perform other duties as assigned. Required Qualifications * 5\+ years of hands\-on data warehouse, business intelligence engineering, database development, data engineering, or closely related experience, including ownership of technical delivery and production solutions. * 3\+ years of advanced SQL Server and T\-SQL development, including query optimization, indexing, execution\-plan analysis, and performance tuning. * Experience building and deploying end\-to\-end ETL/ELT pipelines with tools such as SSIS, Azure Data Factory, Microsoft Fabric, or Azure Synapse. * 3\+ years supporting production data environments, including monitoring, incident investigation, root\-cause documentation, and corrective action. * Experience with Git or Azure DevOps, code review, automated testing, CI/CD, repeatable deployment practices, and Agile or Scrum delivery. * Experience and demonstrated ability to leverage AI for data analysis and development of data solutions. * Demonstrated ability to gather requirements directly from business stakeholders and translate them into modeled, documented, and supportable solutions. * Strong understanding of data warehouse and integration architecture, data quality, governance, security, usability, and production\-support practices. * Ability to lead technical delivery, mentor others, communicate clearly with business and technical audiences, and work effectively amid ambiguity and competing priorities. * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Management Information Systems, Data Engineering, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * Must be able to read, write, and speak English. Preferred Qualifications * Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Data Ecosystem including Fabric, SSIS, Azure SQL Database, and Azure DevOps. * Experience migrating a legacy data warehouse and reporting environment to a modern cloud data platform. * Experience implementing API\-based integrations and working with SQL Server, Dataverse, Excel, SharePoint Lists and Libraries, and unstructured data. * Experience with manufacturing data, MES, SCADA, Historian or Dataverse and Operations data structures. * Working knowledge of Python, PySpark, C\#, SQL or PowerShell. * Microsoft certification such as Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate, Azure Data Engineer Associate, or Azure Database Administrator Associate. * Experience with enterprise data cataloging, identity and access management, secrets management, and monitoring tools. **Staffing Agency Inquiries:** At this time, we are managing our recruitment process internally and are not accepting unsolicited candidate referrals or recruiting services from staffing agencies or third\-party recruiters. We kindly ask that you refrain from contacting our hiring team regarding this position. We appreciate your understanding and cooperation.

jobs.title: Engineer - Data
jobs.description: **UDR, Inc. is now hiring a Data Engineer to join our team.** ***\*\*This is a hybrid position.\*\**** **GENERAL SUMMARY OF DUTIES:** Builds and operates the data pipelines and conformed data models that bring source data into UDR’s enterprise data platform. Primary accountability is ingestion through the conformed layer: source system connectivity, pipeline build and reliability, raw data landing, and the conformed models that downstream analytics depend on. Also contributes to curated modeling and semantic layer work under standards set by Analytics Engineering, providing overlap and coverage across a small team. Works within the platform architecture, engineering, and deployment standards established by the Senior Data Platform Engineer, and partners with the Senior Snowflake Administrator, business analysts, software engineers, and quality assurance to deliver reliable, well\-modeled data in support of UDR’s digital transformation applications. **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:** * Build, operate, and maintain data ingestion pipelines that move data from internal systems, vendor systems, and third\-party sources into the platform, including batch and incremental loads. * Develop and maintain source system connectivity and integrations, including file\-based loads and API\-based interfaces in both real\-time and batch contexts. * Land and preserve raw source data in the platform so that original records remain traceable and reprocessable. * Design, build, and maintain conformed data models, including schema design, cleansing, deduplication, and standardization logic that produce a reliable foundation for curated modeling. * Implement and maintain orchestration, scheduling, and dependency management so that pipelines run in the correct order and downstream consumers receive data on time. * Triage and resolve pipeline failures, monitor pipeline and data health, and implement alerting that identifies issues before downstream consumers are affected. * Manage source schema changes, assessing downstream impact and coordinating updates with affected consumers before they break. * Write advanced SQL for complex transformations and optimize query and pipeline performance, including cost\-aware design of transformation logic. * Implement automated data quality tests embedded in pipelines and models so that issues are surfaced before they reach curated layers. * Contribute to curated dimensional models and semantic layer development under standards set by Analytics Engineering, providing overlap and coverage across the team. * Contribute business context to entity definitions and conformance rules, working with Analytics Engineering, which owns those definitions. * Maintain documentation of data definitions, lineage, and transformation logic sufficient for another engineer or an auditor to trace a reported number back to its source. * Work within the platform architecture, coding, testing, and deployment standards established by the Senior Data Platform Engineer and help establish best practices for pipeline development and data modeling within those standards. * Provide code reviews on pipeline, transformation, and model code, applying established standards consistently and giving actionable feedback. * Support the Senior Snowflake Administrator on environment promotion, platform performance monitoring, and cost\-aware workload design. * Apply version control practices to all pipeline, transformation, and model code, including branching, pull request workflows, and peer review. * Partner with business analysts on requirements, source to target mapping, and acceptance criteria for data work. * Support quality assurance on reconciliation and pipeline validation testing and resolve defects identified during release validation. * and documentation work. * Perform other duties as assigned or as necessary. **EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data science, information systems, business with an information systems major, engineering, or related field; or equivalent combination of education and experience required. * Minimum of three years of experience in data engineering, analytics batch contexts preferred. * Demonstrated experience building data models and analytics\-ready datasets in a cloud data warehouse environment. Snowflake experience preferred. * Working knowledge of layered data architecture, including the purpose of and boundaries between raw, conformed, and curated layers, with hands\-on experience applying that pattern. * Experience designing and implementing enterprise data solutions. * Advanced SQL for complex transformation, performance tuning, and troubleshooting required. * Experience with a modern SQL\-based transformation framework, including model development, automated testing, and documentation. * Working knowledge of a scripting language such as Python for pipeline development, data quality tooling, and automation preferred. * Proficiency with version control and collaborative code review practices in a data or software context required. * Exposure to semantic modeling and enterprise reporting for business audiences preferred. * Experience supporting a migration from on\-premises databases to a cloud data platform preferred. **Benefits Offered:** * Medical, Dental, Vision Plans * Medical Flexible Spending Account * Dependent Care Spending Account * Lifestyle Spending Account * Supplemental Term Life Insurance * Critical Illness Plan * Supplemental Short\-Term Disability Insurance / AD\&D Insurance * Voluntary Long Term Care Insurance * 401(k) Plan with company match **Salary Range:** * $113,575\-$133,618/yr., depends on experience **Bonus Potential:** * 10% annual bonus potential * UDR is proud to provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. jobs.title: Expert Enterprise Knowledge Engineer (Knowledge Graph & GenAI)
jobs.description: **Overview** We are seeking a hands\-on technical lead to design and evolve this capability end\-to\-end. The ideal candidate combines expertise in knowledge graphs, ontologies, and semantic modeling with practical experience applying enterprise knowledge to Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), GraphRAG, hybrid search, and AI applications. This individual will define the architecture and roadmap, steward enterprise semantics, and collaborate with AI engineering, data, business, and governance teams. The role owns the knowledge foundation, not the development of individual AI agents or the underlying AI platform infrastructure. **Responsibilities** * Define the vision, scope, roadmap, and reference architecture for the Enterprise Knowledge Layer, aligned with enterprise AI, data, and business strategy. * Design and guide knowledge graph, ontology, semantic layer, and retrieval architectures that support RAG, GraphRAG, semantic search, and knowledge\-grounded GenAI applications. * Define hybrid retrieval patterns that combine keyword/BM25, vector, and graph\-based retrieval with secure API access to structured enterprise data. * Establish processes to ingest, link, validate, refresh, and maintain trusted enterprise knowledge from documents, data platforms, catalogs, and business systems. * Own enterprise ontology, taxonomy, entity and relationship modeling standards, controlled vocabularies, versioning, and change management; promote consistent definitions across member, provider, claims, and benefits domains. * Lead knowledge technology selection, standards, proof\-of\-concept evaluations, and build\-versus\-buy decisions in partnership with enterprise architecture and AI engineering. * Partner with AI application engineers to expose reusable knowledge and retrieval services through APIs; evaluate retrieval quality and improve grounding, relevance, and traceability of AI responses. * Work with Data Governance and business stewards to establish semantic ownership, data lineage, access controls, privacy protections, and ongoing knowledge curation. * Define and report knowledge\-layer metrics, including coverage, quality, retrieval relevance and accuracy, freshness, usage, adoption, and feedback from AI applications. * Mentor engineers and domain experts in knowledge engineering, ontologies, graph modeling, and retrieval practices, while supporting complex integration and operational issues as needed. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, data science, information management, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience; a related master's degree is preferred. * 8\+ years of experience in data architecture, knowledge engineering, information management, or related technical roles, including at least 3 years leading knowledge graph, ontology, or semantic initiatives. * Hands\-on experience designing and operating knowledge graphs, entity/relationship models, and semantic data integration using graph platforms such as Neo4j, Stardog, GraphDB, Amazon Neptune, or equivalent technologies. * Strong understanding of ontology and semantic modeling approaches, including RDF/OWL, SKOS, SPARQL, SHACL, and/or labelled property graphs; practical expertise matters more than familiarity with every standard. * Practical experience building or integrating enterprise knowledge and retrieval capabilities for GenAI/RAG applications, including semantic search, vector search, hybrid retrieval, and knowledge\-grounded answers. * Solid understanding of enterprise data architecture, metadata management, data catalogs, APIs, access controls, and data integration patterns. * Ability to translate business concepts into interoperable knowledge models and communicate architectural trade\-offs to technical and nontechnical stakeholders. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with GraphRAG, graph\-based retrieval, entity resolution, retrieval evaluation, embeddings, or vector databases/search indexes. * Experience enabling knowledge\-grounded AI assistants or agents through reusable retrieval services and secure APIs. * Familiarity with healthcare payer and insurance ontologies, including member, provider, claims, eligibility, and benefits information. * Experience working in regulated environments requiring strong privacy, security, auditability, human oversight, and governance. Pay: $100\.00 \- $150\.00 per hour Expected hours: 40\.0 per week Application Question(s): * What is your visa type? * Do you have 8\+ years of experience in data architecture, knowledge engineering, or information management? * Have you led a knowledge graph, ontology, or semantic initiative for at least 3 years? * Have you built or integrated a GenAI/RAG application that used enterprise knowledge sources? * Which graph platform(s) (Neo4j, Stardog, GraphDB, Neptune, or similar) have you operated in production? * Describe a knowledge model you designed. Did you use RDF/OWL or a labelled property graph, and why? Which standards (SKOS, SHACL, SPARQL) did you apply in practice? * Describe a retrieval solution you built for a GenAI application. What mix of semantic, vector, hybrid, or graph\-based retrieval did you use, and how did you measure its quality? * Describe your experience in a regulated setting (e.g., HIPAA, SOC 2\). How did privacy, auditability, and governance requirements shape your architecture? Include any healthcare payer or insurance data experience (members, providers, claims, eligibility, benefits). Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Industrial Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About General Flash** ======================= General Flash is re\-inventing the process to convert metal oxides to metal. We are a dedicated team of builders \- experts in materials, physics, chemistry, process and hardware engineering \- united in our goal to re\-shore metal production for critically important metals. We’re looking for exceptional candidates to join us! **The Role** ------------ General Flash is looking for an Industrial Software Engineer to own the software and firmware behind our metal production reactors. You will design how operators run the reactors, how sensor data is captured and stored, and how that data connects to the experiments our engineers and scientists design. The role sits between hardware and data: one day you are writing control logic for a device on the reactor network, the next you are building the pipeline that ties a run's sensor history to its offline lab results. We take an AI\-forward approach to engineering, and we expect you to use current tools, and build new ones, to move faster. We are flexible on level and years of experience. What matters most is evidence that you have owned real systems end to end and can work closely with a small, hands\-on technical team. **Primary Responsibilities** ---------------------------- * Own software stack for our metal production reactors, from device\-level code to the operator interface and data storage and retrieval systems. * Design the operating workflow and GUI that engineers and technicians use to safely set up, run, monitor, and shut down reactor runs. * Write and maintain software to query simple and complex instruments, including: power supplies, gas handling equipment, sensors, valves, and other devices over Ethernet and other communication buses. * Architect and build a data pipeline that captures reactor sensor data, stores it reliably, and makes it easy to query and analyze. * Develop and maintain pipelines to establish provenance of material and process data for all material produced: power/utility consumption, chemical characterization, imaging, physical properties, and other critical product and performance data. * Implement audit trails, and data pipelines compliant with regulated manufacturing requirements. * In conjunction with facilities team, define and maintain the reactor network layout, including segmentation between control devices, data systems and the wider company network. * Bring an AI\-forward approach to your work: Adopt current AI and developer tools, build internal tools where none exist, and set up workflows deployed across the team. * Work with engineers and scientists to generate software requirements that deliver against project milestones. * Set software practices for the team, including version control, code review, testing and documentation. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * B.S. in computer science, electrical engineering or equivalent. * Professional experience building and shipping software that others depend on. We will weigh scope and ownership over years. * Strong Python skills, including writing maintainable, tested code and structuring larger projects. * Fluency with Git and collaborative development (branching, pull requests, code review). * Experience communicating with hardware or instruments over Ethernet (for example TCP/IP sockets, Modbus TCP, SCPI, OPC UA or vendor SDKs). * Working knowledge of network fundamentals, including IP addressing, subnets, VLANs and segmenting control networks from general networks. * Strong understanding of machine\-control fundamentals, including sensors and actuators, feedback control systems, interlocks and other safety components. * Experience designing how data is stored and retrieved, with relational databases, time\-series stores or structured file formats. * Active use of AI tools in your own engineering work, and judgment about where they help, where they don't, and how they should be deployed to move fast with zero physical risk to equipment and your colleagues. * Excellent interpersonal skills: Ability to work directly with engineers and scientists to understand and gather requirements, explore tradeoffs, and agree on deliverables. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Full stack experience, with a focus on process and hardware vs. pure data science (need to touch grass). * Experience writing software for lab equipment, pilot plants, manufacturing lines or other physical systems, especially high\-temperature, high\-power, or gas\-handling processes. * Familiarity and experience with DOD jobs.title: ML Applications Engineer
jobs.description: Zeromatter builds simulation and synthetic sensor data for autonomy teams \- self\-driving cars, delivery drones, aircraft and robots. Synthetic data only matters to a customer if their model gets better on real\-world data. The ML Applications Engineer is the person who makes that happen and proves it. You'll close the sim\-to\-real gap from the customer's side \- run training experiments on their perception models with our data, find where sim and real don't match, and turn that into fixes in our content, sensors and platform. This isn't an FDE role, but you'll sit down with customers when that's what it takes to make progress. You'll be part of Customer Success and work closely with our ML, FDE, content and sensor teams. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Run ML experiments with customers end to end \- agree on the eval set and success criteria up front, train or fine\-tune their perception models with our synthetic data, and report the lift * Build and own our internal benchmark models \- open models trained on public real datasets plus our synthetic data \- so we have our own baseline that doesn't depend on a customer's stack or timeline * Run our content, sensor and platform releases against those benchmarks, so we know if a change closed or widened the sim\-to\-real gap before it reaches customers * Work inside the customer's infrastructure, on their models and data, with scoped access \- so they get results in days without loading their own ML team * Dig into where sim and real don't match \- false positives and negatives, gaps in content, lighting, sensors and labels \- and turn that into concrete asks for our content, rendering and sensor teams * Build the repeatable parts \- pipelines for customer real data, experiment tooling, eval harnesses \- so each experiment is faster than the last * Use agents heavily \- set up loops where agents generate data, train, evaluate and iterate \- and know when to trust the results * Bring what you learn back into our product \- which domain gaps matter most and what should land in the next release * Sit down with customers' ML teams when needed \- explain results, scope the next experiment, push back when a setup doesn't make sense Examples of current work: detecting active school buses and emergency vehicles for a self\-driving customer, and night\-time mid\-air collision avoidance for a drone delivery customer. **Qualifications** ------------------ * 3\+ years training and shipping ML models for perception (detection, segmentation, depth) for autonomy, robotics or something close * Strong Python and PyTorch \- comfortable adapting existing models to new classes and use cases, not only training from scratch * Real eval discipline \- you set up held\-out real test sets, pick the right metrics, and can tell a real improvement from noise * Hands\-on with synthetic data, simulation or domain adaptation \- you know why a model trained on sim can fail on real, and how to find out why * You enjoy getting close to the data \- when results don't add up, you dig in until you understand what's really going on, even when that takes patience * Get productive fast in someone else's environment \- unfamiliar codebases, cloud accounts, data setups * Clear communicator with other ML engineers \- you can explain a result, its limits, and what to try next * Own a problem end to end without needing a full spec **Nice to have** ---------------- * Background in AV, drone, aviation or robotics perception * Sensor knowledge \- camera, lidar, radar \- and how sensor effects like noise, HDR or lens effects show up in model performance * Experience with 3D or rendering tools (Blender, game engines) for generating training data * Built agent\-driven ML workflows, e.g. coding agents running training and eval loops * Data pipeline and MLOps experience \- moving large datasets between orgs securely, experiment tracking Compensation Range: $100K \- $300K

jobs.description: **Join Our Team at Duncan Solutions, LLC** Duncan Solutions, LLC, is a full\-service transportation management company that focuses on connecting people, technology, and data to make cities more livable and efficient. As a leading provider of parking and tolling management solutions, we support municipal and commercial clients with citation processing, debt collection, DMV registered owner identification, back\-office transaction processing, image review, customer service center and customer experience (CX) operations, integrated on\-street parking management, and more. **WORK LOCATION** This is a remote position with eligibility in the following states: **AZ, CA, CO, CT, DE, FL, GA, IL, IN, IA, KS, LA, MD, MA, MI, MO, MN, NJ, NY, NC, OH, PA, SC, TN, TX, VA, WA, WI, WV, D.C.** Candidates must reside in one of the following locations for consideration. **Please note:** Duncan Solutions, LLC, does not provide visa sponsorship now or in the future. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without current or future sponsorship requirements. **PAY TRANSPARANCY** This role will offer **$115,000 \- $125,000 annually,** depending on experience, skills, and location. Employees may also be eligible for performance\-based incentives and additional benefits as part of our total rewards package. **WORKING HOURS** Monday\-Friday 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM **POSITION SUMMARY** The Manager, FinOps \& Vendor Cost Optimization is a high\-level position, where you are responsible for establishing and operating Duncan Solutions’ FinOps and vendor cost optimization program. able to query billing data and build independent analyses. * Strong Excel/Google Sheets modeling skills and experience with a BI tool (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Looker, QuickSight). * Demonstrated track record of delivering quantifiable cost savings, with the ability to show how savings were measured. * Ability to communicate clearly with executives, finance partners, and engineers, and to translate between them. * Self\-starter comfortable defining a process rather than only following one, and comfortable with ambiguity. **EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE / SKILLS** * High School Diploma or GED from an accredited institution required. * Minimum of 5 years of experience in FinOps, cloud financial management, IT finance, technology procurement, or a related analytical finance role. * FinOps Certified Practitioner (FinOps Foundation), AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, or equivalent. * Experience with FinOps or spend\-management platforms (e.g., CloudHealth, Vantage, Apptio Cloudability, Zylo, Tropic). * Experience with ERP and procurement systems (e.g., NetSuite) and with contract and renewal management. **PREFERRED** * Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * Experience in a smaller or high\-growth company where the function was built from the ground up. **DECISION\-MAKING LATITUDE** * Decisions are made with the best interests of the company in mind, guided by ethical considerations and sound judgment. Considers multiple solutions and future impact of decisions. Works with minimal direction. **Physical Demands and Working Conditions** * This role is primarily computer\-based and may be performed in an office or remote work environment. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. **WHAT WE OFFER** Duncan Solutions, LLC, offers a professional environment, stability, upward mobility, and a wide breadth of benefits. We actively encourage applications from everybody. All qualified job applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, creed, national origin, aboriginality, genetic information, ancestry, marital status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, physical or mental disability, pregnancy, veteran status, age, political affiliation or any other non\-merit characteristic.* Please visit our website to learn more about us https://www.duncansolutions.com/ To view all of our current job opportunities, please visit https://businessprocessingsolutions.bamboohr.com/careers

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, Engineering
jobs.description: **About Parameter** ------------------- Security testing still mostly means scanners that miss the real bugs, or human pentesters who show up once a year. Parameter is building AI agents that do the work of a skilled attacker. They break into live applications, APIs and cloud environments, find the access control, auth and business logic flaws that matter, and prove each one before it's reported. We're a Y Combinator company in San Francisco. The team is small and the engineers own large parts of the product. Some of the problems in front of us right now are below. **Problems you might own** -------------------------- * Keeping an agent on task and correct through a multi\-hour engagement against a system it has never seen, and measuring whether a change made it better or worse * Cutting false positives to near zero by building validation that proves a vulnerability is real before it is reported * Running many long agent runs in parallel against customer infrastructure with strict isolation between customers, and making failures loud and cheap * Turning what a skilled attacker does by hand into reliable agent capability * Building the product customers use to review, verify and act on findings **What the work looks like** ---------------------------- The role is broad on purpose. You will usually have a primary area (product, infrastructure, AI and agents, or offensive security) and you will work outside it whenever the company needs it. Day to day that means TypeScript, React and Next.js, GCP, Terraform, Temporal, LangGraph, Docker, Linear and Graphite. You work directly with the founders, talk to customers when it helps, and ship to production within days. **You might be a fit if** ------------------------- * You have built something real that people used, and can say exactly which parts were yours * You have started something, whether a company, an open\-source project, a product, or a research effort, and kept going when it was hard * You have gone deep on something difficult without being asked: CTFs, bug bounty, CVEs, systems work, or competitive programming * You learn quickly and are strong across more than one layer of the stack * You decide things yourself, tell us what you decided and why, and see your work through after it ships * Experience as a founder or founding engineer is a strong signal. Years at a large company and a long title are not what we are looking for **How we work** --------------- * In person in San Francisco, with long hours that we expect to continue at this stage. Most of the team works well beyond a normal week. If you want a balanced 9 to 5, this is not the right job * A small team with high expectations and little process. You will have real scope, direct access to the founders, and fast decisions * We hire slowly. Every engineer we add is a large share of the team **Interview process** --------------------- Intro call with a founder (30 min), technical deep dive on something you built (60 min), a paid work trial of about one day, onsite with the team, then references and an offer. We aim to make an offer within two weeks of first contact. **Compensation** ---------------- $200K to $300K base salary depending on experience, plus 0\.2% to 0\.4% equity. **Logistics** ------------- Full time, onsite in San Francisco. You must be authorized to work in the US. We are not able to sponsor visas at this time. **Application question** ------------------------ Link to something you built or started and tell us which part was yours, and what broke. Please write this yourself. We read every answer. Compensation Range: $200K \- $300K

jobs.title: Principal Engineer
jobs.description: **Principal Engineer, Privacy Products** ======================================== At Cypherpunk Technologies (Cypherpunk), our mission is to advance technologies that guarantee privacy for humans on the internet. As a privacy technology company, Cypherpunk pursues this mission through three primary strategies: mining Zcash through Cypherpunk Mining; accumulating Zcash through open market purchases; and investing in, acquiring, and building technologies that push the frontier of privacy forward. We are a small, ambitious team focused on building the future of privacy. We believe meaningful progress comes from people who are passionate about the mission, willing to challenge assumptions, and ready to adapt as technology and the industry evolve. We value individuals who take ownership, move quickly, and turn ideas into results. Collaboration is central to how we operate, and every team member has a direct impact on our success. We encourage thoughtful debate, value different perspectives, and believe the best work happens when talented people genuinely enjoy working together. We're building something important, and we're looking for people who want to help shape what comes next. If you're excited by the opportunity to make a meaningful impact in a rapidly evolving industry, we'd love to hear from you. **About the role** ------------------ We’re hiring a principal engineer to lead the technical vision for consumer products where privacy is the whole point. You’ll own the big decisions, from what we build to the architecture behind it. You’ll set the engineering bar for the team and still ship much of the code yourself. We’re a lean team at the front of the space with no layers between you and the user, so your judgment directly shapes the product and the company. **What you'll do** ------------------ * **Own the technical vision and roadmap** for our consumer products. You’ll decide what we build, in what order and why, and take it from the first prototype to production. * **Shape the product end to end.** You’ll make the calls on the user experience so that strong privacy feels simple and never costs usability. * **Build and ship hands\-on** across the stack, setting the pace for the team without cutting corners on security. * **Make the privacy decisions.** You’ll lead threat modeling and own the tradeoffs on what we collect, store and expose, and you’ll defend them. * **Set the engineering bar** for code review, testing, security practices and releases. jobs.title: Senior Database Engineer (SQL Server + Data Engineering)
jobs.description: **About NexaMotion Group and Transend** ======================================= NexaMotion Group (NMG) is a national B2B distributor in the automotive aftermarket. Our brands include Transtar and a growing set of acquired businesses. Transend is NMG’s B2B ordering platform. Repair shops, rebuilders and resellers use it to find parts, check price and stock, and place orders. Every Transend order flows through our databases to the ERP (JD Edwards or Epicor Vision) and on to the warehouse. We are modernizing the platform. That means moving from one shared SQL Server to domain\-owned databases on AWS, and building a modern data platform for BI and AI. This role sits at the center of both. **Role summary** ================ You will own the business logic that lives in our databases today, and help move it and its data into the platform of tomorrow. On day one, you are our T\-SQL expert. You write, tune and safely change the stored procedures behind pricing, cart, orders and ERP integration. You work closely with our developers, our BI engineer and business teams across sales, finance, supply chain and customer support. As we split the shared database into domains, you help design each domain’s data model on Aurora PostgreSQL and move data across safely. As stored proc work shrinks, more of your time goes to the bigger prize: turning our data from a reporting tool into a platform that drives decisions and AI **Where we are taking data and AI** Today our data mostly feeds reports. We want it to answer questions, predict what happens next, and power AI agents. Six moves get us there: * **One trusted semantic layer.** Certified models for our core business: customers, accounts, parts, orders, invoices, pricing, inventory and returns. One definition of revenue, margin, return rate and active account, used by everyone. * **An ontology of the business.** Entities and their links defined once, across both ERPs and Transend. Example: a customer has locations, places orders, buys parts; a part has a brand, fits vehicles, belongs to kits and rebuilds. * **AI\-ready data.** Our AI agents (customer support, sales, supply chain) and AI search get governed, secure access to that semantic layer, so a person and an agent asking the same question get the same answer. * **A modern lakehouse.** Raw, cleaned and business\-ready layers (bronze, silver, gold), built with dbt, tested, documented and traced end to end. Domains publish data as events or clean feeds, so analytics never reads production tables directly. * **Fresher data.** Near real\-time feeds for the things that cannot wait a day: stock, order status, delivery times, failed orders. * **Advanced analytics and data science.** Moving past what happened to what will happen: demand forecasts, pricing, at\-risk customers, recommendations. **What you will do** ==================== ### **Own the stored procedure layer** * Write, review and tune T\-SQL stored procs, functions, views and jobs on SQL Server. * Own the procs behind pricing, discounts, cart, order creation and ERP order sync. Example: the proc that turns a web order into a JD Edwards sales order. * Bring code discipline to database changes: source control, peer review, test scripts, rollback plans and deploys through GitHub Actions. No hotfixes straight to production. * Find and fix slow queries using execution plans, indexes and Query Store. * Answer data questions from Sales, Finance, Supply Chain and Customer Support with accurate SQL. * Document what each critical proc does, in plain language, so the business logic is no longer locked in one person’s head. ### **Help split the database into domains** * Map which tables and procs belong to which business domain: identity, pricing, shipping and tracking, returns, payments. * With our architects, design each domain’s own data model, mostly on Aurora PostgreSQL. * Move logic out of stored procs and into services, working side by side with our .NET and Python engineers. * Plan and run data migrations with reconciliation checks, so old and new systems agree before cutover. * Help build a seeded test database in a container, so engineers and AI coding agents can test without touching production. ### **Transform BI and data engineering** * **Build the transformation layer.** Stand up dbt on top of the data our Qlik Replicate pipelines already land from JD Edwards and other sources. Bronze, silver and gold layers, with tests, docs and CI. * **Build certified semantic models.** Power BI and Fabric models for orders, customers, parts, pricing, inventory and returns. Retire one\-off reports that each compute the same number a different way. * **Help design the ontology layer.** Map business entities and relationships across JDE, Epicor Vision and Transend, building on our part identity work (brand plus part number). Example: answer "which shops bought this rebuild kit, and which of its parts are out of stock?" without a custom query. * **Make data AI\-ready.** Give AI agents e and a data catalog so we know who sees what and where each number comes from. * **Build fresher feeds.** Use change data capture and domain events for near real\-time use cases: stock levels, order status, delivery ETAs, failed order alerts. * **Deliver advanced use cases** with business teams. Examples: branch\-level demand forecasting for purchasing; pricing and discount analysis; customers at risk of ordering less; recommended parts and kits; delivery promise accuracy; return and warranty patterns; insights from support tickets and sales call transcripts. * **Shape platform choices.** Help decide when Microsoft Fabric is enough and when a tool like Databricks earns its place, based on real use cases, cost and team skills. * **Own data quality.** Freshness monitors, reconciliation to source systems, and clear data contracts with the domain teams that produce the data. **Must\-have skills and experience** ==================================== * **7\+ years as a database engineer or database developer**, with SQL Server as your main platform. * **Expert T\-SQL.** You write complex stored procs, CTEs, window functions, MERGE and dynamic SQL, and you know when not to. You handle transactions, isolation levels, locking and deadlocks with confidence. * **Performance tuning.** You read execution plans, design indexes, fix parameter sniffing and use Query Store or similar tools. * **Hands\-on with at least one open source or cloud database in production**: PostgreSQL, Amazon Aurora or RDS. You can write PL/pgSQL and know how it differs from T\-SQL. * **Safe change practice.** You keep database code in Git, use review and automated deploys, and always have a rollback plan. * **Data modeling.** Normalized models for apps, plus star schemas and semantic models (measures, hierarchies, shared definitions) for analytics. * **Data engineering.** You have built production pipelines and transformations with dbt, Python or similar, and you understand lakehouse design (bronze, silver, gold). * **A point of view on data and AI.** You can explain how a company moves from reports to a semantic layer that people and AI agents both trust. * **Data migration.** You have moved data between systems with checks that prove nothing was lost. * **Business sense.** You can explain to a non\-technical person what a proc does to an order or a price. * **Clear writing.** You document what you build so others can run it. **Nice\-to\-have skills** ========================= * **Semantic layer and ontology:** Power BI or Fabric semantic models and DAX; knowledge graphs or ontology tools. * **AI on data:** grounding AI agents on business data, text\-to\-SQL or data agents, vector search and RAG. * **Data science and ML:** Spark, Databricks or Fabric notebooks, MLflow, feature stores, forecasting models. * **Lakehouse platforms:** Microsoft Fabric and OneLake, Databricks or Snowflake. Delta or Iceberg tables. * **Streaming and events:** Kafka, AWS EventBridge or Fabric Eventstream. * **Governance:** Microsoft Purview or similar catalogs, row\-level security, lineage. * **Orchestration and CDC:** Dagster or Airflow; Qlik Replicate, Fivetran, Debezium or AWS DMS. * **Breaking up a monolith database:** strangler fig, anti\-corruption layers, event\-driven sync (for example AWS EventBridge). * **ERP data:** JD Edwards (World or E1\) on IBM i / Db2, or Epicor. Distribution or e\-commerce order flows. and using automated tools (AI) while adhering to company policy. * Available for On\-Call rotations based on the team’s escalation policy and support schedule. * Design and integrate AI/ML\-supported evaluation/observability for LLM workloads (telemetry, traces, guardrails) * Building agentic workflows (multi\-step, tool\-using agents) and supporting multi\-agent orchestration patterns (MCP, agent\-to\-agent) * Collaborate with data science and ML platform teams to operationalize models and embed ML\-driven features. **Basic Qualifications:** * BS or MS in Computer Science / Engineering or relevant work experience. * 5\+ years of software engineering experience. * Proficiency with Java. * Demonstrable analytical / problem\-solving skills. * Great communication, collaboration skills, and a strong teamwork ethic with both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Familiarity with core AI/ML concepts (e.g., embeddings, vector similarity, prompt patterns, model evaluation) or willingness to rapidly learn. * Familiarity with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph) * Awareness of guardrails, safety, eval, and cost\-aware usage **Preferred Qualifications:** Experience with: * SpringBoot and related Spring projects. * Non\-relational database technologies like DynamoDB. * Caching datastores such as Redis, ValKey or MemCache. * Data Streaming Mechanisms such as Apache Kafka and/or Kinesis. * Cloud platforms such as AWS. * Modern DevOps tools such as Terraform, Docker, and Kubernetes. * Domain knowledge in the Ad Tech industry. * Experience integrating with external LLM APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS Bedrock) * Experience with multi\-agent orchestration (LangGraph, MCP, A2A) * Experience instrumenting LLM calls with traces and evaluations (e.g., LangSmith) * Experience with prompt / tool pattern design, function calling, streaming, and context management **Additional Information:** * Engineers are expected to be in the office four days a week. * This role is hiring in San Francisco, Santa Monica or Seattle \#TechatDisney **Disclaimer** PAY TRANSPARENCY The hiring range for this position in Santa Monica, California is $144,100\.00 to 193,200\.00 per year, in Seattle, WA is $150,900\.00 to $202,400\.00 per year, and in San Francisco, CA is $157,800\.00 to $211,600\.00 per year. jobs.description: **Software Engineer, Privacy and Zcash Protocols** ================================================== At Cypherpunk Technologies (Cypherpunk), our mission is to advance technologies that guarantee privacy for humans on the internet. As a privacy technology company, Cypherpunk pursues this mission through three primary strategies: mining Zcash through Cypherpunk Mining; accumulating Zcash through open market purchases; and investing in, acquiring, and building technologies that push the frontier of privacy forward. We are a small, ambitious team focused on building the future of privacy. We believe meaningful progress comes from people who are passionate about the mission, willing to challenge assumptions, and ready to adapt as technology and the industry evolve. We value individuals who take ownership, move quickly, and turn ideas into results. Collaboration is central to how we operate, and every team member has a direct impact on our success. We encourage thoughtful debate, value different perspectives, and believe the best work happens when talented people genuinely enjoy working together. We're building something important, and we're looking for people who want to help shape what comes next. If you're excited by the opportunity to make a meaningful impact in a rapidly evolving industry, we'd love to hear from you. **About the role** We’re looking for an engineer who wants to build real privacy technology on Zcash and related protocols. We’re a lean team leading the space, so you’ll own meaningful parts of the stack from day one. You’ll ship production code that people rely on and contribute open source used across the ecosystem. You’ll go deep on the cryptography alongside experienced engineers, learning it by building with it. If you have a track record of shipping and want your work to have direct impact, this is the role. **What you’ll do** * **Own and ship core protocol software**, including wallet infrastructure, SDKs and shielded transaction tooling, from first commit to production. * **Take protocol features from spec to working code.** You’ll implement and test against specs and ZIPs. * **Build in the open.** Your work will land in open\-source libraries and tooling that the wider Zcash ecosystem uses. * **Write clear, well\-tested Rust**, plus glue code in other languages where needed. * **Take on hard problems across the stack**, including sync performance, proof generation, serialization and cross\-platform builds. * **Raise the bar for the team** through code review, documentation and sharing what you learn. * **Bring protocol capabilities into consumer products**, working directly with the principal engineer to put privacy tech in people’s hands. **What we’re looking for** * 2–4 years of professional experience, or the equivalent through open\-source work, research or your own projects * Strong programming fundamentals and solid Rust, or proof that you pick up new languages fast * Real curiosity about cryptography and privacy, especially zero\-knowledge proofs and blockchain protocols * Comfort reading specs, papers and dense codebases, then turning them into working code * Good habits around testing, documentation and clear communication * **A builder’s mindset:** you take ownership, work through ambiguity and ship **Nice to have** * Familiarity with Zcash (Orchard, Sapling, Halo 2, librustzcash, light wallet architecture) * Open\-source contributions to cryptography, blockchain or privacy projects * Experience with cross\-platform builds or FFI (for example, Rust bindings for mobile) * Coursework or self\-study in cryptography, number theory or ZK systems * Participation in hackathons, CTFs or community research Compensation Range: $120K \- $180K

jobs.title: Software Product Development Engineer
jobs.description: Illuminect is developing IllumiQ, a compact microdose calibrator building on technology developed at the National Cancer Institute. The product will measure radioactivity in radiopharmaceutical research, supporting applications such as dose preparation and biodistribution studies. We seek a software engineer or experienced consultant to develop IllumiQ’s acquisition, analysis and operator software. You will work with the PI, hardware developer and scientific collaborators to turn detector data into reliable, traceable activity measurements and a practical laboratory workflow. Responsibilities * Define software requirements, architecture and acceptance tests with the PI; establish interfaces and data formats with the hardware developer. * Integrate digitizer or device SDKs and acquire multichannel events with channel identifiers, timestamps and energy information. Handle streaming, buffering, data integrity and acquisition errors. * Implement and verify event grouping, coincidence processing, spectra and counting algorithms with the scientific team. Support multiple detector configurations and measurement modes. * Implement radionuclide calibration, background subtraction, decay correction, activity calculations and validated count\-loss corrections. Include uncertainty reporting, appropriate units, reference times and valid measurement\-range checks. * Build the operator interface for setup, sample identification, acquisition, calibration, quality control, spectrum review and reporting; consider tablet\-compatible operation where useful. * Store raw data, results, calibration versions and acquisition settings so measurements can be reviewed and reproduced. Provide practical data exports and laboratory reports. * Develop automated tests, hardware simulators or recorded\-data replay and performance benchmarks. Verify numerical results and support integrated prototype testing against reference measurements. * Prepare versioned releases, installation and update procedures, recovery behavior and user documentation. Maintain source control and a documented handoff for continued product development. Qualifications * Degree in computer science, engineering, physics or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. * Demonstrated development of scientific, laboratory, embedded or hardware\-connected software, including device communication and dependable data handling. * Strong skills in an appropriate stack, such as Python with C\+\+ where performance requires it, or C\#/.NET; ability to justify technology choices against instrument requirements. * Experience with automated testing, version control, numerical validation and communicating technical decisions to scientists and hardware engineers. Preferred experience Experience with radiation instrumentation, event\-based acquisition, multithreading, signal processing, statistical uncertainty, scientific visualization, laboratory databases or touch interfaces. Familiarity with instrument deployment and operation without a continuous internet connection is useful. Expected deliverables Expected deliverables include an acquisition and analysis application, an operator interface, reproducible measurement records, documented validation results and a maintainable source\-code and release package. Anticipated start: Summer 2027, subject to the SBIR award schedule. Work arrangement: Part\-time employment, consulting or contract work considered. Hours, scope, milestones and engagement terms will be agreed based on mutual fit. Funding contingency This is a prospective position contingent on Illuminect receiving an SBIR grant and having funding available for the role. Engagement and the start date will be confirmed after funding is secured and mutually acceptable terms are agreed. Pay: $111,000\.00 \- $145,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Flexible schedule * Health insurance * Paid time off Work Location: Hybrid remote in New Jersey
