jobs.title: Technical Support Specialist I
jobs.description: ABOUT VISTIFY Vistify is the menu management and digital signage platform behind some of the fastest\-growing multi\-unit restaurant brands in the country. Our software lets operators publish menus, pricing, and promotions to thousands of screens across hundreds of locations in minutes instead of weeks, with real\-time device health monitoring and native integrations to the major POS systems. We support 50\+ restaurant brands, and every one of them depends on the hardware we ship and the support we provide to keep their screens live and accurate. **POSITION SUMMARY** The Technical Support Specialist I is the person who keeps our customers running and our hardware moving. Reporting to Alex Perez, you will split your time between troubleshooting media players, displays, and network connectivity issues for restaurant locations, and preparing, shipping, receiving, and tracking the hardware those locations depend on. You will be the first voice a restaurant manager hears when a screen goes dark, and the last set of hands on a kit before it leaves our building. This is a hands\-on, high\-variety role built for someone early in their career who is technically curious, unfazed by a ringing phone and a loading dock in the same hour, and genuinely satisfied by closing the loop on a problem. It is an excellent entry point into a growing restaurant technology company, with a clear path toward deeper technical support, field operations, or implementation work. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES *Approximate time allocation. The mix shifts week to week depending on rollout volume and support demand.* Technical Support (\~45%) * Serve as first\-line support for inbound tickets, calls, and emails from restaurant locations and corporate teams, covering digital menu boards, media players, displays, and network connectivity. * Triage and resolve common issues: devices offline, screens showing stale or incorrect content, display and resolution problems, power and cabling faults, and basic network troubleshooting (Wi\-Fi, Ethernet, IP configuration, firewall and port questions). * Use the Vistify platform's monitoring dashboards to proactively identify offline or non\-compliant devices and open tickets before the customer notices. * Document every issue thoroughly in the ticketing system — symptoms, steps taken, resolution — so that patterns become visible and repeat problems get fixed at the root. * Escalate complex or systemic issues to senior support engineers and product teams with clear, complete write\-ups; follow escalated tickets through to closure rather than handing them off. * Stage, image, configure, and test media players and hardware kits prior to deployment; verify each unit connects and displays correctly before it ships. * Help build and maintain internal knowledge base articles, troubleshooting guides, and customer\-facing quick\-reference documents. * Provide basic internal IT support for the Vistify team — workstation setup, account provisioning requests, peripherals, and conference room A/V. Shipping, Receiving \& Inventory (\~35%) * Pick, pack, label, and ship hardware kits, replacement units, and RMA returns using standard carriers and freight as needed. * Receive inbound shipments: verify contents against purchase orders and packing slips, inspect for damage, and log receipts accurately. * Maintain accurate inventory records — serial number tracking, asset tagging, cycle counts — and flag discrepancies and low stock promptly. * Process returns and warranty replacements: test returned units, determine repairable versus scrap, coordinate vendor RMAs, and track credits. * Prepare and coordinate multi\-site deployment shipments so hardware arrives at each restaurant location on schedule and correctly labeled for the installer. * Keep the stockroom, staging area, and shipping bench organized, safe, and audit\-ready. Customer Support \& Service (\~20%) * Communicate with restaurant managers, franchisees, and corporate contacts in clear, non\-technical language, setting accurate expectations on timing and next steps. * Follow up on open items and shipment status proactively so customers never have to ask twice. * Assist with new customer onboarding tasks: account and location setup, shipment coordination, and go\-live day support. * Support scheduled installations and rollouts by phone or video, walking onsite installers or restaurant staff through mounting, connecting, and verifying devices. * Capture recurring customer friction points and feed them back to the support, product, and operations teams. * Contribute to team goals for response time, resolution time, and customer satisfaction. QUALIFICATIONS Required * High school diploma or equivalent. * 0–2 years of experience in technical support, help desk, IT, warehouse or shipping operations, customer service, or a comparable hands\-on role. Relevant internships, coursework, certifications, or personal technical projects count. * Comfort with consumer and business technolo ime. * Organized and reliable, able to juggle a support queue and a shipping deadline in the same afternoon without losing track of either. * Proficiency with everyday business tools (email, spreadsheets, chat) and the ability to learn new internal systems quickly. * Ability to work 100% onsite at our \[City, CA] facility. * Must be at least 18 years of age and legally authorized to work in the United States. Preferred * Coursework, certification, or hands\-on experience in IT support (CompTIA A\+, ITF\+, Network\+, Google IT Support Certificate, or similar). * Exposure to ticketing or CRM systems (Zendesk, Freshdesk, Jira Service Management, HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar). * Experience with digital signage, A/V, POS systems, or restaurant technology. * Shipping software or ERP/inventory system experience (ShipStation, UPS WorldShip, FedEx Ship Manager, NetSuite, or similar). * Restaurant, retail, or hospitality work experience — you will understand the customer's day. * Valid driver's license for occasional local errands and courier runs. PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS \& WORK ENVIRONMENT This role combines desk\-based support work with regular physical activity in a stockroom and shipping area. With or without reasonable accommodation, the position requires the ability to: * Lift, carry, and maneuver packages and equipment up to 50 lbs, occasionally with assistance for larger displays. * Stand, walk, bend, kneel, and reach for extended periods while staging, packing, and receiving hardware. * Use hand tools and work with cabling, mounts, and small components requiring manual dexterity. * Sit at a workstation and use a computer and phone for sustained periods. * Work in a mixed office and warehouse environment with typical equipment noise and seasonal temperature variation. COMPENSATION \& BENEFITS Hourly range: $23\.00 – $27\.00 per hour ($47,840 – $56,160 annualized at 40 hours per week). Placement within the range depends on relevant experience, certifications, and demonstrated technical aptitude. This position is non\-exempt and eligible for overtime in accordance with California law. Benefits include \[medical, dental, and vision coverage; 401(k) with company match; paid time off and paid holidays; paid sick leave; and reimbursement for approved technical certifications]. Vistify supports certification and training for team members who want to grow their technical depth. GROWTH PATH This role is designed as a starting point. Strong performers typically progress toward Technical Support Specialist II and senior support engineering, or move laterally into field operations, deployment and implementation, or inventory and logistics management as the company scales. You will be exposed to the full lifecycle of a customer deployment, which is rare in an entry\-level position and unusually good preparation for whichever direction you choose. HOW TO APPLY Submit a résumé and a short note about why this mix of technical and hands\-on work appeals to you to aperez@vistifyinc.com. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY Vistify, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, medical condition, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the application process and in employment; to request an accommodation, contact \[careers@vistifyinc.com]. *This job description describes the general nature and level of work expected and is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications. Duties may be modified as business needs require. Employment with Vistify, Inc. is at will.* Pay: $23\.00 \- $27\.00 per hour Expected hours: 40\.0 per week Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Sr. Data Engineer- Process Intelligence
jobs.description: Date: Nov 23, 2026 Location(s): Nashville, TN, US, 37228 Business Unit: CORPORATE Workplace Setting: Hybrid **Company / Location Information** ---------------------------------- A.O. Smith is a global leader applying innovative technologies and energy\-efficient solutions to products manufactured and marketed worldwide. The company is one of the world’s leading manufacturers of residential and commercial water heating equipment and boilers, as well as a manufacturer of water treatment products for residential and light commercial applications. A. O. Smith is headquartered in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, with approximately 12,000 employees at operations in the United States, Canada, China, India, Mexico, the Netherlands, and the United Kingdom. **Primary Function** -------------------- The Sr. Data Engineer is the technical and data foundation of A. O. Smith’s Process Intelligence Center of Excellence (CoE). Using the Celonis platform, the incumbent will turn raw data from core enterprise systems into accurate, high\-performing process data models that allow the business to see, measure, and improve how work actually flows. This position is responsible for translating business requirements and use cases into technical and data requirements; identifying, extracting, transforming, and loading (ETL) the source system data required for each process; and designing, building, validating, documenting, and supporting the data architecture and Celonis data model for every process implemented, including object\-centric models for complex cross\-process scenarios and governed, reusable data products that are ready for analytics and AI use cases. The incumbent will serve as the data steward for all Process Intelligence CoE and Transformation Office activities, owning the technical implementation of data governance, lineage, data quality, and business\-approved KPI definitions, while the appropriate business data owners retain accountability for business definitions and KPI approval. The incumbent will act as a key liaison between the business and IT, primarily for the Process Intelligence CoE and secondarily for Transformation Office project work, partnering with business stakeholders to define Process Intelligence requirements and coordinating with IT teams to deliver solutions aligned with enterprise architecture, security, integration, and data standards, so that data is trusted, timely, secure, and ready to drive value realization. The position reports to the leader of Data \& Analytics and works in close partnership with the Transformation Office, Enterprise Excellence, and business process owners. * *For purposes of this document, the terms “Process Intelligence” and “process mining” are used interchangeably and refer to work performed on the Celonis platform. “CoE” refers to the Process Intelligence Center of Excellence.* **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Lead data stewardship and governance for Process Intelligence and Transformation initiatives, ensuring data is accurate, consistent, secure, and appropriately used. * Establish data lineage, quality controls, metadata, access controls, and the technical implementation of approved KPI definitions. * Serve as a key liaison among business stakeholders, the Process Intelligence CoE, Transformation Office, and IT to translate business requirements into scalable data solutions. * Identify and integrate required data from SAP, CRM, cloud platforms, and other enterprise source systems. * Design, build, automate, and optimize scalable ETL/data pipelines using technologies such as SQL and Python. * Design and maintain Celonis data models, including traditional and object\-centric process models supporting complex business processes. * Develop reusable data architecture, semantic models, and data layers that support consistent KPIs, dashboards, process analytics, and value realization reporting. * Establish and monitor data quality and freshness standards, reconcile data to source systems, and lead resolution of data\-related issues. * Ensure solutions comply with enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, privacy, access management, data retention, and governance requirements. * Establish engineering standards for documentation, testing, code review, version control, environment promotion, release management, and ongoing support. * Provide technical leadership and mentorship in Celonis, SQL, ETL, data modeling, process mining, and data governance. * Help define the Process Intelligence data modernization roadmap and evaluate emerging capabilities, including AI\-enabled process intelligence and governed AI/agent solutions. **Qualifications** ------------------ * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Analytics, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience * 2\+ years of hands\-on Celonis experience as a data engineer or technical lead, including end\-to\-end delivery of at least two production process implementations (data extraction and pipeline setup, data model build, PQL\-based KPIs, and validation) * 6\+ years’ experience in data engineering, BI/data warehousing, analytics engineering, or a related data role, including ownership of technical design for data solutions * Advanced proficiency in SQL; working proficiency in Python or a comparable scripting language used for data processing * Hands\-on experience building and supporting production ETL/ELT pipelines (including incremental loads), designing relational data models, and applying testing, data freshness monitoring, and release practices * Experience working with data from at least one major ERP system (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, Infor) and understanding of core business processes such as order\-to\-cash, procure\-to\-pay, Record\-to\-report or Plan\-to\-manufacture * Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into technical and data requirements and to communicate clearly with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders * Working knowledge of data governance principles, including data quality, metadata/lineage, and access control, and experience implementing business\-owned definitions and KPIs * Experience serving as a liaison between business stakeholders and IT organizations to deliver data or analytics solutions aligned with enterprise architecture, security, integration, and data standards * Experience with at least one cloud data platform (e.g., AWS, Azure, Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric) **We Offer** ------------ Competitive compensation package and comprehensive benefits plans which include medical and dental insurance, company\-sponsored life insurance, retirement security savings plan, short\- and long\-term disability programs and tuition assistance. \#LI\-AO \#LI\-Hybrid \#Appcast **ADA Statement \& EEO Statement** ---------------------------------- In developing this job description care was taken to include all competencies needed to successfully perform in this position. However, for Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) purposes, the essential functions of the job may or may not have been described for purposes of ADA reasonable accommodation. All reasonable accommodation requests will be reviewed and evaluated on a case\-by\-case basis. We consider all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity and expression, marital or military status. We also provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act and applicable state and local law. **Nearest Major Market:** Nashville **Job Segment:** Data Modeler, Process Engineer, Information Technology, IT Architecture, Data Warehouse, Data, Engineering, Technology

jobs.title: Senior Java Developer — Enterprise API Integrations
jobs.description: **About ABC Legal Services:** ABC Legal Services is proud to be the national leader in service of process. We are a team of 1000 and growing with offices in Los Angeles, Oklahoma City, Phoenix, Brooklyn, Chicago, Washington DC, and more. Seattle is our home and headquarters. We've been successful in this unique business for over 30 years and we continue to advance our technology and business processes to remain years ahead of what our competition is able to offer. Our focus is to expand our technology lead, acquire and integrate less efficient competitors, and tap into new segments through an integrated inbound marketing and sales approach. **Job Overview:** ABC Legal is seeking a Senior Java Developer to help expand the Enterprise team's capacity for high\-impact customer and partner integrations. This role is centered on designing, building, and supporting reliable APIs and integration services that connect our platform with customers, partners, vendors, and internal products. You will work on our public\-facing APIs and the backend services that support them. This is an opportunity for a senior engineer who enjoys translating complex business workflows into dependable, well\-designed integrations. The work spans Java services, REST contracts, database persistence, security, event processing, and business rules. **What you'll do** * Design, build, and maintain RESTful APIs used by customers, partners, and internal systems. * Extend and support our APIs with the functionality needed for future customer, vendor, and partner integration projects. * Develop secure machine\-to\-machine integrations, including authentication, authorization, API versioning, OpenAPI documentation, and role\-based access controls. * Build resilient integrations that handle inbound requests, outbound status updates, webhooks, document exchange, and asynchronous processing. * Design reliable event\-driven workflows using durable processing, retries, idempotency, rate limiting, audit history, and failure recovery. * Work with relational databases, including SQL, data modeling, query troubleshooting, indexes, transactions, schema migrations, and persistence frameworks such as MyBatis. * Implement and maintain business behavior in Java and Drools rules, keeping rules and service\-layer behavior understandable, testable, and safe. * Collaborate with product, operations, customer\-facing teams, and external technical contacts to turn integration requirements into maintainable technical solutions. * Investigate production issues across application code, integrations, rules, and data; identify root causes and deliver durable fixes. * Contribute to technical design, code reviews, automated testing, and API/integration documentation. * Use AI\-assisted development tools, such as Codex and Claude, thoughtfully to improve development speed, investigation, documentation, and code quality. **What we're looking for\-The ideal candidate combines strong Java fundamentals with practical integration experience: someone who can build a clear API contract, trace a workflow through database and rules layers, and deliver solutions that customers and partner systems can rely on.** * Bachelor's Degree in a Technical Field (e.g., Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related discipline) * 7\+ years of professional software\-development experience, with strong production Java experience. * Strong experience designing and implementing REST APIs and system integrations. * Experience with Spring or Spring Boot, dependency injection, security, and service\-oriented application architecture. * Strong understanding of API security concepts, including OAuth 2\.0, token\-based authentication, authorization, secrets management, and secure handling of external payloads. * Experience integrating with third\-party APIs and managing real\-world concerns such as incomplete documentation, retries, rate limits, duplicate events, partial failures, and evolving contracts. * Solid relational database experience, including SQL, data modeling, query troubleshooting, indexes, transactions, and schema migrations. * Experience with asynchronous or event\-driven processing patterns, including Apache ActiveMQ, message queues, background workers, webhooks, scheduled processing, or durable outbox patterns. * Experience with Drools or another business\-rules engine, or a demonstrated ability to learn and work effectively with rules\-based systems. * Strong automated\-testing discipline, including unit and integration tests for APIs, business logic, and data access. * Experience with or willingness to adopt AI development tools such as Codex and Claude as part of an effective engineering workflow. * Ability to independently analyze ambiguous requirements, make sound technical decisions, and communicate tradeoffs clearly. * Comfort working in a large, established codebase that combines modern and legacy technologies. **We know that a company's success starts with its employees. We also know that an individual's success starts with the right career opportunity. Join our team today!** * Health, Dental, Vision insurance * 401(k) with company matching * Paid time off * 7 Paid company holidays * 4 Floating holidays per\-year * Life Insurance and AD\&D Insurance * Long Term Disability * Health Care Reimbursement Flexible Spending Account * Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account * EAP (Employee Assistance Program) * Pet Insurance **Schedule:** Full\-Time Monday through Friday. Flexible schedule **Salary Range:** $140,000\-$150,000 depending on experience **Application closing date: December 15, 2026, 11:59PM**

jobs.title: Analytics Engineer III, Transportation
jobs.description: If you are looking for a career at a dynamic company with a people\-first mindset and a deep culture of growth and autonomy, ACV is the right place for you! Competitive compensation packages and learning and development opportunities, ACV has what you need to advance to the next level in your career. We will continue to raise the bar every day by investing in our people and technology to help our customers succeed. We hire people who share our passion, bring innovative ideas to the table, and enjoy a collaborative atmosphere. **Who we are:** ACV is a technology company that has revolutionized how dealers buy and sell cars online. We are transforming the automotive industry. ACV Auctions Inc. (ACV), has applied innovation and user\-designed, data driven applications and solutions. We are building the most trusted and efficient digital marketplace with data solutions for sourcing, selling and managing used vehicles with transparency and comprehensive insights that were once unimaginable. We are disruptors of the industry and we want you to join us on our journey. At ACV we focus on the Health, Physical, Financial, Social and Emotional Wellness of our Teammates and, to support this, we offer: * Multiple medical plans including a high deductible, low cost health plan * Company\-sponsored (paid) Short\-Term Disability, Long\-Term Disability, and Life Insurance * Comprehensive optional benefits such as Dental, Vision, Supplemental Life/AD\&D, Legal/ID Protection, and Accident and Critical Illness Insurance * Generous paid time off options, including uncapped vacation days, the greater of 3 paid sick days or in accordance with the applicable state or local paid sick leave law, 6 paid company holidays, 2 floating holidays, parental leave, bereavement leave, jury duty leave, voting leave, and other forms of paid leave as required by applicable law or regulation * Employee Stock Purchase Program with additional opportunities to earn stock in the Company * Retirement planning through the Company’s 401(k) The Analytics Engineer III on the ACV Transportation team is a skilled practitioner who transforms raw data into trusted, decision\-ready models and reports that drive the business forward. Sitting at the intersection of data engineering and business intelligence, this role contributes across the full analytics stack \- from dbt model design and data quality to Omni BI dashboards \- and partners with the Transportation Business to surface insights on operational risk and product initiatives. A key objective of this role is reducing ad\-hoc analytical bottlenecks over time. You will be expected to answer urgent business questions quickly and directly, while systematically building the underlying dbt models, metric definitions, and BI layer in a way that enables self\-serve analytics \- including AI\-assisted querying \- so that business stakeholders can answer common questions themselves. **What you will do (Responsibilities):****Analytics Modeling \& Data Quality:** * Design, build, and maintain dbt models (staging, intermediate, production layers) that serve as the single source of truth for Transport KPIs, with machine\-readability in mind * Enforce data quality through dbt tests, source freshness checks, and documentation so downstream consumers can trust what they see * Write complex SQL transformations on large datasets; optimize for cost and performance **Reporting \& BI:** * Translate business questions into well\-scoped analytical requirements; define metrics in collaboration with Transport stakeholders and keep definitions governed in our semantic layer * Build upon our Omni BI semantic layer, enabling self\-serve chat and dealer\-facing embedded reporting * Balance responsiveness to ad\-hoc requests while optimizing via building: triage what should be answered once vs. what should be codified so stakeholders or AI tools can self\-serve it in the future * Deliver clear, compelling data narratives to non\-technical stakeholders; support follow\-on questions and iterate quickly **Transportation Business Domains:** * Business Operations: * Support the business in ensuring visibility into trends, exceptions, making recommendations for cure * Product: * Develop dealer\-facing dashboards that illustrate their transportation performance trends over time * Help facilitate cost benefit analyses for product and feature buildouts * Help validate and execute experiments **Project Ownership \& Stakeholder Partnership:** * Execute scoped projects with general guidance: define approach and timelines with input from a manager or senior team member, and drive day\-to\-day execution independently * Deliver data\-driven recommendations * Navigate competing priorities across multiple stakeholder groups; propose win\-win solutions when technical requirements conflict **What you will need (Skills, Experience, Education):****Education:** * BA/BS in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Operations Research, or related * Master's or Ph.D. a plus, but offset by demonstrated experience and a deep toolbox **Experience:** * 3\+ years of professional experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or BI * Hands\-on production experience with dbt (model design, testing, documentation, incremental strategies) * Expert\-level SQL; comfortable with window functions, complex joins, and query optimization in BigQuery or a comparable cloud warehouse * Experience delivering analytical initiatives independently, from scoping through stakeholder presentation * Experience with Git\-based version control workflows **Soft Skills:** * Excellent communicator with a strong attention to detail; genuinely curious about the business and willing to dig into the specifics to get things right * Collaborative, low\-ego, and invested in the team's collective output * Strong instinct for knowing when to answer quickly vs. when to build properly * Communicates analytical findings clearly to non\-technical audiences * Comfortable navigating ambiguity **Nice\-to\-Haves:** * Proficiency building semantic layers; Omni or Looker BI experience preferred, but similar experience considered * Experience with Google Cloud Platform * Familiarity with AI\-assisted analytics or developer workflows * Experience with regression modelling. \#LI\-HM1 Our Values Trust \& Transparency \| People First \| Positive Experiences \| Calm Persistence \| Never Settling At ACV, we are committed to an inclusive culture in which every individual is welcomed and empowered to celebrate their true selves. We achieve this by fostering a work environment of acceptance and understanding that is free from discrimination. ACV is committed to being an equal opportunity employer regardless of sex, race, creed, color, religion, marital status, national origin, age, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, disability, military status, status as a veteran, or any other protected characteristic. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires reasonable accommodation, please let us know. For information on our collection and use of your personal information, please see our Privacy Notice. No immigration or work visa sponsorship provided for this position. **Compensation:** The compensation range for this position is listed in the "Job Details" section at the bottom of this posting. Please note that final compensation will be determined based upon the applicant's relevant experience, skill set, location, business needs, market demands, and other factors as permitted by law.

jobs.title: Wastewater Project Engineer
jobs.description: Job Description: **Wastewater Project Engineer \- Des Moines, IA** ================================================= Due to ongoing growth, AE2S is seeking a motivated and team\-oriented**Wastewater Project Engineer** to join our nationally recognized, award\-winning team. At AE2S, we don’t just offer jobs — we provide opportunities for meaningful work, professional development, and long\-term career growth. In this role, you’ll collaborate with experienced engineers and project managers on the design, analysis, and delivery of municipal water and wastewater infrastructure projects. Typical assignments include planning studies, engineering reports, system design, and construction administration for both new developments and system upgrades. jobs.description: **Company Description** **Work with Us. Change the World.** At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. The role includes preparing design drawings, technical specifications, and performing field investigations under the guidance of senior engineering staff or project managers. commuter rail, heavy rail, and freight rail projects. * Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and engineering oversight to mid\-level and junior engineers, designers, and CAD staff, including performing QA/QC reviews and supporting staff development. * Develop signal design packages including signal layouts, interlocking plans, control line diagrams, route and aspect charts, cable routing plans, signal house layouts, equipment location plans, and associated construction documents. * Design and analyze wayside signal systems, interlockings, switch machine systems, train detection systems, vital and non\-vital logic, and highway\-rail grade crossing warning systems in accordance with industry standards and client requirements. * Prepare engineering calculations, technical specifications, bills of materials, cost estimates, design reports, and other technical documentation required to support project delivery. * Coordinate signal system interfaces with traction power, communications, SCADA, OCS, train control, track, civil, roadway, station, and utility systems to ensure successful multidisciplinary integration. * Support the design, integration, testing, and commissioning of conventional signaling, Positive Train Control (PTC), Communications\-Based Train Control (CBTC), Automatic Train Protection (ATP), and Automatic Train Control (ATC) systems. * Support project planning and execution activities, including scope development, resource forecasting, schedule management, technical risk assessment, proposal preparation, fee development, and business development efforts. * Conduct field investigations, site inspections, diagnostic reviews, testing, commissioning, cutovers, and construction support activities, including responding to RFIs, reviewing submittals, and supporting revenue service implementation. * Interface with clients, railroads, contractors, regulatory agencies, and project stakeholders while ensuring compliance with FRA, FTA, AREMA, MUTCD, railroad owner standards, and applicable safety, quality, and environmental requirements. * Lead factory acceptance testing (FAT), site acceptance testing (SAT), commissioning, cutover planning, and revenue service implementation activities for signal, train control, and grade crossing systems. * Develop signal design criteria, standards, specifications, engineer’s cost estimates, and evaluate alternative technical solutions and value engineering opportunities to improve safety, reliability, constructability, and lifecycle costs. * Support and coordinate highway\-rail grade crossings, traffic signal preemption and transit signal priority (TSP) systems, while interfacing with FRA, railroads, transit agencies, roadway authorities, utility owners, and other project stakeholders throughout project development and implementation. * Assist in leading the growth and development of the Signals practice, including recruiting, staff development, succession planning, resource management, and technical capability enhancement. * Serve as the technical point of contact for signal engineering projects and support multidisciplinary coordination across traction power, communications, systems integration, and other rail disciplines. * Support proposal development, technical presentations, client engagement, and strategic business dev ree in Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related field plus 8 years of relevant experience in rail signal design, testing, or construction or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education. * Professional Engineer (PE) licensure or ability and willingness to obtain within two years of hire. * Experience with AREMA guidelines, FRA regulations, and signal design practices. * Experience with CAD software (e.g., AutoCAD, MicroStation) * Experience with reading and programming logic and vital logic equations. * Experience working with microprocessor\-based vital logic controllers such as ElectroLogIXS and Microlock II. * Experience with the working principles of DC and AC track circuits. * Experience with CAB signaling design and coded track circuits, audio frequency track circuits, and phase shift overlay circuits. **Preferred Experience :** * 12 years of relevant experience in rail signal design, testing, or construction. * Working knowledge of legacy and modern interlocking systems. * Familiarity with signal vendors (e.g., Siemens, Alstom, Hitachi, Wabtec). * Knowledge of relay or microprocessor\-based interlocking systems. * Field or construction support experience including signal cutover or testing. * Professional Engineer(PE) License. * Project Management Professional(PMP) License. * Strong problem\-solving, written communication, and documentation skills. * Ability to work collaboratively in multidisciplinary teams. **Additional Information** * We are interested in every qualified candidate eligible to work in the United States. Sponsorship may be available for current visa holders in the United States. * Relocation assistance may be available for this role. At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in\-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.*** **About AECOM** AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD\&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well\-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan. AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. Learn more at aecom.com. **What makes AECOM a great place to work** You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. jobs.title: AI Governance & Risk Lead
jobs.description: APCO Holdings partners with dealerships across North America to deliver innovative vehicle protection products and services that enhance the ownership experience for customers and drive growth for our partners. Through our family of brands, we bring together industry expertise, technology, and data\-driven insights to help dealers strengthen their finance and insurance performance and build lasting relationships with their customers. Our teams work collaboratively across operations, technology, risk, finance, marketing, and sales to deliver solutions that create measurable value and support the continued growth of APCO and the partners we serve. ### **Summary** The AI Governance \& Risk Lead owns how APCO Holdings selects, builds, deploys, and monitors AI so it is safe, compliant, and trusted by dealers, customers, and regulators. This role will stand up and run the AI governance program end to end: policy, model inventory, IT risk assessment, controls, vendor oversight, and reporting to leadership. ### **Key Responsibilities** **Governance framework and policy** * Design and maintain the enterprise AI governance framework, aligned to the NIST AI Risk Management Framework and ISO/IEC 42001\. * Write, review, update, and own the AI acceptable use policy, enterprise policy, model risk standards, and approval workflows for internal, vendor and generative AI tools. * Chair or run the AI governance committee; prepare decisions, track actions, and escalate issues. **Risk assessment and controls** * Maintain a complete inventory of AI systems and use cases, each with a risk tier and owner. * Run pre\-deployment risk and impact assessments covering bias and fairness, explainability, privacy, security, accuracy, and consumer harm. * Define controls for data quality, human oversight, model validation, monitoring and decommissioning, and test that they work. * Lead response and root\-cause review for AI incidents, model failures, and complaints. **Regulatory and compliance** * Track AI\-related laws and guidance (state AI and privacy laws, FTC and CFPB guidance, insurance regulator AI bulletins, the EU AI Act where relevant) and translate them into requirements. * Partner with Legal, Compliance, Privacy, and Information Security on fair lending, UDAAP, consumer disclosure and data protection obligations as they apply to AI. * Prepare evidence for internal audit, regulators, and business partner due diligence. **Third\-party AI risk** * Assess AI capabilities embedded in vendor products before purchase and renewal. * Set contract requirements for data use, model transparency, security, and incident notice. * Review and assess of third\-party risk and capabilities of AI Tool connector(s). **Enablement and reporting** * Advise product, technology, claims, sales, and operations teams on responsible AI design early in projects. * Build training and awareness on safe AI use for employees and leaders. * Report program status, risk posture and key metrics to executive leadership and the board on a regular cadence. ### **Qualifications** **Required qualifications** --------------------------- * Bachelor's degree in computer science, data science, law, risk management, information systems, or related field. * 7\+ years in technology risk, model risk management, compliance, privacy, or information security, including 2\+ years focused on AI or machine learning. * Working knowledge of how ML and generative AI models are built, evaluated, and fail, enough to challenge data scientists and vendors credibly. * Hands\-on experience applying NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, SR 11\-7 model risk guidance, or a comparable framework. * Experience in a regulated industry such as financial services, insurance, or automotive finance. * Track record of writing policy and running cross\-functional programs without direct authority. * Clear written and verbal communication with executives, engineers, and auditors. **Preferred qualifications** ---------------------------- * Master's degree or JD. * Certifications such as IAPP AIGP, CIPP/US, CRISC, CISA or CISSP. * Experience with vehicle service contracts, warranty, insurance, or dealer\-facing products. * Familiarity with AI governance and monitoring tools (model registries, bias testing, LLM evaluation and guardrail platforms). * Experience building a governance program from scratch at a mid\-sized company. At APCO, the way we work matters just as much as the results we deliver. Our values guide how we work, how we partner, and how we deliver results. We C.A.R.E. ***C****ommitted* – We build strong, high\-trust relationships with our partners and each other. ***A****ccountable* – We take ownership of outcomes and hold ourselves to the highest standards of performance and integrity. ***R****esults\-Driven* – We focus on delivering measurable outcomes that create value for our partners and our business. ***E****xcellent* – We strive for excellence in everything we do while balancing short\-term performance with long\-term success. If you're excited about joining a team that values collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement, we'd love to hear from you. *By submitting your application, you acknowledge that you have read and understand our* *Privacy Policy* *and* *Terms \& Conditions**. APCO Holdings may collect personal information (such as name, contact details, and employment history) to evaluate your candidacy. We may share this data with our subsidiaries, affiliates, and service providers. We retain applicant data only as long as necessary for the hiring process or as required by law.* We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Senior AI Forward Deployment Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Company** Armada is the hyperscaler for the edge, delivering modular AI infrastructure from first deployment to AI factory with speed, scale and sovereignty. Named one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and to the CNBC Disruptor 50, Armada's solutions are deployed in over 60 countries globally for organizations ranging from energy to defense. With nearly $500 million in funding to date, Armada is backed by leading investors including Founders Fund, Lux, BlackRock and Microsoft (M12\), alongside strategic partnerships with Microsoft, Dell, Palantir, NVIDIA, SpaceX, and Skydio. We are building the infrastructure layer for sovereign and edge AI \- rugged, deployable compute for customers that cannot rely on centralized cloud. Working at Armada means taking ownership, driving autonomy, and delivering impact. You'll tackle challenges that haven't been solved before and help build something transformative from the ground up. What you do here will not only define your career but help further Armada's mission to bridge the digital divide for customers around the world. **About the role** Armada is seeking a Senior AI Forward Deployment Engineer to work directly with customers to design, build, and operate production AI systems at the edge of the physical world. You will serve as the hands\-on technical lead for customer AI deployments, working alongside operators, domain experts, and engineering teams to understand their workflows, identify valuable use cases, and turn ambiguous requirements into working systems. You will own technical delivery from discovery and architecture through implementation, evaluation, deployment, and operational adoption. Your work may support offshore energy platforms, remote mines, defense installations, transportation networks, industrial facilities, autonomous systems, and distributed camera and sensor networks. These environments demand AI that performs under intermittent connectivity, strict latency requirements, constrained compute and power, noisy data, changing conditions, and rigorous security and data sovereignty requirements. Depending on your expertise and the customer's needs, you will build solutions involving computer vision, language and vision\-language models, multimodal AI, agents, time\-series analysis, anomaly detection, robotics, or distributed inference. You will make practical decisions about when to use existing models, adapt or train models, combine AI with conventional software, and place workloads across cloud, on\-premises, and edge infrastructure. This is a senior individual contributor role with substantial customer responsibility. You will write production code, lead architectural decisions, resolve difficult technical issues, and communicate clearly with both engineers and business leaders. Your success will be measured by customer outcomes, reliable production operation, and the reusable capabilities you contribute to Armada's platform. **Location.** This role is office\-based at our Bellevue, Washington office. **What You'll Do (Key Responsibilities)** * **Lead customer discovery and technical scoping.** Work directly with customers to understand operational workflows, data availability, infrastructure, and constraints. Define the problem, establish baselines, agree on measurable success criteria, and develop an achievable delivery plan. * **Own delivery from concept through production.** Lead architecture and implementation, manage technical dependencies and risks, and guide deployments through validation, acceptance, and adoption. Keep customers and internal teams aligned on progress, tradeoffs, and next steps. * **Build complete AI solutions.** Develop the data pipelines, models, inference services, APIs, and application integrations needed to embed AI into customer operations. Select, train, fine\-tune, or adapt models according to the use case and deployment constraints. * **Engineer for edge and sovereign environments.** Deploy containerized AI workloads across GPUs, Kubernetes, cloud, on\-premises infrastructure, and disconnected environments. Design for local operation, connectivity loss, resource limits, secure updates, and recovery. * **Establish rigorous evaluation.** Build representative datasets and reproducible tests that measure task performance, latency, throughput, robustness, safety, and resource efficiency. Evaluate failure modes and validate improvements against real operating conditions. * **Optimize models and inference.** Profile workloads and apply techniques such as quantization, distillation, batching, caching, and hardware\-aware acceleration to meet customer requirements for performance, memory, power, and cost. * **Own production readiness and reliability.** Implement testing, deployment automation, model and data versioning, observability, and rollback procedures. Establish monitoring for data quality, model performance, and drift, with controlled processes for updates and retraining. * **Resolve issues to travel to customer sites and work alongside customer teams during discovery, implementation, and deployment. **Preferred Experience and Skills** * Production AI deployments in edge, disconnected, air\-gapped, sovereign, or other constrained computing environments. * GPU inference optimization using technologies such as TensorRT, Triton Inference Server, ONNX Runtime, vLLM, or CUDA. * Adaptation of open\-weight models through fine\-tuning, LoRA, distillation, quantization, or related techniques. * Production LLM and agent systems, including retrieval, tool integration, evaluation, observability, and controls for reliable execution. * Multimodal applications combining video, images, language, audio, telemetry, geospatial information, or other sensor data. * Experience in energy, mining, defense, manufacturing, transportation, robotics, or other operationally demanding industries. * Integration with industrial systems, streaming data platforms, camera networks, enterprise applications, or operational technology. * Synthetic data, simulation, active learning, weak supervision, reinforcement learning, or human\-in\-the\-loop workflows. * Experience as a forward deployed engineer, technical founder, customer\-facing engineering lead, or applied AI technical lead. * An MS or Ph.D. in a relevant technical, science, or statistics discipline, or equivalent depth gained through industry experience. You do not need experience in every area listed above. We value technical depth, sound judgment, and a demonstrated ability to deliver AI/SI systems that customers can depend on. **Compensation** For U.S. Based candidates: To ensure fairness and transparency, the starting base salary range for this role for candidates in the U.S. are listed below, varying based on location experience, skills, and qualifications. In addition to base salary, ***this role will also be offered equity and subsidized benefits***(details available upon request). **Benefits** * Competitive base salary and equity * Medical, dental, and vision (subsidized cost) * Health savings accounts (HSA), flexible spending accounts (FSA), and dependent care FSAs (DCFSA) * Retirement plan options, including 401(k) and Roth 401(k) * Unlimited paid time off (PTO) * 14 paid company holidays per year \#LI\-SM2 \#LI\-Onsite **You're a Great Fit if You're** * A go\-getter with a growth mindset. You're intellectually curious, have strong business acumen, and actively seek opportunities to build relevant skills and knowledge * A detail\-oriented problem\-solver. You can independently gather information, solve problems efficiently, and deliver results with a "get\-it\-done" attitude * Thrive in a fast\-paced environment. You're energized by an entrepreneurial spirit, capable of working quickly, and excited to contribute to a growing company * A collaborative team player. You focus on business success and are motivated by team accomplishment vs personal agenda * Highly organized and results\-driven. Strong prioritization skills and a dedicated work ethic are essential for you **Equal Opportunity Statement** At Armada, we are committed to fostering a work environment where everyone is given equal opportunities to thrive. As an equal opportunity employer, we strictly prohibit discrimination or harassment based on race, color, gender, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law. This policy applies to all employment decisions, including hiring, promotions, and compensation. Our hiring is guided by qualifications, merit, and the business needs at the time. **Unsolicited Resumes and Candidates** Armada does not accept unsolicited resumes or candidate submissions from external agencies or recruiters. All candidates must apply directly through our careers page. Any resumes submitted by agencies without a prior signed agreement will be considered unsolicited and Armada will not be obligated to pay any fees.

jobs.title: Software Engineer II, Fullstack (Capital Orchestration)
jobs.description: At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most. Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest. We are looking for a passionate engineer to join our Capital Orchestration team, which is responsible for providing liquidity to Affirm by enabling the sale and collateralization of Affirm loan assets. To achieve this, our team develops a robust and extensible platform for on\-demand transactions with low operational risk that scales to billions of dollars of collateral movement each month. In simpler terms, we help ensure Affirm has enough money to originate loans, pay merchants, and continue to grow. What You'll Do: * With the support of your team's tech lead and manager, you will break down larger projects into individual tasks, deliver them in multiple phases, and collaborate with others to ensure timely delivery of your work. * You will support your peers and stakeholders in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, design \& analytics by participating in ideation, articulating technical constraints, and partnering on decisions that properly consider risks and trade\-offs. * You will support the operations and availability of your team's artifacts by creating and monitoring metrics, escalating when needed, and supporting "keep the lights on" \& on\-call efforts. * You will contribute to a sense of community on your team by engaging in growth and development activities such as participation in the interview process. Team\-specific: * Build a foundational platform enabling us to reconcile each transaction across systems, partners, and cash movements. * Build and integrate data pipelines from a variety of products and systems. * Build intuitive and thoughtful user experiences to streamline the workflows of our business counterparts. * Develop a deep understanding of the capital systems which power and fund Affirm. * Partner with engineers on the team to help improve designs, code quality, and testing. * Collaborate with product managers and business counterparts to design best\-in\-class systems and processes. * Partner with other engineering teams who provide infrastructure, build financial products, and perform financial transactions at Affirm. jobs.title: Partner Solution Architect, Partner Center of Excellence
jobs.description: As the most trusted global leader in data\-first contract lifecycle management (CLM) software, Agiloft helps organizations manage the end\-to\-end process of proposing, negotiating, signing, and leveraging contracts using our flexible Data\-first Agreement Platform (DAP). With contract data as the foundation, customers quickly and collaboratively reach agreement and leverage contract visibility to thrive with competitive advantage. Employing powerful, pragmatic artificial intelligence as a legal force multiplier, and robust integration capabilities as a data liberator, organizations around the world trust Agiloft’s certified implementers to deliver connected, intelligent, and autonomous solutions across the entire contract lifecycle. Top analysts like Gartner, Forrester, and IDC agree, all showing Agiloft as a leader in the CLM space. Our no code platform is easily managed and administered by business users, which is why Agiloft is the contract you keep: nearly a full 100% of new customers are satisfied with their initial implementations, and some 97% of customers renew every year. Ours is a growing, vibrant, successful company that is at the forefront of a market that is becoming a must\-have for all organizations. We believe that the way to build the strongest, most vibrant place to work is to bring in individuals from all walks of life, and to support them in bringing their authentic selves to their day, every day. Our working philosophy is that “EX \= CX”: when employee experience is excellent, so is customer experience. We support multiple Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), and offer a working environment that supports healthy work/life balance, including floating holidays and a quarterly, no\-questions\-asked wellness day.### **Position Overview** Agiloft's customers rely on our Ecosystem of System Integration (SI) partners to help them design, build and deliver solutions on the Agiloft platform. This role is designed to help our partners build robust capabilities within their organization and ultimately ensure our customers are realizing maximum value from the platform. As Partner Solution Architect, you'll support the partners as a technical advisor for partner\-led implementations from kickoff through go\-live. You'll guide SIs on architecture, integrations, data sync, and configuration. When something breaks, you'll figure out whether it's a configuration issue, an integration issue, or a real product defect, and get it to the right owner. You'll sit in the Partner Center of Excellence, the team responsible for making partner delivery repeatable and high quality. Our Partner Alliance Managers own the overall relationship with each partner and this role will be responsible for the successful technical outcome and capability development. You'll work daily with Sales, Professional Services, Product, Engineering, and Support, and you'll turn what you learn on each project into playbooks the whole ecosystem can use. ### **Job Responsibilities** **What you'll do** **Guide Partners to Go\-live** * Serve as the product \& technical point of contact for SI partners and their customers during the implementation project and through go\-live. * Advise on solution architecture, integration design, data synchronization, and configuration best practices across Agiloft's platform: core CLM, procurement and source\-to\-pay workflows, ERP sync (such as SAP S/4HANA), APIs and MCP\-based orchestration, and AI and analytics capabilities. * Help partners separate out\-of\-the\-box capability from custom implementation work so each fix lands with the right owner. **Own the Technical Escalation Path** * Act as the Tier 3 technical resource for partner\-led projects. * Triage and reproduce issues, document them clearly, and log true defects and enhancement requests to Product and Engineering in Jira. * Join partner and customer working sessions when a blocker needs Agiloft in the room. * Hand accounts off cleanly to Support at transition, with documented configuration and open items. **Enable the Ecosystem** * Build and deliver partner training, webinars, and learning content with Product and go\-to\-market teams. * Work with Product and Engineering to stand up and maintain partner sandboxes, test environments, and knowledge base access. * Support the change management and promote the value of monthly releases into the partner ecosystem. **Build the Playbook** * Create and maintain implementation playbooks, a known\-issue library, escalation runbooks, and environment setup guides. * Feed patterns from real projects back into enablement, documentation, and the product roadmap. **What Success Looks Like in Year One** * Partner\-led go\-lives land on schedule, with fewer slipping because of unresolved technical blockers. * Technical escalations from partners reach a clear owner quickly, with reproducible detail, and resolve faster. * Product and Engineering receive structured, prioritized signal from partner projects instead of ad hoc pulls. * Product and Engineering receive a steady, well\-documented stream of implementation feedback that shapes the roadmap. * A working go\-live toolkit exists and partners actually use it: playbooks, known\-issue library, runbooks, reference architectures, and environment guides. * Support inherits cleaner, better\-documented accounts at handoff. * Target metrics: e.g. on\-time go\-live rate, median time to resolve partner escalations, escalations per quarter, training events delivered. * Other duties as assigned. ### **Required Qualifications** **What you'll bring** * 5\+ years in a technical, customer\- or partner\-facing implementation role: solution architecture, professional services, implementation or integration consulting, or sales engineering with post\-sale delivery. * Agiloft certification, or relevant platform certifications (Salesforce, SAP, cloud). * Hands\-on experience designing and troubleshooting enterprise integrations including REST APIs, webhooks, authentication patterns (OAuth, JWT), and data sync between systems of record. * Working knowledge of the systems CLM connects to, such as Salesforce, ERP (SAP, Oracle, NetSuite), and Procurement relevant ISVs * Strong troubleshooting instincts. You can isolate whether an issue is configuration, integration, or product defect, and explain it precisely to engineers and executives alike. * Solution design skills: you can translate business requirements into a technical design and explain the trade\-offs to both technical and business stakeholders. * Experience guiding external partners or customers while working across Product, Engineering, and Support. * Exposure to AI\-enabled workflows, LLM tooling, or MCP\-based integrations. * A builder's habit of turning one\-off fixes into reusable documentation and process. ### **Preferred Qualifications** **Nice to have** * Integration middleware experience: Workato, MuleSoft, or Boomi. * Background in CLM, procurement or source\-to\-pay, CPQ, or related enterprise workflow platforms; hands\-on experience implementing a CLM platform is a strong plus. * Prior work at or alongside SI and consulting partners. * Exposure to ISV/managed\-package delivery, versioning, and enterprise deployment considerations. * Prior experience working directly with or inside SI or consulting partners. Ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace is our priority. We are committed to an environment of acceptance where you are free to bring your full self to work. All employment decisions at Agiloft are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications without regard to race, color, religion or belief, national or social ethnic origin, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, parental status, marital status, Veteran status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. If you have a need that requires accommodation during the recruiting process, please let us know by contacting Director, Talent Acquisition, Brad Toothman at brad.toothman@agiloft.com. Applicants from underrepresented groups such as minorities, veterans, or individuals with disabilities encouraged to apply. Applications will be reviewed as submitted. There will be no application deadline for this opportunity. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. jobs.description: **About Airwallex** ------------------- Airwallex is the AI\-native financial operating system for a real\-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own. We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85\+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia\-Pacific. We're co\-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder\-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full. ### **How you'll make impact** You’ll build AI tools and applications used by Airwallex employees, taking projects from inception through implementation. You’ll work across platform engineering, security, automation, and infrastructure to help teams operate more effectively. * Lead the development of AI tools and applications from inception through implementation * Build, monitor, and maintain infrastructure including Kubernetes clusters, serverless workloads, ETL pipelines, and terabyte\-scale log pipelines * Partner with engineers and product engineering teams to identify opportunities for automation and tooling development * Support incident response by building tools for threat hunting, remediation, and security scanning * Deliver security improvements such as automated patching, gateways, and other services that reduce risk * Mentor Software Engineers and help grow the engineering team You’ll work from our San Francisco office three days a week. ### **What we're looking for** **Essentials** * A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field * 3\+ years of experience as a Software Engineer * Experience working with production codebases * Experience with at least one scripting language, such as Python, and one systems programming language, such as Go or C/C\+\+ * Experience with modern cloud infrastructure, including data pipelines, serverless workloads, and Kubernetes * A track record of working autonomously on projects and delivering high\-quality work on time * Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders * The ability to dive deep to find the best solution to a problem * Strong curiosity and a willingness to ask questions, gather context, and learn **Preferred** * Experience working in a high\-growth technology company * Hands\-on experience with AI, specifically leveraging AI to build applications * Experience maintaining Linux operating systems ### **You'll thrive here if** * You're comfortable owning the roadmap yourself. * You're comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you'll run with it. * You hold yourself to a high standard even when no one is watching. jobs.title: (Sr Dir) Head, AI Drug Discovery & Design
jobs.description: Location: Cambridge, United States Job reference: R\-264912 Date posted: 11/23/2026 **At Alexion, AstraZeneca Rare Disease**, we are innovators, leaders, and collaborators. At the heart of everything we do is an intense desire to pursue the toughest challenges and truly change the world for people living with rare and devastating diseases. **The role in brief** Research is making a deliberate move to put AI at the centre of how scientific decisions are made. We need a leader who will define what that means in practice: where AI creates a real scientific advantage, which bets to make first, and how to turn them into results that scientists adopt and leadership can see. As Senior Director, you will own the AI strategy for Research. You will begin where the leverage is greatest, in target discovery and molecule design, and then broaden the strategy as the evidence builds. You will design and launch the projects, lead the team that delivers them, and act as the voice of Research AI in enterprise conversations across AstraZeneca. **Why this role is different** * **Define the strategy, not just execute it.** The mandate is to decide where AI should and should not be used in Research, in what order, and with which partners. Shape the team, the operating model and the standards that define how AI is done in Research for years to come. * **Direct line to the science.** Work shoulder to shoulder with biologists and chemists on live discovery questions, in a setting where small patient populations and sparse data make smart methods essential. * **Enterprise reach with start\-up agency.** Access to the scale, data and platforms of a global pharma company, while leading a small, effective team that moves quickly and owns its outcomes. * **Visibility.** This senior role works directly with Research leaders and enterprise AI forums, where your recommendations influence investment and strategic direction. **What you will do** **Set the AI strategy for Research** * Define a multi\-year vision and roadmap for AI in Research, grounded in where AI can change scientific decisions and speed, not where the technology is merely fashionable. * Start with target discovery and molecule design, and set out how and when the strategy extends to other parts of the research value chain. * Make clear build, buy and partner choices, and shape the technical architecture and standards the team works to. * Track the external landscape, from frontier models to emerging partners, and translate it into practical direction for Research. **Design the projects and deliver the results** * Turn strategy into a focused portfolio of projects with clear scientific hypotheses, defined success criteria, named owners and credible plans. * Run projects with rigor: pilot quickly, learn, and decide with evidence whether to scale, adapt or stop. * Embed outputs in the way scientists actually work, so that AI informs real programs and decisions rather than sitting in a demo. * Be accountable for delivery and for the quality, validity and reliability of what the team produces. **Lead and build the team** * Use the dedicated budget and resources to build the team: define the roles and skills needed, recruit exceptional computational scientists and technical leaders, and set a high bar for scientific and engineering craft. * Create a culture where scientists across disciplines want to collaborate with the team and where the team’s best ideas are heard. * Set priorities, clarify ownership and grow future leaders. **Represent Research across AstraZeneca** * Be the face of Research AI in enterprise discussions on strategy, platforms, data, investment and priorities. * Influence enterprise roadmaps so that tools and capabilities built centrally work for the needs of rare disease research and bring back what is relevant for Research to adopt. * Develop external relationships with academic groups, technology companies and the wider AI\-for\-science community. **Partner on data and decision intelligence** * Work with the Head of Data, AI \& Decision Intelligence and fellow leaders to make sure the data, platforms and governance needed for ambitious AI exist and are fit for purpose. * jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Memory, SoC HAL
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Annapurna Labs builds the custom silicon at the heart of AWS machine learning servers, and we are hiring a software engineer to bring up and own the software for the High Bandwidth Memory (HBM) subsystem on these chips. HBM is what keeps the compute engines fed: every training and inference job depends on it running at full bandwidth, without errors, for years in the data center. The driver / HAL (Hardware Abstraction Layer) / firmware that initializes, trains, monitors, and repairs that memory is central to the performance and reliability of the whole accelerator. If you love working where hardware meets software, writing the code that boots, configures, and debugs real silicon, this is your team. As a Software Development Engineer on the SoC HAL team, you will write the C\+\+ software that drives the HBM memory controller and PHY across multiple chip generations. You will turn JEDEC standards and memory IP specifications into code, and partner directly with the hardware designers, validation engineers, and system memory engineers who build, characterize, and tune the memory subsystem. You will own your blocks through their whole life: from a new hardware spec, through pre\-silicon emulation and first silicon in the lab, to manufacturing and the fleet. We are looking for a software engineer who has already worked on DRAM\-based memory (DDR, LPDDR, GDDR, or HBM) and wants to go deeper on HBM. You do not need to have designed memory hardware. No machine learning experience is required (you will pick up ML concepts from colleagues if you want to). This role can be based in Cupertino, CA or Austin, TX. Key job responsibilities * Design, implement, and own HAL/driver software for the HBM memory subsystem, including controller and PHY configuration and the power\-on initialization and training sequence, from a new hardware spec to a tested, deployed stack. * Turn JEDEC HBM standards, vendor datasheets, and register specifications into data\-driven C\+\+, with crisp abstractions that keep the hardware detail visible while supporting multiple memory vendors, stack configurations, and chip generations without forking the code. * Bring up memory on pre\-silicon platforms (simulation, emulation, FPGA) and then on first silicon in the lab. Debug boot and training failures using registers, logs, traces, and RTL waveforms, alongside a wider group of validation and system memory engineers. * Enable monitoring and advanced memory test features within controller and PHY HALs for use in bring\-up, characterization, manufacturing test, and in\-fleet qualification, and expose the controller's RAS features (ECC reporting, scrubbing, repair) through the HAL. * Review memory IP and register specifications early, and give software\-driven feedback on programmability, debug visibility, and error reporting. * Support chips already in production with features and bug fixes, and continuously refactor, test, and deploy your stack to internal customers. * Use AI\-assisted development tools to work faster, and validate their output to the standard that hardware\-facing code demands. A day in the life A typical day moves between writing and reviewing C\+\+ for the HBM HAL, working through a training or controller question with an RTL or design verification engineer, and debugging a bring\-up failure on emulation or in the lab. You might chase a training failure or ECC event down into registers and logs and decide whether the fix belongs in the initialization sequence, the error\-recovery path, or the hardware. Then you fold what you learned into abstractions that keep the important details visible and carry across chip generations. Along the way you work with memory design, validation, and system memory engineers. About the team Annapurna Labs designs and deploys some of the largest custom silicon in the world, including the Trainium and Inferentia machine learning accelerators. Our SoC HAL team builds the low\-level software that boots, configures, and manages these chips, sitting between the hardware and the system software that runs the server. We are a small team that works closely with hardware, holds a high engineering bar, and gives engineers real ownership. The team spans Cupertino, CA and Austin, TX, and this role can be at either site. We value mentorship, clear written design, and software that outlasts any single chip.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience * 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience * Experience with modern C\+\+ programming including object\-oriented design * Experience with low\-level hardware/software interaction, such as device drivers, firmware, bare\-metal or embedded software, or register\-level programming of hardware blocks * Experience developing software for DRAM\-based memory (DDR, LPDDR, GDDR, or HBM), such as initialization and training, memory controller or PHY drivers, BIOS memory reference code, or memory test **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience * Experience writing HBM firmware or driver software, such as HBM initialization and training, or HBM controller / PHY drivers * Working knowledge of the JEDEC memory standards (HBM3 / HBM3E / HBM4, DDR5, LPDDR5\), including timing parameters, mode registers, and training / calibration concepts such as read/write leveling, eye centering, and periodic retraining * Experience supporting hardware in production, such as manufacturing test, qualification, or fleet operations * Knowledge of computer architecture and operating systems * Experience with memory RAS or test features: ECC, scrubbing, error logging, row or lane repair, or memory stress testing for bandwidth, latency, and data integrity Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.
