jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II, AWS Invoicing
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- AWS is expanding into more markets around the world than ever before, and the bottleneck is not customer demand — it is launch speed. Our mission is to make every new market launch faster, more reliable, and ultimately automatic — building the next\-generation automation platforms that fundamentally change how quickly AWS can reach customers in new countries. Our platforms are powered by generative AI, large language models, knowledge graphs, and agentic architectures that dynamically compose specialized agents based on context. We apply these capabilities across three reinforcing areas: intelligent launch readiness — where autonomous AI agents analyze, generate, and validate the information needed to go live in a new market; cloud\-native service orchestration — where configuration\-driven microservices replace per\-launch bespoke engineering with centralized, reusable capabilities so that expanding into a new country becomes a zero\-code configuration change rather than a development cycle; and continuous validation — where self\-healing autonomous workflows manage the full validation lifecycle from planning through execution to intelligent failure diagnosis. These three platforms feed into each other — the generative AI layer drives the orchestration layer, and the validation framework validates both, creating a closed\-loop feedback system that improves accuracy and reliability with every launch. Together, they compress what has historically been a multi\-month launch process into a matter of weeks. We are looking for engineers who can help us build the platforms and tooling that will scale AWS's global expansion by an order of magnitude — with a growing backlog of market launches and a committed pipeline ahead. In this role you will: Design and build agentic AI systems that analyze, generate, and validate launch information across multiple countries, enabling domain experts to review in hours what previously took weeks. Build agentic architectures that compose specialized AI agents dynamically, enabling rapid iteration without code deployments and continuous learning from expert feedback. Architect configuration\-driven pipelines so that launching a new market requires a config change, not a development cycle. Partner with engineers across service teams to make integration points configurable and testable by design, creating one\-time investments that pay off on every subsequent launch. Build AI\-driven continuous validation frameworks powered by agentic workflows and large language models that autonomously manage the full validation lifecycle. Collaborate with cross\-functional stakeholders to close the feedback loop between AI\-generated output and domain expertise. You're a good fit if you: Have built or contributed to AI/ML systems in production — agentic workflows, LLM pipelines, knowledge graphs, or retrieval\-augmented generation — and know the difference between a demo and a system experts trust. Think in systems — how configuration propagates across services, how validation maps to launch readiness, and how failures surface to the right team. Are comfortable with ambiguity, making architectural decisions with incomplete information and iterating based on real results. Write clean, testable code and care about operational excellence on systems that sit on the critical path of AWS's global expansion. Prefer partnering with another team to solve a problem at the source over building a workaround on your side. Want measurable impact — we track launch velocity, automation coverage, accuracy, and defect reduction. What makes this team different: Every launch you accelerate opens a new market for AWS. You'll work across a state\-of\-the\-art AI\-powered platform that spans launch readiness, service orchestration, and continuous validation — not just one slice. We build AI systems that experts use daily and measure success by whether they trust the output enough to stop doing it manually. You'll spend real time understanding adjacent systems and codebases, not just calling their APIs. Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have ten employee\-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust. Work/Life Balance Our team puts a high value on work\-live balance. It isn’t about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it’s about the flow you establish that brings energy to both parts of your life. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life\-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives. This position involves on\-call responsibilities, typically for one week every two months. We don’t like getting paged in the middle of the night or on the weekend, so we work to ensure that our systems are fault tolerant. When we do get paged, we work together to resolve the root cause so that we don’t get paged for the same issue twice. Mentorship \& Career Growth Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one\-on\-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better\-rounded engineer and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future. * We own the mission\-critical data aggregation layer powering AWS Billing Console. * We work on impactful projects that have org\-level visibility. * We solve challenging scaling and performance problems. * We use cutting\-edge AWS technologies and implement all best practices. * Excellent work\-life balance and sustainable operational load. **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience * 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience * Experience programming with at least one software programming language **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience * Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. The technology works — the gap is in the last mile: getting production systems running inside complex enterprises where legacy infrastructure, regulated data, and organizational complexity collide. You work directly inside enterprise customers: performing discovery, defining outcomes, writing specs, managing trade\-offs, and working hand\-in\-hand with engineering to ship production systems under compressed timelines. This is not a traditional AWS PM role. You are field\-facing — you work with customers regularly and turn engagement learnings into platform improvements. You own the why and what for your engagements, while engineering owns the how. Traveling 30\-50% is required for this role. jobs.title: Sr. Software Development Engineer – AI/ML Networking Disaggregated Inference, Annapurna Labs, Annapurna Labs
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Every token a large language model generates depends on data reaching the right accelerator at the right moment. As AI models outgrow any single chip, the network between accelerators becomes the bottleneck that decides how fast — and how affordably — the world's largest models can serve real users. That network layer is what our team builds. We're in search of an engineer to work at the frontier of disaggregated inference: splitting LLM serving into separate prefill and decode pools and moving the model's KV cache between them at the absolute limit of what the hardware allows. Get it right and users get answers in milliseconds; get it wrong and the fastest accelerators in the world sit idle waiting on data. You'll own pieces of the high\-speed transfer path that make the difference, and you'll measure your success in how close you run to the theoretical peak of the machine. What we're looking for: Strong C/C\+\+ and a love for low\-level, performance\-critical systems — solid command of Linux, kernels, memory, and writing fast code. The instinct to ask "how fast could this possibly go?" and the rigor to measure it. Experience with high\-speed networking or HPC interconnects (RDMA, InfiniBand, libfabric, UCX, NIXL, MPI) is valued highly; embedded\-systems experience is a plus. Prior AI/ML experience is welcome but not required — if you're a great systems engineer, we'll teach you the ML side. If you like solving genuinely hard problems, working shoulder\-to\-shoulder with HPC and ML customers, iterating fast, and shipping at a scale few places can offer, come join us. This is a role on the leading edge of AI/ML infrastructure. Key job responsibilities Build and optimize the low\-level data\-movement software across accelerators, servers, and heterogeneous memory — over AWS's highest\-performance network fabric. Push performance to the hardware roofline: profile, find the real bottleneck, and close the gap between "it works" and "it runs as fast as physics permits." Work across the stack — from kernel and network transport up to the inference frameworks — and partner with teams building the chips, runtime, and models. Deliver features that run on our largest clusters, for our largest customers, serving the largest AI models in production. A day in the life Annapurna Labs, a crucial part of AWS, is responsible for developing hardware and software components for EC2 infrastructure. Our team focuses on building networking solutions that for Machine Learning (ML) and High\-Performance Computing (HPC) workloads on AWS. We have mixed discipline orgs, you’d be working side by side with infrastructure experts, hardware engineers, RTL engineers, scientists \& architects. Our workforce spans the globe and is truly international, you’ll find yourself working side by side with individuals from numerous countries. We take mentorship seriously, you can both expect senior mentorship and will be expected to mentor new and junior engineers. The pace is fast as we work on the latest advancements of AI/ML, but we take the time to bond as a team and enjoy the successes. We offer flexibility in working hours, and respect WLB as a core org tenet. The team enjoys working with numerous principal\-level engineers and closely with directors, career growth opportunities are certainly available. This is a role where you will always be encouraged to keep learning, the AI/ML field is fast moving and constantly evolving. About the team You'd be joining Annapurna Labs, an integral part of AWS. Annapurna designs the hardware and software building blocks behind EC2 — every EC2 instance runs on hardware we designed. We specialize in the chips, systems, and software that optimize the AWS customer experience, and this team sits where cutting\-edge AI meets the silicon and the network underneath it. **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 5\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience * 5\+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience * 5\+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience * 5\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience * Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team * Must have C/C\+\+ Coding Experience **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent * ML Communications (NCCL, NIXL, NVSHMEM) Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. jobs.title: Cabling Infrastructure Manager, DCC Communities
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- AWS Infrastructure Operations seeks an Infrastructure Delivery Manager to lead our network capacity cabling infrastructure team. This leadership role combines technical expertise with people management to drive our Data Center Operations forward, focusing on delivering network capacity with zero rework targets. The Infrastructure Delivery Manager will oversee the cabling infrastructure installation for inbound capacity and equipment while managing a growing team. Key responsibilities include developing sustainable processes, driving automation initiatives, and overseeing low voltage structured cabling across AWS data centers. The role requires expertise in budget tracking, strategic planning, and technical solution development to optimize delivery cycle times without compromising network availability. As part of AWS Infrastructure Services, you'll join the team that maintains our global infrastructure powering millions of customer workloads. Working alongside software engineers, hardware specialists, and security experts, you'll help ensure reliable service delivery while optimizing costs. The position demands proven people management experience, strong technical understanding of data center operations, and a track record of process improvement and automation. This role directly impacts AWS's global infrastructure, which includes the design, planning, and operation of our data centers, servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment. You'll collaborate across AWS teams to maintain industry\-leading safety and security standards while scaling our infrastructure to meet growing customer demands. The CE serves as an expert technical resource reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager, interacting with onsite Engineering Operations Technicians (EOT) and any third\-party vendors. Chief Engineer will be responsible for managing small\-to\-medium large impact projects from conception to completion. These projects can involve large amounts of independent work as well as collaboration with external support groups including engineering, automation, processing, and finance in both local and global settings. The CE will be tasked with creating and delivering milestones, obtaining and tracking quotes for all necessary costs, and documenting project results for future implementation at other facilities. Current work spans multimodal video, audio, and language models; spatial and temporal understanding; active\-speaker and point\-of\-interest detection; scene retrieval; video super\-resolution; and learned methods for improving compression. These problems rarely have a single accepted metric or a ready\-made dataset. You will help define the task itself, determine what evidence is needed, and build evaluation methods that reflect the experience of people watching and working with the resulting video. This role combines applied research with the practical demands of a real\-time media service. You will design datasets and objectives, train models at scale, run controlled comparisons, and investigate failures. You will also work closely with engineers to export, optimize, and deploy those models. A result is not finished when it performs well in a notebook. It must preserve its quality after conversion, fit within GPU memory, meet latency and throughput targets, handle the temporal behavior of live video, and operate at a cost customers can sustain. You will be a technical leader on the team as well as an individual contributor. The role calls for someone who can take an ambiguous customer problem, separate the scientific questions from the engineering constraints, and lead a team toward a defensible answer. You will review experiments and models, mentor other scientists and engineers, and improve the shared methods the team uses for training and evaluation. Strong judgment matters here. So does the ability to explain a complicated result clearly, including its limitations, to people from several disciplines. We welcome candidates with deep experience in computer vision, multimodal learning, video processing, or related areas. Direct media experience is valuable but not required. A scientist who has solved difficult problems in another field, understands how to test ideas rigorously, and wants to learn the video domain can also succeed in this role. Key job responsibilities Lead the formulation of ambiguous video problems into research plans with clear datasets, objectives, baselines, evaluation protocols, and production acceptance criteria. Develop models for multimodal video understanding and generation, spatial and temporal reasoning, detection and tracking, scene retrieval, video enhancement, and learned compression. Develop models for multimodal video understanding and description, spatial and temporal reasoning, detection and tracking, scene retrieval, video enhancement, and learned compression. Build evaluations that measure the behavior customers will see. Depending on the problem, this may include task accuracy, factual support, temporal localization, retrieval quality, perceptual video quality, rate\-distortion performance, or human review. Take models from research code to production\-ready artifacts. Partner with engineers on model export, reduced\-precision inference, quantization, numerical parity, accelerator\-specific optimization, and integration with serving systems and video pipelines. Balance model quality against latency, throughput, GPU memory, context limits, and operating cost. Diagnose problems across training stability, data quality, precision, compilation, serving, and live temporal behavior. Build reusable mechanisms for dataset management, experimentation, model comparison, regression detection, and performance measurement rather than solving each research problem in isolation. Review scientific work and production code. Identify weak comparisons, data leakage, unsupported conclusions, untested edge cases, and operational risks before they reach customers. Work with product managers, software engineers, and other scientists to make scope and design decisions. Use evidence to resolve disagreement and communicate what is known, what remains uncertain, and what further work is worth doing. Mentor scientists and engineers in experimental design, machine learning methods, video evaluation, and production ML practices. Contribute applied research through internal technical reports, patents, and publications at appropriate conferences or workshops. About the team AWS Elemental provides a portfolio of cloud media services built to prepar sing, distributed systems, advertising, and the operational demands of professional media. Elemental Inference applies machine learning across that video pipeline. The team works on video understanding and enhancement, contextual metadata, smart composition, event detection, retrieval, and compression. Some projects use large multimodal models that combine video, audio, and language. Others use specialized temporal or spatial models designed for a narrow task and a strict real\-time budget. We choose the approach that fits the customer problem rather than forcing every problem into the same model family. Scientists on the team own more than model architecture. They compare internal models with external alternatives and track accuracy, perceptual quality, latency, memory use, and cost. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II, System Health
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- When a Severity 1 incident disrupts shopping on Amazon, every minute matters. Help responders find the cause across thousands of interconnected services and restore the customer experience faster. The System Health team is looking for a Software Development Engineer II to build full\-stack applications and AI\-powered reasoning systems for incident response at Amazon scale. During a major incident, responders must turn a flood of alarms, metrics, logs, and change events into answers: What is failing? Which team can fix it? What action will reduce customer impact? You will build the software that helps answer those questions. Your work will span investigation experiences in React and TypeScript, backend services in Python and Java, and infrastructure defined through AWS CDK in TypeScript. You will apply AI to connect signals across services, investigate likely causes, and deliver evidence\-backed recommendations that responders can understand and act on. Working directly with incident responders and partner engineering teams, you will own features from design through production. You will tackle hard problems in distributed systems, user experience, and AI reasoning with a clear purpose: shortening the path from customer impact to recovery. Key job responsibilities * Build full\-stack incident response tools that help engineers investigate Severity 1 incidents and localize failures across thousands of services. * Create intuitive React and TypeScript experiences that turn complex service\-health data and AI reasoning into clear, actionable insights. * Develop scalable backend services and APIs in Python and Java, with infrastructure defined through AWS CDK in TypeScript. * Apply generative AI to correlate operational signals, investigate failure hypotheses, identify likely failing services, and recommend engagement or mitigation actions. * Connect alarms, metrics, logs, dependencies, and change events so responders can distinguish likely causes from downstream symptoms. * Evaluate reasoning and recommendation quality against historical incidents, measuring accuracy and timeliness rather than relying on compelling demonstrations. * Own features from customer requirements through production operation, designing for the reliability, responsiveness, and usability that incident response demands. * Partner with responders and engineering teams, contribute to design and code reviews, and mentor other engineers. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Online Proxy Fleet (OPF)
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- OPF is a reverse proxy and trusted solution powering over 2,500\+ Amazon websites, managing incoming traffic from the public internet to Amazon websites, services, and subsidiaries—including store and non\-store websites, services like Alexa and Music, and other subsidiaries. OPF processes over 20 trillion requests monthly from the internet. We are looking for a passionate, results\-oriented, inventive Software Development Engineer to refine and deliver our grand vision, design and implement technical solutions useful for teams across Amazon. The candidate should thrive in a fast\-paced environment, understands service\-oriented architecture, and will help us help the business innovate quickly at scale. Successful candidates will have a proven track record of developing highly distributed systems using Agile and incremental delivery methods. You must enjoy working on complex software systems in a customer\-centric environment and be passionate not only about building good software but also ensuring that same software achieve its goals in operational reality. By submitting your application here, you can apply once to be considered for multiple Software Engineer openings across various Amazon teams. jobs.title: Commissioning Engineer, Electrical I/II – Data Center (REMOTE)
jobs.description: ***From power\-generation equipment to big auto and tire plants, the Upstate runs on electrical talent. Put yours to work on hyperscale data centers nationwide.*** **Commissioning Engineer, Electrical I/II – Data Center** --------------------------------------------------------- **Location:** Greenville, SC (home\-based, with travel to project sites) **Employment type:** Full\-time, salaried, exempt **Travel:** 75% (project sites nationwide) **Base salary:** $95,000 – $123,000, depending on experience and level (I or II) ### **WHY THIS ROLE** Anchor Mission Critical commissions the data centers that keep the modern world connected. We start working on a project early, test every system right the first time, and don't treat commissioning as a checkbox. We're hiring Electrical Commissioning Engineers at two levels. Level I is for engineers building their commissioning foundation. Level II is for engineers ready to run functional testing on their own. You'll test the power systems that keep hyperscale facilities running: switchgear, UPS, generators and everything between the utility and the rack. ### **WHAT YOU'LL DO** * Do pre\-functional checks and Level 2–3 readiness inspections on electrical equipment * Run functional performance tests (FPT, Level 4\) using approved procedures, under supervision at Level I and on your own at Level II * Support integrated systems testing (IST, Level 5\), including utility\-failure, generator transfer and recovery scenarios * Work with electrical contractors, equipment makers (OEMs) and the controls team during startup and testing * Carry out electrical commissioning work assigned by Senior Engineers, Leads and the Cx PM. Record test results, deficiencies and corrective actions, and keep commissioning documentation accurate and timely (e.g., in CxAlloy) * Read and mark up one\-line diagrams, schematics and sequences of operation * Follow strict safety practices around energized equipment: LOTO, NFPA 70E and arc\-flash boundaries ### **WHAT YOU BRING** **Required:** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, or equivalent hands\-on electrical experience. Military electrical, power\-production or nuclear experience counts as equivalent (e.g., Navy Nuclear EM/ET, Air Force 3E0X1/3E0X2, Army 12P/12R, Marine 1141/1142\) * 2–7 years in electrical systems work, such as utility, power generation, heavy industrial, manufacturing, construction, inspection or commissioning * Working knowledge of power distribution: switchgear, transformers, UPS, generators and automatic transfer switches * Ability to read and interpret electrical one\-lines and schematics, and a basic understanding of redundancy and failure concepts * Willingness to learn commissioning processes and tools; ability to travel 75% and work on active construction sites **Preferred:** * Data center or other mission\-critical experience (hospitals, utilities, semiconductor or pharmaceutical plants) * Exposure to startup, testing or commissioning * OSHA 10 or 30; NFPA 70E training; commissioning\-related coursework or training * Electrical inspector, journeyman or master electrician background, or military electrical/power experience (Navy nuclear, Air Force 3E0, Army 12P Prime Power) ### **LEVEL I VS. LEVEL II** * Level I: 2–5 yrs industry, 1–3 yrs mission\-critical. Runs Level 1–4 test scripts under supervision. Learning one\-lines, sequences and test discipline. * Level II: 4–7 yrs industry, 2–4 yrs mission\-critical. Runs Level 4 FPT on own and supports Level 5 IST. Building documentation and punch\-list skills; working toward Uptime ATD or similar certification. ### **WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE** * Safe, accurate execution of assigned testing * Complete, defensible commissioning documentation * Responds well to direction and feedback Steady technical growth and readiness for more responsibility (Level I Level II* Senior) ### **WHY ANCHOR** * Competitive base salary, plus eligibility for our performance bonus program * Travel expenses and per diem covered under company policy * Medical, dental, vision and other benefits * A clear career ladder from Engineer to Senior to Lead, with both technical and leadership tracks * A firm built on discipline, not heroics. We own outcomes together, hold the line under pressure, and follow the process even when it's harder. ### **ABOUT ANCHOR MISSION CRITICAL** Anchor Mission Critical is a professional services firm built to support hyperscale and high\-reliability infrastructure. We provide commissioning, integrated systems testing (IST), QA/QC and operational readiness services for data centers and other no\-fail environments. Our Playbook sets a standard delivery framework built on readiness, risk prevention and repeatable execution. This position is full\-time and exempt. Employment is at\-will, subject to applicable state and federal law. Pay above the posted range may be considered for exceptional experience or faster development. Anchor Mission Critical is an equal opportunity employer. Veterans and transitioning service members are encouraged to apply.

jobs.title: Applied AI Architect, Technology Partnerships
jobs.description: **About Anthropic** ------------------- Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. **About the role** ------------------ As an Applied AI Architect on the Technology Partnerships team at Anthropic, you will be the technical lead for strategic ISV and technology partners building unique product integrations with Claude. These are software companies whose platforms are systems of record for their customers, and who want those customers to be able to work with their data and workflows directly inside Claude. This role goes deep with each partner. You will own the technical side of product partnerships from first scoping through launch and beyond. You will help partners design how their platform shows up in Claude (MCP servers, connectors, plugins, and skills), hold the quality bar through evaluations, and act as the bridge between the partner's product and engineering teams and Anthropic's Product, Engineering, and Research teams. You will be a trusted technical advisor to partner engineering leaders and executives, and you will turn what you learn into patterns and playbooks that make every future integration faster and better. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * **Technical ownership of strategic integrations:** Serve as the technical lead for strategic ISV and technology partners building product integrations with Claude. Own the technical plan from use\-case definition and scoping through build, launch, and post\-launch iteration. * **Integration architecture:** Advise partners on how to expose their platform to Claude, including MCP server design, tool and API surface design for large platforms, authentication and admin onboarding, permissions, and plugin and skill structure. Be opinionated about the patterns that lead to the best experience for joint customers. * **Evaluations and quality:** Design and run evaluations of partner integrations against the use cases that matter most to joint customers. Turn results into concrete, prioritized feedback for partner engineering teams and hold a high quality bar before launch. * **Hands\-on prototyping:** Build prototypes, demos, and reference skills that show partners the art of the possible, accelerate their build, and contribute to product improvements. * **Launch readiness:** Partner with Product, Partnerships, Marketing, and GTM teams to get integrations launch\-ready on partner\-driven timelines such as customer conferences and product events, and support partners and early customers through launch. * **Product and research feedback loop:** Act as the connective tissue between partners and Anthropic's Product, Engineering, and Research teams. Surface integration gaps and platform requirements, help shape the roadmap for how Claude works with third\-party software, and bring early capabilities to partners. * **Executive technical relationships:** Build trusted relationships with partner CTOs, product leaders, and engineering leads. Explain technical tradeoffs and Anthropic's point of view clearly to technical and executive audiences alike. * **Scale what works:** Codify reference architectures, integration best practices, evaluation approaches, self\-serve guidance, and playbooks so each new technology partnership starts from a stronger foundation, and help enable account teams and the broader partner ecosystem. * **Joint customer success:** Support account teams on strategic joint customers adopting partner integrations, and serve as an escalation point for complex technical issues. **You may be a good fit if you have** ------------------------------------- * 8\+ years of experience in technical customer\-facing or partner\-facing roles such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Partner Engineer, Developer Relations Engineer, or Technical Account Manager, or as a software engineer on platform, API, or integrations work * A track record of leading complex technical integrations with ISVs or technology partners, from solution design through launch * Deep experience with APIs, platform integration, and enterprise SaaS architecture, including authentication and authorization models, permissions, and admin experience * Hands\-on familiarity with LLM applications and agentic tooling, such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP), tool use, agents, and evaluation frameworks * Strong coding ability; you can build prototypes, write evals, and work in a real codebase (comfort with Python or TypeScript expected) * Exceptional ability to build relationships with and communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders, including C\-suite executives and engineering leaders * Product sense, and the judgment to know when to push a partner toward a better design and when to adapt to their co  degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience **Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience **Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position **Location\-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. **Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. **For roles performing work in California:** We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. **We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. **Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. **How we're different** ----------------------- We believe that the highest\-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large\-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long\-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest\-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT\-3, Circuit\-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI \& Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. **Come work with us!** ---------------------- Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:** Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: NOC Engineer – Network
jobs.description: **Company Overview:** Arctiq is a leader in professional IT services and managed services across three core Centers of Excellence: Enterprise Security, Modern Infrastructure, and Platform Engineering. Renowned for our ability to architect intelligence, we connect, protect, and transform organizations, empowering them to thrive in today's digital landscape. Arctiq builds on decades of industry expertise and a customer\-centric ethos to deliver exceptional value to clients across diverse industries. **Position Overview:** The NOC Engineer – Network owns second\-level network troubleshooting for the Managed Services NOC. You are the escalation point for L1 analysts: you take firewall, SD\-WAN, switching, wireless, VPN and carrier incidents to resolution, manage vendor and TAC cases, validate and apply security advisories and firmware updates, and escalate to Network Engineering only for design\-level issues. You also act as the day\-shift lead for the L1 team, coaching analysts and improving runbooks and alerting. **Responsibilities:** * Own L2 incidents escalated from the NOC, and troubleshoot connectivity, routing, VPN, firewall, SD\-WAN, switching and wireless issues to root cause. * Use remote access through collectors and jump hosts, device CLIs and monitoring data to isolate faults, and document each step taken. * Escalate to Network Engineering (L3/L4\) for design or architecture issues, with the findings and impact already attached. * Open and drive vendor TAC cases (for example Fortinet, SonicWall, Cisco and Meraki), including confirming upgrade paths and recovery steps before changes. * Lead carrier escalations for persistent circuit issues, and maintain accurate carrier, account and circuit details so L1 can open cases on the first call. * Assess security advisories and vendor notices against customer environments and perform firmware upgrades and configuration changes under change management. * Validate each change afterward and update the ticket and customer documentation. * Analyze repeat alerts, alert storms and recurring incidents, and work with Monitoring and Automation to tune thresholds, suppress noise and reduce ticket volume. * Raise and track problem records for recurring issues and report on trends and improvements. * Train L1 analysts on network triage and runbooks and help cross\-train them on backup and DR monitoring. * Write and maintain runbooks, knowledge articles and site and carrier documentation. * Participate in the NOC Engineer on\-call rotation (approximately one week in five) for swing and night network escalations, backed by Network Engineering. **Qualifications:** * 8\+ years of experience architecting and managing technical delivery for the Dynatrace platform, including both Managed and SaaS deployments. * Deep familiarity with configuration as code for Dynatrace. * Hands\-on integration experience with ServiceNow and the Atlassian product suite. * Deep knowledge of Gen2 to Gen3 Dynatrace migration. * Strong understanding of the current Dynatrace roadmap, including Bindplane and Arize. * Demonstrated SRE discipline, with concepts you have operationalized in customer environments. * Experience designing and delivering observability assessments that led to additional workstreams. * Experience evaluating other observability tools and building consolidation roadmaps onto Dynatrace. * Experience with FinOps practices. * Experience building automated remediation with Dynatrace Workflows and other ecosystem tools, including Ansible. * Understanding of AI observability, including monitoring of AI and LLM\-based workloads. * Active Dynatrace Associate certification. * High competency across core observability practices: tagging, synthetics, RUM, logging, and dashboards. * Experience designing customer journey stories to structure operations. * Deep familiarity with large enterprise customer processes and compliance concerns. * Ability to travel up to 35% for strategic sessions, kick\-offs, and close\-outs. * A strong, confident communicator who can conceptualize technical implementations for practitioners, business stakeholders, and executives. **Technical Requirements:** * 4–6 years of network support or engineering experience in a NOC, managed services or enterprise environment. * Solid routing and switching knowledge (OSPF, BGP, VLANs, spanning tree), WAN and carrier circuits, and VPN. * Hands\-on troubleshooting experience with firewalls (Fortinet, SonicWall, Cisco ASA or Palo Alto) and at least one SD\-WAN or wireless platform (CloudGenix or Prisma SD\-WAN, Silverpeak, Meraki). * Comfort working from the CLI and through remote\-access tools, with a structured troubleshooting method. * Experience with monitoring tools (LogicMonitor, BigPanda or similar) and an ITSM platform such as Jira Service Management. * Strong written communication, and the ability to coach less experienced engineers. * Ability to work days with an on\-call rotation, to occasionally work nights, weekends and holidays, and to be on site in Duluth, GA when needed. **Nice to have:** * Cisco CCNP Enterprise or CCNA, Fortinet NSE 4 or NSE 5, or Meraki certification. * Scripting or automation experience (Python, PowerShell, Ansible). * Familiarity with backup and recovery monitoring (Commvault, Cohesity, Veeam, Zerto) and ITIL Foundation. * Experience in a multi\-customer managed services environment. Arctiq is an equal opportunity employer. If you need any accommodations or adjustments throughout the interview process and beyond, please let us know. We celebrate our inclusive work environment and welcome members of all backgrounds and perspectives to apply. *We thank you for your interest in joining the Arctiq team! While we welcome all applicants, only those who are selected for an interview will be contacted.*

jobs.title: (Sr Dir) Head, AI Drug Discovery & Design
jobs.description: **Location** Cambridge, Massachusetts, United States **Job ID** R\-264912 **Date posted** 22/11/2026 **At Alexion, AstraZeneca Rare Disease**, we are innovators, leaders, and collaborators. At the heart of everything we do is an intense desire to pursue the toughest challenges and truly change the world for people living with rare and devastating diseases. **The role in brief** Research is making a deliberate move to put AI at the centre of how scientific decisions are made. We need a leader who will define what that means in practice: where AI creates a real scientific advantage, which bets to make first, and how to turn them into results that scientists adopt and leadership can see. As Senior Director, you will own the AI strategy for Research. You will begin where the leverage is greatest, in target discovery and molecule design, and then broaden the strategy as the evidence builds. You will design and launch the projects, lead the team that delivers them, and act as the voice of Research AI in enterprise conversations across AstraZeneca. **Why this role is different** * **Define the strategy, not just execute it.** The mandate is to decide where AI should and should not be used in Research, in what order, and with which partners. Shape the team, the operating model and the standards that define how AI is done in Research for years to come. * **Direct line to the science.** Work shoulder to shoulder with biologists and chemists on live discovery questions, in a setting where small patient populations and sparse data make smart methods essential. * **Enterprise reach with start\-up agency.** Access to the scale, data and platforms of a global pharma company, while leading a small, effective team that moves quickly and owns its outcomes. * **Visibility.** This senior role works directly with Research leaders and enterprise AI forums, where your recommendations influence investment and strategic direction. **What you will do** **Set the AI strategy for Research** * Define a multi\-year vision and roadmap for AI in Research, grounded in where AI can change scientific decisions and speed, not where the technology is merely fashionable. * Start with target discovery and molecule design, and set out how and when the strategy extends to other parts of the research value chain. * Make clear build, buy and partner choices, and shape the technical architecture and standards the team works to. * Track the external landscape, from frontier models to emerging partners, and translate it into practical direction for Research. **Design the projects and deliver the results** * Turn strategy into a focused portfolio of projects with clear scientific hypotheses, defined success criteria, named owners and credible plans. * Run projects with rigor: pilot quickly, learn, and decide with evidence whether to scale, adapt or stop. * Embed outputs in the way scientists actually work, so that AI informs real programs and decisions rather than sitting in a demo. * Be accountable for delivery and for the quality, validity and reliability of what the team produces. **Lead and build the team** * Use the dedicated budget and resources to build the team: define the roles and skills needed, recruit exceptional computational scientists and technical leaders, and set a high bar for scientific and engineering craft. * Create a culture where scientists across disciplines want to collaborate with the team and where the team’s best ideas are heard. * Set priorities, clarify ownership and grow future leaders. **Represent Research across AstraZeneca** * Be the face of Research AI in enterprise discussions on strategy, platforms, data, investment and priorities. * Influence enterprise roadmaps so that tools and capabilities built centrally work for the needs of rare disease research and bring back what is relevant for Research to adopt. * Develop external relationships with academic groups, technology companies and the wider AI\-for\-science community. **Partner on data and decision intelligence** * Work with the Head of Data, AI \& Decision Intelligence and fellow leaders to make sure the data, platforms and governance needed for ambitious AI exist and are fit for purpose. * Provide scientific and strategic input across the wider portfolio of AI and decision\-support work in Research, so that efforts reinforce each other. * Promote responsible, transparent AI, with the validation and oversight that scientists and leaders need in order to trust results. **Qualifications** **Required** * PhD in computational biology, machine learning, computational or medicinal chemistry, bioinformatics, or a related quantitative life\-science field. * 10\+ years of post\-PhD experience applying machine learning and AI to drug discovery or biology in biotech, pharma or a technology\-enabled discovery company, including 5\+ years leading ML or data science teams at Director level or above. * Demonstrated ability to lead both target discovery and molecule design AI, with credible depth in each and a track record of linking the two. * Hands\-on experience in small\-molecule discovery AI, such as generative design, structure\-based modelling or co\-folding, ADMET and toxicity prediction, and design–make–test–learn cycles. * Experience in target discovery AI, such as single\-cell or perturbation data, functional genomics, causal inference, and foundation models for biology. * Proven record of delivering measurable business or pipeline impact from AI, including defining KPIs and making stage\-gate decisions. * Strong leadership of small, senior\-skilled teams and of cross\-functional matrix delivery with wet\-lab scientists, chemists, engineers and IT, without relying on formal authority. * Excellent communication with senior leaders and scientists; comfortable translating technical trade\-offs into business terms. **Preferred** * Experience in rare or genetically defined disease, or with small patient populations and limited data. * Experience with lab\-in\-the\-loop and active\-learning workflows, CRISPR perturbation screens, and patient\-derived models. * Familiarity with agentic workflows, LLM\-enabled automation, knowledge graphs and MLOps. * Experience adopting enterprise AI platforms from a larger parent organization, and managing vendors and academic collaborations. * Exposure to biologics or genomic medicine design and safety. * Experience contributing to data strategy, FAIR data practices and data governance. * Publications, patents or other external recognition in AI for drug discovery. **Leadership attributes** * **Scientific credibility:** earns trust from biologists and chemists by engaging deeply with the science, not only the models. * **Outcome orientation:** focuses on value and decisions, and is willing to stop work that is not paying off. * **Builder and coach:** develops people, sets high standards, and creates clear ownership in a small team. * **Collaborator:** works easily across Research, IT, Data, and AstraZeneca enterprise teams. The annual base pay for this position ranges from $203 213,60 \- 304 820,40 USD Annual. Our positions offer eligibility for various incentives—an opportunity to receive short\-term incentive bonuses, equity\-based awards for salaried roles and commissions for sales roles. Benefits offered include qualified retirement programs, paid time off (i.e., vacation, holiday, and leaves), as well as health, dental, and vision coverage in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans. When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life\-changing medicines. In\-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world. **Date Posted** 23\-nov.\-2026 **Closing Date** 13\-dec.\-2026 Our mission is to build an inclusive environment where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. In furtherance of that mission, we welcome and consider applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of their protected characteristics. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please complete the corresponding section in the application form.

jobs.description: At Audible, we believe stories have the power to transform lives. We are dreamers and inventors who come from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences to empower and inspire each other. Imagine your future with us. ABOUT THE TEAM Every time a customer presses play on Audible, whether on a morning commute, a long run, or the last chapter before bed, playback should start right away and run without interruptions or errors. The Playback Insights \& Optimizations team makes that happen at global scale, for millions of listeners on every device they use. The team built and owns Audible's playback insights platform, which brings together a large set of data to produce insights used across the Playback organization. The team uses those insights to understand how customers experience playback and to find where it can get better. It then makes the changes and measures the results to confirm they helped. The team also uses machine\-learning anomaly detection to catch problems early, often before customers notice. When something looks wrong, the team is usually first to investigate. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience. Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well\-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20\+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non\-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics. **About BAE Systems, Inc.** BAE Systems, Inc. is a defense, aerospace, and security company headquartered in Falls Church, Virginia, with more than 40,000 employees worldwide. We serve, supply, and protect those who protect us. As one of the most geographically diverse international defense companies, we deliver a full range of products and services spanning air, land, maritime, space, and cyber, including advanced electronics, intelligence solutions, and dedicated customer support. Our culture is performance\-driven and values\-led, built on curiosity, creativity, and collaboration. Purpose isn't a tagline here. It's what drives us. jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, Full Stack
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Join an early engineering team building AI\-powered software that helps small businesses manage operations and grow. You will take customer problems from discovery through production, working across the stack to build dependable tools and AI\-driven workflows. ### **What You'll Do** * Scope and ship complete features, from backend services and data models to user interfaces, then learn from how customers use them. * Build integrations with business systems such as CRMs, accounting tools, email, phone, and SMS, including systems with non\-standard APIs. * Develop data models and pipelines that organize business records into useful context for AI agents. * Build agent capabilities including retrieval, tool use, evaluation, and human approval workflows. * Debug issues across third\-party APIs, application data, and model outputs, and address their root causes. * Contribute to code review, AI\-assisted development workflows, and engineering practices for a fast\-moving team. ### **What We're Looking For** * At least 8 years of full\-stack engineering experience shipping products across backend, frontend, and data layers. * A track record of taking products from zero to real users, ideally in a startup or as an early engineer. * Experience building product features with LLMs, including prompting, retrieval, tool use, and evaluations. * Experience integrating third\-party systems or building data pipelines with messy or non\-standard APIs. * Strong fundamentals in data structures, systems design, and debugging, with the ability to solve problems across multiple layers. * Experience using AI\-first development tools in day\-to\-day work; production experience with agent reliability, evaluation tools, or guardrails is a plus. * Experience designing human\-in\-the\-loop workflows or mobile and mobile\-web experiences is also useful. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary range: $200,000 to $300,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is available. ### **Location** Hybrid in San Francisco, California. Compensation Range: $200K \- $300K

jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Join a product engineering team building a platform and marketplace for reinforcement learning environments. You will own end\-to\-end product problems that help environment creators and research teams create, discover, test, and evaluate AI agent workflows. ### **What You'll Do** * Partner with product, design, engineering, research, and go\-to\-market teams to understand user needs and prioritize improvements. * Talk with environment creators and research teams to uncover friction in creating, testing, evaluating, and discovering environments. * Define, prototype, ship, and iterate on improvements across platform and marketplace experiences. * Build frontend and backend features for onboarding, environment submission, review, and discovery workflows. * Design interfaces that make agent runs, evaluation results, reward signals, and quality feedback clear and actionable. * Use user feedback and product data to assess results and inform product tradeoffs. ### **What We're Looking For** * Experience shipping software products end to end, from user problem discovery through implementation and iteration. * Full\-stack web development experience, including polished frontend interfaces and backend services or APIs. * Experience designing and shipping product improvements across a platform, with strong interaction design and usability judgment for complex technical workflows. * Experience conducting user interviews and applying qualitative feedback and product data to improve products. * Technical education or strong technical fundamentals, and the ability to make sound scope and tradeoff decisions amid uncertainty. * Background in developer tools, data\-rich products, marketplaces, or products serving distinct user groups is valuable. * Familiarity with AI agents, evaluations, reinforcement learning, training data, or workflows for review, debugging, and quality feedback is valuable. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary range: $100,000 to $225,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is available. ### **Location** On\-site in San Francisco, California, or remote. Compensation Range: $100K \- $225K

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Join an early\-stage team building AI\-powered software and infrastructure for automating supply chain integrations. You will help shape foundational systems that connect the agent platform with a reliable runtime for integrations. ### **What You'll Do** * Design and build purpose\-specific AI coding agents for supply chain connectivity. * Develop and maintain infrastructure for hosting and running integrations. * Own core systems end to end, from agent tooling to integration runtimes, and make key architectural decisions. * Establish engineering patterns and practices as the team and product grow. * Work across agentic software and backend infrastructure, including orchestration and cloud systems. ### **What We're Looking For** * Two to five years of experience as a full\-stack or backend software engineer. * Proficiency in TypeScript and modern full\-stack development, with experience in technologies such as React, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, and AWS. * Hands\-on experience building with AI agents or LLMs using current development patterns. * A track record of autonomous, hands\-on engineering and building products or systems from scratch in an early\-stage environment. * Experience with backend or infrastructure systems such as runtimes, orchestration, or cloud platforms, beyond product UI work. * Strong engineering fundamentals, demonstrated through relevant education, early\-stage company experience, founding work, or substantial technical projects. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** * Base salary: $150,000 to $300,000 annually. * Visa sponsorship is available. ### **Location** On\-site in San Francisco, California. Compensation Range: $150K \- $300K

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer (Cloud Infrastructure)
jobs.description: Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster. We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy\-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI. We're looking for problem\-solving, opportunity\-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services. If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high\-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe. ### **About the Role:** We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Fleet Operations Engineer to join Crusoe’s Fleet Operations team. This role is focused on the advanced diagnosis, maintenance, and repair of high\-performance GPU compute clusters, ensuring maximum uptime, reliability, and performance across our fleet. The ideal candidate will be hands\-on with GPU rack\-level troubleshooting/Hyperscaler Cloud Infrastructure and work closely with data center operations, engineering, and vendors to support cutting\-edge infrastructure featuring the latest NVIDIA and AMD GPUs. This position plays a critical role in maintaining the health and scalability of Crusoe’s rapidly growing GPU fleet. ### **What You’ll Be Doing:** * Automate deep\-level diagnosis and troubleshooting of hardware faults within GPU racks and high\-density compute systems. * Develop software to troubleshoot and support GPU platforms including NVIDIA A100, H200, GB200, B200, B300 and AMD 350X / 355X. * Execute component\-level diagnosis and remediation for failed or degraded hardware. * Partner with data center operations to manage and perform field\-replaceable unit (FRU) repairs for GPUs, power supplies, cooling systems, interconnects, and networking hardware. * Implement and execute preventative maintenance procedures to improve fleet reliability and extend hardware lifespan. * Develop automation tools to streamline server provisioning and reduce SLA times. * Develop and update standard operating procedures (SOPs) for troubleshooting, repair, and validation workflows. * Transition Crusoe’s environment to Kubernetes and containerized workflows. * Participate in a rotating infrastructure on\-call schedule (about one week every 4–6 weeks) with daytime coverage and handoff to the Europe team. ### **What You’ll Bring to the Team:** * Strong managing/administration experience in one of the cloud providers(GCP, AWS, Azure) * Strong experience building CI/CD pipeline for modern software development and delivery * Strong hands\-on experience with Kubernetes, covering core administration or application development. * Proven background utilizing source control systems, specifically GitLab, GitHub, within software engineering workflows. * Demonstrated familiarity with container platforms and runtime environments, with a strong preference for Docker. * Strong Linux experience (Ubuntu, Rocky Linux, CentOS) using the command line for diagnostics and testing. * Experience working with enterprise server hardware, power delivery, and cooling systems. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills. * Excellent communication and collaboration skills. * Ability to work independently in a fast\-paced data center or operations environment. ### **Nice to Have:** * Technical certification or Associate’s/Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field or demonstrated experience. * Experience working directly with hardware vendors and escalations. * Background in large\-scale GPU fleet operations or hyperscale data center environments. **Benefits:** * Hybrid work schedule * Industry competitive pay * Restricted Stock Units in a fast growing, well\-funded technology company * Health insurance package options that include HDHP and PPO, vision, and dental for you and your dependents * Employer contributions to HSA accounts * Paid Parental Leave * Paid life insurance, short\-term and long\-term disability * Teladoc * 401(k) with a 100% match up to 4% of salary * Generous paid time off and holiday schedule * Cell phone reimbursement * Tuition reimbursement * Subscription to the Calm app * MetLife Legal * Company paid commuter benefit; $300 per pay period **Compensation Range:** Compensation will be paid in the range of $215,000 \- $260,000\. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicants knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

jobs.title: AI/ML Engineer
jobs.description: **Entity:** CSL Behring **Job Category:** Information Technology **Job Family:** Applications **Job Type:** Full Time **Location****:** Boca Raton, Florida, United States **Employer Reference:** R\-293990 **Job Description** ------------------- **Key Responsibilities:** **1\. AI/ML Solution Development** * Design, build, train, and evaluate machine learning models for use cases including predictive analytics, natural language processing, anomaly detection, recommendation systems, and donor behavior modeling * Develop and maintain end\-to\-end ML pipelines from data ingestion and feature engineering through model training, validation, and deployment * Implement generative AI solutions and LLM\-based workflows using technologies like AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, or open\-source frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex , LangGraph). Design retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) systems as the default pattern for knowledge\-intensive workflows before considering fine\-tuning * Finetune generative and open\-weight models where prompt engineering and RAG do not achieve the required quality, cost, or latency. Apply fine\-tuning judiciously given the ongoing maintenance and evaluation burden it creates * Design agentic workflows where multi\-step reasoning, tool use, or orchestration is required. Apply agentic patterns judiciously; single\-shot prompts and RAG remain the right answer for most use cases * Extend model applications to multi\-modal inputs (text, structured data, and where relevant images and documents) as use cases require **2\. AI Operations \& Production Deployment** * Build and maintain MLOps infrastructure including model registries, automated retraining pipelines, A/B testing frameworks, and model monitoring dashboards * Deploy models to production using technologies like AWS SageMaker, Azure ML, or containerized services (Docker/Kubernetes) with appropriate CI/CD integration * Monitor deployed models for data drift, performance degradation, and bias; implement remediation strategies and retraining triggers * Establish and maintain evaluation harnesses for LLM and RAG systems. Write evaluations that run automatically on every prompt, model, or code change and act as the quality gate for production deployment. Frameworks such as Ragas, LangSmith, DeepEval, or evals\-as\-code implementations * Implement LLM and agent observability distinct from classical model monitoring. Cover prompt and response logging, trace visualization, prompt drift detection, and runtime debugging of agent workflows. Frameworks such as Langfuse, Helicone, Arize AI, or WhyLab * Apply version control, review, and deployment discipline to prompts and prompt templates. Treat prompts as code, not configuration * Implement guardrail patterns for content safety, PII redaction, output validation, and jailbreak resistance. In regulated donor and medical contexts these are not optional. Frameworks such as NeMo Guardrails, Guardrails AI, or equivalent * Manage inference cost as a first\-class operational discipline. Track token usage, tier models to task complexity (cheap models for cheap tasks, more capable models only where required), apply caching strategies, and measure cost per successful outcome **3\. Integration of AI into Product Platforms** * Collaborate with integration developers to embed ML model inference into MuleSoft, Informatica, UiPath, and AWS Step Functions pipelines * Expose ML capabilities as secure, low\-latency APIs consumed by the Donor App, web platforms, and internal operational tools * Evaluate and implement AI\-enhanced automation across QA, scheduling, and payments workflows using the UiPath platform, freeing operational capacity for higher\-value donor interactions and improving decisions where accuracy has business consequences * Serve as the internal capability provider for AI features, already in production that are consumed by other product teams. Establish the patterns other engineers will adopt as AI use cases multiply across the ecosystem **4\. Data Engineering \& Feature Development** * Develop and maintain feature stores and data transformation pipelines that supply high\-quality, well\-governed training and inference data * Partner with the Data Engineer on the shared data capability, including the Data Backbone initiative. Contribute the AI\-facing requirements early so that data contracts, quality thresholds, freshness expectations, and lineage cover both classical ML training and generative AI retrieval needs * Apply data augmentation, synthetic data generation, and class balancing techniques to address data scarcity in regulated domains **5\. Governance, Compliance \& Ethics** * Ensure all AI/ML solutions comply with applicable regulations including HIPAA, GDPR, and 21 CFR Part 11 for models used in GxP contexts * Document model design, training methodology, validation results, and known limitations in accordance with CSL quality and regulatory standards * Apply responsible AI principles including exp ** * Prior AI or ML work in pharma/biotech, life sciences, healthcare, or a comparably regulated setting with formal model validation practice * Knowledge of responsible AI frameworks, model explainability tools (SHAP, LIME), and bias detection * Familiarity with healthcare data standards (HL7 FHIR) or regulatory validation in GxP environments * Experience with time\-series forecasting, NLP for clinical or operational text, or computer vision * AWS Certified Machine Learning Specialty or equivalent certification * Hands\-on experience with the UiPath platform (for example, UiPath Studio, Orchestrator, AI Center, and Document Understanding) to integrate AI/ML and generative AI models into automated business workflows. * Technical training or certification in vendor\-specific technology, such as UiPath (for example, UiPath Certified Professional) **Competencies** * Intellectual Curiosity — continuously explores new AI techniques and evaluates their practical applicability to business challenges * Product Mindset — prioritizes AI solutions that deliver measurable, production\-ready value over academic experimentation * Responsible Innovation — applies ethical AI principles and ensures compliance without sacrificing performance * Cross\-Functional Collaboration — works effectively across data, product, engineering, and regulatory teams * Communicates with Clarity — explains complex model behavior and trade\-offs to diverse technical and non\-technical audiences Evaluation\-Driven Mindset * \- Writes evaluations before deploying. Uses them as the safety net for every prompt, model, or code change. Treats production AI as a system to be evaluated continuously, not a model to be trained once Production Ownership * \- Owns AI systems in production, not just at training time. Investigates drift, responds to on\-call, reruns evaluations after changes, and treats the reliability of AI in production with the same discipline applied to any other production system **About CSL Behring** --------------------- CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients' needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives. CSL Behring operates one of the world's largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries. To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit https://www.csl.com/ and CSL Plasma at https://www.cslplasma.com/. **Our Benefits** ---------------- For more information on CSL benefits visit How CSL Supports Your Well\-being \| CSL. **You Belong at CSL** --------------------- At CSL, Inclusion and Belonging is at the core of our mission and who we are. It fuels our innovation day in and day out. By celebrating our differences and creating a culture of curiosity and empathy, we are able to better understand and connect with our patients and donors, foster strong relationships with our stakeholders, and sustain a diverse workforce that will move our company and industry into the future. To learn more about inclusion and belonging visit https://www.csl.com/careers/inclusion\-and\-belonging **Equal Opportunity Employer** ------------------------------ CSL is an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you are an individual with a disability and need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, please visit https://www.csl.com/accessibility\-statement.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time. **Position Summary** This Data Engineer will be involved in all facets of data ingest and export for Wellpartner. They are responsible for ensuring that data received from external parties (such as our Covered Entity and Contract Pharmacy partners and drug wholesalers) are successfully ingested and available for processing in our transactional system, while also ensuring that file extracts for external business partners are produced and delivered on the agreed upon schedule. Responsibilities include but no limited to: * Develop pipelines to extract, transform, and load (ETL) data from CVS Health pharmacy claims systems, 340B third\-party administrator (TPA) platforms, Covered entity eligibility files, Drug inventory and pricing systems. * Implement data validation rules within SSIS/Python to ensure compliance with 340B program requirements (e.g., patient eligibility, drug utilization). * Support incremental and full data loads to accommodate daily, weekly, and monthly data warehouse refresh cycles. * Integrate data from disparate formats (e.g., CSV, XML, flat files, and relational databases) into a centralized SQL Server data warehouse. * Ensure data quality through error checking and data validation using T\-SQL and SSIS among other tools. **Required Qualifications** * High proficiency with SQL/T\-SQL, SSIS, and Python * Deep understanding of stored procedures, as well as T\-SQL queries. * Knowledge of data relationships, querying / processing data, and designing well\-structured data flows. * Experience with C\# is nice to have **Preferred Qualifications** * Healthcare industry experience. * 340B experience * Performance tuning processes and T\-SQL **Education** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics or Information Technology or equivalent work experience. **Anticipated Weekly Hours** 40**Time Type** Full time**Pay Range** The typical pay range for this role is: $79,310\.00 \- $158,620\.00 This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full\-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls.
