jobs.title: Senior Marketing Manager
jobs.description: Pleasanton, CA **About****Calfus** Calfus builds Aetherion, the agentic AI platform for the enterprise. Companies use it to turn manual, human\-run processes into autonomous, governed agent workflows, and everything we build and sell runs on it. Our forward\-deployed engineers (FDEs) embed with customers to take Aetherion live against their hardest, highest\-value processes, working from Pleasanton, Redmond, Vancouver, Pune, and Bangalore. That work spans healthcare revenue cycle, supply chain, background screening, and enterprise systems, and we stay engaged through go\-live and beyond. It is platform speed with the reliability of a team that has done this before. Our FDEs are how customers get to production fast; Aetherion is what they keep running. If you want to build governed, production\-grade agents and see your work running inside real enterprises, you’ll fit in here. **About the role** You’ll be our first marketer in the U.S., working closely with our sales and alliance teams and our cloud partners. This is a hands\-on role. You won’t start from a blank page. A 12\-month go\-to\-market plan, playbooks, and templates will be in place when you arrive. Your job is to put that plan to work, focus on the programs that build pipeline, and use pipeline data and buyer behavior to decide where to invest next. As results come in, you’ll adjust the plan and help shape what comes next. We’re looking for someone with 6 to 8 years of experience who still gets excited about the work, understands how technical buyers make decisions, and wants to build something with a team over the long term. Join the team taking agentic AI from pilot to production for the world’s largest enterprises. Few marketers get to launch an enterprise AI platform in the U.S. market from the ground floor. jobs.title: Junior Software Developer – Print & Packaging
jobs.description: **Junior Software Developer – Print \& Packaging** ================================================== **Company:** PackOS / Calyx Containers **Location:** West Valley City, Utah (On\-site) **Employment Type:** Full\-Time **Experience Level:** Entry\-Level / Junior **Compensation:** Competitive, based on experience **About PackOS** ---------------- PackOS is building the operating system for the print and packaging industry. Our mission is to connect the entire packaging production process from customer requests and artwork submission to quoting, prepress, manufacturing, quality control, and order fulfillment, through intelligent software and automation. PackOS is being developed alongside Calyx Containers, a vertically integrated packaging manufacturer with real\-world production capabilities in digital printing, labels, flexible packaging, and rigid containers. Unlike traditional software companies, we build and test our technology directly inside an operating manufacturing facility. **About the Role** ------------------ We are looking for a **Junior Software Developer with hands\-on experience in printing, packaging, or prepress** to help build the next generation of manufacturing software. This is a unique opportunity for someone who understands how a print shop or packaging operation works and wants to transition into software development. You don't need to be an experienced software engineer. We are looking for someone with a technical mindset, basic programming knowledge with AI tools like Codex/ Claude Code, Antigravity, and a genuine interest in building software that solves real manufacturing problems. You will work closely with experienced developers, production operators, and company leadership to build practical software solutions that improve how packaging is designed, quoted, manufactured, and delivered. You will also use modern AI\-assisted development tools to accelerate your work while learning professional software engineering practices. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ **Software Development** * Develop and improve features within the PackOS platform. * Build user interfaces, dashboards, and internal tools. * Assist with coding, debugging, testing, and maintaining applications. * Work with APIs, databases, and manufacturing system integrations. * Use AI\-assisted coding tools such as Claude Code and other modern development environments. * Review, test, and validate AI\-generated code with guidance from senior developers. **Printing \& Packaging Automation** * Help automate artwork intake, preflight checks, quoting, and production workflows. * Translate real\-world print shop operations into software requirements. * Support integration with print MIS, ERP, and manufacturing equipment. * Assist in developing tools for production tracking, machine data collection, and quality control. * Work directly with operators to understand production challenges and test software improvements. **Collaboration \& Learning** * Work alongside the software development team to build and release new features. * Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and product testing. * Learn modern web development tools and software engineering practices. * Troubleshoot issues directly on the manufacturing floor. * Document technical processes and software functionality. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- We are primarily looking for someone who combines **print or packaging industry experience with foundational software development skills**. * Hands\-on experience in commercial printing, labels, packaging manufacturing, or prepress. * Basic programming knowledge, demonstrated through coursework, personal projects, professional experience, or self\-directed learning. * Familiarity with at least one programming language, such as JavaScript, TypeScript, or Python. * Basic understanding of how software applications, databases, or APIs work. * Ability to troubleshoot technical problems and learn new systems. * Strong attention to detail and willingness to work directly with manufacturing teams. * Interest in AI, automation, and modern software development. A computer science degree is not required. Relevant industry experience, demonstrated technical ability, and a strong willingness to learn are more important. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- Experience with any of the following is a plus, but not required: **Print \& Packaging** * Digital printing, especially HP Indigo equipment * Flexographic printing and label converting * Flexible packaging production * Adobe Illustrator and print production workflows * Dielines, color separations, PDF preflight, and artwork preparation * Print MIS systems such as LabelTraxx or Radius * Manufacturing ERP systems such as NetSuite **Software \& Technology** * JavaScript / TypeScript * React and Node.js * SQL and PostgreSQL * REST APIs and system integrations * Git and GitHub * Claude Code or other AI coding assist --------------------------------------- **Learn software development inside a real factory.** You will have direct access to production equipment, manufacturing operators, and real\-world workflows while helping develop the software that supports them. **Work with modern AI technology.** Our development approach incorporates AI\-assisted programming, workflow automation, and intelligent software systems. **Build technology with immediate impact.** Rather than working on abstract projects, you will help solve actual manufacturing problems and see your software used in production. **Grow into a software engineering career.** You will work with experienced engineers and develop practical skills in full\-stack development, manufacturing technology, and AI\-driven applications. **Benefits** ------------ * Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience * Health insurance benefits * 401(k) retirement plan * Professional development and mentorship * Hands\-on exposure to advanced manufacturing and AI technology * Opportunity for career growth as PackOS expands MORE ABOUT US: Our team is composed of bright, hardworking, creative, and highly motivated individuals looking to make an impact on the world. We seek like\-minded colleagues who share our values and want to apply their experience, energy, and enthusiasm to help grow and scale a dynamic business in a rapidly expanding industry. The Calyx Containers culture fosters the personal and professional growth in a challenging and rewarding environment. We operate at a fast pace, demand high personal standards, and offer everyone the opportunity to contribute, skill\-build, and develop their talents. Benefits and Perks offered to full time employees: * Flexible Paid Time Off \-Comprehensive benefits offerings including: Medical (with company\-funded HRA), Dental, Vision, Short\- and Long\-Term Disability Insurance, Life Insurance, Headspace Care Mental Health support...all effective the first day of the month following hire. * 401(k) * Ability to make an immediate impact * Monthly team meetings and frequent social events An ideal Calyx candidate looks like: * Has experience in the cannabis and/or packaging industry * Thrives in a fast\-paced environment * Handles ambiguity with a positive attitude * Rolls up their sleeves to help their team How success is measured at Calyx: First 30 days spent getting to know the company and our team! Ability to make an immediate impact \- we’re growing quickly and want you to help cultivate that! Living our core values: \-X\-treme Ownership * \-Be Quick, But Don’t Hurry * \-Sustainability Is Multi\-Dimensional * \-We Are Square: Quality Does Not Cut Corners * \-Customer Is The Only Boss * \-Earn Success Every Day * \-The Biggest Failure Is The Failure To Ask For Help * \-Better Together: Cultivate An Inclusive Environment Calyx Containers is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe strongly in fair hiring practices and in creating a welcoming environment for all team members. Diversity drives innovation; inclusion drives success. We believe a multitude of approaches and ideas enable us to deliver the best results for our workforce, workplace, and customers. jobs.title: Data & AI Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: Catholic Charities Fort Worth is seeking a **Data \& AI Solutions Engineer** to build secure data and AI solutions that expand organizational learning capacity. This role is responsible for designing, building, testing, deploying, and supporting practical solutions that improve decision\-making, service delivery, and organizational effectiveness. You will connect data, systems, and organizational knowledge to develop trusted AI capabilities, including intelligent agents and multi\-agent solutions that combine governed data with approved document context. Success in this role requires strong technical judgment. You'll determine what works, why it works, and whether it should be deployed. **This role may be a fit if you:** * Prefer evidence over assumptions * Are highly analytical and detail\-oriented, with a commitment to accuracy * Enjoy evaluating technology, not just implementing it * Like solving complex problems with incomplete information * Can translate organizational challenges into scalable, secure systems * Are comfortable being the expert others rely upon The ideal candidate brings a bachelor's degree in a related field and at least three years of relevant experience. Experience in nonprofit, human services, education, healthcare, or other mission\-driven environments is preferred. **Top Accountabilities** * Develop Data and AI Capabilities * Connect Data, Systems \& Organizational Knowledge * Deliver Trusted \& Responsible Solutions * Support Adoption, Learning \& Continuous Improvement **What Will You Be Doing?** **Develop Data and AI Capabilities** * + Design, build, test, deploy, and support practical data and AI solutions that improve service delivery, decision\-making, and organizational capacity. + Develop retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) applications that combine governed organizational data and documents with large language models to produce grounded, cited responses subject to appropriate human review. + Translate program and operational needs into clear technical requirements, prototypes, production solutions, and reusable components in collaboration with program, evaluation, data, and technology stakeholders. + Develop data agents and multi\-agent solutions that combine governed structured data with approved document context and clearly distinguish source evidence from generated interpretation. + Evaluate models, retrieval approaches, agents, and solution designs for accuracy, groundedness, cost, latency, security, maintainability, and mission value; document tradeoffs and recommendations. **Connect Data, Systems \& Organizational Knowledge** * + Build and maintain solutions on the organization’s cloud data platform (currently Microsoft Fabric), including warehouse and Lakehouse components, data pipelines, medallion data flows, identity\-resolution routines, and secure integrations with enterprise systems and APIs. + Implement governed ingestion of approved organizational documents using metadata, document\-processing, and search services while preserving source, version, effective\-date, ownership, and access\-control information. + Develop context\-registry data and metadata that link documents to programs, measures, versions, and effective dates so analytics and AI use the applicable organizational context. + Support certified semantic models and implement approved glossary terms, measures, descriptions, synonyms, lineage, stewardship metadata, sensitivity labels, data\-quality controls, and data loss prevention requirements established through the organization’s data governance program and tools. + Build hybrid, vector, and semantic retrieval capabilities with security trimming, de\-identified or minimum\-necessary AI\-facing data, and row\-level security that provide the governed retrieval foundation for RAG applications and other AI solutions. **Deliver Trusted \& Responsible Solutions** * + Configure answer provenance so AI outputs identify the measures, data sources, and cited document passages, versions, and dates used to generate each response. + Create and maintain an evaluation gold set of validated questions and use repeatable correctness and groundedness testing after material changes to data, definitions, indexes, models, or prompts. + Implement human\-review controls and reviewer routing for low\-confidence or flagged outputs; ensure AI\-generated content does not become an approved definition, finding, or program decision without appropriate review. + Apply version control, deployment pipelines, automated testing, monitoring, logging, error handling, and audit records so solutions are reliable, supportable, and traceable. **Support Adoption, Learning \& Continuous Improvement** * + Create technical documentation, architecture diagrams, data flows, support procedures, configuration records, and end\-user guidance; provide demonstrations and hands\-on support for responsible adoption. + Use preview and emerging capabilities in bounded pilots, maintain production sys Python and SQL * Experience designing and consuming REST APIs and working with structured and unstructured data * Experience with cloud data platforms, data pipelines, dimensional and/or medallion architectures, data quality, and identity resolution * Experience with generative AI and retrieval patterns, including embeddings, hybrid or vector search, RAG, agents, evaluation, citations or provenance, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls * Working knowledge of Power BI semantic models and data\-governance practices such as business glossaries, stewardship metadata, lineage, sensitivity labeling, DLP, access controls, row\-level security, and minimum\-necessary data * Experience with Git\-based version control, deployment pipelines, automated testing, monitoring, logging, documentation, and change management * Demonstrated ability to turn unclear organizational needs into practical, secure, maintainable solutions, access emerging capabilities, and explain technical tradeoffs to non\-technical stakeholders * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and cross\-functional collaboration skills Strongly Preferred: * Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Fabric (including Warehouse, Lakehouse, and Data Factory) or comparable cloud data platforms * Experience with Microsoft Azure AI services (including Azure AI Search, Azure AI Document Intelligence, Microsoft Foundry, and Fabric data agents) or comparable AI services * Experience in nonprofit, human services, education, healthcare, or another mission\-driven environment **Here's the Good Stuff...** * **Full\-time position with a starting salary of $100,000**. jobs.title: AI Engineer IV
jobs.description: **Who we are…** Cell Signaling Technology (CST) is a different kind of life sciences company, one founded, owned, and run by active research scientists, with the highest standards of product and service quality, technological innovation, and scientific rigor for over 20 years. We consistently provide fellow scientists around the globe with best\-in\-class products and services to fuel their quests for discovery. Helping researchers find new solutions is our main mission every day, but it's not our only mission. We're also dedicated to helping identify solutions to other problems facing our world. We believe that all businesses must be responsible and work in partnership with local communities, while seeking to minimize their environmental impact. That's why we joined 1% for the Planet as its first life science member, and have committed to achieving net\-zero emissions by 2029\. **The role...** The AI Engineer designs, builds, measures and runs the AI agents CST employees use every day. You will build custom agents, configure agent frameworks, and connect assistants such as Claude to CST data and tools through MCP servers and skills. Above all, this role is about building agents that give correct answers. At CST, a confident wrong answer about a product, a target or a customer is worse than no answer. Your agents must ground every answer in the data and context they have, and recognize when a question goes beyond what that context supports. When it does, they say so clearly, show what they do and don't know, and point users to the right source or person. You are also CST's guide to a field that changes every month. You decide, with stakeholders, which new capabilities to adopt now and which to hold back. The goal is to keep CST current without losing the stability teams need to get work done. You are the public face of AI at CST: you train users, gather their feedback and turn it into better agents. **What you will do...** Build and run agents * Design, deploy and operate AI agents that answer questions and do work across CST's scientific, commercial and operational domains. * Turn business problems into well\-scoped agent use cases, and prioritize them by value, feasibility and risk. * Build bespoke agents in code where off\-the\-shelf tools fall short, using agent SDKs, tool calling and retrieval. * Configure and manage agent frameworks on our platform, such as Snowflake Cortex Agents, Cortex Analyst and Cortex Search. * Enable assistants such as Claude across CST by building and maintaining MCP servers, connectors and skills. * Design the tool layer agents use: tool schemas, permission scopes, access controls, audit trails and error handling. * Build the retrieval layer for unstructured content such as data sheets, protocols and publications: embeddings, chunking, vector search and retrieval quality. * Design multi\-agent workflows where specialized agents hand off tasks and share context. * Own agents in production: monitoring, incident response, cost and safe handling of confidential data. Measure and improve * Define what "good" means for each agent: accuracy, groundedness, task completion, latency, cost and user satisfaction. * Measure how well agents know their limits: how often they answer correctly, decline correctly, or answer when they should have declined. * Build evaluation sets and automated regression tests, and run them before and after every change. * Instrument agents with logging, tracing and evaluation hooks so they can be trusted, debugged and improved in production. * Tune agents through prompts, instructions, tools, retrieval and model choice, based on evidence rather than anecdote. Shape the semantic foundation * Advise data engineers and intelligence and insight engineers on ontologies, semantic models and metric definitions that let agents reason correctly about CST data. * Help define how core business concepts (products, targets, applications, customers, orders) are named, related and governed, so agents and people get the same answer. Set the pace of adoption * Track progress in models, agent frameworks and tools, and test what matters for CST. * Recommend what to adopt, pilot or wait on, balancing the cost of falling behind against the need for stable tools. * Keep a clear roadmap and change process so users know what is changing and when. Be the face of AI at CST * Train users through workshops, office hours, demos and self\-serve guides. * Manage stakeholders across business, science and IT: gather needs, set expectations, report results and secure support. * Keep documentation current: agent catalog, how\-to guides, evaluation results, architecture and runbooks. Work as part of the data team * Collaborate daily with data engineers and intelligence and insight engineers on shared data products, pipelines and semantic layers. * Share standards and reusable components so the whole team can build with AI. **Who you are and what you bring to the team...** * 4\+ years in software ti\-step workflows and failure handling. * A track record of evaluating LLM systems with test sets and metrics, including hallucination and groundedness, and improving them based on results. * Working knowledge of data modeling, semantic layers or ontologies, and why they matter for AI accuracy. * Clear communication with non\-technical audiences; experience training users or presenting to leaders. * Sound judgment on data security, privacy and responsible AI. **Ideally, you have...** * Experience with Snowflake. * Experience building MCP servers or Claude skills, or with frameworks such as the Claude Agent SDK, LangGraph, CrewAI or similar. * Experience with multi\-agent designs: orchestrator and subagent patterns, agent handoffs or agent\-to\-agent protocols. * Experience with vector databases and retrieval evaluation. * Experience with LLM observability and evaluation tools, or custom evaluation pipelines. * Familiarity with knowledge graphs or ontology standards (LinkML, RDF, OWL, SKOS). * Background in life sciences, biotech or manufacturing, or comfort learning scientific vocabulary such as targets, pathways and applications. * Experience as an internal product owner or change agent rolling out new tools. * Degree in computer science, data science, a life science or equivalent experience. This position has a starting base salary range of $140,000 \- $202,000 per year, which the company, in good faith, reasonably expects to pay for this role at the time of posting. Actual compensation within this range will be determined based on factors including, but not limited to, relevant skills, qualifications, experience, and internal equity. **What we offer...** At Cell Signaling Technology (CST), we recognize that people will always be our most important asset. Providing a safe, inclusive, and stimulating working environment that understands the importance of diversity, human dignity, and meaningful work is as important as establishing company policies that incorporate excellent health insurance and pay benefits. We recognize that the development of people is the key to their happiness and thus ensure every employee has impactful discussions with their manager and develops actionable performance and professional development plans. Lastly, we are committed to engaging and supporting our employees in committees and philanthropy that benefit their local communities and environment through community investment programs. **Benefits** * Medical (BCBS) and Dental (Delta Dental) plans paid at 90% * Vision Insurance * Life Insurance, Short and Long Term Disability * Flexible Spending accounts * 401(k) Plan with 6% match * Tuition Reimbursement * Generous PTO package * Parental Leave * Pet Insurance * Employee Assistance Program * Onsite Subsidized Cafeteria * Free Parking Cell Signaling Technology (CST) is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, status as a veteran or as a member of the military or status in any group protected by applicable federal or state laws. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability. **AGENCIES** All resumes submitted by search firms/employment agencies to any employee at Cell Signaling Technology (CST) via email, the Internet, or in any form and/or method will be deemed the sole property of CST unless CST engaged such search firms/employment agencies for this position and a valid agreement with CST is in place. jobs.title: Technical Services Engineer - Houston, TX
jobs.description: Certarus is the North American leader in providing low\-carbon energy solutions through a fully integrated compressed natural gas (CNG), renewable natural gas (RNG), and hydrogen platform. The company safely delivers clean\-burning fuels to remote communities and industrial customers not connected to a pipeline. By displacing more carbon\-intensive fuels, Certarus is leading the energy transition and helping customers lower operating costs and improve environmental performance. With the largest fleet of specialty trailers in the world, the company is uniquely positioned to meet the growing demand for low and zero\-emission fuel distribution. #### **Summary:** Certarus is seeking a Technical Services Engineer to support the operational performance and reliability of our Pressure Reduction Systems (PRS) fleet across North America. The position is centered on three priorities: resolving complex field issues, commissioning new and retrofitted equipment, and driving fleet reliability improvements through root cause analysis (RCA) and corrective actions. The Technical Services Engineer serves as a technical link between Operations and Engineering, works closely with Projects and field teams, and reports to the Technical Services Engineering Lead. #### **Primary Responsibilities** **1 \| Commissioning of New Builds and Retrofits** * Lead and execute commissioning of new\-build and retrofitted PRS equipment, including startup, pre\-commissioning inspections, instrument and control verification, functional testing, and operational proving. * Validate equipment safeguards, shutdowns/interlocks, operating sequences, and system performance; identify and resolve deficiencies before turnover to Operations. * Coordinate with Engineering, fabrication partners, and Operations to implement design and control changes; maintain commissioning procedures, test records, checklists, and punch lists. **2 \| Operational Troubleshooting** * Provide technical escalation and hands\-on troubleshooting support to Operations for equipment malfunctions, abnormal operating conditions, and recurring field issues; restore safe, reliable operation. * Diagnose problems across mechanical, pneumatic, electrical, instrumentation, and control systems, including PLC\-based controls, pressure regulators, valves, boilers, heat exchangers, and safety systems. * Use SCADA/HMI trends, alarm history, operating data, drawings, and field observations to isolate faults, recommend repairs, and verify that solutions are effective. **3 \| Fleet Reliability and Root Cause Analysis** * Investigate equipment failures, repeat faults, and unplanned downtime; jobs.title: Forward Deployment Engineer
jobs.description: **We’re unique. You should be, too.** We’re changing lives every day. For both our patients and our team members. Are you innovative and entrepreneurial minded? Is your work ethic and ambition off the charts? Do you inspire others with your kindness and joy? We’re different than most primary care providers. We’re rapidly expanding and we need great people to join our team. The Forward Deployment Engineer is an AI\-native builder embedded directly within one or more ChenMed Centers of Excellence (COEs), working side\-by\-side with business partners to identify and solve real operational problems using AI\-assisted development tools. Rather than acting as an order\-taker, the incumbent partners with COE domain experts \- coaching them through the build process \- to deliver working tools while leaving lasting technical capability behind. This is an entry\-level, cohort\-based role intended for builders who demonstrate strong technical instincts, business curiosity, and the interpersonal skill to earn trust with non\-technical partners. **ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES:** ------------------------------------------ * Embeds directly within one or more assigned Centers of Excellence (COEs) to understand day\-to\-day operations firsthand and identify high\-value problems suited to AI\-assisted tooling. * Partners with COE domain experts \- who may have no engineering background \- as a technical coach, guiding them through the build process rather than building solutions independently on their behalf, sometimes iterating at the problem to land on solutions. * Designs, builds, and iterates on functional automation tools, dashboards, and lightweight applications using AI\-assisted development platforms (e.g., Claude, Claude Code). * Applies prompting discipline and AI\-output verification practices to confirm that AI\-generated code, configurations, and recommendations are accurate, secure, and appropriate before implementation. * Recognizes when an AI tool's recommendation touches infrastructure, data storage, system permissions, or PHI\-adjacent systems, and escalates to IT for review before execution, per ChenMed's AI governance framework. * Documents completed tools clearly for non\-technical audiences and registers them with the Center of Excellence (CoE) App Registry. * Coaches a named COE champion to independently operate, troubleshoot, and extend delivered tools so capability remains with the business after rotation. * Completes a rotation readiness check before transitioning off an engagement, confirming COE champion capability, documentation completeness, and a defined escalation path. * Completes structured, cohort\-based onboarding covering the ChenMed care model and value\-based care economics, ChenMed's operational structure (centers, COEs, care teams), systems thinking and database fundamentals, prompting discipline, and governance protocols. * Builds under the active guidance of Forward Deployed Engineer program leadership and senior FDE staff, escalating ambiguous technical or governance questions rather than resolving them independently. * Operates within ChenMed's tiered AI governance framework (Personal/Team/Enterprise/Production), ensuring tools are built and deployed at the appropriate governance level. * Rotates across COEs based on strategic priority and business need, as directed by Forward Deployed Engineer program leadership. * Shares knowledge, patterns, and lessons learned with peers and COE champions. * Performs other duties as assigned and modified at manager’s discretion. **KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:** ------------------------------------ * Basic\-level business acuity; developing understanding of ChenMed's care model, value\-based care economics, and health system operations. * Demonstrated portfolio evidence of building \- shipped projects, deployed tools, or other demonstrated technical output \- required; academic credentials alone are not sufficient. * Prior hands\-on experience building functional software, scripts, or automation tools using AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) required. * Basic understanding of prompting discipline and techniques for verifying AI\-generated output before use. * Developing business savviness \- genuine curiosity about the assigned COE's domain and willingness to learn its operational and clinical context. * Developing people skills \- ability to build rapport and earn early trust with non\-technical business partners. * Ability to coach a non\-technical domain expert through a build process rather than building independently on their behalf. * Ability to recognize when an AI recommendation touches infrastructure, data, or permissions and knows to stop and escalate rather than proceed. * Ability to work productively under close guidance and mentorship from senior Forward Deployed Engineer staff or program leadership. * Ability to document technical work clearly for non\-technical audiences. * Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast\-paced, ambiguous environment. * Well\-respected and viewed as a motivated, coachable contributor. * Expert skill in Microsoft Office Suite products including Excel, Word, PowerPoint and Outlook; competent in other systems required for the position. * Ability and willingness to travel locally, regionally and/or nationally up to 25% of the time to support embedded COE engagements; flexible to work evenings, weekends and/or holidays as needed. * Spoken and written fluency in English. * This job requires use and exercise of independent judgment. **EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE CRITERIA:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Information Technology, or a related field OR additional experience above the minimum will be considered in lieu of the required education on a year\-for\-year basis. * A minimum of 2 years' experience building software, scripts, or technical tools, including internship, cohort, or academic project experience, required. * Demonstrated portfolio of shipped projects, deployed tools, or comparable technical output required. * Hands\-on experience with at least one AI\-assisted development tool (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) required. **PAY RANGE:** $91,165 \- $130,235 Salary The posted pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full\-time salary for this position. Final compensation will depend on a variety of factors including but not limited to experience, education, geographic location, and other relevant factors. This position may also be eligible for a bonuses or commissions. **EMPLOYEE BENEFITS** https://chenmed.makeityoursource.com/helpful\-documents We’re ChenMed and we’re transforming healthcare for seniors and changing America’s healthcare for the better. Family\-owned and physician\-led, our unique approach allows us to improve the health and well\-being of the populations we serve. We’re growing rapidly as we seek to rescue more and more seniors from inadequate health care. ChenMed is changing lives for the people we serve and the people we hire. With great compensation, comprehensive benefits, career development and advancement opportunities and so much more, our employees enjoy great work\-life balance and opportunities to grow. Join our team who make a difference in people’s lives every single day. Current employees, if you want to apply to our internal career site, please click HERE \#LI\-Onsite

jobs.description: Senior Network Services Engineer (IT Infrastructure Engineer 3\) \- Provisional **GENERAL DUTIES** This position encompasses professional and responsible highly technical consultative and/or administrative work unique to the design and engineering of complex datacenters, networks and cloud deployments. Under administrative direction of a university IT manager, with broad latitude for independent action or decision, is responsible for the development of comprehensive infrastructure solutions. Engineer and operate mission critical infrastructure and be responsible for the access and protection of sensitive data, systems, and networks. May lead a team or participate in a team in planning, designing, implementing, and maintaining datacenter and cloud operations that includes the management of IT facilities, network, security, telecommunications, servers, storage, and virtualization components. There are three Levels of this title. Assignment Levels 2 and 3 may oversee multiple projects and supervise employees. This specification describes typical assignments for this title; related duties may be assigned as needed. To view the complete job description, go tohttp://www.cuny.edu/about/administration/offices/hr/classified\-civil\-service/ccsjobs/and view the Job Description for **IT Infrastructure Engineer.** **CONTRACT TITLE** IT Infrastructure Engineer **FLSA** Non\-exempt **CAMPUS SPECIFIC INFORMATION** The Office of Computing and Information Services (CIS) at the City University of New York (CUNY) supports the IT and telecommunications needs of CUNY's 26 colleges. CIS supports enterprise IT and applications, identifies and develops new technologies that advance the University's core mission, operates and maintains the University's network, the enterprise Data Center, and the CUNY Service Desk. Additionally, CIS manages the processes that safeguard the University’s IT assets and maintains the security posture by operating the CUNY Security Operations Center (SOC), develops disaster recovery plans for business continuity, and supports the CUNYfirst Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) solutions that integrate student administration, financial management, and human resources operations across CUNY’s 26 colleges. Lastly, CIS provides strategic and operational IT leadership to all CUNY campuses. Reporting to the Director of Network Services, the Senior Network Services Engineer designs, implements, operates, and optimizes secure, resilient, and scalable network solutions, provides technical leadership for complex projects and major incidents and supports network modernization, automation, cloud connectivity, and infrastructure resiliency initiatives. The position supports the University’s enterprise network infrastructure and shared technology services and provides senior\-level engineering expertise across CUNY’s WAN/MAN, core and campus networks, optical transport, datacenter networking, wireless infrastructure, network security, cloud connectivity, and network automation. The Sr. Network Services Engineer also develops engineering and operational documentation and provides technical guidance to engineers and Network Operations Center personnel. Key duties include, but are not limited to the following: * Designs, engineers, implements, and operates highly available enterprise network infrastructure, including core routing and switching, WAN/MAN, optical transport, dark\-fiber interconnects, wireless networks, and datacenter network fabrics. * Engineers and maintains modern datacenter architectures and services, including spine\-leaf fabrics, VXLAN/EVPN, network virtualization, application delivery/load balancing, DNS/DHCP, and enterprise IP Address Management (IPAM). * Architects and implements secure network segmentation, access controls, and enterprise network security technologies, including VRFs, VLANs, firewalls, TACACS\+, RADIUS, Cisco ISE, and Zero Trust principles. * Engineers and integrates hybrid and multi\-cloud connectivity across on\-premises infrastructure and public cloud platforms, including Azure, AWS, GCP, and OCI. * Develops and implements network automation and Infrastructure\-as\-Code capabilities using APIs, configuration templates, source control, CI/CD pipelines, Zero\-Touch Provisioning (ZTP), and NetDevOps practices; implements and maintains enterprise routing and switching technologies and protocols, including BGP, OSPF, IS\-IS, MPLS, IPv4/IPv6, QoS, and related technologies. * Provides senior\-level technical leadership and escalation support for complex network incidents, including packet and traffic\-flow analysis, troubleshooting, service restoration, root cause analysis, and post\-incident problem management. * Implements and maintains network monitoring, observability, telemetry, capacity management, configuration compliance, and AIOps capabilities to improve availability and performance; engineers and maintains resilient network architectures supporting high availability, business  ce of at least 20 hours per week may be prorated by half and credited instead of,but not in addition to, full\-time experience during the same period (e.g., two months of related work experience at 20\-34 hours per week equates to one month of full\-time related work experience.) Part\-time experience of fewer than 20 hours per week **cannot** be credited at all. **OTHER QUALIFICATIONS** Preferred: * Extensive experience designing, engineering, and supporting large\-scale, highly available enterprise networks, including routing, switching, WAN/MAN, wireless, datacenter, and network security technologies. * Advanced knowledge of enterprise routing and switching technologies and protocols, including BGP, OSPF, IS\-IS, MPLS, IPv4/IPv6, QoS, and Metro Ethernet. * Demonstrated experience with modern datacenter networking technologies, including spine\-leaf architectures, VXLAN/EVPN, network virtualization, load balancing/application delivery, and hybrid cloud connectivity. * Strong experience in network automation and Infrastructure\-as\-Code using technologies such as Python, Ansible, APIs, Git/source control, CI/CD pipelines, configuration templating, orchestration, and Zero\-Touch Provisioning. * Experience implementing enterprise security and Zero Trust networking principles, including segmentation/micro\-segmentation, firewalls, identity\-based network access, Cisco ISE, TACACS\+/RADIUS, and secure administrative access. * Hands\-on experience with enterprise networking and security platforms such as Cisco routing, switching, wireless, and optical technologies; Palo Alto Networks firewalls; Infoblox DNS/DHCP/IPAM; and enterprise application delivery technologies. * Experience with network observability, telemetry, packet analysis, performance management, and monitoring platforms such as ServiceNow, Datadog, SolarWinds, or comparable enterprise technologies. * Experience supporting public and hybrid cloud networking, including private cloud connectivity, ExpressRoute, Direct Connect, Cloud Interconnect, or comparable dedicated cloud connectivity services. * Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical projects and major incident response, develop architecture and engineering documentation, communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders, and mentor technical staff. **COMPENSATION** Level 3: **$126,287 \- $155,000** **BENEFITS** CUNY offers a comprehensive benefits package to employees and eligible dependents based on job title and classification. Health benefits are also extended to retirees who meet the eligibility criteria. **HOW TO APPLY** For full consideration, submit a cover letter and resume online via CUNY's web\-based job system, addressing how your experience and credentials meet the responsibilities and qualifications outlined. jobs.title: Principal Engineer
jobs.description: **Position Summary** The Principal Engineer is an established subject matter expert in utility engineering and provides technical oversight and leadership for the Engineering Department, using broad expertise and extensive experience. This role drives complex solutions that align with CoServ's strategy and may direct the activities of others. The position is responsible for developing standards through technical research, mentoring the team about problem\-solving methodologies, and establishing excellence in all engineering practices. The Principal Engineer exercises independent judgment in methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria to obtain results without oversight and is accountable for results that may impact the entire organization. **Responsibilities** **Primary Position Responsibilities** * Responsible for implementing processes and devices to comply with ERCOT emergency protocols, such as load shed and under\-frequency, and to comply with other ERCOT protocols. * Provides testimonial support as needed by the organization on technical and regulatory matters. * Maintains comprehensive knowledge of NESC, NFPA, RUS, ANSI, IEEE, and OSHA regulations and ensures compliance in all projects. * Develops engineering standards through research of regulations, laws, and industry codes and is responsible for implementation within the organization. * Maintains a thorough knowledge of equipment and device specifications and construction practices used within the electric distribution system. * Exercises full autonomy in material selection for projects, considering cost, quality, and project requirements. * Lead complex engineering projects throughout the project lifecycle, including budgeting, design, material selection, procurement, risk management, and construction. * Oversees contingency solutions, which includes preparation of power system grid modeling on engineering software to assess potential system overloads to the electric grid. * Provides technical guidance for power quality investigations, including power outages, equipment failures, insufficient grounding, harmonics, ferroresonance, voltage sags and swells, flicker, animal protection, tree trimming, recloser and breaker trips, etc. * Performs forensic studies on failed equipment and executes corrective solutions without supervision. * Performs loading, voltage, and motor analysis of potential future large or sensitive loads, routing of onsite facilities, and direction and options of feeds. This can include recommending two\-way feed systems. * Recommends permanent mainline changes of feed (switching) when needed. * Attends industry conferences and trainings to stay abreast of the latest developments related to gas and electric distribution safety, efficiency, and reliability. * Assists in training new engineering department personnel in planning and designing electric power facilities. * Identifies electrical facilities to be placed into the system, including sizing wire, calculating transformer capacity, sizes and classes of poles, computing voltage levels, assessing capacitor placement and size, regulator placement, vaults, switchgears, and duct banks. * Oversees preparation of five\-year Construction Work Plan that identifies system improvements, budget, and schedule that are required to meet the expected demand of the gas and electric distribution systems throughout the planning period. * Provides technical guidance for various system studies such as saturation studies, substation justification studies, coordination studies, long range studies, power factor studies, switching studies, and voltage studies. * Advises senior management on long\-term engineering strategies and goals. * Oversees preparation of 10\-year load forecast for Construction Work Plan, ERCOT ALDR, and transmission and substation budget. * Complies with established CoServ safety and operating rules, procedures and guidelines including reporting unsafe practices to a supervisor. * Complies with established CoServ Information Security Handbook, policies, procedures, and guidelines including reporting suspected information security incidents to Tech Support. **Secondary Position Responsibilities** * Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends to identify opportunities for innovation and competitive advantages. * Maintains department standards on a consistent basis. * Creates and maintains databases within Engineering \& GIS software. * Attends power distribution conferences and other meetings to stay abreast of the latest developments in the transmission and distribution of electricity. * Mentors new engineering staff employees. * Assists coworkers in Engineering Department. * Demonstrates self\-motivation, ownership of job responsibilities, and being pro\-active in seeking solutions for the department. * Attends Engineering meetings jobs.title: Senior Threat Hunter
jobs.description: **About Coalfire** Coalfire is on a mission to make the world a safer place by solving our clients’ hardest cybersecurity challenges. We work at the cutting edge of technology to advise, assess, automate, and ultimately help companies navigate the ever\-changing cybersecurity landscape. We are headquartered in Chicago, Illinois with offices across the U.S. and U.K., and we support clients around the world. But that’s not who we are – that’s just what we do. We are thought leaders, consultants, and cybersecurity experts, but above all else, we are a team of passionate problem\-solvers who are hungry to learn, grow, and make a difference.### **Position Summary** The Senior Threat Hunter leads intelligence\-driven hunting operations across client environments, leveraging deep expertise in EDR telemetry, network forensics, and cloud log analytics to uncover advanced adversaries and security control gaps. You will craft hypotheses, execute hunts across on\-premises, hybrid, and cloud infrastructures, validate findings through adversary emulation, and partner with detection engineers to operationalize new coverage in SIEM/EDR systems. You will work across multiple vendor ecosystems (Microsoft Defender/Sentinel, CrowdStrike Falcon, SentinelOne, Entra, AWS IAM) to support diverse client environments. Your work directly strengthens our customers' security posture and shapes Coalfire's next\-generation threat\-hunting services. **Note: This is a hands\-on threat hunting role. We do not perform incident response, forensics, or incident investigation as part of this position. You will focus exclusively on proactive threat hunting, gap assessment, and detection engineering.** ### **What You'll Do** * Formulate, document, and execute threat\-hunting hypotheses using data from multiple EDR platforms (CrowdStrike Falcon, SentinelOne, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint), SIEM (Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, Chronicle), and cloud/native logs (AWS CloudTrail, Azure Activity Logs, GCP Cloud Audit Logs). * Analyze host artifacts, network traffic, and attack surface data across Windows, Linux, macOS, and cloud workloads to identify anomalous behaviors and previously undetected malicious activity. * Hunt across on\-premises, hybrid, and cloud environments, leveraging cloud\-native threat vectors (IAM misconfigurations, container/Kubernetes attacks, API exploitation) and traditional network\-based detection approaches. * Perform gap assessments using adversary\-emulation techniques (MITRE ATT\&CK\-aligned campaigns, emulation tools, purple\-team exercises) to validate visibility, exploitability, and resilience of client defenses. * Translate hunt results into high\-fidelity detections, dashboards, and automated response playbooks in collaboration with Detection Engineering teams. * Produce concise, executive\-ready reports and technical deep dives that clearly articulate impact, risk, remediation guidance, and business implications. * Mentor junior hunters and SOC analysts; develop and document reusable methodologies, hunting runbooks, and training materials. * Track, curate, and operationalize adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) from open\-source intelligence (OSINT), threat intelligence feeds, and cross\-client pattern analysis; feed insights into hunt planning and service roadmap. * Evaluate emerging threat\-hunting tools, SIEM/EDR platforms, and detection technologies; contribute to vendor selection, procurement, and integration processes. * Monitor and track hunting productivity and impact metrics (hunts executed per quarter, findings per hunt, mean time to uncover malicious activity, detection operationalization rate) to inform service improvements and ROI. * Contribute to service maturation (process improvements, methodology enhancements, metrics refinement) and evangelize Coalfire's threat\-hunting value to prospects, clients, and industry forums (conferences, ISSA, community events). ### **What You'll Bring** * 5\+ years in Threat Hunting, Penetration Testing, Red Team operations, or closely related security roles with hands\-on hunt experience. * Demonstrated expertise with at least two major EDR platforms (CrowdStrike Falcon, SentinelOne, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint), including proficiency in query languages, telemetry interpretation, and detection engineering. * Hands\-on experience designing and executing threat\-hunting campaigns across Windows, Linux, macOS, on\-premises, hybrid, and cloud workloads (AWS, Azure, GCP). * Strong proficiency in scripting and automation languages (Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar) to manipulate data, optimize queries, and accelerate hunt execution. * Hands\-on experience with cloud\-native threat hunting, including IAM security (Entra, AWS IAM), identity threat vectors, and cloud infrastructure attack chains. * Proficiency in query languages and search syntax (KQL for Azure/Sentinel, SPL for Splunk, PromQL for Prometheus, or equivalent) and the ability to build and op ools in enterprise environments, and unconventional attack vectors, affect detection strategies and hunting hypothesis development. * Exceptional analytical and written/verbal communication skills, able to convert complex technical findings into clear business impact and risk context for executive and technical audiences. **Required Certifications (or equivalent demonstrable skills)** * One or more of: OSCP, GPEN, GCIH, CISSP, Blue Team Level II, GIAC GMON/GCFA, or equivalent demonstrated skills through published research, tool development, or documented successful hunt campaigns that have identified and operationalized previously undetected threats. ### **Bonus Points** * Experience integrating hunt outputs into SOAR platforms (Splunk SOAR, Palo Alto Cortex XSOAR, etc.) and modern SIEMs (Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk Enterprise Security, Chronicle). * Hands\-on experience with adversary emulation and threat simulation tools (Atomic Red Team, CISA's Emulation Plans, Caldera, Breach and Attack Simulation platforms). * Cloud threat\-hunting, offensive research, or tool development; published research, GitHub tools, or conference talks. * Familiarity with threat intelligence feeds (OSINT, paid feeds, ISACs) and the ability to operationalize threat intelligence into concrete hunting hypotheses. * Prior consulting or client\-facing delivery experience; ability to manage client expectations, communicate technical findings to non\-technical stakeholders, and adapt hunting methodology to client environments. * Active involvement in security communities (ISSA, SANS, Black Hat, DEFCON, or local security groups); public speaking or conference presentations. * Experience with identity threat detection and response (ITDR) platforms and identity\-based attack vectors. *The salary range listed is a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role based on national salary averages. The actual salary offer to the successful candidate will be based on job\-related education, geographic location, training, licensure and certifications and other factors. You may also be eligible to participate in annual incentive, commission, and/or recognition programs.***Why You’ll Want to Join Us** At Coalfire, you’ll find the support you need to thrive personally and professionally. In many cases, we provide a flexible work model that empowers you to choose when and where you’ll work most effectively – whether you’re at home or an office. Regardless of location, you’ll experience a company that prioritizes connection and wellbeing and be part of a team where people care about each other and our communities. You’ll have opportunities to join employee resource groups, participate in in\-person and virtual events, and more. And you’ll enjoy competitive perks and benefits to support you and your family, like paid parental leave, flexible time off, certification and training reimbursement, digital mental health and wellbeing support membership, and comprehensive insurance options. At Coalfire, equal opportunity and pay equity is integral to the way we do business. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. Coalfire is committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. To request reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, contact our Human Resources team at HumanResourcesMB@coalfire.com. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: CodePath is the largest educator of college computer science students in the country. We've trained over 50,000 students from more than 1,000 universities. Our partners include Amazon, Google, and other leading technology companies. After nearly a decade of training technical talent, we launched a $150M initiative with Anthropic to prepare people for careers in AI. We're expanding into new markets and growing our team as AI changes the workforce. People joining CodePath now will help shape this next stage of our work. We believe technical skills create opportunities. Our goal is to train millions of learners and create lasting economic impact. If you want to build something new, take ownership, and see the results of your work, this is a place to do it. **About the Role** **Location:** Remote (US) **Role Type:** Full\-Time **Reporting to:** Head of Measurement, Evaluation \& Learning **Compensation:** $110,000 to $150,000 per year We’re looking for a highly capable and pragmatic Senior Data Engineer who thrives in environments where they can take initiative, wear multiple hats, and turn ambiguity into action. This is a deeply hands\-on role for someone eager to help shape our next\-generation infrastructure. Data is the foundation of CodePath’s work, shaping how the organization serves learners, develops curriculum, and makes decisions. In this role, you will own the design of the architecture, pipelines, and models that power every critical function at CodePath, from student success analytics to business intelligence to AI\-driven personalization. Because these systems hold student records, privacy and FERPA compliance are a central design consideration in all of this work. As a Senior Data Engineer at CodePath, you will: * Help lead the design and development of a modern, scalable data platform that fuels analytics, data science, and machine learning * Work cross\-functionally with engineers, data scientists, and business leaders on high\-impact projects * Help build the foundation for data systems that directly enable student success, program outcomes, and organizational growth This is a unique opportunity to: * **Build something new:** Design and build the next stage of CodePath’s data platform on top of the foundation we already have * **Drive visibility and impact:** Partner closely with leadership and cross\-functional teams to deliver insights that shape our strategy * **Scale CodePath’s mission:** Ensure our 50,000\+ learners and alumni (and growing) are supported with the infrastructure to thrive in the AI\-native workforce Every pipeline you build and every model you optimize will ripple across an organization supporting tens of thousands of students, alumni, learners, and partners, making this a unique opportunity to do data work with real\-world impact. This is your chance to help design, build, scale, and address the systems that will serve as the backbone of CodePath’s future. Expect work that blends a mix of new projects and rebuilds of existing pipelines and models that require attention. **What You'll Do** * **Data Platform \& Architecture:** Design and maintain a scalable, modern data infrastructure (data warehouses, pipelines, data lakes, analytic products) * **Pipelines \& ETL/ELT:** Build and optimize robust data workflows using SQL, dbt, Fivetran and other tools to deliver clean, reliable, and timely data * **Data Ingestion:** Bring in many new sources of data (such as our attendance bot, CredLens, Revelio, and the National Student Clearinghouse), migrate ingestion to Datastream, and build the monitoring we need now that Fivetran handles only a fraction of our ingestion * **Modeling \& Analytics Enablement:** Create effective data models to power self\-serve analytics, performance reporting, and strategic insights across teams * **Business Intelligence:** Develop and maintain dashboards and reporting tools (Hex or equivalent) that drive decision\-making and clarity on key KPIs * **AI\-Ready Data Access:** Enable secure and reliable use of our data by AI tools operated by non\-technical stakeholders * **LinkedIn Data Access:** Enable cheap, safe, and reliable ad\-hoc access to CodePath’s offline LinkedIn dataset * **Governance, Privacy \& Quality:** Establish data quality and governance standards, and treat FERPA and student data privacy as a core design consideration, ensuring stakeholders can trust and act on data * **Documentation \& Maintainability:** Document systems, models, and pipelines to support transparency, onboarding, and long\-term scalability * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Work closely with engineers, data scientists, and business stakeholders to scope, prioritize, and deliver data solutions * **Strategic Data Leadership:** Partner with leadership to define and evolve CodePath’s data strategy, ensuring that infrastructure investments align with long\-term organizational goals * **Mentorship \& Standards:** Establish engineering best practices for data workflows, empower non\-technical stakeholders to work confidently with data, and mentor and manage junior data engineers as the team grows **What Success Looks Like** * Review and improve existing data models and schemas to support analytical and reporting needs * Share ownership of CodePath’s ETL pipeline and (BigQuery) data warehouse with the other data engineer; develop new data models (using dbt) to support evolving data needs across the organization * Share responsibility for CodePath’s Google Cloud Platform infrastructure (CloudRun, BigQuery, App Engine) to support data and dashboarding needs, including security and permissions, scalability, and uptime * Define a roadmap for data infrastructure that aligns with organizational growth and impact measurement goals * Propose and implement innovative solutions to improve data ingestion, processing, and storage * Develop and implement metrics to demonstrate that data engineering solutions align with business objectives and strategic goals **What We're Looking For** * 5\+ years of experience in data engineering or similar roles * Strong SQL skills and experience building efficient pipelines, including performance tuning * Proven ability to work autonomously and deliver outcomes in a fast\-changing environment * Expertise in building data pipelines end\-to\-end, from ingestion through transformation to final visualization. Deep understanding of data modeling principles (dimensional modeling, data normalization) * Hands\-on experience managing cloud data warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake, Databricks, or Redshift) * Proficiency with CodePath’s primary data stack, including BigQuery, Postgres, Fivetran, dbt, Hex, and Streamlit * Strong communicator who can make complex analysis clear and actionable for diverse stakeholders **Nice to Have** * Expertise in, or strong interest in, one or more of the following: integration with AI agents, AI classification workflows and evals, and privacy and compliance * Experience developing custom data connectors and integrating third\-party data sources such as the National Student Clearinghouse, Revelio, and CredLens * Familiarity with data quality frameworks and governance best practices * Familiarity with data privacy and security best practices * Background in a fast\-paced, startup environment with the adaptability to thrive in ambiguity **Compensation** CodePath has standardized salaries based on the position’s level, no matter where you live. For this role, we’re hiring for a senior level position at an annual salary of $110,000 to $150,000\. Salary is determined based on your relevant experience and skills as evaluated through our interview process. **Full\-Time Employee Benefits** This is a remote position—work from anywhere in the US! CodePath prioritizes employee well\-being with a competitive benefits package to support your health, financial security, and work\-life balance. * Health \& Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance (90% employer\-covered for employees and dependents), employer\-funded healthcare reimbursement, FSAs, and Employee Assistance Program * Financial Security: 401(k), employer\-paid life \& disability insurance, and identity theft protection * Work\-Life Balance: Generous PTO, paid holidays, 10 weeks of fully paid parental leave, and an annual year\-end company closure (Dec 24 – Jan 2\) * Professional Growth: $1,000 annual professional development stipend and home office setup support * Student Loan Forgiveness: CodePath is a qualifying employer for Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF), helping employees manage student loan debt * Additional Perks: Pet wellness plans, legal services, home/auto insurance discounts, and exclusive marketplace savings Pay range $110,000 \- $150,000 USD

jobs.title: Sr. AWS Cloud Migration Architect
jobs.description: **Role Summary :** AWS Cloud Migration Architect to lead and execute enterprise workload migrations from discovery and assessment through wave planning, cutover, stabilization, and hypercare. The role covers rehost and re\-platform migrations from on\-premises environments to AWS. The architect must combine technical leadership with individual\-contributor delivery, including resilience, monitoring, and operational integration. ### **Location : REMOTE (Anywhere in the USA)** ### **Key Responsibilities** * Lead discovery, application and server assessment, dependency analysis, migration strategy, wave planning, and readiness reviews. * Determine the appropriate migration approach, primarily Rehost or Replatform, based on infrastructure, operating system, network, security, application, database, and operational requirements. * Create migration runbooks, test plans, cutover and rollback procedures, validation criteria, operational handover, and hypercare plans. * Identify and actively manage technical risks, client dependencies, blockers, remediation actions, and escalation paths. * Lead production cutovers, post\-migration validation, defect triage, stabilization, and transition to operations. ### **Migration Delivery \- Rehost \& Replatform** Lead migration assessments, dependency analysis, migration strategy, wave planning, readiness reviews, execution, cutover, stabilization, and hypercare across rehost and replatform workloads. Deliver large\-scale rehost migrations using AWS Application Migration Service (MGN) and AWS Cloud Migration Factory (CMF), including replication, staging, launch configuration, test launches, cutover, validation, automation, and troubleshooting. Design and enable replatform migrations using appropriate AWS target services, Terraform, Infrastructure as Code, and CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure deployment; partner with DevOps teams that own application deployment. Own migration wave planning and lead cross\-functional execution while also contributing directly to architecture, engineering, issue resolution, go/no\-go decisions, rollback planning, and delivery activities. Design and implement backup, disaster recovery, business continuity, monitoring, alerting, and operational readiness capabilities, including integration with enterprise and third\-party tools. ### **Client \& Stakeholder Leadership** * Lead technical workshops, assessment sessions, architecture reviews, migration readiness reviews, cutover calls, and hypercare checkpoints. * Work effectively with client application owners, infrastructure, network, security, database, DevOps, operations, AWS, and program leadership teams. * Communicate architecture decisions, migration status, dependencies, risks, blockers, remediation plans, and escalations clearly to technical and executive stakeholders. ### **Required Skills \& Experience** **Capability** **Requirement** Enterprise AWS migration delivery across on\-premises\-to\-AWS and AWS/Azure\-to\-AWS scenarios **Must have** Rehost and Replatform migration experience **Must have** AWS Application Migration Service (MGN) **Must have \- hands\-on** AWS Cloud Migration Factory (CMF) **Must have \- hands\-on** Discovery, assessment, dependency analysis, and wave planning **Must have** Technical leadership plus individual\-contributor delivery **Must have** Cutover, troubleshooting, stabilization, and hypercare **Must have** Backup, disaster recovery, business continuity, monitoring, and third\-party tool integration **Must have** AWS networking, IAM, compute, storage, security, and operations **Must have** Client\-facing communication and stakeholder management **Must have** Terraform, Infrastructure as Code, and CI/CD for infrastructure deployment **Strongly preferred** ### **AWS Technical Knowledge** **Core:** EC2, VPC, subnets, route tables, security groups, NACLs, IAM, EBS, ELB/ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudWatch, Systems Manager, AWS Backup, Secrets Manager, Parameter Store, MGN, and CMF. Experience should include backup architecture, disaster recovery, business continuity, monitoring and alerting implementation, and integration with enterprise or third\-party tools. ### **Experience Profile** * 10\+ years of infrastructure/cloud experience, including substantial recent AWS architecture and migration delivery experience. 5\+ years of AWS experience preferred, with demonstrated delivery of large enterprise migration programs. Experience migrating workloads from on\-premises environments, including VMware, physical infrastructure, private cloud, and data centers, to AWS, as well as AWS\-to\-AWS and Microsoft Azure\-to\-AWS migrations. Proven ownership of migration assessment, dependency analysis, wave planning, build, test migration, cutover, validation, stabilization, and hypercare. Able to lead architects and engineers while also operating as an individual contributor across design, implementation, troubleshooting, and migration execution. ### **Preferred Certifications** **AWS Certified Solutions Architect \- Professional; AWS Certified Solutions Architect \- Associate; AWS Certified DevOps Engineer \- Professional.** Certifications are preferred, but demonstrated hands\-on migration execution is more important. Applications will be accepted until 12/15/2026 The annual salary for this position is between **$140,000\- $160,000** depending on experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate. This position is also eligible for Cognizant’s discretionary annual incentive program, based on performance and is subject to the terms of Cognizant’s applicable plans. Benefits: Cognizant offers the following benefits for this position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements: * Medical/Dental/Vision/Life Insurance * Paid holidays plus Paid Time Off * 401(k) plan and contribution * Long\-term/Short\-term Disability * Paid Parental Leave * Employee Stock Purchase Plan Disclaimer: The salary, other compensation, and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. Cognizant reserves the right to modify this information at any time, subject to applicable law

jobs.title: Principal Data Scientist
jobs.description: Make your mark at Comcast \- a Fortune 30 global media and technology company. From the connectivity and platforms we provide, to the content and experiences we create, we reach hundreds of millions of customers, viewers, and guests worldwide. Become part of our award\-winning technology team that turns big ideas into cutting\-edge products, platforms, and solutions that our customers love. We create space to innovate, and we recognize, reward, and invest in your ideas, while ensuring you can proudly bring your authentic self to the workplace. Join us. You’ll do the best work of your career right here at Comcast. (In most cases, Comcast prefers to have employees on\-site collaborating unless the team has been designated as virtual due to the nature of their work. If a position is listed with both office locations and virtual offerings, Comcast may be willing to consider candidates who live greater than 100 miles from the office for the remote option.) **Job Summary** As a Data Scientist within the CONNECT Data Engineering and Science team, you will develop and apply advanced data science techniques to analyze large\-scale, real\-time and historical network data, processing millions of events per second and billions each day. Working closely with software engineers, network architects, service delivery teams, and business stakeholders, you will build models and data solutions that uncover customer and network insights, solve complex optimization challenges, and help improve the performance of Comcast’s next\-generation access network and overall customer experience. **Job Description** **Required Skills and Qualifications** * Advanced degree in Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, or a related scientific or engineering discipline. * Principal\-level machine learning experience, including designing and delivering production ML systems at enterprise scale. * Strong ML and statistical foundation, including deep learning, regression, probability and statistical distributions, model evaluation, and statistical testing. * Expertise in at least one major ML framework or data science toolkit, such as TensorFlow, Keras, or scikit\-learn, with the ability to select and apply methods appropriately. * Advanced programming skills in Python, Scala, Java, or Go, and experience developing reliable, maintainable software. * Strong SQL skills and experience querying large\-scale datasets using SQL, Hive, or similar tools. * Experience with distributed data processing, including Spark batch workloads and large\-scale data lake or warehouse environments. * Experience designing or operating production data pipelines, including handling structured and semi\-structured data formats such as Parquet or Avro. * Knowledge of relational and NoSQL data systems, including how to select storage technologies based on workload and scale. * Technical leadership skills, including setting technical direction, mentoring engineers and data scientists, and partnering across teams. * Strong communication skills,
