jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Data Integrations
jobs.description: At Commure, we're building the AI Operating System for healthcare, the foundation that defines how care is delivered, documented, and financed. Our platform spans the full care journey: Ambient AI and Dictation eliminating documentation burden at the point of care, intelligent Agents automating patient and revenue workflows, and autonomous RCM processing billions in claims, all on a single AI\-native platform integrated with 60\+ EHRs. Healthcare carries a $1 trillion administrative burden and we're at the center of transforming it. Today, 500,000\+ clinicians across 500\+ healthcare organizations nationwide trust Commure to handle $25B\+ in annual claims and support over 200 million patient interactions. Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We've also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for “Overall NLP Company of the Year.” Our team works directly alongside clinicians, not through layers of process, which means the gap between what you build and its impact on patient care is immediate. We move fast, deploy daily, and take full ownership from early thinking to production. If you're energized by hard problems, high stakes, and a team that holds itself to a high bar, you'll find your people here. The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation. **About the Role** ------------------ The Data Integrations team owns the systems that move clinical and financial data between Commure and hundreds of external healthcare systems using FHIR, HL7, Flat files, RPA etc. The domain is EMRs and Portals like Availity, but the engineering problem is distributed systems at scale: durable orchestration on Temporal, strong delivery semantics against unreliable third parties, and a data and networking substrate that has to keep up as the business grows. We're looking for a **Senior Software Engineer** to own multi\-component projects on this platform end to end and help us scale as we move towards more enterprise customers. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Own multi\-component projects where requirements are incomplete or evolving: define the approach, sequence the work, and see them through design, implementation, migration, rollout, and running them in production. * Design and build robust systems across the orchestration layer, the pipelines, and the data stores, with strong boundaries and observability built in.. * Set the bar for observability and operational readiness (monitoring, logging, distributed tracing, dashboards, alerting, SLOs, and safe production rollouts). * Work hand\-in\-hand with platform and product teams to keep sensitive customer data protected, tighten security boundaries, and stay on top of our regulatory and compliance obligations. * Make pragmatic calls that weigh security, correctness, reliability, performance, and simplicity against how fast we need to ship. * Mentor other junior and senior engineers on the team, lead team\-level and cross\-org design reviews, and help improve hiring and team processes. * Take real ownership in a fast\-moving environment. Fix root causes instead of patching around them. **Our Tech Stack** ------------------ * **Backend:** Python (FastAPI) monolith on Kubernetes; supporting services in Go (e.g. HL7/MLLP gateways) * **Database:** PostgreSQL (SQLAlchemy) · Redis * **Cloud \& orchestration:** GCP (Cloud Tasks, Pub/Sub, GCS, Cloud Run / Knative), Temporal * **Integrations:** HL7 v2, FHIR R4, REST/OAuth (SMART), Selenium, SFTP * **Monitoring:** Prometheus \+ Grafana * **Other tools:** Linear, Notion, Slack **What You Have** ----------------- * Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent extensive experience. * **5\+ years** of professional software engineering experience, including leading multi\-component projects with ambiguous requirements from design through production. * Deep experience building and operating distributed systems at scale, high\-throughput pipelines, data\-intensive services. You can talk about the non\-obvious failure modes, not just the happy path. * Strong data\-layer and concurrency judgment. You've made a relational database (Postgres or similar) do more than it wanted to, and you know when to reach for a DB lock, when Redis is the right tool, and when the right move is a design that doesn't need either. * Real depth in the boring\-but\-critical layers. Networking and egress (NAT, static IPs, connection lifecycle, DNS, TLS), the database, the container runtime. You're comfortable debugging when something below the application layer misbehaves. * Production experience with GCP and container orchestration (Kubernetes, Knative, or similar serverless\-on\-k8s), and fluency in a modern backend language (Python strongly preferred; Go or similar is a plus). * The ability to explain technical tradeoffs in language non\-engineers can act on, and to coordinate dependencies across teams. * A history of leveling up the engineers around you. **Bonus** --------- * Healthcare integrations experience — HL7 v2, FHIR, and EHRs like Epic, Cerner, or Athenahealth. We can teach the domain; we're hiring for the systems judgment above. * Experience with the compliance envelope this work lives inside (HIPAA, SOC 2\) and the security posture that comes with handling PHI. Please be aware that all official communication from us will come exclusively from email addresses ending in **@****commure.com**. Any emails from other domains are not affiliated with our organization. Employees will act in accordance with the organization’s information security policies, to include but not limited to protecting assets from unauthorized access, disclosure, modification, destruction or interference nor execute particular security processes or activities. Employees will report to the information security office any confirmed or potential events or other risks to the organization. Employees will be required to attest to these requirements upon hire and on an annual basis. Compensation Range: $180K \- $230K

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Data Infrastructure
jobs.description: **About Decagon** Decagon is the leading conversational AI platform empowering every brand to deliver concierge customer experiences. Our technology enables industry\-defining enterprises like Avis Budget Group, Block’s Cash App and Square, Chime, Oura Health, and Hunter Douglas to deploy AI agents that power personalized, deeply satisfying interactions across voice, chat, email, SMS, and every other channel. We’re building a future where customer experiences are being redefined from support tickets and hold music to faster resolutions, richer conversations, and deeper relationships. We’re proud to be backed by world\-class investors who share that vision, including a16z, Accel, Bain Capital Ventures, Coatue, and Index Ventures, along with many others. We’re an in\-office company, driven by a shared commitment to excellence and velocity. Our values — Just Get It Done, Invent What Customers Want, Winner’s Mindset, and The Polymath Principle — shape how we work and grow as a team. **About the Team** ------------------ The **Infrastructure** team builds and operates the foundations that power Decagon: networking, data, ML serving, developer platform, and real‑time voice. We partner closely with product, data, and ML to deliver high‑scale, low‑latency systems with clear SLOs and great developer ergonomics. We organize around four focus areas: * **Core Infra:** The foundational cloud stack—networking, compute, storage, security, and infrastructure‑as‑code—to ensure reliability, scale, and cost efficiency. * **Data Infra:** Streaming/batch data platforms powering analytics/BI and customer‑facing telemetry, including for customer‑managed and on‑prem environments. * **ML Infra:** GPU and model‑serving platforms for LLM inference with multi‑provider routing and support for on‑prem/air‑gapped deployments. * **Platform (DevEx):** CI/CD, paved paths, and core services that make shipping fast, safe, and consistent across teams. Our mission is to **deliver magical support experiences** — AI agents working alongside humans to resolve issues quickly and accurately. **About the Role** We're hiring a Senior Data Infrastructure Engineer to design, build, and operate the data systems that power Decagon's AI products. You'll own critical data pipelines and storage layers end‑to‑end, improve reliability and performance, and create paved paths that let every Decagon engineer work confidently with data at scale. **In this role, you will** * Design and implement high‑throughput data pipelines and streaming systems with strong SLOs, clear runbooks, and actionable telemetry. * Build and operate real‑time and batch ingestion infrastructure using tools like Kafka, Flink, and Airflow. * Own our analytical data layer — schema design, query performance, and cost optimization across ClickHouse, BigQuery, or similar. * Partner with research and product teams to architect data solutions, evaluate performance, and scale new features. * Tune pipeline and query latencies: optimize data paths, apply smart caching/partitioning, and hit tight p95/p99 targets. * Lead infrastructure‑as‑code (Terraform) and GitOps practices for data systems; reduce drift with reusable modules and policy‑as‑code. * Participate in on‑call and drive down toil through automation and elimination of recurring data issues. **Your background looks something like this** * 8\+ years building and operating production data infrastructure at scale. * Hands\-on experience with Tier 1 data technologies: ClickHouse, Kafka (or MSK/Pub‑Sub/RabbitMQ), and Flink or dbt. * Proven track record meeting high availability and low latency targets across streaming and batch workloads. * Excellent observability chops (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/Grafana, Datadog) and strong incident response discipline. * Clear written communication and the ability to turn ambiguous data requirements into simple, reliable designs. **Even better if you have** * Experience with CDC tooling (Debezium) and orchestration frameworks (Airflow, Dagster, or Prefect) * Familiarity with Spark or Dask for large‑scale data processing * Experience with cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks) * Experience being an early data/platform/infrastructure engineer at another company * Strong Kubernetes experience (GKE/EKS/AKS) and multi‑cloud exposure (GCP, AWS, Azure) * Experience with customer‑managed deployments **Compensation** ---------------- $200K – $400K \+ Offers Equity This range reflects the expected compensation for this role. Compensation within the range is determined based on experience, skills, and the scope of responsibilities, with flexibility for candidates who demonstrate exceptional impact. In addition to base salary, we offer competitive equity. Final compensation may vary based on location within the United States. **Benefits** We proudly offer the following benefits for our full\-time employees: * Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits for you and your family * Life Insurance and Disability Benefits * Retirement Plan (e.g., 401K, pension) * Parental Leave * Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot * Monthly stipend to support your wellness, lifestyle, and work\-life balance * Daily lunches and snacks in the office to keep you at your best * Take what you need vacation policy (subject to local requirements; UK employees receive 25 days of statutory leave) *Decagon offers a competitive benefits package that varies by country and complements local statutory benefits. Details for this location will be provided during the recruitment process.* Compensation Range: $200K \- $400K

jobs.description: Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. * 5 years of experience in product management or related technical role. * 2 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end\-to\-end, 0 to 1, etc.). * Experience building or managing generative AI, LLM, or ML\-powered products, and partnering with UX or product design teams on user\-facing workflows. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Experience shipping 0\-to\-1 AI\-native workflows, creative/collaborative software, or developer tools in R\&D\-heavy environments. * Experience with front\-end technologies (e.g., React, Svelte) and modern AI APIs, prompt engineering, and evaluation paradigms. * Experience with human\-computer interaction (HCI), accessibility, AI safety, and responsible AI evaluation frameworks. * Excellent written communication skills, synthesizing complex technical and latency trade\-offs for various stakeholders. **About the job** ----------------- The AIUX team inspires and accelerates people\-centric futures for emerging technologies across Google DeepMind. We work across disciplines, answering difficult user questions, prototyping, and sharing new UX practices. In this role, you will advocate the intersection of cutting\-edge AI capabilities and human\-centered interaction design. You will define the goal, user journeys, and evaluation criteria for AI\-native workflows—steering prompt strategy, human\-in\-the\-loop interaction patterns, and next\-generation UI models from rapid discovery and prototyping through continuous user validation. Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. jobs.title: Staff Software Systems Engineer, Companion Robots, DeepMind
jobs.description: Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. * 8 years of experience in software development. * 5 years of experience testing, and launching software products. * 5 years of experience with software architecture and embedded systems. * 3 years of experience operating within the core technology stack of modern Large Language Models. * Experience in robotics research and in one or more of the following: computer vision, LIDAR, object tracking, sensor fusion, perception, machine learning, motion planning, and control. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field. * 8 years of experience with data structures/algorithms. * 3 years of experience working in a complex, matrixed organization involving cross\-functional, or cross\-business projects. * 3 years of experience in a technical leadership role leading project teams and setting technical direction. **About the job** ----------------- At Google DeepMind our mission is to build the world's first general\-purpose learning agent. Central to this mission is the complex task of measuring the intelligence of our prototypes. As a Software Engineer, you will be working with the cutting edge AI agents developed by our exceptional team of Machine Learning and Neuroscience research scientists. Your responsibilities will include everything from creating systems for agent testing using 2D and 3D games to developing test problems within physics simulators. You will create graphical visualization of results, build competitive agent leaderboards and test new algorithms on robots. To succeed in this role you will need to have a strong foundation in software engineering and enjoy working on a wide range of challenging problems within a mission\-driven team. As a Systems Engineer on the Companion Robots team, you will be the person who puts intelligence into bodies. You will bring up new robot platforms behind a shared cognitive architecture, build the sensing and perception that lets a robot understand a home, and own the on\-device stack that has to run inside a robot's power and compute budget. You will work across the range — sensor selection and audio hardware, real\-time control loops, model deployment and optimization, and the integration of evolving vision\-language and embodied\-reasoning models. This role suits someone who is comfortable debugging a 50 Hertz (Hz) control loop and getting a model to fit in memory. Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high\-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority. We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $207000 \- $300000 (USD) \+ 20% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Integrate new robot embodiments behind a shared behavior stack — sensors, actuators, real\-time runtime, and hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing — while keeping the architecture independent of any one body. * Develop person detection, recognition and tracking, object recognition, and spatial understanding that works in unstructured home environments rather than a laboratory or simulator. * Select, optimize, quantize and deploy models within memory, compute and power budgets, keeping the perception and behavior loop running locally so the robot remains responsive and in character without a network connection, using cloud reasoning as an enrichment rather than a dependency in the control loop. * Evaluate and integrate microphone arrays, cameras, inertial and proximity sensing; own the audio front end, including sound\-source localization and onset detection. * Wrap fast\-moving cloud and on\-device models behind stable interfaces, and own version pinning, migration, and regression testing. Why Join Work directly with company leadership and an experienced CTO; own important production software systems and help modernize an established business. **Benefits** * Employer\-paid health, dental and vision insurance * Paid time off and paid company holidays * Access to a full benefits suite through TriNet * Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM — no weekends **Work Location** 760 NW 4 St., Miami, Florida — Full\-time on\-site \- not remote or hybrid. **How to Apply** Submit your résumé and a short description of one or two production software projects you personally built, deployed, or supported. jobs.title: Engineering Lead
jobs.description: **Overview** ============ The Engineering Lead leads the architecture, delivery, and engineering team for Independent AI Evaluation Foundation (IAEF), a platform for evaluating the trustworthiness of artificial intelligence (AI). Reporting to the Founding Director of IAEF, this leader combines technical ownership, team development, security leadership, and external representation. Independent AI Evaluation Foundation (IAEF)’s mission is to identify and reduce barriers to evaluating the efficacy, transparency, and safety of specific educational AI\-centric solutions used by students and opportunity seekers in their educational context. IAEF is a fiscally sponsored project of Digital Harbor Foundation. Digital Harbor Foundation is dedicated to fostering learning, creativity, productivity, and community through education with a vision of digital equity for everyone. Driven by our sincere belief that access to opportunity is a basic right, we take bold yet practical actions to support making a better future now. Through a portfolio of projects focused on developing leadership within communities, we support those closest to challenges to take deliberate actions based on a design thinking approach, backed by data analysis, grounded in a practice of collective impact, and driven by a commitment to racial equity. **Education and Experience Requirements** ========================================= **Required** ------------ * 12\+ years of software engineering experience, including at least four years in senior technical leadership at a startup, evaluation or audit firm, machine\-learning infrastructure company, or research\-grade platform team. * Experience building and operating a platform with a plugin, extension, or component model, and running AI evaluation, red\-teaming, machine\-learning observability, or model\-testing systems in production. * A record of hiring and retaining senior engineers in a distributed team, including at least one applied machine\-learning or agentic\-systems specialist. **Strongly preferred** ---------------------- * Prior CTO, VP Engineering, or founding\-engineer experience at an early\-stage company that raised institutional capital; experience enabling external developers to build on a platform; and prior evaluation\-methodology work with academic or civil\-society partners. * A PhD and extensive experience at a frontier AI research laboratory are not required. **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities** ==================================== * Ability to design reusable platform components and work with human\-in\-the\-loop (HITL) transcripts, benchmark scores, and large language model (LLM) red\-teaming results. * Ability to communicate technical decisions to enterprise security leaders, foundation program officers, investors, customers, and partners. * Ability to prioritize competing technical and organizational needs and lead a distributed engineering team through delivery, operational issues, and growth. * Understanding of the operational separation required between a public benefit corporation, a companion nonprofit, and grant\-funded programs. * Strongly preferred: experience leading implementation of ISO 42001, the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, or SOC 2 requirements, rather than participating only as a reviewer. **Additional Notes** ==================== This is a full\-time, remote\-first role based in the US or EU. New York or the San Francisco Bay Area is strongly preferred for quarterly in\-person meetings with the Founding Director of IAEF, partners, and board. Travel is approximately 15% for funder meetings, partner sites, conferences, and off\-sites. **Role and Responsibilities** ============================= **Platform architecture and delivery** -------------------------------------- Own the Workbench’s Design Test Analyze* Publish (DTAP) workflow, Component Contract, Artifacts API, component registry, and canvas interface. * Create a persistent, structured, queryable evaluation history rather than one\-off engagement exports, and integrate the existing red\-teaming platform, administrative dashboard, and HITL data\-capture architecture instead of rebuilding them from scratch. * Decide when to build or buy authentication, storage, orchestration, LLM\-provider services, and sandboxing for the planned notebook environment. **Engineering leadership** -------------------------- * In conjunction with the Human Resources Department of Digital Harbor Foundation, recruit, develop, and retain the engineering organization against the approved build plan, including Staff/Senior Backend, Senior Frontend, DevOps/site reliability, Applied Machine Learning, and Senior Product Manager roles * Set planning, code\-review, on\-call, incident\-response, and roadmap\-review practices; provide engineering progress and risks for board and funder reporting. **Evaluation platform strategy** -------------------------------- * Partner with the IAFE’s Founding Director and Evaluation Science Lead to translate HITL red teaming, automated benchmarks, LLM red teaming, LLM\-as\-judge, and drift detection into a Component Contract that supports all three Test artifact types and planned agentic components. **Security, compliance, and trust** ----------------------------------- * Lead the PBC’s technical security program, including SOC 2 readiness, safeguards for HITL transcripts and adversarial prompts, and customer security reviews. Provide technical requirements for data processing agreement (DPA) templates in partnership with authorized legal and operations reviewers. * Lead vendor risk reviews for LLM providers, cloud infrastructure, and third\-party evaluation tools. * Coordinate with Digital Harbor Foundation’s Leadership, where applicable, on required approvals, funder restrictions, and separation of PBC and nonprofit resources, data, and intellectual property under approved agreements. Escalate unresolved risks rather than independently determining legal or sponsor policy. **External representation and fundraising** ------------------------------------------- * Represent IAEF in technical conversations with customers, partners, funders, and press, and own the technical content of investor fundraising decks, roadmap materials, demonstrations, and due diligence reviews in partnership with the Founding Director of IAEF and Digital Harbor Foundation’s leadership. * Lead the developer\-relations narrative for software and agent development kits (SDK/ADK) as the Component Contract opens to outside developers in Phase 1, partnering with the Developer Relations \& Ecosystem hire planned for Period 2\. **Other Duties** ================ This job description is not a comprehensive listing of all activities, duties, or responsibilities required for this role. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. **Compensation** ---------------- Compensation for this full\-time position is $215,000 \- $315,000 annually, commensurate with experience. Digital Harbor provides a best\-in\-class, comprehensive set of benefits to support the team. All regular, full\-time employees are eligible to receive: **Health Benefits \& Insurance** -------------------------------- * Carefirst Blue Cross Blue Shield \- Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance (100% of the premium paid for employees and 85% of dependents) * Pre\-Tax Health Savings Account (HSA) (with $365 monthly employer contributions) * Pre\-Tax Flexible Savings Account (FSA) * Paid Accidental Death \& Dismemberment (AD\&D) Insurance * Paid Short\-Term \& Long\-Term Disability Insurance * Paid Basic Life Insurance * Supplemental Voluntary Life Insurance (Employee, Spouse \& Dependent Children) * Total Pet Plan and Supplemental Wishbone Pet Insurance * Employee Opportunity Program (EAP) \- Health and Wellness * Wellness Reimbursement Program **Retirement** -------------- * 401k Retirement Plan (with 6% matching) **Paid Time Off** ----------------- * 15 Days Paid Time Off Per Year * 20 Days Paid Time Off Per Year (after 3rd Anniversary) * 25 Days Paid Time Off Per Year (after 6th Anniversary) * 16 Paid Holidays (14 common plus 2 flexible holidays, including Dec 25 \- Jan 1\) * Paid Bereavement Leave * Paid Parental Leave for Moms and Dads (two weeks after first year) If our mission and vision align with your personal values, please apply! A cover letter outlining your qualifications for the position, along with your resume, is required. Interviews will be conducted virtually. Digital Harbor and IAEF are equal opportunity employers. 6yDMI3ZJKI

jobs.title: Process Transformation Director
jobs.description: **Company Overview** -------------------- Docusign brings agreements to life. More than 1\.8 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business\-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using the Docusign AI\-native IAM platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the \#1 company in e\-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM). **What you'll do** ------------------ The Process Transformation Director leads the strategic, long\-term transformation of a high\-touch portfolio of Docusign’s most critical enterprise customers to leverage our Agentic platform capabilities. Operating as a hybrid between an executive consultant driving digital process transformation and a strategic account leader, this role builds trusted advisor and trusted partner status with customer executives to lead the strategic development of their Transformation Roadmap and target operating models to maximize the measurable value of Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management (IAM) Platform. Working in close cross\-functional alignment across Sales, Services, TAM, Partner Delivery, and Product teams, the Process Transformation Director connects technical delivery directly to executive business outcomes, drives complex organizational change, and accelerates enterprise\-wide platform adoption. Beyond standard account execution, this role expands Docusign’s operational footprint into new functional areas. Crucially, it partners with customers to help them establish their own Centers of Excellence (CoE), building long\-term capability around agentic AI solutions, Docusign’s API ecosystem, and MCP Server, while continuing to prescribe and refine target operating models. This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Vice President, Enterprise Customer Success, Americas. **Responsibility** * Partner with customer C\-suite and Senior Leadership to co\-author, execute, and continuously refresh multi\-BU agentic transformation strategies and roadmaps using established Business Process Re\-engineering (BPR) frameworks * Define transformation business cases, measurable impact, and Value Management frameworks, conducting periodic Value Realization Audits to ensure Docusign IAM and agentic AI capabilities directly align with corporate ROI goals * Lead the creation, execution, and ongoing governance of a mutually agreed Enterprise AI Transformation Plan * Partner closely with the TAM to ensure the technology roadmap is fully integrated into the Customer’s technical and governance activities, driving rapid time\-to\-value and measurable business outcomes across active use cases and professional services engagements * Drive joint delivery alignment with Global System Integrator (GSI) and SI partners to scale solution delivery and expand account footprints * Facilitate executive workshops to analyze agreement workflows and prescribe target operating models and modernized strategies using Docusign IAM and agentic AI * Guide customers on replacing fragmented processes with intelligent intake, automated routing, and centralized agreement analytics * Apply structured change management strategies to overcome adoption hurdles across matrixed business units * Guide customers in establishing and scaling internal Docusign Centers of Excellence (COE) to standardize best practices, governance, and self\-sustaining platform growth * Identify and mitigate adoption and strategic risks early using strong executive presence * Partner with the TAM to proactively resolve emerging technical risks before they escalate into support cases, presenting clear mitigation strategies and trade\-offs to executive sponsors * Mobilize and align internal cross\-functional teams, including Sales, Product, Engineering, and Professional Services, to deliver unified account strategies * Maintain close operational alignment with the TAM to provide seamless executive and technical account coverage * Leverage platform usage analytics, business outcome tracking, and account insights to build defensible renewal strategies in active preparation for renewal cycles, while uncovering adjacent high\-value use cases for account expansion in partnership with Sales * Act as a recognized Subject Matter Expert (SME) internally and externally * Drive thought leadership by sharing industry insights, publishing reusable CoE frameworks, and coaching team members to elevate customer success practices across the global organization **Job Designation** ------------------- **Remote:** Employee is not required to be in or near an office frequently and works from a designated remote work location for the majority of the time. Positions at Docus f publishing thought leadership or presenting at major industry events **Wage Transparency** --------------------- Pay for this position is based on a number of factors including geographic location and may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Based on applicable legislation, the below details pay ranges in the following locations: California: $152,700\.00 \- $231,625\.00 base salary Illinois, Colorado, Massachusetts and Minnesota: $148,300\.00 \- $215,050\.00 base salary Washington, Maryland, New Jersey and New York (including NYC metro area): $148,300\.00 \- $221,400\.00 base salary Washington DC: $152,700\.00 \- $221,400\.00 base salary Ohio: $141,000\.00 \- $204,450\.00 base salary This role is also eligible for the following: * Bonus: Sales personnel are eligible for variable incentive pay dependent on their achievement of pre\-established sales goals. Non\-Sales roles are eligible for a company bonus plan, which is calculated as a percentage of eligible wages and dependent on company performance. * Stock: This role is eligible to receive Restricted Stock Units (RSUs). Global benefits provide options for the following: * Paid Time Off: earned time off, as well as paid company holidays based on region * Paid Parental Leave: take up to six months off with your child after birth, adoption or foster care placement * Full Health Benefits Plans: options for 100% employer paid and minimum employee contribution health plans from day one of employment * Retirement Plans: select retirement and pension programs with potential for employer contributions * Learning and Development: options for coaching, online courses and education reimbursements * Compassionate Care Leave: paid time off following the loss of a loved one and other life\-changing events **Work Authorization Notice:** Please note that we do not provide visa sponsorship or immigration support for this position. Applicants must already be authorized to work in the United States on a full\-time, permanent basis without the need for current or future sponsorship. **Life at Docusign** -------------------- **Working here** Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal. We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live. **Accommodation** Docusign is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need such an accommodation, or a religious accommodation, during the application process, please contact us at accommodations@docusign.com. If you experience any issues, concerns, or technical difficulties during the application process please get in touch with our Talent organization at taops@docusign.com for assistance. **AI in Our Hiring Process** At Docusign, we embrace technology to enhance efficiency and create a better candidate experience. jobs.description: ### **Company Overview** EZ Aerial is a leading military\-grade autonomous Drone\-in\-a\-Box designer and manufacturer headquartered in the Brooklyn, New York. With a team composed of former military personnel and seasoned aerospace and robotics engineers, we pride ourselves on delivering innovative drone technologies built in the USA. The daily challenges will require creative problem\-solving and engineering intuition. This role will require the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and work cross\-functionally to advance the product lines. A mechanical engineer at Easy Aerial is expected to run projects from start to finish, including concept development, prototyping, and transition to production. We are looking for candidates that will be committed to continuous improvement of the products and are always eager to stay ahead of industry trends, ensuring that your designs are at the forefront of technological advancement. ### **Key Responsibilities:** * Design and develop mechanical components and systems for autonomous drone platforms, ensuring functionality and manufacturability, while optimizing system performance. * Translate operational and system requirements into design guidelines and robust solutions. * Conduct analysis and simulations to validate designs (stress, thermal, and vibration) * Create and revise detailed 3D CAD models, 2D drawings, specifications, and documentation for manufacturing and assembly. * Participate in prototyping, assembly, fabrication, and validation of new designs. * Identify system design and manufacturing issues by conducing root cause analysis, evaluating impacts and risks, and implementing solutions to the product. * Carry design projects through the full Engineering process and coordinate implementation through an Engineering Change Process. * Drive continuous improvement of products through cross\-functional collaboration and conducting design reviews for Engineering and leadership stakeholders * Participate in integration efforts to support customer requests and growing applications of Easy Aerial products. ### **Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field. (Master’s degree is a plus) * 8\+ years of experience in mechanical design and analysis in the aerospace or defense industries as applied to unmanned aircraft systems. * Familiarity with regulatory standards for military vehicles, systems, and equipment. (MIL\-STD, etc.) * Proficiency in CAD/PDM software (Solidworks, Autodesk, etc.) with experience in simulation tools (Solidworks Simulation, etc.) * Demonstrate knowledge of materials and manufacturing processes relevant to aerospace applications. * Demonstrate hands\-on prototyping experience and familiarity with fabrication/manufacturing techniques. * Strong communication and teamwork skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across disciplines in a small\-business environment. * U.S. National (Citizen, naturalized, etc.) * Familiarity with ISO9001 and AS9100 standards is highly desirable ### **Tools and Knowledge Base:** * CAD Systems (Solidworks proficiency preferred) * Configuration Management principles and tools (Solidworks PDM preferred) * Design Simulation Tools (Solidworks Simulation preferred) ### **Why Join EZ Aerial?** * Be part of a pioneering company at the forefront of autonomous drone technology. * Work in a collaborative and innovative environment with a talented team. * Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package. * Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.

Lilly is investing over $3 Billion to create a new state\-of\-the\-art manufacturing site for Drug Substance, in Lebanon, Indiana. The brand\-new facility will utilize a variety of Platforms and have the latest technology for API Manufacturing and Technology. This is an exciting once\-in\-a\-lifetime opportunity to help build and operate a new site. The Lilly Lebanon API Manufacturing site will be built using the latest high\-tech equipment, advanced highly integrated and automated manufacturing systems, and have a focus on minimizing the impact to our environment. This is an opportunity you don’t want to miss! **What You’ll Be Doing:** You will be part of Tech at Lilly MQ (Manufacturing and Quality), an organization that drives manufacturing operational excellence and productivity efforts through utilization of technology. Tech at Lilly MQ strives to enable the making of medicine “with safety first and quality always”. As a Lab System Engineer, you will ensure the manufacturing Labs systems (MODA, LabVantage, NuGenesis, Empower, WInKQCL, etc) as well as computerized labs instruments are deployed with proper and right sized validation documents at LP1, including authoring or directing the creation and publishing of required CSV packages. Once systems and Instruments are deployed, this role will evolve into monitoring, execution, and maintenance of the Laboratory IT Systems and Instruments, with an emphasis on continuous improvement, especially with regards to data integrity. This role will leverage a deep understanding of CSV and Data Integrity principles ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, consistent application, and sustainability for local and global Tech at Lilly systems, and labs instruments used at the LP1 site. This role will collaborate with the local and global Computer System Quality Assurance team and Tech at Lilly organization to enable best practices, processes, and governance to consider new points to strengthen the Tech at Lilly CSV and Data Integrity position and align with corporate objectives and initiatives. **How You’ll Succeed:** * Leads and/or supports the laboratory with the validation of laboratory equipment and software systems including computerized analytical instrument qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ) and computerized system validation across GAMP 5 software categories. * Supports the establishment and maintenance of the validated state of software\-based computerized systems and lab instruments in use in the lab, including ownership of periodic review cycles to confirm ongoing compliance and fitness for intended use. * Partner cross\-functionally with site DI SMEs to ensure a common, systematic approach to meeting existing and new DI/CSV expectations. This includes, but is not limited to, audit trail management, workstation security, and connecting stand\-alone equipment. * Supports site deployment and upgrade of laboratory IT systems such as MODA, Empower, NuGenesis, and LabVantage with any CSV needs * Partners and builds relationships with Global Quality Laboratory Network, Global and Site IT team members, Computer System Quality Assurance (CSQA), site Quality Assurance, and external vendor/supplier organizations. * Provides oversight and supports continuous improvement of systems/instruments as they relate to the labs * Applies knowledge of quality principles, cGMP, and laboratory systems towards the development and execution of local procedures, training courses, and practices * Manages and supports both internal or external audit and inspection activities for the laboratory. * Performs change control, investigations, ro uirements/solutions * Must have excellent communication skills. **Basic Qualifications:** * Bachelor of Science degree in IT, Engineering, or related field * 3\+ years of relevant work experience in labs system administration and CSV capacity working in a regulated industry (i.e., GMP) and strong understanding of quality processes in IT that applies to manufacturing. * Qualified applicants must be authorized to work in the United States on a full\-time basis. Lilly will not provide support for or sponsor work authorization or visas for this role, including but not limited to F\-1 CPT, F\-1 OPT, F\-1 STEM OPT, J\-1, H\-1B, TN, O\-1, E\-3, H\-1B1, or L\-1\. **Additional Preferences:** * Understanding of cybersecurity concepts and best practices related to IT technologies. * Build solutions using an agile framework for the entire solution lifecycle including designing, implementing, automating, modernizing, maintaining, and optimizing solutions. * Experience with technical mentoring and developing technical team members. * Exposure to international operations, diverse teams, global IT projects, or working in a global organization. * Previous Agile experience. * Experience deploying new system implementations * Experience in standing up greenfield facilities **Other Information:** * Role is Monday through Friday and based on\-site. Must be flexible in providing support to accommodate other inputs (production schedules, shutdowns, etc.). Occasional extended hour and / or off\-hour work may be required. * Position will be based out of the Lebanon, IN site with ability to travel to other US and global Lilly sites as required. If you require accommodation to submit a resume for a position at Lilly, please complete the accommodation request form (https://careers.lilly.com/us/en/workplace\-accommodation) for further assistance. Please note this is for individuals to request an accommodation as part of the application process and any other correspondence will not receive a response. Our employee resource groups (ERGs) offer strong support networks for their members and are open to all employees. Our current groups include: Africa, Middle East, Central Asia (AMECA), Black Employees at Lilly (BE@Lilly), Chinese Culture Network (CCN), EnAble, Evolve, Lilly Indian Network (LIN), Organization of Latinx at Lilly (OLA), Pride (LGBTQ\+ Allies), Veterans Leadership Network (VLN) and Women’s Initiative for Leading at Lilly (WILL). jobs.title: Engineer I, Data

jobs.title: AI\ML Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Overview** As an AI/ML Engineer, you’ll turn data into practical solutions by building, evaluating, and deploying artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning models. You’ll partner with research and analytics teams to develop predictive and generative AI capabilities, strengthen data workflows, and deliver scalable systems. Your impact: Reliable, well\-evaluated models help research teams uncover useful insights and enable stakeholders to make better\-informed decisions. **Duties** * Prepare and transform data through extract, transform, load (ETL) workflows, data mining, and linked data practices; work with SQL databases and big data systems. * Train, evaluate, and deploy AI models for machine learning, unsupervised learning, natural language processing, and predictive modeling. * Apply statistical modeling, statistical analysis, and machine learning/AI\-based analysis to research and analytics questions. * Build scalable solutions using machine learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, Spark, Hadoop, and machine learning cloud services, including Amazon Web Services (AWS). * Collaborate on AI implementation and Spark implementation; use analytics and data visualization tools such as Looker where appropriate. **Requirements** * Experience with Python and SQL; familiarity with Java, C, R, or VBA is useful. * Knowledge of machine learning, model training and evaluation, statistical analysis tools, and statistical analysis for research. * Understanding of database design, ETL, scalability, big data, and data analytics; exposure to Talend or Bash (Unix shell) is a plus. * Familiarity with SAS, generative AI, and machine learning cloud services is beneficial. * Interest or experience in quantum engineering is welcome; it is not required. jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** Eurofins Scientific is a network of independent companies providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic, and labelling is accurate. Eurofins is dedicated to delivering testing services that contribute to the health and safety of society and the planet, and to its corporate responsibility to protect the environment and ensure diversity, equity, and inclusion across the entire network of Eurofins companies. With over 50 laboratories and more than 40 service centers nationwide, Eurofins Environment Testing provides full\-service environmental analysis across all 50 states. Our network supports public and private clients—including DoD, DOE, and municipalities—through robust logistics and continuous investment in people, technology, and infrastructure.We offer comprehensive testing for air, water, soil, sediment, tissue, and waste, covering a wide range of analytes including PFAS, metals, VOCs/SVOCs, dioxins/furans, radiochemicals, and more. **Job Description** As an Applied AI Engineer, you will design and deploy AI\-powered applications that extract, organize, and analyze laboratory information from forms, reports, and instrument\-generated documents. You will leverage modern OCR, Vision\-Language Models (VLMs), and Large Language Models (LLMs) to automate laboratory workflows and improve operational efficiency across the organization. This role focuses on practical AI application development, system integration, and workflow automation. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** * Design, develop, and deploy AI\-powered solutions for document understanding, information extraction, and workflow automation. * Build and maintain OCR, VLM, and LLM\-based pipelines to process laboratory forms, reports, chromatograms, certificates, and instrument\-generated documents. * Develop and integrate REST APIs and backend services to support AI\-enabled applications. * Collaborate with laboratory analysts, software engineers, and business stakeholders to identify automation opportunities and translate business requirements into scalable solutions. * Evaluate and implement commercial and open\-source AI technologies, including foundation models, document intelligence platforms, and retrieval systems. * Develop data ingestion, transformation, validation, and monitoring processes for structured and unstructured laboratory data. * Optimize AI application performance, reliability, and cost in cloud and on\-premises environments. * Troubleshoot complex technical issues across AI, data, and software systems. * Stay current with advances in AI, LLMs, VLMs, OCR, and related technologies, and assess their applicability to laboratory operations. * Perform other duties as assigned. **Qualifications** **Basic Minimum Qualifications** * M.S. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related field and 1\-3 years of experience in software development, AI engineering, machine learning, data engineering, or a related field; OR * Ph.D. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related field. * Strong programming skills in Python. * Experience developing software applications using modern software engineering practices. * Authorization to work in the United States without current or future sponsorship. **Ideal Candidates will have** * Experience working with Large Language Models (LLMs), Vision\-Language Models (VLMs), or multimodal AI systems. * Experience with document intelligence and OCR technologies such as Azure AI Document Intelligence, Amazon Textract, Google Document AI, Tesseract, or PaddleOCR. * Experience building data extraction, document processing, or workflow automation solutions. * Experience developing and consuming REST APIs. * Experience with Microsoft Azure and cloud\-native services. * Experience with Docker, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and software deployment best practices. * Experience with C\# and .NET development. * Knowledge of relational databases and SQL. * Exceptional problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills. * Experience working with laboratory, scientific, environmental, or analytical chemistry data is a plus. * Candidates located in the Greater Houston area or willing to relocate to Stafford, Texas are strongly preferred. **Additional Information** * Position will be a Full Time position, Monday\- Friday * Position will be onsite based in Stafford, TX **We support your development!** Do you feel you don’t match 100% of the requirements? Don’t hesitate to apply anyway! Eurofins companies are committed to supporting your career development. **We embrace diversity!** Eurofins network of companies believe in strength and innovation through diversity, being an Equal Opportunity Employer. We prohibit discrimination against employees or applications based on gender identity and/or expression, race, nationality, age, religion, sexual orientation, disability, and everything else that makes employees of Eurofins companies unique. **Sustainability matters to us!** At Eurofins, we believe sustainability is at the heart of everything we do. Guided by our vision to be the Global Leader in “Testing for Life,” our mission to contribute to a healthier and safer world, and our core values, we are building a strong foundation for Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives. Eurofins’ commitment to sustainability begins within our own companies through a shared responsibility to people and the planet. With climate change posing an imminent threat, Eurofins and its many companies recognize their duty to proactively reduce or offset the environmental impact of essential operations while also helping our clients do the same—serving as a true ESG Enabler. **Find out more in our career page: https://careers.eurofins.com/** ***We do not offer Visa Sponsorship for this role.*** As a Eurofins employee, you will become part of a company that has received national recognition as a great place to work. we offer excellent benefits including comprehensive medical coverage, life and disability insurance, 401(k) with company match, paid holidays, paid time off, and dental and vision options. * The benefits package offered will vary based on the employee's full\-time or part\-time regular status. **Eurofins USA Environment Testing is a Disabled and Veteran Equal Employment Opportunity employer.**

jobs.title: Senior Applied Scientist - Experience Data and Capabilities Team
jobs.description: At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business. Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors\-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together\-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere. **Introduction to the Team:** Expedia Technology teams partner with our Product teams to create innovative products, services, and tools to deliver high\-quality experiences for travelers, partners, and our employees. A singular technology platform powered by data and machine learning provides secure, differentiated, and personalized experiences that drive loyalty and traveler satisfaction. The Experience Data and Capabilities team at Expedia is at the forefront of innovation in AI\-driven agentic systems. We're dedicated to enhancing customer experiences, increasing engagement, and strengthening traveler relationships through cutting\-edge machine learning solutions. Our work directly impacts millions of travelers worldwide, shaping their journey from dreaming to booking and beyond. Join a team that’s focused on Agentic Data and Context revolutionizing traveler experiences through autonomous, intelligent agent systems. From building cutting\-edge conversational AI that anticipates traveler needs to developing proactive solutions for personalized trip planning, your work will shape the future of travel assistance and directly impact millions of users worldwide. This is a rare opportunity to build foundational systems in a high\-impact domain, backed by Expedia’s AI\-first vision. **In this role, you will:** * Research and implement state\-of\-the\-art techniques in agentic architectures, such as ReAct, reflection loops, chain\-of\-thought prompting, and tool\-augmented reasoning * Develop and maintain agent orchestration frameworks, defining how agents decompose tasks, delegate to sub\-agents, and handle failure and recovery * Integrate large language models (LLMs) with external tools, APIs, databases, and code execution environments to enable real\-world task completion * Define and own evaluation frameworks for agentic systems, measuring task success, reliability, latency, cost, and safety across diverse benchmarks and production scenarios * Collaborate closely with product, engineering, and research teams to translate business requirements into agentic system designs and deliver production\-grade solutions * Identify and mitigate risks specific to agentic systems, including prompt injection, unintended actions, hallucination in long\-horizon tasks, and unsafe tool use * Stay current with the rapidly evolving agentic AI landscape, synthesizing academic research and industry developments to inform the team's technical direction Mentor junior ML engineers and scientists, providing technical guidance on agentic design patterns, LLM best practices, and experimentation methodology * **Minimum Qualifications:** * 8\+ years of related industry experience * Demonstrated experience designing and deploying agentic or multi\-step AI systems (e.g., ReAct, tool\-calling agents, multi\-agent pipelines) in production or research settings * Strong proficiency in Python and ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX); experience with LLM APIs and orchestration libraries (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar) * Experience integrating LLMs with external tools, APIs, and structured data sources for real\-world task completion * Solid understanding of prompt engineering techniques including chain\-of\-thought, few\-shot prompting, and structured output generation Experience defining and running evaluation frameworks for ML systems, including offline benchmarking and production monitoring * **Preferred Qualifications:** * PhD, MS, or BS in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Engineering, or a related field; or equivalent professional experience * Experience in the travel or e\-commerce industry * Publications in top\-tier ML conferences or journals * Patented Inventions, pending and issued * Contributions to open\-source ML projects * Experience taking models from prototype to production in collaboration with Machine Learning Engineering teams The total cash range for this position in Seattle is $184,500\.00 to $258,000\.00\. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $295,000\.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.\&\#xa; Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future. **Benefits and perks** Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership. Learn more about life at Expedia Group at https://careers.expediagroup.com/life . **Accommodation requests** Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service\-now.com/askeg?id\=job\_accommodation . **About Expedia Group** Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands \- Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo \- along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease. **Important notice** Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/ . **Equal Opportunity** Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. This employer participates in E\-Verify. The employer will provide the Social Security Administration (SSA) and, if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) with information from each new employee's I\-9 to confirm work authorization.

jobs.title: Data Quality Engineer
jobs.description: **The Team You'll Join** ======================== First American Data \& Analytics helps bring greater clarity and confidence to real estate decisions through industry\-leading property data, risk management, and valuation solutions. Built on one of the industry's largest and most comprehensive property and ownership datasets, our team combines advanced data, technology, and industry expertise to help lenders, real estate professionals, title companies, and organizations across diverse sectors make more informed decisions throughout the real estate life cycle. You'll work alongside experts who transform complex property, ownership, valuation, tax, compliance, and risk information into actionable insights that help clients identify opportunities, improve efficiency, and manage risk. Along the way, you'll have the freedom and support to innovate, collaborate, and grow professionally alongside people who genuinely care about your success. **The Impact You'll Make** ========================== Primary point of responsibility, accountability and activity for the assessment, improvement and governance of quality and ongoing fitness\-for \-purpose of an organizations critical data assets. Data Quality Engineers are not the producers of the data but serve as trustees to ensure data quality is maintained to support business products and processes. Using SQL queries, monitors, tracks and reports ongoing data quality levels of the data loaded into the database systems. Identifies data quality metrics and executes data quality audits to benchmark the state of data quality. Provides production job support from a quality perspective serve as a data quality subject matter expert partnering with Product and Technology Teams to implement data logic and product releases. Engages with business leadership to quantify and articulate the business impact of data quality issues. **HOW YOU’LL CONTRIBUTE** * Tests new data logic and derived content and provides data insight for ETL, IT development, and other teams. * Conducts data quality reviews using various tools and methodologies. * Participates in projects involving new data aggregations and custom solutions. * Utilizes tools to analyze, query and manipulate data according to defined business rules and procedures. * Performs QC tests (system and visual) to verify data integrity. * Manages minor data quality errors. * Documents and works to resolve basic \& mid\-level problems. * Updates and maintains database with reviewed and corrected data. * Communicates issues to programmers to resolve data quality issues. * Updates logs, tracks user requests, fulfills basic requests. * Works with offshore support team(s) responsible for reoccurring fulfillments and/or QC processes. * Other duties as assigned **WHAT YOU’LL BRING** Required Education, Experience, Certification/Licensure * Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience * 3\-5 years of experience working with public record data **KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES (KSAs)** * Experience with SQL and ETL tools * Experience performing data quality reviews and data gap analysis on county recorder content * Ability to enhance, edit and correct data content issues based on knowledge and experience * Excellent verbal and written communication skills, and ability to interface effectively with product, development, data inquiry and data fulfillment teams * Ability to formulate conclusions and define next steps upon completion of a data quality review process * Tenacity for solving detailed issues * Knowledge of MS Word and Excel to create/update documents and spreadsheets containing basic formulas and formatting * Talent for quickly learning new tasks * Objective, creative, and diplomatic team player **Pay, Benefits, and Support** ============================== Pay Range: $73,900\.00 \- $98,500\.00 Annually This hiring range is a reasonable estimate of the base pay range for this position at the time of posting. Pay is based on a number of factors which may include job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, business requirements and geographic location. Based on eligibility, First American offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, 401k, PTO/paid sick leave and other great benefits like an employee stock purchase plan. Our people first culture is built on creating a workplace where different perspectives are welcomed, respected, and valued. We believe teams are stronger when employees feel supported, included, and encouraged to contribute as themselves. Here, you’ll be part of a culture built on collaboration, respect, accountability, and continuous improvement — so you can do meaningful work, grow your career, and help move our customers, communities, and company forward. **About First American** ======================== First American Financial Corporation (NYSE: FAF) is a premier provider of title, settlement, and risk solutions for real estate transactions. Backed by financial strength and stability built over more than 135 years, the company is leading the digital transformation of the industry through continued investment in proprietary technologies, unmatched data assets, and scalable solutions designed for what’s next. First American’s commitment to putting its people first has resulted in numerous accolades, including being named one of the 100 Best Companies to Work For by Great Place to Work® and Fortune Magazine for more than ten consecutive years. The company has also been included on the PEOPLE® Companies that Care and Fortune Best Workplaces lists for Financial Services and Insurance, in addition to earning national recognition as a best place to work for women, parents, and LGBTQ\+ employees. These accolades reflect a workplace where collaboration, respect, accountability, and continuous improvement guide how we work together every day. Learn more about the company at www.firstam.com. \*\*Note that the following statements only apply to candidates who will be working from an unincorporated area within Los Angeles County.\*\* First American will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws (e.g., the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act). First American intends to conduct a review of an applicant’s criminal history in connection with a conditional offer. First American reasonably believes that a criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following material job duties for this position potentially resulting in the withdrawal of the conditional offer of employment: handling of confidential, proprietary or trade secret information belonging to First American or its customers, administering or facilitating financial transactions, and the ability to meet customer\-imposed criminal history requirements.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Security Engineer
jobs.description: **THE POSITION** Our roster has an opening with your name on it FanDuel is expanding its Cyber Fusion Center designed to bring together detection, response, threat intelligence, vulnerability validation and offensive security into a tightly integrated security capability. We are looking for an exceptional **Lead, Offensive Assurance (OA)** to build and lead the offensive security capability within the Cyber Fusion Center. **FanDuel Offensive Security Mindset: Real\-world Continuous Adversarial Testing** You will establish a highly technical team capable of conducting sophisticated and covert adversary operations across FanDuel's environment. The team will run multiple sustained campaigns throughout the year, emulating realistic threat actors and testing our ability to prevent, detect, investigate and respond to compromises. The remit also extends to the rapidly evolving AI attack surface. OA will use AI to enhance offensive operations while developing the capability to adversarially test AI systems, agents and the infrastructure and controls surrounding them. Alongside dedicated red team operations, OA will work closely with Detection \& Response, Threat Intelligence, Vulnerability Validation, Security Engineering, AI and technology teams to conduct purple team exercises, adversary emulation and continuous control validation. OA will also collaborate and coordinate all offensive operations with our legal and GRC partner teams. This is an opportunity to build the capability from the ground up: its operating model, tooling, infrastructure, tradecraft, campaign methodology, AI capabilities, metrics and culture. Role Mission and Context **THE GAME PLAN** Everyone on our team has a part to play Offensive Assurance \& Continuous Adversary Emulation Lead and mature FanDuel's offensive assurance capability from first principles, moving the organization from periodic testing toward continuous, intelligence\-driven validation. * **Program \& Team Leadership:** Define the operating model, rules of engagement, technical infrastructure, and multi\-year maturity roadmap; mentor and lead a high\-caliber offensive security team. Collaborate with relevant functions to develop the existing deconfliction process and the White Cell. * **Continuous Covert OffSec Operations:** Design and execute discreet, multi\-vector adversary campaigns across cloud, identity, endpoint, application, API, and third\-party attack surfaces. Build campaign objectives around intelligence, realistic adversary behavior and FanDuel's evolving technology environment. * **AI\-Enabled Offensive Tradecraft \& AI Red Teaming:** Pioneer the use of AI/autonomous agents to scale offensive speed and attack\-path discovery, while systematically stress\-testing FanDuel's own AI systems, models, and agentic workflows against compromise and abuse. * **Purple Teaming \& CFC Integration:** Partner directly with Detection \& Response (DART) and the broader Cyber Fusion Center to run iterative purple team exercises, converting offensive findings into actionable detections, telemetry uplifts, and regression\-testable control validations. * **Adversary Research:** Continuously research emerging threat actor tradecraft, zero\-days, and novel attack surfaces to ensure our defenses are tested against tomorrow's attacks, not yesterday's. **THE STATS** What we're looking for in our next teammate * Previous experience establishing an internal red team, purple team, or adversarial simulation capability from the ground up, including writing ROEs and deconfliction protocols. * Demonstrated experience designing and running realistic, multi\-stage adversary campaigns rather than isolated security exercises. * Strong understanding of modern defensive security, including security telemetry, detection engineering and how defenders monitor and track adversary activity. * Track record operating in high\-volume, 24/7, highly regulated environments (gaming, sports tech, fintech, big tech, or large\-scale consumer e\-commerce). * Demonstrated experience attacking and pivoting through modern cloud\-native infrastructures (AWS/GCP), container/orchestration environments (Kubernetes), and complex identity fabrics (Okta, Azure AD/Entra ID). * Proficiency in developing custom tradecraft, C2 frameworks, evasion techniques, and automation tooling in Python, Go, Rust, or C/C\+\+. * Hands\-on exposure to frontier model security and modern AI red teaming initiatives, benchmarks, or frameworks. * Ability to lead highly technical practitioners while remaining deeply hands\-on. * Strong judgement and experience defining the scope, operating safely within the RoE and authorization boundaries and risk tolerances. * Experience in leading and conducting Purple Team exercises in collaboration with defensive teams. **AI\-Enabled Offensive
