jobs.title: Staff Native Apps Engineer
jobs.description: FloSports is a world\-class sports media company strategically positioned to be the essential destination for passionate sports fans, delighting them with live event coverage, breaking news, highlights, stats, rankings, and team and player profiles. We are growing Our Sports every day by continuing to invest in our ever\-expanding ecosystem, which consists of over a dozen sport verticals and hundreds of streaming partners. FloSports is creating the home for college conferences/leagues and sports like grappling, hockey, track \& field, racing, cheer, wrestling, and more, and we are looking for innovative and passionate people like you to help us! THE ROLE: We are seeking a Staff Native Apps Engineer to help drive the technical direction of our mobile and TV platforms: the apps fans watch live sports on. Our native apps are mature and shipping. What we're adding is an engineer who can take a new initiative from an ambiguous starting point all the way through delivery: framing the problem, setting the approach, and leading a team to ship it. You'll do that alongside our other Staff and Principal engineers, where direction gets set collectively rather than handed down. The experiences you'll own are defined by live sports. Video playback has to hold up on real\-world networks during events that don't get a second take. Increasingly the work is also realtime data: live stats, scores, and rankings arriving during a match and rendering correctly across every platform at once. This is a hands\-on individual contributor role across iOS, Android, and our native TV platforms (Apple TV, Fire TV/Android TV). Our streaming footprint also includes Roku, Samsung, LG, and Vizio. Experience there is a plus, not a requirement. RESPONSIBILITIES: * Own new initiatives end to end: take an ambiguous business or platform goal, frame the problem, define the approach, and lead a team through delivery. * Help drive the technical direction of the native platform alongside other Staff and Principal engineers: architecture, shared patterns, and the trade\-off calls between platform investment and delivery. * Work across the systems behind our live experiences, from video playback to the realtime data paths powering live stats, scores, and rankings, and shape their architecture as initiatives take you into them. * Help guide the direction of our backend\-for\-frontend (BFF) alongside Staff\+ engineers on that side of the stack, shaping the contract between the native experience layer and the services behind it, not just consuming it. * Write production native code and stay close to the details that matter. Architecture decisions here are made by someone who still ships. * Own release quality across platforms, including rollout and upgrade strategy, and the app store review risk that comes with shipping against a live event calendar. * Raise the bar for the engineers around you. Mentor senior engineers, and set quality and review standards that hold across platforms. * Partner with product, design, and engineering leadership to shape the roadmap, surfacing technical constraints and opportunities early enough to change the plan. * Own the long\-term health of the platform (stability, performance, app security, and crash reporting), including the instrumentation that tells you something is degrading before fans do. * Establish how the squad uses AI\-assisted development: the workflows, guardrails, and review practices that make these tools a durable productivity gain rather than a source of technical debt KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES: ### **Required** * Track record of owning ambiguous initiatives through delivery: you've been handed a goal rather than a spec, defined what to build, and led a team to ship it. * Experience setting technical direction collaboratively with other senior\-most engineers, reaching decisions through influence rather than authority. * Hands\-on experience with native video playback (AVPlayer, ExoPlayer/Media3, or equivalent) and with HLS streaming in production. * Expert\-level proficiency in Swift or Kotlin, with professional fluency in the other and the ability to set technical direction across both. We're looking for depth in one platform, not a claim of mastery in two. * Demonstrated experience owning the architecture of a native platform, with decisions that outlived the project that prompted them. * Experience designing API contracts with backend teams, including backend\-for\-frontend (BFF) architectures. * Experience owning crash reporting and app performance for a production mobile app, defining what gets measured, not just reading the dashboard. * Experience with mobile CI/CD and release tooling, and ownership of how an app actually gets shipped. ### **Strongly preferred** * Experience with realtime or live\-updating data on mobile: UI that stays correct as data changes underneath it. * Experience shipping to TV platforms such as tvOS, Fire TV, or Android TV. * Experience with Roku (BrightScript/SceneGraph). * Experience with AI\-assisted development tools and a point of view on where they help and where they don't. * Contributions to shared component libraries or design systems in a native mobile context. OUR COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY: At FloSports, we are bonded by our passion for sports and our purpose to unite communities around experiences that finally give underserved sports the love they deserve. We recognize the need to build a company that seeks out, embraces, and celebrates our individual differences, ideas, and talent. FloSports is committed to the pursuit of a fair, equal and inclusive workplace where everyone is given the opportunity to grow to their fullest potential. OUR BENEFITS: * Recognized three years in a row as a Top Workplace by the Austin\-American Statesman * Flexibility at work \- you can take control of your profession and personal schedule * All\-hands events hosted in beautiful Austin, Texas * Annual equity awards for all top performers * Competitive and comprehensive medical, dental and vision plans * Peace of mind through company\-paid short\-term disability, long\-term disability and life insurance * Generous 401(K) company match vested immediately * Progressive parental leave policies * Flexible paid time off * Hack\-a\-thons and a full calendar of team\-building and social events * Company donation to youth teams and leagues that our employees coach * Stocked snack bar, catered lunch and breakfast tacos every week

jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Austin, TX; New York, NY; San Francisco, CA **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- On\-site **Department** -------------- Development **Compensation** ---------------- * $264K – $322K *To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base pay ranges for all US\-based job postings. Our compensation package includes base salary, equity for all full time roles, benefits, and, for applicable roles, commissions plans.* *This range reflects a good\-faith estimate based on the applicable pay scale, the range previously established for this role, the compensation of individuals currently in equivalent positions, and/or the budgeted amount for the position. Outstanding candidates may be eligible for adjusted terms, plus meaningful equity that ensures you benefit directly from the company's long\-term performance.* *Total compensation may also include equity in the form of restricted stock units.* **About Fluidstack** ==================== We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built \- but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it. We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them \- with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization\-scale infrastructure for AI. **We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!** **How We Operate** ================== * **Be a barrel.** Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role. * **Insane urgency.** We drive everything forward as fast as possible. * **Reason from first principles.** Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins. * **Love of the game.** The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward. * **Build something that actually matters.** If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world. **The Controls Team** ===================== **Examples of key problems the team is working on** * Deliver the controls behind gigawatt\-scale data centers this decade. * Own real\-time load control and MEP and behind\-the\-meter integration. * Automate Level 4 and Level 5 commissioning. * Drive autonomous, robotic deployment. **Role Scope** ============== * Lead the team of PLC and SCADA engineers who build the controls libraries every Fluidstack data center runs on, setting priorities, reviewing their work, and owning what ships to site. * Set the controls architecture and design standards for the fleet, from network topology and controller selection to equipment and controls specifications, so every new campus starts from one validated reference design. * Define the deliverables for every controls package, including template PLC programs, HMI screens, point lists, and sequences of operations, and build them as templates so deployment is low\-touch configuration that can be automated. * Own the alarm philosophy and point naming standards that keep tags, alarms, and data models identical from the PLC through SCADA to the operator's screen at every site. * Onboard system integrators to Fluidstack standards, write the specifications they build to, and review their work before it reaches a live site. **What We're Looking For** ========================== **The below is a starting point. Industrial protocols (BACnet, Modbus, DNP3, OPC UA). SCADA platforms and historians (Ignition, AVEVA). Alarm management and HMI standards (ISA\-18\.2, ISA\-101\). Automated controls deployment (code generation, version control for PLC code, hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing). We are committed to pay equity and transparency. If there is an error with your submission and you* ***did not*** *receive a confirmation email, please email careers@fluidstack.io with your resume/CV, the role you've applied for, and the date you submitted your application\- someone from our recruiting team will be in touch.* Compensation Range: $264K \- $322K

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ At Ford, you’ll work on ideas that matter, alongside passionate people who want to make a global impact. Together, we’re shaping the next era of transportation—grounded in purpose, driven by progress. Make your move. * Job Type: Full time * Work Type: Hybrid We made history and now we work to transform the future – for our customers, our communities and our families. You'll see your work on the road every day, helping people move freely and pursue their dreams. At Ford, you can build more than vehicles. Come build what matters. Do you believe data tells the real story? We do! Redefining mobility requires quality data, metrics and analytics, as well as insightful interpreters and analysts. That's where **Global Data Insight \& Analytics** makes an impact. We advise leadership on business conditions, customer needs and the competitive landscape. With our support, key decision makers can act in meaningful, positive ways. Join us and use your data expertise and analytical skills to drive evidence\-based, timely decision making. Ford's GDI\&A department is on the hunt for talented individuals skilled in Machine Learning, Big Data, Statistics, Econometrics, and Optimization. Our mission is to foster evidence\-based decisions by unlocking insights from data. Our projects span various domains, including Connected Vehicle, Smart Mobility, Operations, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Logistics, and Warranty Analytics. We're looking for exceptional Machine Learning and AI scientists who are eager to engage in all project stages, from problem identification to model deployment. Ideal candidates are self\-motivated, have a strong sense of initiative, and a lifelong passion for learning to navigate the rapidly evolving field of mobility technology. We offer the freedom to conduct original research, select the most suitable methodologies, and tackle world\-class machine learning challenges. This role involves applying AI and ML to innovate in areas such as autonomous vehicles, cybersecurity, customer interaction, and product design. You'll be part of a forward\-thinking team dedicated to using AI and ML to create groundbreaking solutions and shape our strategic direction in these fields and beyond. * Analyze source data and data flows, working with structured and unstructured data (text, audio, images, video, etc.) * Manipulate high\-volume, high\-dimensionality data from varying sources to expose and highlight patterns, anomalies, relationships, and trends * Apply AI and Machine Learning technology to solve complex, real\-world problems * Analyze and visualize diverse sources of data, interpret results in a business context and report results clearly and concisely * Fulfill problem formulation and ML technique consulting requests in a timely manner * Communicate and present analytical models to business customers and executive management * Work collaboratively with different business partners and be able to present results in a clear and concise manner **Minimum Qualifications:** * **Education**: Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Operations Research, or related field. You may not check every box, or your experience may look a little different from what we've outlined, but if you think you can bring value to Ford Motor Company, we encourage you to apply! jobs.description: At GSK, we see a world in which advanced applications of machine learning and AI will allow us to develop novel therapies for existing diseases and respond quickly to emerging or changing diseases with personalized drugs, driving better outcomes at reduced cost and with fewer side effects. It is an ambitious vision that will require the development of products and solutions at the cutting edge of machine learning and AI. If that excites you, we’d love to chat. **Job Purpose:** The AI/ML Controllable Biology Team applies machine learning and AI methods to biological networks and sequence data from large\-scale human genetic, functional genomic, and single\-cell experiments. Models that control biological networks have the potential to be transformative in drug discovery, empowering us to find new life\-saving medicines. We are looking for a Staff AI/ML Engineer – Controllable Biology. Competitive candidates will have a track record of developing SOTA deep learning models to solve challenging real\-world scientific problems. You should be an outstanding scientist with in\-depth knowledge of modern machine learning. You can convert vaguely described biological and drug discovery challenges into well\-defined machine learning problems. You can independently execute and deliver full AI/ML\-driven solutions end to end: sourcing training data, designing and implementing SOTA machine learning models, defining metrics and benchmarks, and shipping stable, tested, performant code and services in an agile environment. The AI/ML team is built on the principles of ownership, accountability, continuous development, and collaboration. We hire for the long term, and we're motivated to make this a great place to work. Our leaders will be committed to your career and development from day one. **Key Responsibilities:** As a Staff AI/ML Engineer \- Controllable Biology you will: * Convert complex biological questions into tractable mathematical problems that can be solved by modern computational methods. * Be adept at decomposing large problems into quarterly, measurable results and consistently working towards delivering these through engineering sprints. * Be a technical mentor in a multidisciplinary engineering team, including delegating tasks to junior colleagues and guiding them through delivery, while fostering an inclusive, supportive team culture. * Be comfortable demoing early and often, balancing research and engineering velocity. * Be a standard\-bearer for machine learning, software engineering, code review and agentic development best practices within the organisation. * Define technical strategy and roadmaps for AI/ML products, balancing scientific needs, safety, and operational reliability. * Operate in a transparent way, communicating clearly and accurately to leadership and the broader organisation. * Partner with stakeholders to ensure models are explainable, safe, and relevant. **Basic Qualifications:** * Master’s degree in a related field (e.g. computer science, mathematics or natural sciences). * 7\+ years’ experience with standard deep learning algorithms, model architectures, machine learning best practices, scalable training and deployment. * 7\+ years’ experience in software development, including code reviews, version control systems, CI/CD pipelines, software testing, technical documentation and Agile delivery methodologies. * 5\+ years’ experience in a technical lead or engineering manager role with direct reports, mentoring software engineers or machine learning practitioners. * 7\+ years’ experience with Python and PyTorch, or an equivalent machine learning framework. * Experience working with biological sequence and network data, including genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, gene regulatory networks or related biological datasets. * Experience collaborating with stakeholders across multiple teams, functions and geographic regions. **Preferred Qualifications:** If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus: * PhD in a quantitative or computational field. * Background in modelling disease biology, systems biology, molecular biology and biochemistry. * Track record of delivering high\-quality, research\-level machine learning and robust software solutions. * Peer\-reviewed publications in major AI conferences. **Work Arrangements:** The role is hybrid, requiring on\-site work 2 days per week. Remote or fully home\-working arrangements are not available for this role. **Skills** Artificial Intelligence (AI), Artificial Intelligence Ethics, Artificial Neural Networks (ANNS), Classification Models, Deep Learning, Intelligent Automation (IA), Machine Learning (ML), Model Evaluation, Predictive Modeling, Python (Programming Language), Test Documentation* If you are based in Cambridge, MA; Waltham, MA; Rockville, MD; or San Francisco, CA, the annual base salary for new hires in this position ranges $200,475 to $334,125\. Gartner IT values its culture of nonstop innovation, an outcome\-driven approach to success, and the notion that great ideas can come from anyone on the team. **About the Role** : Gartner is seeking a visionary and execution\-oriented **Vice President of AI Platform Engineering** to lead the organization responsible for developing, evolving, operating, and supporting **AskGartner** , Gartner’s premier client\-facing AI tool. jobs.title: Lead Robotics Engineer, Deployments
jobs.description: **About Generalist** ==================== At Generalist, we are on a mission to build general intelligence for the physical world and make it useful to everyone. We believe the industries and homes of the future will depend on humans and machines working together in new ways. Robots can help us build more and get more done. We build embodied foundation models, starting with a focus on dexterity. This requires advancing the frontiers of data, models, and hardware, to enable robots to intelligently interact with the physical world. The company embraces both large\-scale AI and robotics as core to its DNA. Our team of researchers, roboticists, and company builders come from OpenAI, Boston Dynamics, Google DeepMind, and other frontier labs—with a track record of shipping AI breakthroughs. Before Generalist, we pioneered large embodied multimodal models and vision\-language\-action models (PaLM\-E, RT\-2, Gemini Robotics), launched and scaled ChatGPT and GPT\-4 to hundreds of millions of users, engineered the foundations of autonomous driving, built next\-generation robots (Atlas, Spot, Stretch) and pushed the limits of what they can do (from parkour to manipulation, and testing robustness). We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. **About the Role** ================== Generalist is building AI that enables robots to do useful work in the physical world. Based in San Mateo, you’ll lead the engineering work that takes our robots from a first trial to reliable operation at a customer site. You’ll work with the people who do the job today to understand the workflow, agree on what the robot needs to do, and decide how to test it under real operating conditions. You’ll set the technical direction for the deployments you lead and directly manage members of the forward deployed engineering team. You’ll stay close to both parts of the job, shipping code alongside the team and helping your direct reports grow in their own right. Expect to write production code, work directly with robot hardware, train and evaluate machine learning models, and spend time at customer sites. When a robot performs well in a test but struggles on the customer’s floor, you’ll work alongside engineers and operators to understand what changed and decide whether it’s ready to run again. **You’ll be responsible for** ============================= * Leading deployments from scoping through onboarding and ongoing operation. Agree on success criteria with the customer, make sure each part of the rollout has an owner, and use field results to decide when to expand or pause. * Designing and building integrations between Generalist’s systems and customer APIs, applications, and workflows. Review designs with other engineers and write code for the parts that carry the most risk. * Designing robot tasks and evaluations that reflect the customer’s workflow. Work with research and engineering to understand where performance falls short and what to change before the next rollout. * Leading field debugging across software, integrations, model performance, data quality, and the operating environment. Help engineers narrow the failure, test a fix, and verify it with the people who encountered the problem. * Serving as the customer’s technical point of contact. Work with partnerships, operations, research, and engineering to explain tradeoffs, agree on next steps, and follow through on commitments. * Managing and developing your direct reports. Set clear expectations, give specific feedback, and support each person as they take ownership of a customer rollout. Share tools and lessons from those deployments with the wider engineering team. **You might thrive in this role if you** ======================================== * Have led engineers through a complex production rollout and can describe a technical decision you owned, the code you shipped yourself, and how you knew the system worked for its users. * Have strong software engineering fundamentals and experience designing integrations across APIs, services, or complex systems. You can explain your design choices and reason through failure modes. * Have experience applying foundation models in robotics to real tasks, evaluating their performance, and driving up success rates by analyzing and improving data quality. * Have guided a team through a failure that was hard to reproduce. You can explain what evidence changed your diagnosis and how you checked that the fix held in production. * Enjoy working directly with customers and users. You ask good questions, translate their needs into engineering work, and explain complex issues clearly without making promises the system cannot support. * Have helped another engineer take ownership of a difficult project. You know when to step in, when to coach, and when to let them make the call. * Are excited to work hands\-on with robots and customer teams, including time at customer sites.

jobs.title: Research Engineer II
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ Georgia Tech prides itself on its technological resources, collaborations, high\-quality student body, and its commitment to building an outstanding and diverse community of learning, discovery, and creation. We strongly encourage applicants whose values align with our institutional values, as outlined in our strategic plan. These values include academic excellence, diversity of thought and experience, inquiry and innovation, collaboration and community, and ethical behavior and stewardship. Georgia Tech has policies to promote a healthy work\-life balance and is aware that attracting faculty may require meeting the needs of two careers. **About Georgia Tech** Georgia Tech is a top\-ranked public research university situated in the heart of Atlanta, a diverse and vibrant city with numerous economic and cultural strengths. The Institute serves more than 45,000 students through top\-ranked undergraduate, graduate, and executive programs in engineering, computing, science, business, design, and liberal arts. Georgia Tech's faculty attracted more than $1\.4 billion in research awards this past year in fields ranging from biomedical technology to artificial intelligence, energy, sustainability, semiconductors, neuroscience, and national security. Georgia Tech ranks among the nation's top 20 universities for research and development spending and No. 1 among institutions without a medical school. **Georgia Tech's Mission and Values** Georgia Tech's mission is to develop leaders who advance technology and improve the human condition. The Institute has nine key values that are foundational to everything we do: 1\. Students are our top priority. 2\. We strive for excellence. 3\. We thrive on diversity. 4\. We celebrate collaboration. 5\. We champion innovation. 6\. We safeguard freedom of inquiry and expression. 7\. We nurture the wellbeing of our community. 8\. We act ethically. 9\. We are responsible stewards. Over the next decade, Georgia Tech will become an example of inclusive innovation, a leading technological research university of unmatched scale, relentlessly committed to serving the public good; breaking new ground in addressing the biggest local, national, and global challenges and opportunities of our time; making technology broadly accessible; and developing exceptional, principled leaders from all backgrounds ready to produce novel ideas and create solutions with real human impact. **Location** ------------ Atlanta, Georgia **Department Information** -------------------------- **About H. Milton Stewart School of Industrial \& Systems Engineering** The H. Milton Stewart School of Industrial and Systems Engineering (ISyE) is the largest and highest\-ranked industrial and systems engineering program in the nation. The Research Engineer will join a dynamic, research\-intensive environment within ISyE, working closely with ISyE faculty, students, and research staff while engaging broadly across Georgia Tech as appropriate. The position is deeply embedded in ISyE's research mission, with strong connections to the XR Makerspace and the School's emerging Human\-Centered Systems Engineering field of specialization. The Research Engineer will participate in interdisciplinary collaborations both within ISyE and across campus, including partnerships with industry, government, and applied research units. This position is ideally suited for researchers who wish to anchor their work within ISyE while bridging rigorous academic research with the design, implementation, and evaluation of high\-impact, real\-world engineering systems. **Job Summary** --------------- The H. Milton Stewart School of Industrial and Systems Engineering (ISyE) at the Georgia Institute of Technology seeks a highly motivated and creative Research Engineer to support and advance research in Human\-Centered Systems Engineering, including Extended Reality (XR), Physical AI, and related human\-centered technologies. The Research Engineer is expected to exercise substantial intellectual leadership and be eager to play a key role in building a vibrant, externally funded research ecosystem at the intersection of engineering, XR, and human\-centered systems. The Research Engineer will work closely with the Director of the Allen Davidson Coleman XR Makerspace and ISyE faculty, as well as collaborators across Georgia Tech, to co\-direct the XR Makerspace, lead and support research initiatives, mentor students, and actively pursue external funding. The position is structured as an appointment between XR Makerspace leadership and research development. The Research Engineer will also help lead ISyE's growing robotics, automation and Physical AI research infrastructure and supervise the technical staff who support it. **Responsibilities** -------------------- **XR Makerspace and Physical AI Research Infrastructure** The Research Engineer will serve in the XR Makerspace with a primary emphasis on research enablement and community bu ing independent and collaborative research in XR, HCI, human\-centered systems engineering, or related areas. Strong track record or clear potential for securing external research funding. Experience publishing in peer\-reviewed journals and top\-tier conferences. Technical expertise in XR systems (e.g., VR/AR/MR), experimental design, and data analysis. Ability to work effectively in interdisciplinary research environments. Experience supervising technical staff or managing a research lab or shared facility. Working knowledge of industrial automation, robotics, Physical AI, or smart manufacturing systems sufficient to provide research direction and supervise technical staff. Experience managing or co\-leading shared research facilities or laboratories. Prior industry, government, or applied research experience. Experience mentoring graduate and undergraduate researchers. Familiarity with safety, ethics, and compliance considerations in human\-subjects research. **Required Documents to Attach** -------------------------------- **Applicants should submit:** An academic cover letter A current curriculum vitae The names and contact information for at least three references. **Note: References will only be contacted for candidates invited to a second round interview.** **Contact Information** ----------------------- Requests for more information may be directed to Dr. Mohsen Moghaddam (mohsen.moghaddam@gatech.edu) **USG Core Values** ------------------- The University System of Georgia is comprised of our 26 institutions of higher education and learning as well as the System Office. Our USG Statement of Core Values are Integrity, Excellence, Accountability, and Respect. These values serve as the foundation for all that we do as an organization, and each USG community member is responsible for demonstrating and upholding these standards. More details on the USG Statement of Core Values and Code of Conduct are available in USG Board Policy 8\.2\.18\.1\.2 and can be found on\-line at https://www.usg.edu/policymanual/section8/C224/\#p8\.2\.18\_personnel\_conduct. Additionally, USG supports Freedom of Expression as stated in Board Policy 6\.5 Freedom of Expression and Academic Freedom found on\-line at https://www.usg.edu/policymanual/section6/C2653\. **Equal Employment Opportunity** -------------------------------- The Georgia Institute of Technology (Georgia Tech) is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. The Institute is committed to maintaining a fair and respectful environment for all. To that end, and in accordance with federal and state law, Board of Regents policy, and Institute policy, Georgia Tech provides equal opportunity to all faculty, staff, students, and all other members of the Georgia Tech community, including applicants for admission and/or employment, contractors, volunteers, and participants in institutional programs, activities, or services. Georgia Tech complies with all applicable laws and regulations governing equal opportunity in the workplace and in educational activities. Equal opportunity and decisions based on merit are fundamental values of the University System of Georgia ("USG") and Georgia Tech. Georgia Tech prohibits discrimination, including discriminatory harassment, on the basis of an individual's race, ethnicity, ancestry, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, disability, genetics, or veteran status in its programs, activities, employment, and admissions. Further, Georgia Tech prohibits citizenship status, immigration status, and national origin discrimination in hiring, firing, and recruitment, except where such restrictions are required in order to comply with law, regulation, executive order, or Attorney General directive, or where they are required by Federal, State, or local government contract. **Background Check** -------------------- A successful candidate must be able to pass a background check. jobs.description: . **Title:** Lead Software Developer **Company:** Global Power Components – www.globalpowercomponents.com **Location:** Milwaukee, WI (onsite 5\-days/week) **Hire Type:** Direct Hire **Position Summary:** Global Power Components is seeking a Lead Software Developer to design, build and maintain the internal applications and integrations that support our enterprise systems, and to serve as the technical lead for the team's development work. Above all, we are looking for deep, hands\-on expertise with automated build, test and deployment pipelines and a genuine enthusiasm for using AI to accelerate software development. This developer will lead how the Enterprise Systems team writes, reviews and ships code. They are experienced enough to read, interpret and challenge any code, whether a person or an AI wrote it, and open to sharing the workload with AI tools. That includes using GitHub Copilot and AI agents to draft code, generate tests and run the first pass of code reviews, so that people can focus on the changes that truly need human judgment. Working closely with the Enterprise Systems Director, ERP and HRIS specialists, and business stakeholders, this position will raise the quality, speed and consistency of our development work and grow into greater leadership responsibility as the team expands. **Essential Duties \& Responsibilities:** **Software Development** * Design, develop, test and maintain internal web applications, APIs and integrations. * Build and support integrations between enterprise systems such as ERP, HRIS and other business\-critical applications. * Write clean, well\-documented, maintainable and secure code that follows team standards. * Translate business requirements into sound technical designs in partnership with business analysts and stakeholders. * Troubleshoot, debug and resolve application issues in development, test and production environments. **CI/CD \& DevOps Automation** * Design, build and maintain automated build, test and deployment pipelines using GitHub Actions. * Establish branching strategies, environment promotion, release processes and rollback procedures. * Automate quality gates such as unit and integration tests, linting, code coverage, dependency checks and security scanning. * Manage secrets, environment configuration and deployment targets safely and consistently. * Monitor pipeline health and continuously reduce build times, failed deployments and manual steps. **AI\-Assisted Development** * Use GitHub Copilot and other AI coding assistants to accelerate coding, testing, refactoring and documentation. * Design and implement AI agent workflows that perform the basic pre\-checks of a code review, summarize each pull request and highlight the key changes that need human review. * Critically review AI\-generated code for correctness, security, performance and maintainability before it is merged. * Define team guidelines for responsible AI use in development, including protecting sensitive data and source code. * Evaluate new AI development tools and share practical techniques with the wider team. **Technical Leadership \& Collaboration** * Serve as technical lead for the team's development work, owning technical decisions, coding standards and code review practices, and combining AI\-generated insights with human judgment. * Establish and maintain coding standards, documentation practices and testing expectations. * Mentor and coach the team's developers, including on effective and safe use of AI tools, and take on increasing leadership responsibility as the team grows, including potential future direct\-report management. * Collaborate with the Enterprise Systems team, IT security and business users to prioritize and deliver work. * Participate in Agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, backlog refinement and retrospectives. **Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 7\+ years of professional software development experience, including experience leading development work or mentoring other developers. * Proficiency in at least one modern programming language; experience with Python and the Django framework is a strong plus. * Proven experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, ideally with GitHub Actions. * Advanced proficiency with Git and GitHub, including pull requests, branch protection, code owners and repository administration. * Hands\-on experience using GitHub Copilot or similar AI coding assistants in day\-to\-day development. * Experience with, or strong interest in, AI agents that automate parts of the development lifecycle such as code review, testing or documentation. * Experience with relational databases (such as SQL Server or PostgreSQL), REST APIs and automated testing frameworks. * Familiarity with containers (Docker) and cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure is a plus. * Experience integrating with ERP or HRIS platforms (for example Epicor) is a plus. * Secure coding knowledge, including common vulnerabilities and dependency management. **Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities:** * Ability to read, interpret and critically evaluate unfamiliar code quickly, whether written by a person or by AI. * Open, curious mindset toward sharing work with AI, paired with healthy skepticism and sound engineering judgment. * Strong automation mindset: looks for repetitive manual work and eliminates it. * Excellent problem\-solving and debugging skills. * Clear written and verbal communication with both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Ability to explain AI\-assisted practices to teammates and help them adopt them safely. * Strong ownership, accountability and follow\-through. * Commitment to continuous learning as development tools and AI capabilities evolve rapidly.

jobs.title: Control Electronics Engineer, Neutral Atoms, Quantum AI
jobs.description: The application window will be open until at least December 7, 2026\. This opportunity will remain online based on business needs which may be before or after the specified date.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics, a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 4 years of experience in analog, digital, or mixed\-signal design at the board level. * 4 years of experience with hardware development projects, including system deployments. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics, or a related field. * Experience with vendor management. * Expertise in multiple electrical engineering design disciplines (e.g., AMS, RF, or FPGA at the board and, possibly, chip level), with extensive experience from specification discovery to system deployment. * Strong understanding of industry board\-level design practices across relevant disciplines (AMS, RF, FPGA, etc), including relevant design tools. **About the job** ----------------- In this role, you will be a key team member in the development of control and measurement systems for neutral atom based quantum computers. You will leverage RF, analog, or mixed\-signal expertise to implement high\-performance board\-level designs which are then used to control our state\-of\-the\-art quantum computers. You will document your designs and measurement results and present the data to relevant stakeholders. You will support team\-members using the equipment you have designed as they integrate it into larger quantum computing systems. Google Quantum AI is building quantum computing for otherwise unsolvable problems. The full potential of quantum computing will be unlocked with a large\-scale computer capable of complex, error\-corrected computations. From pre\-computed summaries for email threads, summaries for meetings, and videos created from a document using lifelike AI avatars, our AI opportunity is huge. Our mission is to meaningfully connect people so they can create, build, and grow together and as part of the team you can build how productivity tools should work 5\-10 years into the future. jobs.title: Senior Detection Engineer
jobs.description: Graylog builds the AI\-powered SIEM and log management platform that security and IT teams rely on to quickly catch threats, investigate with clarity, and control data costs — all without trade\-offs. Our platform brings together scalable log management, real\-time visibility, and explainable AI that supports analysts with clear insights instead of black\-box guesses. It helps teams zero in on real threats, act faster, and make decisions with confidence. More than 60,000 organizations across 180 countries use Graylog products — from Security and Enterprise to our long\-standing Open edition — to gain clarity, context, and control across their environments. Rooted in open source and headquartered in Houston, we continue to grow a global community and customer base that values speed, transparency, and practical innovation. We’re a people\-first company. Remote\-friendly by design, we offer the flexibility to work where you’re most effective — whether that’s one of our hubs in Hamburg, London, or Houston, or from a home office anywhere in the world. Prefer the office? Go for it. Want to hot\-desk now and then? No problem. Fully remote? That works too. And yes, it’s working. In addition to industry recognition, Graylog was named to BuiltIn’s Best Places to Work list — a reflection of how we operate and the impact our teams make every day. If you’re looking to join a team that values curiosity, craftsmanship, and impact — and you want to build tools that make real work easier — we think you’ll feel right at home. **Role summary** Graylog is hiring a Senior Detection Engineer to build and own the detection content that small, resource\-constrained security teams rely on out of the box: use cases, detection rules, dashboards, reports, and the remediation guidance that ships with them. You will be the first dedicated detection engineer on the Security Content team, and you will set the standard for how detections are defined, built, tested, documented, and shipped. **Key Responsibilities** **Define and manage use cases** * Own the detection use case lifecycle: document the business need, the threat, and the implementation for every use case, kept as versioned artifacts. * Turn customer threat profiles, MITRE ATT\&CK coverage gaps, actively exploited vulnerabilities, and field feedback into a scored, visible detection backlog, working with product management. **Author detection content** * Write detections against a normalized data model: vendor agnostic detections, single\-event detections, multi\-stage correlation chains, anomaly detection, writing detections based on novelty detection or baselining use cases. . * Focused on continuous delivery of quality detection content and documentation. * Work with product engineering to define the alerting capabilities detections need, such as novelty, outlier, and multi\-stage query detection, so content drives the roadmap. * Partner with developers to support the development of additional capability to support detections. **Build detection\-as\-code** * Stand up and run the separate detections repository: an open rule format, automated tests, peer review, and CI/CD. * Put a quality gate in front of imported third\-party and community Sigma rules, so nothing ships unreviewed. * Review field, partner, and community contributions to the repository. **Validate, document, and tune** * Define "done": positive and negative test data, ATT\&CK mapping, a detection strategy, tuning guidance, and response guidance. * Be able to build guidance and procedure steps for content to provide insight to the customer on how to handle the specific threat identified. Conduct QA on detection content using tools like Atomic Red Team and Caldera for testing. Keep shipped content healthy by tuning false positives and reacting to schema drift. **Build dashboards and reports** * Deliver the dashboards, reports, and saved searches that make each detection usable by an analyst on day one. **Raise the bar for the team** * Write the content standard and contributing guide, and mentor newer engineers and field contributors. * Give the schema and parser teams structured feedback on field coverage and event categorization. * Capture research in a shared knowledge base so it is retained, and feed customer feedback back into the backlog. **Required qualifications** The best fit is a SOC analyst or engineer who moved into content, or a detection engineer from another SIEM vendor. This is a hands\-on SIEM role rather than a pure threat\-research or threat\-hunting role. * 3 to 5\+ years in security operations, detection engineering, or SIEM content development, with a track record of detections that ran in production. * Hands\-on SIEM experience: building correlation rules, alerts, and dashboards in Graylog, Splunk, Elastic, Sentinel, QRadar, Chronicle, or similar. * Deep working knowledge of MITRE ATT\&CK, attacker TTPs, and how they appear in endpoint, identity, network, and cloud logs. * Experience writing Lucene Queries and Sigma rules or an equivalent open detection format, and reasoning from normalized fields (ECS,GIM, or similar) to threats rather than from vendor log strings. * Familiarity with code: Python or similar for tooling, tests, and automation, plus Git and pull\-request workflows. * Experience testing detections: false\-positive analysis, tuning, and positive and negative test cases. * Clear writing. You will produce use case definitions, tuning guidance, and response guidance that analysts rely on. * Ability to work independently on a small team with no existing playbook, and to set standards others follow. **Preferred qualifications** * Experience with detection\-as\-code: rule repositories, CI pipelines, automated rule testing, and linting. * Familiarity with adversary emulation tools such as Atomic Red Team, Caldera, or breach\-and\-attack simulation platforms. * Experience with Graylog pipelines, event definitions, or OpenSearch queries. * Exposure to anomaly or statistical detection (baselining, outlier and rare\-event logic), or a willingness to learn it. * Background in compliance frameworks (NIST 800\-53, CMMC, PCI DSS), enough to map detections to controls. * Experience with cloud, container, or emerging attack surfaces such as GenAI and AI agents. * Prior contribution to open\-source detection projects (Sigma, SigmaHQ, or similar), or published detection research.

jobs.description: **Job Summary** --------------- The IT Deskside Support Engineer is responsible for delivering hands on, onsite technical support within healthcare facilities to ensure device reliability, end user productivity, and zero disruption to clinical and business operations. The role provides physical presence and smart hands capabilities that cannot be fulfilled remotely, especially in environments where uptime, speed, and accuracy directly impact patient care. This position is a critical extension of healthcare IT operations, bridging Service Desk, Infrastructure, Network, Security, and Application support teams by executing physical, device level, and site specific support activities. The role requires strong technical capability, disciplined process adherence, high situational awareness, and strict compliance with healthcare safety, access, and security standards. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ 1\. Onsite Deskside \& Field Incident Resolution • Act as the primary onsite technical resolver for incidents escalated by the Service Desk. • Provide in person support for clinicians, nurses, researchers, and corporate staff. • Resolve hardware, OS, and peripheral issues that cannot be remediated remotely. • Troubleshoot and resolve: o Laptop and desktop failures o Boot, OS, driver, and performance issues o Peripheral connectivity and malfunctions • Ensure minimal downtime for users performing patient care or time critical activities. • Restore operational capability with speed and accuracy while maintaining safety. \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ 2\. IMAC \& Deployment Services (Install, Move, Add, Change) • Perform full IMAC lifecycle activities, including: o New device deployments and refreshes o User onboarding and workstation setup o Physical moves and reconfigurations o Device replacements and upgrades • Coordinate installations with user availability and site access constraints. • Configure devices as per standards, images, and security baselines. • Validate post deployment functionality before handover to the user. • Ensure old or replaced assets are returned, secured, or disposed of correctly. \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ 3\. Hardware \& Peripheral Support • Provide hands on support for: o Laptops and desktops o Monitors (single/multi display) o Printers (local and network) o Docking stations, keyboards, mice, accessories • Replace faulty components and coordinate warranty or vendor repairs where required. • Perform physical inspections to identify early hardware degradation risks. • Support clinical adjacent equipment where permitted under scope. • Ensure cleanliness, labeling, cabling discipline, and workstation safety. \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ 4\. Smart Hands \& Data Closet Activities • Execute smart hands tasks in data closets and site IT rooms, including: o Cable tracing and patching (as instructed) o Power cycling of devices o Equipment, labeling and verification o Physical checks on network and infrastructure devices • Support remote Infrastructure, Network, or Cloud teams with physical interventions. • Follow safety, access control, and change awareness procedures strictly. • Document every smart hands action in the ticket for audit and traceability. \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ 5\. Healthcare Environment Sensitivity \& Compliance • Operate with full awareness of healthcare sensitivity: o Patient safety o Infection control zones o Clinical workflow disruptions • Follow hospital and clinic access protocols at all times. • Ensure devices and tools do not interfere with medical equipment. • Respect privacy, confidentiality, and data security requirements. • Escalate immediately if any activity may pose operational or safety risk. \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ 6\. ServiceNow \& Asset Management Discipline • Accurately update ServiceNow tickets with: o Actions performed onsite o Parts replaced o User confirmations o Follow up requirements • Maintain accurate asset records including: o Device assignment o Location changes o Status updates o Serial numbers and lifecycle stage • Ensure asset movements are fully traceable and auditable. • Prevent asset loss through strict documentation and handoff procedures. \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ 7\. Site Rounding \& Preventive Maintenance • Perform regular site walk throughs to: o Proactively identify device issues o Validate workstation standards o Spot recurring failure patterns • Identify aging or unstable hardware before failure. • Validate printer health and consumable status as per scope. • Report environmental, ca **Skill Requirements** ---------------------- Technical Skills • Strong hands on experience with: o Windows desktops and laptops o Common peripherals and printers o Basic networking concepts o Remote support coordination tools • Familiarity with ITSM tools (preferably ServiceNow). \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ Behavioral \& Operational Skills • High attention to detail and documentation discipline. • Ability to work independently onsite with accountability. • Strong communication and interpersonal skills. • Ability to function under pressure in clinical environments. • Strong sense of ownership and reliability. \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ Additional Expectations • Ability to lift and move IT equipment safely. • Willingness to travel within assigned field region. • Flexibility for after hours or emergency support when required. • Adherence to organizational security and safety policies. **Must Have Skill** ------------------- Microsoft Windows,MS Remote Desktop Services (RDS),Touch Services,Video/Telepresence \- Others **Good to Have Skill** ---------------------- **Other Requirements** ---------------------- 1\. Microsoft Certified: Modern Desktop Administrator Associate (Optional But Valuable). 2\. Itil Foundation Certification (Optional But Valuable) The IT Deskside Support Engineer is fully accountable for: • Business Hours \& Non Business Hours On Call support required • Onsite incident and request execution quality • Physical device availability and readiness • Accurate asset tracking and lifecycle updates • Safe handling of equipment in clinical environments • Timely resolution of issues escalated from Service Desk • Clear communication with users, Service Desk, and resolver teams

jobs.description: **Job Summary** --------------- Job Title: Principal Forward Deployed Engineer, AI Factory (Platform and AI Software) \- NVIDIA Ecosystem Business Unit **Team:** Leads the platform and AI software workstream of an AI Factory FDE pod; works with the Infrastructure Principal and the pod's FDE III engineers**Travel:** travel as required to client sites and data centers; indicative 40\-60% **Role Summary** HCLTech is seeking a Senior Principal Forward Deployed Engineer to own the platform and AI software approach of client AI Factories on NVIDIA platforms: the multi\-tenant, secure, observable platform and model serving at target latency and cost per token. apply **quantization, batching and parallelism** techniques * Build CI/CD and MLOps automation for model packaging, versioning, rollout and evaluation * Build reference **RAG and agentic workflows** with evaluation and guardrails; define runbooks and **incident response** for hypercare * Track **factory KPIs** (utilization, availability, **cost per token**) and report them to the client **Client \& Team Collaboration*** Agree interfaces with the pod's infrastructure FDEs between the cluster and platform layers * Bridge infrastructure and platform teams with client data science and application teams * Document the **operating model**, lead **hypercare handover** and train client platform teams * Contribute technical inputs to **presales** scoping and estimates **Technical Leadership \& Ownership (Principal)*** Own the platform and software approach across the pod: **control\-plane automation model**, tenancy and security design, inference serving architecture * Own the path to the **first client workload** inside 90 days; unblock cross\-layer issues with NVIDIA engineering * Coach and review FDE III and FDE II engineers; set platform and GitOps standards * Publish **reusable control\-plane blueprints** and custom operators; contribute to HCLTech AI Factory offerings * Engage client CTO, platform and data science leadership **Skill Requirements** ---------------------- **Required Skills \& Experience** * 12\+ years of experience, including 5\+ years in AI platform engineering * **Production Kubernetes with GPU workloads**; strong Python or Go * Proven **IaC and GitOps delivery** with CI/CD, state management and drift control * Experience with **multi\-tenancy**, RBAC and **policy\-as\-code** (OPA / Gatekeeper) * Production **model serving** on GPUs and inference optimization (quantization, batching, parallelism) * **Observability stack experience** (Prometheus, Grafana, logging) * **Client\-facing experience**; able to explain platform and inference trade\-offs to technical and business stakeholders * Record of leading platform builds and engineers on multi\-month deployments **Must Have Skill** ------------------- AI/ML Tools \- Others,Kubernetes,GPU **Good to Have Skill** ---------------------- **Other Requirements** ---------------------- **Key Performance Indicators*** First client workload live within 90 days * Time to onboard a new tenant or workload * Share of the environment reproducible from Git (automation coverage) * Inference latency and **cost per token** against agreed targets * Platform availability and GPU utilization at handover * Reusable control\-plane modules and use\-case assets contributed * NVIDIA certifications completed against the agreed path **Required Skills \& Experience*** 12\+ years of experience, including 5\+ years in AI platform engineering * **Production Kubernetes with GPU workloads**; strong Python or Go * Proven **IaC and GitOps delivery** with CI/CD, state management and drift control * Experience with **multi\-tenancy**, RBAC and **policy\-as\-code** (OPA / Gatekeeper) * Production **model serving** on GPUs and inference optimization (quantization, batching, parallelism) * **Observability stack experience** (Prometheus, Grafana, logging) * **Client\-facing experience**; able to explain platform and inference trade\-offs to technical and business stakeholders * Record of leading platform builds and engineers on multi\-month deployments **Preferred*** **CKA** / **CKAD**, Terraform Associate, **NVIDIA\-Certified** credentials (including Generative AI / LLMs) * **Kubernetes operator or controller development** * **SLURM** or **Run:ai** administration * TensorRT\-LLM or disaggregated inference serving experience * RAG and agentic workflow delivery; fine\-tuning and SLM experience **Key Proficiencies****Domain** **Target level** **What this domain covers** **AI infrastructure \& systems** 3 \- Proficient Physical and fabric layer of the AI Factory: **GPU servers and rack\-scale systems**, **InfiniBand** / **RoCE** networking, **high\-performance storage**, firmware and **bare\-metal bring\-up**, **cluster validation** and **fault isolation**. **Platform, orchestration \& inference** 4 \- Expert Software layer that makes the cluster usable: Kubernetes and **SLURM** scheduling, **GPU sharing and quotas**, **multi\-tenancy**, cluster management (**BCM**, **Run:ai**), and **model serving** (NIM, vLLM, Triton, TensorRT\-LLM) tuned for latency, throughput and **cost per token**. **DevOps \& control\-plane scripting** 4 \- Expert Automation of the factory lifecycle: **infrastructure\-as\-code**, GitOps, CI/CD, provisioning and tenant\-onboarding scripts, operators and APIs, **observability as code**. **Data \& applied AI** 3 \- Proficient Data pipelines and use\-case delivery on the factory: fine\-tuning, **RAG and agentic workflows**, evaluation and guardrails. **Security, governance \& sovereignty** 3 \- Proficient Securing and governing the factory: RBAC and **tenant isolation**, **secrets management**, hardening, audit, **confidential computing**, **data residency**, **sovereign and air\-gapped builds**. **Presales \& client engagement** 3 \- Proficient Presales and client\-embedded delivery: technical scoping inputs, **client technical sessions**, **tokenomics** / TCO inputs, **as\-built documentation**, **hypercare and handover**. Scale: 1 Aware \| 2 Working \| 3 Proficient \| 4 Expert

jobs.description: Power Mechanical Engineer \- (198277\) At HDR, our employee\-owners are fully engaged in creating a welcoming environment where each of us is valued and respected, a place where everyone is empowered to bring their authentic selves and novel ideas to work every day. As we foster a culture of inclusion throughout our company and within our communities, we constantly ask ourselves: What is our impact on the world? Watch Our Story:' https://www.hdrinc.com/our\-story' Each and every role throughout our organization makes a difference in our ability to change the world for the better. Read further to learn how you could help make great things possible not only in your community, but around the world. We believe electricity powers modern life. As part of our Power sector, you’ll help shape how electricity is generated, transmitted and delivered as global energy demands grow. From massive data centers to modernizing transmission systems, our industry\-recognized engineers and scientists have been at the forefront of grid transformation for more than a century. You’ll work side\-by\-side with these experts and contribute to reliable, resilient and sustainable power systems, helping communities thrive and industries expand. This isn’t just a job, it’s a chance to drive infrastructure forward, power innovation and leave your mark on our energy future. HDR is seeking an experienced Mechanical Engineer to join our Power Generation team. As a Mechanical Engineer, you will be joining a highly capable, multi\-discipline team that supports power and energy projects primarily within the utility, IPP, industrial, institutional, and municipal sectors. Preferred candidates will have a working knowledge of industrial\- and utility\-scale power generation systems as required to carry out the typical job duties which include: mechanical equipment/pipe sizing; equipment/piping layout considerations; construction document development (P\&IDs, system layout/installation drawings and specifications); engineer/equipment vendor submittal reviews, vendor/contractor communications; technical writing (reports, procurement specifications, etc.); code reviews; site visits; project planning; and working within an assigned budget and schedule. Significant experience with the design and specification of power generation fluid systems including steam, condensate, fuel gas, cooling water, compressed air, and similar systems is preferred. The candidate will be encouraged and trained to develop from a mechanical or lead engineer to a project engineer and ultimately into a project manager or engineering manager. Most tasks will be done in a collaborative manner involving engineers and designers from several other disciplines. The candidate will be expected to share the benefits of his or her experience with others, including the mentoring of less experienced engineers. Communication and leadership skills as required to direct a small team of engineers and designers are also desired. The position will require travel for site surveys, technical conferences, client meetings and monitoring of construction. Travel is typically less than 10%. **Preferred Qualifications** * BS degree in Mechanical Engineering from an ABET accredited university. * 5\+ years of experience, ideally in the fossil power industry with a blend of design and field projects. * P.E. license in Texas or ability to obtain reciprocity. * Be able to coordinate their work with others; have good communication, written, analytical and organizational skills. * Attention to accuracy, detail orientated, self\-directed learning, meeting deadlines, and multi\-tasking are also required. * Willing to mentor EITs **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Engineering * Requires professional engineering license recognized by the licensing board for the location of the position offered. Example: Professional Engineer (PE or P.Eng) license. * Previous experience in project execution within the Power Market Sector. * Computer skills in Microsoft Office as well as standard Power Market Sector design software. (examples include PLS CAD, AutoCAD, Plant 3D, AutoPipe, and Revit) * An attitude and commitment to being an active participant of our employee\-owned culture **What We Believe** HDR is our company. Together, we build on each other's life experiences and perspectives to make great things possible every day. This shapes our collaborative culture, encourages organizational trust and connects us closer to the clients and communities we serve. **Our Commitment** As employee owners, we all have a role in creating an inclusive environment where each of us is welcomed, valued, respected and empowered to bring our authentic selves to work every day. Our eight Employee Network Groups (Asian Pacific, Black, Hispanic/Latino(a), LGBTQ\+, People with Disabilities, Veterans, Women, Young Professionals) help create a sense of belonging and foster a supportive environment where everyone is empowered to engage and contribute. Each group has an executive sponsor and is open to all employees. We provide a comprehensive benefits package that promotes employee ownership, employee health, performance, and success, which includes medical, dental, vision, short and long\-term disability, life insurance, an employee assistance program, paid time away, parental leave, paid holidays, a retirement savings plan with employer match, employee referral bonus and tuition reimbursement. jobs.title: Sr Field Application Engineer- INT
jobs.description: **Job Details: Sr Field Application Engineer** ---------------------------------------------- Full details of the job. **Vacancy Name** Sr Field Application Engineer **Vacancy No** VN290 **Form of Employment** Permanent **Work Location** USA \- Chicago **Job Details** **ABOUT HMS NETWORKS** We shape the connected world! HMS Networks makes the World more connected, productive and sustainable. HMS industrial communication products enable millions of machines such as robots, drives and air\-conditioners to get connected to software and systems – A necessity to meet the future demands for energy efficiency and sustainability. HMS Networks helps industrial devices communicate across networks and systems. Within our Industrial Network Technology division, we serve device makers and industrial customers with embedded connectivity, gateways and other industrial communication solutions. **ROLE PURPOSE** The Field Application Engineer (FAE) is the technical bridge between customers, partners, sales teams and product development, providing pre\-sales and post\-sales expertise for HMS industrial communication, industrial networking, remote connectivity and industrial software solutions. Acting as a liaison between HMS and its customers, the FAE helps customers solve automation challenges, recommends and demonstrates solutions, supports implementation on site, and ensures HMS products are deployed successfully and services meet HMS quality standards and customer expectations. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** * Serve as the primary technical resource for customers, partners and Regional Sales Managers during pre\-sales and post\-sales, identifying customer requirements and recommending HMS solutions for industrial networking, protocol conversion, remote access and industrial software. * Conduct product demonstrations, technical presentations, proof\-of\-concept testing and customer evaluations, and address technical objections during the sales process. * Assist customers with product selection, system architecture design, integration, configuration and troubleshooting. * Install, configure and test equipment at customer locations, and support commissioning, startup and deployment activities. * Serve as the primary contact for customers with on\-site technical support needs, using diagnostic tools and methods to resolve issues and repair malfunctioning equipment and systems. * Provide training to customers, distributors, system integrators and internal teams on HMS products and technologies, including operation and maintenance of installed equipment. * Document common issues and resolutions, and prepare clear, comprehensive service reports for customers. * Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, Technical Support and project managers to share customer feedback and market requirements. * Build and maintain strong customer relationships to ensure satisfaction, and support trade shows, webinars and customer workshops. * Perform other duties as assigned. **AUTHORITY \& DECISION\-MAKING** * Recommend HMS products, configurations and system architectures to customers within published product specifications. * Decide the on\-site troubleshooting, configuration and repair approach for installed HMS equipment. * Escalate product issues, nonconformities and customer complaints to Technical Support, Engineering or Product Management. **COMPETENCE REQUIREMENTS** **Education** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Automation Engineering, Computer Science or a related technical field (required). **Experience** * Minimum three years of experience in industrial automation, controls engineering, technical support or applications engineering. * Experience supporting customers in manufacturing or industrial environments. **Skills, Certifications \& Languages** * Knowledge of industrial networking protocols, including EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, Modbus TCP and EtherCAT. * Knowledge of PLCs, HMIs, SCADA systems and industrial software platforms. * Ability to use diagnostic tools and methodologies to troubleshoot industrial equipment and networks. * Excellent verbal, written and presentation communication skills in English. **KEY COMPETENCIES** * Customer focus – builds strong, trusted relationships with customers and partners. * Communication – explains technical concepts clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences. * Problem solving – applies strong analytical skills to find effective solutions. * Collaboration – works across Sales, Product Management, Engineering and Support. * Ownership – follows issues through to resolution and documents outcomes. **WORKING CONDITIONS** Based in Chicago, Illinois. Up to 30% travel throughout North America as business needs require, including work at customer manufacturing and industrial sites during installation, commissioning, repair and training activities. **EQUAL OPPORTUNITY**

jobs.title: Front-End Web Developer
jobs.description: **About Hamilton Beach** Hamilton Beach Brands is a leading designer, marketer, and distributor of innovative household and commercial appliances trusted by consumers around the world. Founded in 1910 and headquartered in Glen Allen, Virginia, we develop and market a broad portfolio of products under well\-known brands including **Hamilton Beach®, Weston®, Lotus®, and Hamilton Beach Professional®**. For more than a century, our products have helped simplify everyday life – from preparing meals and beverages at home to supporting foodservice professionals in restaurants, hotels, and commercial kitchens. Our culture is guided by a shared set of values that shape how we work and make decisions every day: Customer Obsession, People, Good Thinking, Ethics, Passion for Quality, Embrace Change, Teamwork, and commitment to Our Environment and Community. At Hamilton Beach Brands, we look for people who are collaborative, curious, and motivated to make meaningful impact. **About the Role** We are seeking a **Front\-End Web Developer** that independently develops, implements, maintains, and improves our front\-end eCommerce websites. This role translates business and marketing needs into website enhancements through hands\-on coding, troubleshooting, and performance improvements. The position works closely with the Full Stack Digital Marketing Manager and IT's eCommerce Manager to ensure changes align with business priorities and technical requirements. This full\-time, hybrid position is based at our corporate headquarters in Glen Allen, Virginia, and reports to the Manager, Full Stack Digital Marketing. **Salary Range**: $76,000 \- $93,245 Annually **What You’ll Do** * Independently develop and implement front\-end website enhancements across branded eCommerce platforms. Responsible for hands\-on coding, technical updates, resolving tickets, and supporting website deployments, along with ongoing marketing initiatives and content updates. Work with Digital Marketing and IT to implement approved changes. * Manage and perform accessibility testing to ensure full ADA/WCAG compliance and conduct rigorous cross\-browser/device QA to maintain a high\-quality, inclusive user experience. Recommend remediation in areas that do not meet WCAG standards. Manage and validate ADA code from vendors such as UsableNet. * Identify, investigate, and lead the resolution of front\-end website issues impacting customer experience, website functionality, and marketing performance. Develop and implement solutions independently, escalating more complex issues to senior developers or IT when needed. * Experience implementing and validating marketing technology integrations, such as promotional forms, embedded media, Consent Management Platform (CMP) such as TrustArc, and tracking tags/pixels via Google Tag Manager (GTM) to ensure sites remain functional and up to date. * Identify and implement improvements to website speed, stability, functionality, and user experience. Make technical decisions related to front\-end site performance while partnering with IT's eCommerce Manager on larger architectural or system\-related changes. * Lead initial investigations into front\-end website issues, identify the cause, and document the impact and steps taken to resolve them. Work with IT and senior technical resources when issues require additional support. * Act as a technical point of contact for external vendors and agencies to gather information, relay requirements, and verify that delivered solutions meet brand standards and expectations. * Clearly report technical progress and findings to internal stakeholders, including marketing leadership, analytics partners, and the broader development team. **What We’re Looking For** * Bachelor’s degree in web design, computer science, marketing, information technology, or a related field focused on web technology. A combination of education and experience will also be considered. * Advanced HTML5, CSS3, SASS/LESS, and modern JavaScript skills, with experience building responsive, mobile\-first websites. Working knowledge of React, Vue.js, or Angular. * Experience working across headless, data\-driven eCommerce environments, including commerce platforms, content management systems, site search, marketing automation, and presentation layers. * Foundational knowledge of web performance optimization, ADA requirements, and WCAG accessibility guidelines. * Proficiency with Google Tag Manager and Google Merchant Center, experience using Google Analytics 4 to identify and implement improvements, and working knowledge of search engine optimization and generative engine optimization. * Experience supporting user acceptance testing and documenting procedures, plus familiarity with Git, Azure DevOps, and collaborative development workflows. * Ability to manage multiple priorities, independently troubleshoot issues, and explain technical information clearly to nontechnical partners. * Certified Professional in Web Accessibility (CPWA) certification preferred. **What We Offer** Hamilton Beach Brands offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your well\-being and long\-term success. Other offerings include: * Hybrid work schedule * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage * Company HSA contributions * 401(k) plan with immediate vesting * Profit sharing program * Paid vacation, holidays, and a paid charitable day * Summer hours to support work\-life balance * Employee discounts on Hamilton Beach products *Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.* Hamilton Beach Brands, Inc. is committed to hiring and retaining a diverse workforce. We are an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer, making decisions without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, or any other protected class. To learn more about E\-Verify, including your rights and responsibilities, please visit www.E\-Verify.gov.
