We're pairing that intelligence with next\-generation hardware to create a universal interface between humans and machines. While today's AI largely operates through chat boxes and decade\-old devices, Hark is focused on what comes next: agentic systems that interact naturally with people and the real world. To get there, we're developing multimodal models and next\-generation AI hardware together \- designed from the ground up as a single, unified interface for a new era of intelligent systems. **About the Role** We’re hiring our first Deployed Engineers to take Hark into the enterprise. You’ll sit with our earliest customers, learn how their teams actually work, and ship the integrations, skills, and workflows that make Hark indispensable inside their org. **Responsibilities** * Ensure customer successes for any deployments * Own technical deployment for a set of enterprise accounts, from pilot to org\-wide rollout * Build custom connectors, MCP servers, and API integrations into each customer’s internal tools and data * Write Hark skills that slot into existing workflows: research, reporting, approvals, and anything that needs computer action or judgment * Deploy Hark’s computer\-use agent against legacy apps that have no API * Work through customer onboarding, including security and compliance reviews with customer IT, alongside our security team * Turn repeated field work into product: send patterns, fixes, and reusable integrations back to core engineering * Help define how the FDE function runs as we grow it **Requirements** * 4\+ years of software engineering, with production code shipped in the last year * Owned customer deployments end to end * Strong backend and integration skills: APIs, auth (OAuth, SSO), data pipelines, and debugging in someone else’s environment * Comfortable in front of customers, from an end user to a CIO * Startup pace and full ownership: you find the problem, scope it, and ship it **Bonus Qualifications** * Forward deployed or field engineering at agent startup * Built with LLMs in production: tool use, MCP, prompt and skill design, or agent evals * Experience with enterprise security reviews, SOC 2, and data retention requirements * Founding or early team experience **Compensation** The US base salary range for this full\-time position is between $200,000 \- $350,000 annually. data) * Write automated tests and maintain clear technical documentation, including how and why the system produced a given result * Ensure performance, security, and data integrity across the API and team and help shape engineering standards as tools evolve **Front\-End Support*** Contribute to front\-end screens and internal tools as needed (e.g., work queues, review screens, and reporting views) **Platform \& Compliance*** Deploy solutions through the IT team’s established processes, on\-premises and in Azure * Follow security, change management, and audit requirements for systems that handle protected health information (PHI) * Use Git source control, code review, and pull requests as part of a team workflow **Reasonable Accommodations Statement** To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable Accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. **PREFERRED POSITION QUALIFICATIONS** **Competency Statement(s)*** Excellent Communication skills and ability to work well with others in a fast paced, dynamic environment. * Strong initiative and ability to manage multiple projects, as well as strong follow through skills. * Ability to complete projects timely and accurately * Must be detail oriented with strong organizational and analytical skills * Ability to multitask and meet constant deadlines * **PREFERRED SKILLS \& ABILITIES****Education:** Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field preferred. High school or equivalent graduate required. **Experience:** 3\-5 years of experience in: **Core Engineering** + Professional back\-end development with Node.js (JavaScript and/or TypeScript) and Python: strong in at least one, with working proficiency in the other + Experience designing and building RESTful APIs + Solid proficiency in Microsoft SQL Server, T\-SQL, and relational database design + Experience with Git\-based source control, code review, and automated testing**AI\-Assisted Development** + Demonstrated daily use of agentic coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) on real projects, well beyond autocomplete + Able to walk through concrete examples of features built with AI agents: how the work was planned, how context was managed, and how the output was verified + Experience configuring AI development tooling, such as project rules or instruction files, custom prompts or skills, sub\-agents, and MCP servers + Strong code review and testing habits suited to reviewing AI\-generated code + Understanding of AI limitations and security risks (e.g., data leakage, prompt injection, insecure generated code) and of responsible use in enterprise environments, including where protected data may not be used **Preferred/Nice to Have** + Front\-end experience with a modern JavaScript framework (e.g., React, Vue, or Angular) + Healthcare claims experience, such as X12 EDI (837/835\), CMS\-1500/UB\-04 claim data, Medicare fee schedules + Experience building systems that require audit trails, data versioning, or regulatory compliance (e.g., HIPAA, SOC 2\) + Experience with Azure services (App Services, Functions, Azure SQL, Storage, etc.) + Familiarity with Microsoft identity and access (Entra ID) + Experience with C\#/.NET **Certificates \& Licenses:** N/A

jobs.description: Electrical Hardware Fabric Development Engineer This role has been designed as ‘’Onsite’ with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office.**Who We Are:** Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge\-to\-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE. **Job Description:** The Hardware Fabric Engineer designs, simulates, validates, debugs, and optimizes high\-performance electrical systems for industry\-leading supercomputer and networking platforms. This role works collaboratively with engineering teams responsible for system design, validation, scaling, deployment, and support. jobs.title: Senior AI Automation Engineer
jobs.description: **About Your Role** ------------------- As our Senior AI Automation Engineer at QGenda, your primary responsibility will be to help every department build its own AI factory by designing, building, and deploying AI skills, connectors, and agents that streamline workflows, improve operational efficiency, and enable teams to deliver measurable business results. Reporting to and partnering closely with the Chief Administrative Officer, you will drive AI adoption across the company. You’ll collaborate with department leaders to assess existing workflows, identify opportunities to leverage AI to improve efficiency and effectiveness, and deliver working solutions using tools like Claude Code, ChatGPT Codex, LLM APIs, and MCP connections to our SaaS applications and data platforms such as Salesforce, Google Workspace, and Snowflake. You will work closely with Procurement to incorporate AI into every buying decision, and alongside IT, Security, and CRM to lay the groundwork for everyone to build with AI securely and safely. Together, you’ll make the secure way the easy way: building within our approved tools and guardrails, shaping AI policy from a builder’s perspective, and equipping teams to build for themselves. This is a hands\-on, high\-impact role at the center of QGenda’s move to become an AI\-first company. **How You’ll Make an Impact** ----------------------------- * Independently own and drive high\-visibility AI projects from concept through production, ensuring successful implementation and adoption of AI solutions that deliver measurable business value. * Proactively consult with department leaders to map workflows and identify high\-impact opportunities for AI, translating business needs into working solutions. * Connect AI tools to our platforms and data, configuring vendor\-provided connectors and building custom MCP integrations where none exist, so access is secure, governed, and limited to those who need it. * Partner with Procurement at renewals and new purchases to evaluate whether to build, adopt the vendor’s AI, switch, or cut, and lead the in\-house build when that’s the right call. * Act as a go\-to resource and evangelist for AI, maintaining deep technical knowledge, creating reusable skills and documentation, and helping teams across the company build for themselves. * Help develop, document, and champion best practices for building with AI at QGenda, partnering with IT and Security so solutions are scalable, secure, and aligned with our policies. * Provide meaningful input into the company’s technical roadmap for internal tooling, AI platforms, and data access. * Measure and report the impact of AI solutions, including time returned, costs avoided, and adoption. **Who You Are** --------------- * Communicate clearly with technical and non\-technical audiences, including department leaders and executives. * Proactively identify and solve problems, then build sustainable solutions others can use and maintain. * Manage multiple projects, work to deadlines, and prioritize competing demands. * Proficiency in programming languages (e.g., Python, TypeScript) and AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Codex. * Hands\-on experience building AI agents, skills, and workflows using LLM APIs and agent frameworks. * Skill in prompt and context design, and in testing AI output for consistent, high\-quality results. * Experience integrating SaaS applications through APIs, webhooks, and MCP. * Experience delivering AI solutions in tools employees already use, such as Slack. * Working knowledge of identity and access management (e.g., Okta, OAuth, SSO) to control access and tailor AI responses by role. * Strong data skills, including SQL and data warehouses such as Snowflake. * Experience deploying and running solutions on major cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Google Cloud, Azure). * Curious and eager to keep up with fast\-moving AI tools, models, and trends. **Experience You Bring** ------------------------ * Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university or equivalent industry experience. * 5\+ years of experience in software engineering, automation, systems engineering, or a related technical field. * 2\+ years of hands\-on experience building with LLMs and generative AI. * Proven track record of shipping internal tools or automations that business teams adopted and relied on. * Experience setting technical direction or standards for others **Not Required, But Nice to Have** ---------------------------------- * Engineering, computer science, or other technical degree. * SaaS application administration and configuration experience. * Experience in healthcare or with handling sensitive data. * Professional software engineering experience.

jobs.title: Cyber Security Engineer, Software Solutions
jobs.description: Description **Cyber Security Engineer, Software Solutions** **About the role** ------------------ Are you the kind of security engineer who wants to be in the code, not on the sidelines? Our software teams move quickly to deliver solutions for commercial clients, and security needs to move just as fast. In this role, you’ll work directly alongside engineering teams, reviewing designs before they’re built, uncovering real vulnerabilities in real code, and helping make the secure path the easy path for developers. This is a hands\-on role. Expect to spend most of your week in code, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud configurations, not buried in policy documents. **What you will do** -------------------- * Perform threat modeling and security design review on new features and services, early enough to change the outcome. * Review application code for security defects, focused on authentication, authorization, injection, secrets handling, and dependency risk. * Own and tune the application security tooling in CI/CD: SAST, DAST, SCA, and secrets scanning. Reduce false positives so developers trust the results. * Triage findings from scans, bug bounty submissions, and client security reviews. Assign real severity, write reproducible tickets, and drive them to closure. * Review cloud infrastructure\-as\-code for misconfiguration, with a focus on identity, network boundaries, and data exposure. * Build secure defaults: reusable libraries, hardened baseline configurations, and paved\-road patterns that remove entire vulnerability classes. * Support client\-facing security questionnaires, penetration test remediation, and control evidence for SOC 2 or ISO 27001 audits. * Coach developers through pairing, review comments, and short internal training. Security literacy across the team is part of the deliverable. **Required qualifications** --------------------------- * 3\+ years of professional experience in application security, product security, or software engineering with security responsibilities. * Experience using at least one modern programming language in a production environment, such as Python, Java, C\#, Go, TypeScript, or a similar language. * Experience working with OWASP Top 10 application security risks and vulnerabilities. * Experience working hands\-on with at least one major cloud platform, such as Azure, AWS, or GCP, including identity and access management. * Experience integrating security tools into CI/CD pipelines. * Experience working hands\-on with containers, including troubleshooting common container issues. **Preferred qualifications** ---------------------------- * Clear written communication. Vulnerability writeups that developers can act on without a follow\-up meeting. * Experience with infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform, Bicep, or CloudFormation) and policy\-as\-code. * Exposure to SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, or HIPAA in a commercial delivery context. * Offensive security experience: CTFs, bug bounty participation, or professional penetration testing. * Certifications such as OSCP, GWAPT, GCSA, CCSP, or a cloud security specialty credential. * Experience in a consulting or multi\-client delivery environment, where security standards have to travel across different client stacks. **What we offer** ----------------- * Compensation reviewed annually against market, with a defined path to Senior Security Engineer. * Annual budget for certifications, conferences, and training, plus dedicated time to use it. * Direct access to engineering leadership and real authority to block an unsafe release. **Working at ICF** ICF is a global advisory and technology services provider, but we’re not your typical consultants. We combine unmatched expertise with cutting\-edge technology to help clients solve their most complex challenges, navigate change, and shape the future. We can only solve the world's toughest challenges by building a workplace that allows everyone to thrive. We are an equal opportunity employer. Together, our employees are empowered to share their expertise and collaborate with others to achieve personal and professional goals. For more information, please read our EEO policy. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. **Work Authorization and Sponsorship** All candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. This position is not eligible for new H\-1B visa sponsorship by ICF. Candidates who currently hold valid work authorization may be considered for a change of employer petition, subject to company policy and applicable immigration requirements. **Reasonable Accommodations** Reasonable Accommodations are available, including, but not limited to, for disabled veterans, individuals with disabilities, and individuals with sincerely held religious beliefs, in all phases of the application and employment process. To request an accommodation, please email Candidateaccommodation@icf.com and we will be happy to assist. All information you provide will be kept confidential and will be used only to the extent required to provide needed reasonable accommodations. Read more about workplace discrimination rights or our benefit offerings which are included in the Transparency in (Benefits) Coverage Act. **Bot and Third\-Party Applications** Please note that this application must be submitted directly by the applicant for consideration. Failure to do so may result in the application being excluded for consideration. Applicants needing an accommodation for disability or religious purposes in connection with the application process should contact Candidateaccommodation@icf.com for assistance. **Candidate AI Usage Policy** At ICF, we are committed to ensuring a fair interview process for all candidates based on their own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools to generate or assist with responses during interviews (whether in\-person or virtual) is not permitted. This policy is in place to maintain the integrity and authenticity of the interview process. However, we understand that some candidates may require accommodation that involves the use of AI. If such an accommodation is needed, candidates are instructed to contact us in advance at candidateaccommodation@icf.com. We are dedicated to providing the necessary support to ensure that all candidates have an equal opportunity to succeed. **Pay Range** There are multiple factors that are considered in determining final pay for a position, including, but not limited to, relevant work experience, skills, certifications and competencies that align to the specified role, geographic location, education and certifications as well as contract provisions regarding labor categories that are specific to the position. The pay range for this position based on full\-time employment is: $98,187\.00 \- $166,919\.00 DC Remote Office (DC99\)

jobs.title: Lead Mechanical Commissioning Engineer (Data Center Construction Experience)
jobs.description: InPwr, Inc. is looking for a seasoned **Lead** **Mechanical Commissioning Engineer**to join our dynamic team! We are an award\-winning electrical design\-build firm headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, with offices in Columbus, Indiana; Charlotte, North Carolina; Denver, Colorado; Monterey Park, California; Grand Prairie, Texas; and Fort Myers, Florida. Recognized as a **Top Place to Work in** **2019, 2022, 2023, 2024, and 2026**, we are committed to building it better, pursuing complex opportunities, and taking electrical design to the next level. With licenses in more than 40 states, we proudly deliver projects across the nation. We InPwr through personal commitment, relentless dedication, and driving results together. **Come join our team!** **Skills and Requirements:** * **Certificates and Knowledge** + Bachelor of Science of Mechanical Engineering. + HVAC, CRAC, AHU, ACCU, others + OSHA 10 + Complete all Safety Certifications + Script development for L2\-L5 + Daily Reports + Knowledge of CAD, Bluebeam, and others * **Ability to work directly on site, and ability to travel required 75%** **Benefits:** * Medical, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance 100% company paid for employees * Paid vacation \& holidays * 401(k) company match * 30\-day paid sabbatical every 5 years of employment * Stable employment with a growing company * Highly competitive salary **A Mechanical Commissioning Engineering role involves overseeing the installation, testing, and verification of mechanical systems and equipment to ensure they are functioning correctly and meet design specifications before they are put into operation.** **Essential Functions:** * **Planning and Coordination:** Participate in the planning and coordination of commissioning activities, working closely with project managers, design engineers, construction teams, and other stakeholders to ensure that commissioning activities are properly scheduled and executed. * **Installation Verification:** Verify that mechanical systems and equipment are installed according to design specifications, manufacturer's recommendations, and applicable codes and standards. This involves reviewing installation drawings, conducting site inspections, and ensuring proper alignment, assembly, and connections. * **Functional Testing:** Perform functional tests on mechanical systems and equipment to ensure they operate as intended. This may include testing components such as pumps, motors, valves, actuators, HVAC systems, plumbing fixtures, and other mechanical devices to verify their performance and functionality. * **Performance Testing:** Conduct performance tests to verify that mechanical systems meet performance requirements under normal operating conditions as well as during peak loads or other demanding scenarios. This may involve testing parameters such as flow rates, temperatures, pressures, vibration levels, and energy efficiency. * **Documentation:** Document all aspects of the commissioning process, including test procedures, test results, equipment specifications, and any modifications or adjustments made during commissioning. jobs.title: Staff Scientist, Remote Sensing
jobs.description: **About the company:** In the coming decades, demand for critical minerals such as copper, lithium, and cobalt will continue to grow. These minerals are needed to build electric infrastructure, vehicles, data centers, and electronics. However, the mining industry is making 10x fewer discoveries per dollar spent on exploration compared to 30 years ago because the easy\-to\-find, near surface deposits have largely been discovered. KoBold was founded to be the first AI native mineral exploration, mine development, and technology development company. Our goal is to turn mineral exploration into a repeatable science to discover the minerals the world needs—by integrating artificial intelligence, human intelligence, and new technology. Our multidisciplinary teams of data scientists, engineers, and geologists work together to build data systems, design new sensors, and establish industry\-leading workflows to develop and test subsurface predictions on our exploration projects. Our first discovery, Mingomba, is a high\-grade copper deposit in Zambia, found after spending materially less than industry average. We are developing Mingomba with the same technical rigor that we apply to exploration. The Mingomba team brings together mine and processing engineers, geologists, data scientists, software engineers, and community, health \& safety, construction, and operations specialists. By combining industry knowledge and cutting edge technology, we are developing Mingomba into a world class project that has safer and more predictable outcomes for ourselves, partners, and communities. It is expected to create thousands of good jobs for generations. KoBold runs exploration programs in eight countries, all with the potential for another discovery. KoBold is privately held; investors include institutional asset managers T. Rowe Price and Canada Pension Plan Investments; technology venture capitalists Andreessen Horowitz, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, BOND Capital, Durable Capital, StepStone, and Standard Investments; and strategic natural resources companies BHP and Mitsubishi. **About The Role:** In this role, you will develop state of the art instruments to collect data to guide our exploration programs. You will simulate, characterize, and calibrate sensor performance and design new data acquisition systems. Working with vendors and partners, you will build hardware and work with our operations staff to deploy it in the field. With this sensor data and other data sources at KoBold, you will build models and apply a wide range of scientific computing, statistical, and physics\-based methods to find places where there is evidence of ore\-forming processes at work and to predict the locations of ore\-grade mineralization in 2D and 3D. You will help build a worldwide dataset that underlies our exploration program, with careful attention to identifying and quantifying uncertainty in the data and in our predictions. You will be creating models and developing software to accelerate discovery of critical battery metals. You will join an outstanding team of data scientists and engineers and will work closely with KoBold's world\-renowned geoscientists to incorporate our best understanding of the chemical and physical processes that create ore deposits. Working with your geoscience colleagues, you will identify new opportunities and technologies for geophysical data collection, create 2D and 3D geologic predictions, identify exploration targets, design field programs to collect data, and use that data to reduce the uncertainty in our predictions and guide the next phase of field work. Ultimately, your role is to help KoBold make valuable discoveries by building and deploying next generation hardware and using data tools to solve scientific problems. As one of the early members of this team, you will help build these tools from the ground up. Responsibilities of this position include: **Technical execution** * Design, develop, and deploy new mineral exploration data collection instruments and methods. * Help develop KoBold's proprietary software exploration tools. * Find and curate a wide variety of geospectral, geophysical, geochemical, geologic, and geographic data and integrate it into KoBold's proprietary data system. * Build models to make statistically valid predictions about the locations of compositional anomalies within the Earth's crust. * Create effective visualizations for evaluating model performance and enabling rapid interaction with the underlying data and key features. * Develop and apply a range of data processing, statistical, and physics\-based techniques to geoscientific data — from computer vision to geophysical inversions — and use the results to guide our targeting efforts and inform our acquisition and exploration decisions. * Present to and collaborate with our external partners and stakeholders. * Push the state of the art in analysis capabilities by implementing statistically rigorous spatially aware clus w concepts and technologies. * A successful track record of developing complex equipment with cross\-disciplinary teams and vendors. Technical skills, including extensive experience with: * Physical measurement and data analysis systems that use phenomena such as optics, electromagnetism, radiation, and gravity. * Applying scientific knowledge to identify and prototype emerging technologies * Systems integration and data acquisition. * Python's data science packages and general software engineering practices. * Collaborative software development (git), and familiarity with software engineering best practices like unit test / integration test suites, and CICD pipelines. * SQL, as well as familiarity with non\-relational databases. * Cloud computing resources. * Building a wide variety of predictive models, applying them to different problems, and evaluating and interpreting the results. * Data analysis, physics analysis, and applied statistics on a broad range of types of data including data from physical systems. * Capacity to dive deep on novel challenging problems in applying ML to mineral exploration, including understanding a complex domain of geology and mineral exploration practices as well as working with limited, disparate and noisy data sources * Experience deploying sensors in the field Work practices and motivation: * Ability to take ownership and responsibility of large projects. * Intellectual curiosity and eagerness to learn about all aspects of mineral exploration, particularly in the geology domain. Open to working directly with geologists in the field. Enjoys constantly learning such that you are driving insights and innovations. * Ability to explain technical problems to and collaborate on solutions with domain experts who aren't software developers. A strong communicator who enjoys working with colleagues across the company. * Excitement about joining a fast\-growing early\-stage company, comfort with a dynamic work environment, and eagerness to take on a range of responsibilities. * Keen not just to build cool technology, but to figure out what technical product to build to best achieve the business objectives of the company. * Ability to independently prioritize multiple tasks effectively. It is also helpful but not required to have experience with: * Remote sensing * Creating machine learning models on geospatial data * Image processing or computer vision * Project and team management **What to Expect** Joining KoBold means getting the opportunity for hands\-on exposure to our exploration projects around the world. All employees are expected to travel to project sites, with a minimum of one week per year. Field\-facing and technical roles spend significantly more time in the field. KoBold Metals is an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity for people of any race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, age, citizenship, disability, or veteran status. This position is Full\-time Exempt Salary is one part of KoBold's total compensation. The US salary range for this role is between $125,000 and $235,000, and will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. In addition to salary, we offer equity compensation. We also offer benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401k retirement plan, short \& long term disability and life insurance. We also offer paid sick time and parental leave." Location: Remote, Candidates can be located anywhere in the United States or Canada. All candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States or Canada. 10\-20% travel required. Compensation ranges are listed in USD. If you are based outside the US, the range may not translate directly: US pay reflects a different market with different competitive dynamics, so we benchmark roles against the local market rather than converting the listed figure.

In this role, you will work across the full software development lifecycle, guide technical design and architecture, and mentor other engineers through pairing, design reviews and code reviews. This position is required to be onsite in our Wichita, KS office. for deep experience. * Guide technical design and architecture decisions, promoting scalable, secure, reusable and supportable solutions. * Champion strong engineering practices, including code quality, automated testing, CI/CD and observability, with a relentless focus on long\-term value over short\-term fixes. * Use AI\-assisted and agentic engineering practices across design, coding, testing and documentation, while staying accountable for the quality, security and supportability of what you ship. * Support and maintain existing applications, including troubleshooting and resolving production issues. * Act as a role model for the team, mentoring engineers through pairing, design reviews and code reviews, and staying open to learning from them in return. * Partner with support delivery commitments. * Serve as a subject matter expert in the logistics domain, translating between technical and business needs, eliciting requirements directly from stakeholders and stepping into the BSA role when needed. * Contribute to engineering standards, development practices and delivery processes, and propose practical, repeatable improvements to current architecture and technology stacks. * Help build a culture of continuous learning and principled entrepreneurship, and share knowledge across the wider development organization. **Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)** * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience delivering production systems. * Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers, influence technical direction, and work through complex technical challenges. * Technical leadership of design or architecture efforts for complex enterprise applications, whether as a technical lead, architect or senior engineer. * Deep fluency in modern programming languages, frameworks, architecture patterns, and software engineering practices. * Experience building enterprise\-grade, scalable solutions on Amazon Web Services (AWS) with services such as Lambda, SNS, SQS, API Gateway, EventBridge, DynamoDB and S3\. * Strong background building and supporting production\-grade software in Python, Node.js or similar modern technologies. * Working knowledge of generative AI development tools such as GitHub Copilot or Claude Code, and how to use them to improve software development and solution delivery. * Experience applying modern software delivery practices, including Git, CI/CD, automated testing, code reviews, and production support. * Experience working in Agile or other iterative development environments. * Legally authorized to work in the United States. **What Will Put You Ahead** * Expertise designing cloud\-native, event\-driven or microservices\-based architectures in AWS. * Hands\-on work developing generative AI or agentic services with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore or similar technologies. * A practical approach to verifying AI\-generated code and output, using automated testing, evaluation and review so that AI\-accelerated delivery still meets production standards. * A history of helping establish engineering standards and improving development, testing, deployment and operational practices across a team. * Success modernizing legacy applications and moving workloads to cloud\-native architectures. * Confidence working directly with business stakeholders to elicit and shape requirements. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship or relocation at this time. At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy. **Hiring Philosophy** All Koch companies value diversity of thought, perspectives, aptitudes, experiences, and backgrounds. We are Military Ready and Second Chance employers. Learn more about our hiring philosophy here . **Who We Are** As a Koch company, Koch Ag \& Energy Solutions (KAES) is a global provider of value\-added solutions for the agriculture, turf and ornamental, energy and chemical markets. From agriculture to energy, KAES makes things grow better with plant nutrient and biological technologies. Our team of innovators unleash their potential while developing the technologies that feed and power the world. At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company. **Our Benefits** Our goal is for each employee, and their families, to live fulfilling and healthy lives. We provide essential resources and support to build and maintain physical, financial, and emotional strength \- focusing on overall wellbeing so you can focus on what matters most. We seek to enable the best work environment that helps you and the business work together to produce superior results. **Equal Opportunities** Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status. jobs.title: Staff Optical Network Engineering
jobs.description: Lambda, The Superintelligence Cloud, is a leader in AI cloud infrastructure serving tens of thousands of customers. Our customers range from AI researchers to enterprises and hyperscalers. Lambda's mission is to make compute as ubiquitous as electricity and give everyone the power of superintelligence. One person, one GPU. If you'd like to build the world's best AI cloud, join us. * Note: This position requires presence in our Bellevue or San Francisco office location 4 days per week; Lambda’s designated work from home day is currently Tuesday. Lambda, The Superintelligence Cloud, is a leader in AI cloud infrastructure serving tens of thousands of customers. Our customers range from AI researchers to enterprises and hyperscalers. Lambda's mission is to make compute as ubiquitous as electricity and give everyone the power of superintelligence. One person, one GPU. Our vision is bold and is not an incremental exercise. We will continually re\-evaluate and reinvent our current ways of working and the automation underneath all of it, while operating the existing network flawlessly for all customer workloads. Lambda has 10x'd over the last three years, and the network engineering organization is scaling to match. We're looking for a Staff Optical Network Engineer to lead building our metro, backbone and customer interconnectivity. This connectivity is going to play a critical role to ensure a flawless customer connectivity experience to our GPU cloud infrastructure. We're looking for an experienced senior engineer with deep technical expertise to own optical based outcomes end to end — and to set the technical direction for how it scales. You'll mentor and grow engineers across the organization, automate everything we do, shape team culture, and partner with technical leadership to deliver other mechanisms needed to stay ahead of our scale ambitions. This role will report to the Director of Network Capacity Delivery, working alongside a highly capable and passionate team of engineers. If you'd like to join a great team of customer obsessed engineers building the world's best AI cloud, come join us. **What You'll Do** * Own optical network planning, design, delivery and operation end to end — and be accountable for capacity landing ahead of demand * Set optical standards, reference designs and runbooks used by engineers and field teams * Shape the multi\-year technical optical transport strategy for capacity, performance and delivery to ensure it continually scales * Be a subject matter expert for our automation strategy \- the goal is a capacity pipeline that runs without heroics, not a better\-organized set of runbooks * Own the operational bar for the optical network: how capacity work is planned, reviewed, shipped, measured and learned from when it goes wrong * Mentor peer engineers and grow their scope and technical depth in optical networking * Partner and support our Interconnect team who negotiate, acquire and coordinate on external connectivity * Partner with engineers and technical leadership to maintain a high engineering bar across design, code quality and operational reliability * Own vendor relationships for optical systems and evaluate new platforms and pluggables and recommend what we adopt to scale capacity * Partner with Infrastructure, Supply Chain, Data Center Operations, Product and Finance to align capacity roadmaps, forecast jobs.title: Performance Engineer, Load Testing
jobs.description: LiteLLM is the world’s most popular AI Gateway, trusted by companies like Okta, NASA, and NVIDIA. We’ve grown ARR 6x in the last year to nearly $30M with a team of 20, and thousands of companies run production AI through LiteLLM across 100\+ provider integrations. We're looking for a Performance Engineer to own load, performance, and regression testing for the gateway. **About the role** ------------------ This is a hands\-on role. You'll build the tests and tooling that tell us whether a release is faster or slower than the one before it, and catch the difference before it reaches customers. Our performance problems rarely come from one big mistake. Changes across a few releases raised proxy overhead about 5x at the median and 18x at p95, and cut throughput by about 22%. One authorization change added about 35 database queries every time a client listed its MCP tools, and Claude Code timed out loading them. Each change looked fine on its own. Catching them means measuring the right things on every release and telling real regressions apart from noise. You’ll work with our engineering and Rust teams and report to the CEO, and later to our Head of Engineering. This role is in person in San Francisco. We help with relocation and support H\-1B transfers. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Build load, soak, and regression tests that measure latency, throughput, memory, and database load on every release candidate. * Make performance a release gate, so a regression past an agreed budget blocks the release. * Give engineers a smoke test they can run on their laptops before they open a PR. * Trace regressions to the change that caused them, down to an extra database query, a serialization step, or a call to Redis. * Reproduce real customer workloads: streaming responses, large payloads, high concurrency, and many proxy replicas sharing Postgres and Redis. * Benchmark our move to Rust so components get faster without changing behavior. * Work with the engineers who own each area to fix what the tests find. **What is our tech stack** -------------------------- The tech stack includes Python, FastAPI, Redis, Postgres. We're moving the gateway to Rust. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * You've built the load, performance, or regression testing system at your company, and other engineers relied on it. * You've caught a performance regression before it shipped and traced it to its cause. * You know how to get reliable numbers from noisy benchmarks. * A deep understanding of high\-throughput services: concurrency, event loops, connection pooling, and databases on the request path. * Strong software engineering fundamentals, preferably in Python. * You build tools other engineers want to use. * This isn't an SRE or DevOps role. You build the tests and tooling, and work with the team on the fixes. **Bonus points** ---------------- * You've built load testing or performance regression detection at large scale. * You've worked on a proxy, gateway, or load balancer where overhead is what you optimize. * Rust experience. * Experience at an early\-stage startup. **Why join LiteLLM?** --------------------- * Work directly with the founders every day. * Own the performance of infrastructure that thousands of companies run in production. * Own a whole area of the codebase. We don't have PMs: engineers talk to customers and decide what to build. * Your work ships in open source, used by engineering teams around the world. * Move incredibly fast and see your work in production immediately. * Competitive salary, equity, health, dental, and vision benefits. **About LiteLLM** ----------------- LiteLLM is the world's most widely adopted AI Gateway. We provide a unified API for 100\+ LLM providers along with routing, authentication, budgets, observability, and governance for production AI systems. Thousands of companies rely on LiteLLM to power AI in production. If you want to own the performance of the gateway thousands of companies depend on, we'd love to meet you.

jobs.title: Research Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Overview** ==================== Each year, 2\.5 trillion hours are spent on household chores. At Matic, we’re on a mission to recapture that lost time, and we’re doing it by revolutionizing home robotics. Our first product, also called Matic, is a Wall\-E\-esque floor cleaning robot. We've built what amounts to "full self\-driving in the home” with real\-time 3D mapping, adaptive path\-tracking, and a precise semantic understanding of the home. Our breakthroughs in spatial AI allow Matic to work reliably in real homes, using only RGB cameras and neural networks running on\-device. **Privacy First** ----------------- What happens in the home, stays in the home. Our robots are private by design, with all data processing performed by the robot itself, not in the cloud. **Our Approach** ---------------- Before the iPhone, consumers adopted several distinct devices; cell phones, PDAs, and portable music players each served a particular need. We believe in a similar progression for home robotics, starting with single\-purpose robots and building iteratively toward more complex capabilities over time. **Our Culture** --------------- Matic is a tight\-knit and collaborative team, singularly focused on building products our customers will cherish. We're ultra\-hardworking people committed to solving tough problems that save precious time and energy. **About the role** ================== We're looking for a motivated perception engineer to join us on the ground floor, with a runway for huge and immediate impact. **What you'll do** * Translate open\-ended, real\-world problems into well\-defined machine learning problems * Design, build, and code computer vision\-based algorithms * Build novel neural network architectures * Design and implement robust 3D geometry\-based vision algorithms * Build scalable machine learning infrastructure to train on large datasets and simultaneously be reproducible * Analyze results, continuously update and improve accuracy \& speed of various algorithms * Deploy algorithms \& machine learning pipelines at scale on the edge devices with limited compute without sacrificing performance * Work to enable Level 5 autonomy in consumer robotics * Cross\-collaborate with Hardware, Electrical, and Systems teams to bring product vision to life **What we look for** * Robust machine learning background in computer vision and perceptual tasks, including 3D perception, multi\-class object detection, 3D maps, and advanced robotics controls * Track record of product\-focused research applied to real\-world applications * Fluency with Rust (or C\+\+) and Python (PyTorch or similar tools) * Ability to write clean, reliable code that is easily maintained **We'd love to hear from you if...** * You are genuinely motivated to help those around you * You are passionate about learning outside of your normal comfort zones * You love diagnosing complex technical issues * You are excited to do great work **Compensation** Base $140,000 — $220,000 Actual Compensation will depend on skills, experience and qualifications. Base Salary is one part of the total compensation package. The role is also eligible for equity through the company’s discretionary equity program, along with a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental and vision coverage access to a 401(k) plan.

jobs.title: Product Lead, Enterprise AI
jobs.description: **About Mercor** ================ Mercor’s mission is to organize human intelligence for the AI economy. We build the infrastructure that enables frontier AI labs and enterprises to train, evaluate, and improve AI on real\-world professional work. More than five million experts have joined our network, and we pay out over $5 million daily for their knowledge and expertise. We built our training and evaluation infrastructure alongside the world’s leading AI labs. Now, we’re bringing those capabilities to enterprises across industries, enabling them to train, evaluate, and improve AI using their own expertise and standards. Our APEX benchmarks measure how AI performs on economically valuable work, while our enterprise evaluations and post\-training capabilities turn those insights into measurable improvements across real\-world workflows. Our work sits at the intersection of frontier AI, human expertise, and real\-world application. We’re solving problems few companies have encountered, with the opportunity to influence what the world’s most advanced AI systems become capable of doing. We’re looking for people who bring different perspectives, take ownership, exercise sound judgment, and hold themselves to an exceptionally high standard. You’ll have the opportunity to do consequential work alongside talented colleagues who challenge one another, collaborate openly, and share a commitment to excellence. Mercor is profitable and recently raised a $750 million Series D at a $20 billion valuation. We work in person five days a week in San Francisco, New York, and London. ### **About the Role** As Product Lead for Enterprise AI, you will own Mercor's portfolio of enterprise AI products end to end, spanning evaluation, post\-training, failure analysis, and the deployment and optimization of AI agents. Much of this work started as custom, forward\-deployed projects for individual customers, and you will turn it into products that labs and enterprises can adopt at scale. jobs.title: Embedded Software Tools Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About Mainspring** Mainspring Energy manufactures and delivers fuel\-flexible, low\-emissions local power solutions that rapidly add new capacity and deliver reliable, affordable, and sustainable electric power. The company began commercial shipments of its Mainspring Linear Generators in 2020 and today has hundreds of megawatts in advanced development and field operations for leading Fortune 500 companies, data centers, and utilities. Mainspring also partners with global energy leaders including AEP, NextEra Energy Resources, Schneider Electric, and more. The core values that ground our work, guide our decisions, and connect us together: * Pragmatic Optimism * Excellence without Ego * Proactive Collaboration ### **Job Overview** Mainspring Energy’s revolutionary linear generator is a sophisticated robot. Inside the generator is a network of computers combining embedded Linux and real\-time bare metal applications. These orchestrate the critical tasks of shaping control signals and collecting data from a wide variety of sensors which make this technology possible. Our embedded platform is rapidly evolving, and we need great software developers to make it happen. If you love building systems, getting hands on hardware and just making everything work, then we need you! ### **Responsibilities** This is a software engineering role with emphasis on applications that interface with embedded systems. As a developer on the team you will contribute to: * **Software Tooling \& Automation**: Develop custom Python, C\+\+, Bash, Rust or Web applications that interface directly with embedded devices (via Serial, USB, CAN, or Ethernet) for hardware bring\-up, configuration, data logging, and manufacturing tests. * **Firmware \& Software Integration**: Analyze and integrate with C\+\+ code for diverse hardware architectures, including both embedded Linux platforms and bare metal/RTOS environments. * **Diagnostic \& HMI Interfaces**: Design and implement standards\-based communication interfaces (e.g. standard APIs, Modbus, MQTT, or industry\-specific protocols) that expose telemetry, system states, and error logs directly to technician HMIs. * **HIL \& Automated Test Infrastructure**: Design, develop and/or maintain Hardware\-in\-the\-Loop (HIL) test systems and automated testing frameworks to validate firmware performance, simulate fault conditions, and ensure system robustness across releases. * **Diagnostic \& Service Tooling**: Build external log\-parsing utilities, automated health\-check scripts, and diagnostic dashboards that translate device telemetry and fault data into clear, actionable insights for test engineers and field service technicians? to streamline hardware troubleshooting and repair. ### **Qualifications** You have: * **Experience**: 3\+ years embedded software development experience (real\-time a plus) * **Languages**: C/C\+\+, Python, Bash (JavaScript/TypeScript, Rust a plus) * **Debugging Skills**: Strong ability to debug complex systemic issues across the hardware/software boundary using logic analyzers, multimeters, and physical debuggers. * **Education**: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. This position is **onsite** at our **Menlo Park HQ**. The salary will be adjusted to reflect local market conditions based on employee location as well as the experience of the employee. Mainspring can sometimes be flexible enough to shift responsibilities for the right person, or otherwise identify open or upcoming roles that may better fit your professional background. jobs.description: Job Description **About the Role:** Our IT team operates as a business partner proposing ideas and innovative solutions that enable new organizational capabilities. We collaborate internationally to deliver the services and solutions that help R\&D global users to be more productive and enable innovation. A GenAI Software Engineer on our Data Science team builds the AI services that draft regulatory documents from clinical study data, and understands the product and the business well enough to know what good looks like. This is the module where clinical results become regulatory\-ready narrative: you will work on the services that orchestrate model calls, ground generated text in the correct study data, and return section\-level content to our authoring applications — and you will work with the authors, product owners, and data scientists who depend on that content to understand why it matters and how to make it better. We are building an engineer who works across the whole problem, not one layer of it. Day to day that means backend services and APIs, clinical data pipelines, AWS deployment, and applied GenAI, grounded in a real understanding of the users and the regulatory process they work within. AI is part of how we do that work: we expect you to use AI tools to learn faster, move across disciplines, and take on responsibilities that would once have required a larger team — and to bring a critical eye to when AI output is right and when it is not. This is a durable role on the team rather than a role scoped to a single project. Our GenAI authoring work is currently proving itself out, and our portfolio of regulatory and clinical digital solutions will keep evolving. Whatever the trajectory of any one initiative, the capabilities this role builds — backend services, clinical data engineering, cloud, product thinking, and applied GenAI in a regulated environment — are ones we will continue to invest in, and we expect the role to grow into broader responsibility alongside them. **Key Responsibilities:** **Product \& Business Understanding:** * Develop a good understanding of our company's biopharmaceutical R\&D business processes, systems, and data, with a focus on clinical and regulatory processes. * Learn how regulatory documents are authored, reviewed, and submitted, and use that understanding to shape what you build and how you prioritize it. * Partner directly with product managers, medical writers, statisticians, data scientists, and business technology partners to turn user needs into well\-defined technical work. * Contribute to product discovery and refinement: ask the questions that clarify the problem, weigh options, and help define what success looks like and how it will be measured. * Gather user feedback on generated content and translate it into concrete improvements to prompts, data, and services. **GenAI Solution and refine LLM\-based generation approaches — prompt and instruction design, structured output, grounding in source data, and guardrails — to improve the accuracy, consistency, and safety of generated regulatory text. * Evaluate generated output rigorously: build curated test sets, define quantitative and rubric\-based measures of quality, run regression comparisons as models and approaches change, jobs.title: Computational Imaging and Signal Processing Engineer
jobs.description: Merge Labs is a frontier research lab with the mission of bridging biological and artificial intelligence to maximize human ability, agency and experience. We’re pursuing this goal by developingfundamentally new approaches to brain\-computer interfaces that interact with the brain at high bandwidth, integrate with advanced AI, and are ultimately safe and accessible for anyone to use. **About the Team** We turn physical signals into information and back. We reason backward from neural readout and stimulation goals to co\-optimize the physical and computational systems that make them possible. Working with scientists and engineers, we combine simulation, measurement, and signal processing across neural interfaces, device characterization, and high\-throughput biological screening. Our systems stream tens of gigabits per second. Within constrained power envelopes, we find what limits sensitivity, resolution, and reliability, push what today’s devices can deliver, and set the specifications for future generations. **About the Role** You will build and maintain a shared imaging core that turns raw ultrasound data into image series across our platforms. You will define performance objectives and develop, optimize, and rigorously validate reconstruction methods. A central challenge is making these methods fast enough for real\-time imaging and efficient enough for large\-scale offline processing. Early work includes bringing existing acquisition and processing pipelines into a common framework that other engineers can use and improve. **In this role, you will:** * Develop reusable methods for beamforming/backprojection, clutter filtering, and motion and displacement estimation within a shared imaging core for processing and optimization. * Optimize imaging pipelines through controlled experiments, balancing sensitivity, robustness, and computational cost. * Rigorously validate imaging pipelines using reproducible benchmarks, reference measurements, and regression tests, quantifying performance and uncertainty even when ground truth is limited. * Produce reliable imaging results, analyze them rigorously, and present findings concisely with their quality and limitations explicit. * Meet sustained throughput and latency targets for real\-time and large\-scale offline processing within compute and memory budgets. * Use measured imaging performance and system limits to shape device and acquisition requirements. * Explore learned methods, including deep learning, and integrate them when independent evaluation shows a useful improvement over strong baselines. **You might thrive in this role if you have:** * Strong signal\-processing and computational\-imaging fundamentals, with deep experience in at least one imaging or sensing modality. * Experience developing or materially improving reconstruction methods that others use. * Strong scientific Python skills and experience profiling and improving GPU performance and memory use for large datasets or high\-rate data streams. * Experience designing and maintaining shared scientific software, with clear interfaces, tests, and documentation. * Sound judgment in experimental design, optimization, and interpreting measurements. * A track record of rigorous validation and honest reporting of uncertainty, limitations, and negative findings. * Experience turning ambiguous scientific needs into useful engineering results with colleagues across disciplines. **Useful, but not required** * Ultrasound or related wave\-based imaging. * Prior experience with real\-time reconstruction. * Learned reconstruction or denoising. * Wave\-propagation simulation. * C\+\+ or custom GPU\-kernel development. * Experience turning scientific Python prototypes into production\-quality software, including work with build systems such as Bazel. * Experience using AI tools or agents to develop scientific software and optimize processing pipelines. If you're excited about this role but don't meet every qualification, please apply. As we build, we're hiring for complementary strengths to form a high\-impact team. **For more information about hiring at Merge, please visit our** **Hiring FAQ** *Merge Labs does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, family status, ancestry, citizenship, U.S. military (state and federal) and veteran status, or any other legally protected status. You'll work with direct executive sponsorship from the Chief Transformation Officer and the autonomy to move fast on reversible decisions. **What you'll do** ================== ### **Embed and discover** * Sit with one or two business domains at a time, learn how the work actually gets done, and surface the highest\-value opportunities for AI — the ones that redirect hours, cut cycle time, or remove error\-prone handoffs * Turn fuzzy asks into crisp problem statements, success metrics, and a buildable MVP scope within days, not weeks ### **Design, build, and deploy** * Build production\-grade solutions on Claude — Projects, Skills, Claude Code, and agentic workflows — connected to the systems our teams live in (Salesforce, NetSuite, Asana, Jira, Microsoft 365, our Databricks data platform, and internal APIs) via connectors and MCP * Write the integration code, prompts, evaluations, and guardrails that make a solution reliable enough to run without you * Ship fast with time\-boxed experiments and small test groups, then harden what works ### **Measure and scale** * Instrument every solution for business value — hours redirected, turnaround time, adoption, quality — and report it against our enterprise AI scorecard * Convert one\-off wins into reusable patterns, connectors, and playbooks the next team can adopt * Coach team champions so solutions have local owners, and feed what you learn back into our enterprise AI fluency program ### **Operate responsibly** * Build inside our AI governance framework: approved tools, data\-handling standards, and the security and compliance requirements of a fintech serving regulated financial institutions * Partner with Security, Data, and Business Systems so solutions are supportable and sustainable — never shadow IT **How we work** =============== We optimize for transparency over perfection — a red metric is fine, a hidden one is not. Most decisions are two\-way doors: we expect you to make them with your sponsor and keep moving. You'll get a weekly check\-in with the Chief Transformation Officer and a clear set of outcomes, not daily direction. You'll be measured on what's running in production and doing useful work. **What success looks like in the first 90 days** ================================================ * Three AI solutions shipped and in daily use across at least two business domains, each with a baseline and a measured result * A starter library of reusable connectors, prompts, and evaluation patterns * A prioritized, sized backlog of next opportunities co\-owned with business sponsors **What you bring** ================== * 6–9 years in software, solutions, integration, or implementation engineering, including 2\+ years shipping LLM\-based workflows that real teams use in production — not demos * Hands\-on depth with Claude (or equivalent frontier models), including agentic workflows, tool use, connectors/MCP, and prompt and evaluation design * Strong Python and/or TypeScript; comfortable with REST APIs, webhooks, authentication, and integrating SaaS systems * Working fluency with enterprise data — SQL, data warehouses, and the judgment to know when a data problem is the real blocker * A track record of working autonomously with ambiguous scope, and of saying “here's what I shipped” rather than “here's what I'd recommend” * Clear, direct communication with executives and front\-line users alike; you can run a discovery session and a demo in the same afternoon **Nice to have** * Prior Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Engineer, or AI implementation role * Experience in fintech, lending, or another regulated SaaS environment * Exposure to Salesforce, NetSuite, Databricks, or revenue and finance operations processes * Experience with change enablement — getting people to adopt, not just getting systems to work Compensation Range: $114,593 \- $230,000 Apply for this Job

jobs.title: Principal Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** ACES CØDE is a Microsoft engineering organization focused on reducing operational demand across the Microsoft Cloud including but not limited to the avoidable support cases, repeated troubleshooting, and manual interventions that arise when cloud products, platforms, or processes do not work as intended. Our mission is to engineer this demand out of the Microsoft Cloud by turning customer and operational signals into lasting product improvements, intelligent diagnostics, autonomous resolution systems, and AI\-powered capabilities. As cloud services grow in scale and complexity, we are moving beyond simply reacting to problems after they occur. We work to understand why operational demand exists, prevent it at the source where possible, resolve it autonomously when it does occur, and continuously learn from those signals to make our products and support experiences more reliable. We look for teammates who can navigate ambiguity, reason from data and customer signals, work across technical and organizational boundaries, and turn complex problems into durable, measurable outcomes. Within this mission, the ACES CØDE engineering team is building domain\-specific agents and intelligent services that are transforming Azure customer support and product quality, moving from reactive, human\-only workflows toward AI\-first systems that resolve customer issues and product repairs at Azure scale. We are seeking a Principal Applied AI Engineer to serve as a hands\-on technical architect and senior developer for production agentic AI services. You will define and implement the architecture for next\-generation AI agents, including LLM orchestration, multi\-agent coordination, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), tool integration, and evaluation systems. You will write production code, lead complex technical initiatives, establish engineering standards, and guide engineers across organizational boundaries through technical influence rather than people management. This is a deeply technical individual contributor role with broad architectural scope and direct accountability for production outcomes. You will turn ambiguous customer and business problems into scalable systems, make critical design decisions, build foundational components, and help teams ship secure and reliable AI services that handle thousands of customer cases per month. Every day, our customers stake their business and reputation on our cloud. You can help Azure EngOps provide our customers with the world\-class cloud services they need to succeed. Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day, we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. **Responsibilities** * Architect and build production agentic AI systems: Design and implement scalable AI agents and services, including LLM orchestration, multi\-agent workflows, RAG pipelines, tool integrations, memory and state management, and human\-in\-the\-loop experiences. * Lead through hands\-on engineering: Write, review, and maintain production\-quality C\# and Python code. jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, Browser Engineering - AI Experiences, Microsoft Edge
jobs.description: **Overview** Our AI Experiences, Microsoft Edge team is seeking exceptional **Principal Software Engineers** to build and evolve one of the world's most sophisticated browsers. We are looking for engineers with deep expertise in Chromium, C\+\+, and complex client systems who are also at the forefront of transforming how software is engineered using AI. Browser engineering presents some of the hardest challenges in software development. Our engineers work across an enormous codebase, complex multi\-process architectures, operating system integrations, performance\-critical components, and demanding security and reliability requirements. Delivering great browser experiences requires deep technical expertise, strong engineering judgment, and the ability to solve difficult problems at scale. We believe AI is fundamentally changing what exceptional engineers can accomplish. We expect engineers to embrace AI coding agents, automated development workflows, and emerging tools to dramatically increase their productivity, accelerate experimentation, and take on more ambitious engineering challenges. We are not simply looking for engineers who occasionally use AI to write code. We want engineers who have fundamentally evolved how they work, using AI to investigate unfamiliar code, implement changes, generate tests, diagnose failures, automate repetitive tasks, and accelerate the entire software development lifecycle. This is an opportunity to combine world\-class systems engineering with a new model of software development, where exceptional engineers leverage AI to achieve unprecedented levels of productivity without compromising quality. Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. *AI Experiences employees who live within a 50\-mile commute of a designated Microsoft Hub in the U.S. are expected to work from the office at least four days per week. This expectation is subject to local law and may vary by jurisdiction.* **Responsibilities** Software engineering is undergoing one of the most significant transformations in its history. AI is rapidly changing how code is written, understood, tested, debugged, and maintained. We believe the most effective engineers will be those who combine deep technical expertise with the ability to leverage AI as a force multiplier. This is particularly important in browser engineering. Chromium is an extraordinarily complex software system, and navigating its architecture, dependencies, build infrastructure, and validation requirements has traditionally required substantial time and specialized knowledge. AI creates an opportunity to fundamentally change that equation. We want engineers who can use AI to move faster through complexity, investigate problems more effectively, automate routine development work, and focus their expertise on the hardest architectural and technical decisions. **Our ambition is to build an engineering organization where exceptional engineers, empowered by AI, can accomplish dramatically more while delivering software of uncompromising quality.** We are looking for people who are not waiting for this future to arrive. Swiss army knife, plug in where the team needs you and provide maximum value. * **The TOOLS you'll bring with you:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent experience. * 5\+ years of QA engineering experience supporting web and digital platforms. * Clear and confident communication skills. * Experience testing complex websites, ecommerce solutions, or customer\-facing web applications. * Strong experience testing REST APIs and validating JSON\-based integrations. * Hands\-on experience with test automation frameworks such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, or similar. * Proficiency using TypeScript, JavaScript, or comparable scripting languages. * Experience implementing automated testing within CI/CD pipelines. * Knowledge of modern web technologies, browser debugging tools, and responsive design principles. * Experience validating SEO requirements, web analytics implementations, and accessibility standards. * Strong understanding of Agile development methodologies. Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills. * **Other TOOLS we prefer you to have:** * Experience with Payload or comparable CMS platforms. * Experience testing product information management (PIM) systems, digital asset management systems, or product data platforms. * Familiarity with ecommerce platforms and customer\-facing configurator experiences. * Experience with performance and load testing tools such as K6, JMeter, or Azure Load Testing. * Experience with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or similar CI/CD platforms. * Knowledge of accessibility standards (WCAG) and SEO best practices. Experience working in manufacturing, retail, construction, or consumer products industries. * **We provide these great perks and benefits:** * Robust health, dental, and vision insurance plans * Generous 401(k) savings plan * Education assistance * On\-site wellness, fitness center, food, and coffee service And many more — check out our benefits site for details * *Milwaukee Tool is an equal opportunity employer.*

jobs.title: Data Platform Engineer, Observability
jobs.description: **ABOUT MINERVA** ----------------- Minerva builds AI for marketing leaders. We work together with marketers to automate and accelerate their workflows with AI agents. Our agents augment the end\-to\-end workflow of the marketer by automating analysis, campaign planning, activation, measurement and reporting. Customers like the NBA, Ramp, Wander, Hard Rock Stadium Group and Luxury Presence use Minerva to develop a better understanding of their customers and introduce AI specifically built to understand the customer into their commercial organizations. Our campaigns outperform other tools because we built the entire stack: from identity to enrichment to data integration as well as agents to action and report on the analysis. We've raised $20M from The General Partnership, 8VC, Lingotto, NBA Investments, Topology Ventures, Future Positive, Background Capital and many others. Our team brings together operators and investors from Citadel, Dentsu, Bridgewater, Meta Superintelligence, Growthloop, Amazon and Lazard, alongside engineers and researchers from Berkeley, MIT, Stanford and Cambridge. **THE ROLE** ------------ A green job can still hide a stale input or a failed publication. By the time someone downstream notices, a customer usually has too. You own pipeline health and actionable alerting across our first\-party and third\-party data. You cover our dbt pipelines and Dagster workflows, catch failures as they happen, and warn us about problems before they reach downstream delivery. This is a mid\-level individual contributor seat on the data platform team, reporting to our Head of Data Platform. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** ------------------ * **Define what healthy means.** Freshness, completeness and successful\-delivery expectations for our critical dbt and Dagster workflows and their Airflow and SQLMesh dependencies. * **Build one alerting framework.** Clear severity, ownership, routing, deduplication and escalation, tuned so people trust it and don't mute it. * **Catch problems early.** Detect missing deliveries, stalled runs and stale outputs. Add early warnings for growing lag, schema drift and abnormal volumes or coverage. * **Trace the impact.** Connect health signals across dependencies to find the failing step and what it breaks downstream. * **Keep recovery repeatable.** Maintain runbooks, and test detection and recovery on purpose. * **Build checks into onboarding** so every new source arrives monitored. Agree data\-quality thresholds with our data product team and measure detection time, recovery time and false positives. **WHAT YOU HAVE** ----------------- * Experience operating data transformation and orchestration systems, and diagnosing problems beyond job status. dbt and Dagster experience is valuable. * You've built production monitoring and actionable alerts, including early warnings, and kept false positives down. * You can tell a source delay from a processing failure from a quality regression, trace the impact and coordinate the fix with the pipeline's owner. * You've maintained reusable checks and runbooks that other people used. * You're in New York City or willing to relocate. **NICE TO HAVES** ----------------- * Data\-quality frameworks. * Anomaly detection. * Service\-level objectives for data. **WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE** --------------------------- * **First 90 days:** monitoring and alerting run on selected first\- and third\-party workflows, you've shown failure detection and early warnings in controlled tests, and the framework is part of onboarding. * **The numbers you own:** detection time, recovery time and false\-positive rate. **COMPENSATION** ---------------- $170,000–$236,000 base salary, depending on level. Meaningful equity. Medical, dental and vision. **HOW TO APPLY** ---------------- Skip the cover letter. Tell us about an alert you built that caught a real problem before anyone downstream noticed, and one you had to kill because it was noise. **WHERE WE WORK** ----------------- We work in person from our office at 300 Kent Avenue in Williamsburg, Brooklyn. **BENEFITS** ------------ Every full\-time role includes equity; medical, dental and vision coverage; unlimited PTO; a monthly fitness stipend; and an annual company offsite. We'd rather pay people well than buy perks nobody uses. **PAY TRANSPARENCY** -------------------- The salary range in this posting is our good\-faith range for the role in New York City at the time of posting. Where an offer lands depends on the level and experience we see in the interview process. **APPLYING** ------------ Apply on this page. We don't take applications by email, and we don't accept unsolicited submissions from recruiting agencies. If you need an accommodation at any point in the process, write to hiring@minerva.io. **WORK AUTHORIZATION** ---------------------- You'll need to be authorized to work in the United States. We consider visa sponsorship case by case, so tell us on the application if you'll need it. **EQUAL OPPORTUNITY** --------------------- Minerva is an equal opportunity employer. We make hiring decisions without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, citizenship status, age, disability, marital status, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by federal, New York State or New York City law. **RECRUITMENT FRAUD** --------------------- Our hiring runs through Ashby and @minerva.io email addresses. We will never ask you for money, bank details or other financial information during the process. If a message claiming to be from Minerva looks wrong, forward it to hiring@minerva.io. Compensation Range: $170K \- $236K
