Until we hire a dedicated observability engineer, pipeline health and alerting are yours too. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** ------------------ * **Design and deliver shared platform capabilities** across ingestion, transformation, storage and downstream delivery. * **Set the standards** for data contracts, safe reprocessing, monitoring, alerting, releases and recovery, and get the team to adopt them. * **Solve the scale and correctness problems:** inconsistent data, partial failures and large backfills, balancing performance and cost. * **Lead complex cross\-system delivery,** like moving consumers onto normalized lakehouse data with parity checks and a controlled cutover, and making sure a privacy request is verifiably carried out everywhere the data lives. * **Make the team independent.** Review designs, mentor engineers and hand over critical workflows with tested recovery. * **Partner with our Head of Data Platform** on architecture and priorities. **WHAT YOU HAVE** ----------------- * Proven ownership of a production data platform handling large, heterogeneous datasets, from design through ongoing operation. * Hands\-on experience across ingestion, orchestration, storage and observability. Meaningful equity. Medical, dental and vision. **HOW TO APPLY** ---------------- Skip the cover letter. We'd rather pay people well than buy perks nobody uses. **PAY TRANSPARENCY** -------------------- The salary range in this posting is our good\-faith range for the role in New York City at the time of posting. Where an offer lands depends on the level and experience we see in the interview process. **APPLYING** ------------ Apply on this page. If you need an accommodation at any point in the process, write to hiring@minerva.io. **WORK AUTHORIZATION** ---------------------- You'll need to be authorized to work in the United States. jobs.title: Senior Engineer, Advanced Quality Planning
jobs.description: **Your Job** Join the Advanced Quality Planning team as a senior technical leader for next\-generation, high\-speed interconnect platforms. You will provide end\-to\-end quality leadership from Advanced Development through design qualification, supplier industrialization, process qualification, first\-off\-tool builds, production ramp, and handoff to mass production. This role is designed for an experienced engineer who can integrate product, process, supplier, measurement, and reliability risks across multiple products and global teams. The Senior Engineer, AQP serves as the platform quality lead and technical integrator. The role influences through expertise, governance, and cross\-functional alignment rather than direct people management. This role is not open to Visa sponsorship. Scope of Role: This position is based in the Lisle, Illinois office and requires on\-site presence five days per week to support close collaboration with engineering, manufacturing, and product development teams. You will collaborate with teams across North America and Asia. The role includes occasional early\-morning or evening meetings, generally two to three times per week, with flexible scheduling to help balance these commitments. Quarterly travel to Asia is part of the role, with trips typically lasting up to two weeks and focused on product launches, supplier development, and manufacturing readiness. **What You Will Do** * Provide end\-to\-end quality governance: Establish decision criteria and lead quality readiness reviews across Technology Readiness, Supplier Readiness, Product Design Readiness, Process Readiness, and FOT / launch readiness milestones. * Integrate risk across the platform: Maintain a consolidated view of requirements, critical\-to\-quality characteristics, NUDDs, DFMEA/PFMEA risks, DFM concerns, validation gaps, supplier capability, measurement readiness, and launch risks across product configurations. * Drive early technical risk reduction: Partner with Product Design Engineering, Signal Integrity, Process Engineering, Reliability, Product Management, and AQP engineers to define requirements and CTQs, component and process qualification plans, and proof\-of\-concept learning. * Strengthen design robustness: Guide tolerance analysis, corner\-case strategy, DVP\&R, reliability planning, failure\-mode closure, qualification evidence, and design\-to\-process traceability before release. * Connect suppliers and manufacturing: Align supplier feasibility, component qualification, tooling and process risks, measurement methods, capability evidence, process controls, and safe\-launch expectations with the overall platform risk profile. * Lead complex problem solving: Provide technical direction for cross\-functional failure analysis, 8D, root\-cause investigations, risk\-based containment, corrective action, and escalation of systemic issues. * Create continuity through handoffs: Define clear deliverables, owners, entry/exit criteria, and evidence for handoffs among Design AQP, Advanced Supplier Quality, Manufacturing AQP, Manufacturing Quality, Product Engineering, Operations, and Customer Quality. * Build scalable capability: Standardize work packages, templates, decision logic, lessons learned, and reusable quality methods across components, products, suppliers, and sites. * Influence executive decisions: Convert complex technical and quality information into concise risk assessments, options, and recommendations for engineering and business leaders. * Mentor and elevate the team: Coach AQP and cross\-functional engineers in risk\-based thinking, APQP methods, requirements flow\-down, validation strategy, statistical methods, and launch readiness. **Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)** * Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing or Industrial engineering * Legal authorization to work in the U.S. without sponsorship now or in the future * Willingness and ability to travel to Asia once per quarter for trips lasting up to two\-weeks * Minimum of 4 years of combined experience in quality engineering, product development, manufacturing engineering, reliability, supplier quality, or New Product Introduction * Experience leading quality planning or technical risk management across multiple products, subsystems, suppliers, or manufacturing sites * Working knowledge of APQP, requirements and CTQ flow\-down, DFMEA, PFMEA, control plans, DVP\&R, qualification planning, safe launch, and launch\-readiness methods * Technical proficiency in GD\&T, tolerance analysis, metrology, Measurement Systems Analysis, Gauge R\&R, process capability, statistical analysis, and structured problem solving **What Will Put You Ahead** * Experience with high\-speed interconnects, cable assemblies, optical or copper systems, precision components or electronics * ASQ Certified Quality Engineer, Six Sigma Black Belt or comparable technical certification For this role, we anticipate paying $120,000 \- $130,000 per year. This role is eligible for variable pay, issued as a monetary bonus or in another form. At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy. **Hiring Philosophy** All Koch companies value diversity of thought, perspectives, aptitudes, experiences, and backgrounds. We are Military Ready and Second Chance employers. Learn more about our hiring philosophy here . **Who We Are** As a Koch company, Molex is a leading supplier of connectors and interconnect components, driving innovation in electronics and supporting industries from automotive to health care and consumer to data communications. The thousands of innovators who work for Molex have made us a global electronics leader. Our experienced people, groundbreaking products and leading\-edge technologies help us deliver a wider array of solutions to more markets than ever before. At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company. **Our Benefits** Our goal is for each employee, and their families, to live fulfilling and healthy lives. We provide essential resources and support to build and maintain physical, financial, and emotional strength \- focusing on overall wellbeing so you can focus on what matters most. Our benefits plan includes \- medical, dental, vision, flexible spending and health savings accounts, life insurance, ADD, disability, retirement, paid vacation/time off, educational assistance, and may also include infertility assistance, paid parental leave and adoption assistance. Specific eligibility criteria is set by the applicable Summary Plan Description, policy or guideline and benefits may vary by geographic region. If you have questions on what benefits apply to you, please speak to your recruiter. Additionally, everyone has individual work and personal needs. We seek to enable the best work environment that helps you and the business work together to produce superior results. **Equal Opportunities** Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status. Except where prohibited by state law, some offers of employment are conditioned upon successfully passing a drug test. This employer uses E\-Verify. Please click here for additional information. You have experience building reliable, scalable services and are comfortable working across the stack, from data modeling and API design to deployment and operations. You care about great user experience, but your strength is delivering well\-engineered systems end to end. You are comfortable integrating APIs and services, both local and cloud\-based, and you'll work with tools such as Python, FastAPI, TypeScript, React, Snowflake, dbt, AWS (ECS Fargate, Lambda, S3\), and AWS CDK. You also have experience adopting AI across the software development lifecycle, including AI\-assisted coding, spec\-driven development, and automated testing and review, and you have hands\-on experience designing and building agentic workflows that automate real operational tasks. Together with the engineering team, product managers, and designers, you will build new and impactful experiences for our customers. **PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:** * **Technical ownership:** Design the architecture for applications, integrations, and data flows. Participate in design and code reviews, follow and contribute to engineering standards, and balance delivery speed against reliability, maintainability, and cost. Provide technical input to roadmap planning. * **Delivery and operations:** Translate operational requirements into clear specifications and designs. Ensure production systems are monitored, supportable, and well documented, with defined incident response and on\-call practices. Own testing, CI/CD, and release practices for your systems, and maintain cloud infrastructure, security, access patterns, and infrastructure as code. Experience in regulated or validated environments is a plus. * **Collaboration:** Partner with data scientists and analysts to productionize models, forecasts, and reports. Work with operations, automation, IT, and quality stakeholders on integrations with systems such as ticketing, data warehouses, and specialized equipment software. Communicate tradeoffs, risks, and progress clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences. * **AI and innovation:** Design and build AI agents that automate operational workflows. Apply AI throughout the development lifecycle, including AI\-assisted coding, spec\-driven development, and agentic engineering practices. Evaluate emerging tools and frameworks, and help define guardrails for safe and effective use, including data privacy. **QUALIFICATIONS:** * 7\+ years of overall software development experience, preferably secure, scalable web applications with frontend and backend web technologies **KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:** **Backend and APIs** * Experience with Python and modern backend frameworks, especially FastAPI (with Pydantic and Uvicorn) * Experience designing and building RESTful APIs * Experience with microservice architectures, cross\-platform integration, and building scalable applications in heterogeneous environments **Data** * Strong relational database skills, including database design and optimization, with SQL databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and cloud data platforms * Experience with data warehousing and analytics, especially Snowflake and dbt **Frontend** * Experience with React and TypeScript, ideally with Material UI and Vite * Experience with identity and integration platforms such as Okta (SSO) **Cloud and infrastructure** * Experience with cloud providers, with AWS preferred * Experience with AWS services such as ECS (Fargate), Lambda, Step Functions, S3, SQS/SNS, CloudFront, ECR, EFS, and Secrets Manager * Experience with infrastructure as code using AWS CDK (TypeScript) * Experience with Docker and container\-oriented technologies **Software development lifecycle and quality** * Experience with the full software development lifecycle, including build, configuration management, change control, release, and deployment * Experience with CI/CD, specifically GitLab CI * Experience with automated testing using pytest, Vitest, and Playwright * Quality assurance mindset; familiarity with regulated environments is a plus **Professional skills** * Demonstrated teamwork and a solid analytical background * Excellent organizational, communication, presentation, and facilitation skills **OUR OPPORTUNITY** Natera™ is a global leader in cell\-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women's health, and organ health. When you join Natera, you'll work hard and grow quickly. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program! jobs.title: Staff Engineer, AI Engineering Products
jobs.description: WORK OPTION: Remote \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ **Position Summary** The National Basketball Association (NBA) is seeking a hands\-on Staff Engineer, AI Engineering Practices to own AI practices across Software Engineering and Program Delivery. Reporting to the Vice President, Software Engineering \& Program Delivery, this role is the single owner accountable for AI engineering standards, tool governance and the AI\-native product development lifecycle (AI\-DLC), and for scaling AI\-enabled practices across engineering teams and technical program managers (TPMs). AI transformation is an organizational priority area, but today it relies on leaders who already run people and project delivery, which limits how fast the organization can transform. Adoption is fragmented across teams and dependent on individual leaders. The Staff Engineer will change that by building practices that are repeatable, governed and measured: tool\-agnostic standards for agentic coding and spec\-driven development, reusable agentic pipelines and context engineering frameworks, and structured evaluations of new tools. This is a practitioner role. The Director builds hands\-on, works credibly with both engineers and program managers, and brings the same AI capability to TPMs for planning, forecasting, status reporting and risk management. Early priorities are standard AI engineering frameworks for GitHub Copilot, Claude Code and Atlassian Rovo, and an AI\-DLC engineering workflow. **Major Responsibilities** **AI Engineering Standards and Tool Governance** ------------------------------------------------ * Own AI engineering standards and tool governance across Software Engineering and Program Delivery, replacing fragmented, leader\-dependent adoption with one accountable approach. * Set tool\-agnostic standards for agentic coding and spec\-driven development. * Deliver standard AI engineering frameworks for GitHub Copilot, Claude Code and Atlassian Rovo as a first priority. Keep the development lifecycle tool\-agnostic across Claude Code, GitHub Copilot and Codex, so that practices do not depend on any single tool. * **AI\-Native Development Lifecycle (AI\-DLC)** ---------------------------------------------- * Own the AI\-native PDLC / AI\-DLC for Software Engineering and Program Delivery. * Design and roll out an AI\-DLC engineering workflow as a priority roadmap item. Create a repeatable, governed and measurable operating capability behind the workflow, so that it does not depend on individual leaders. * **Agentic Pipelines, Frameworks and Automation** ------------------------------------------------ * Build reusable agentic pipelines hands\-on, as a practitioner. * Build context and harness engineering frameworks that engineering teams can adopt and reuse. Build AI\-enabled automations that reduce administrative overhead across engineering and program delivery. * **Tool Evaluation and Measurement** ----------------------------------- * Run structured evaluations of new AI tools and make the adopt / hold / drop decision. * Track and report the share of developers and TPMs actively using AI capabilities. * Report AI token cost and headcount cost per project. Measure and report improvement in delivery velocity, software quality and administrative overhead. * **Enablement for Engineering Teams and TPMs** --------------------------------------------- * Enable engineering teams and TPMs on AI adoption, patterns and practice. * Bring AI\-enabled planning, forecasting, status reporting and risk management to Program Delivery value streams. Serve as the credible bridge between engineers and program managers on how AI changes the way work is planned, built and reported. * **Required Education and Professional Experience** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * Background as a senior engineer or engineering leader, with 8 years of relevant experience. * Demonstrated hands\-on experience running agentic tooling in production. Practical experience with AI engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Codex and Atlassian Rovo. * **Knowledge, Skills and Abilities** * Hands\-on practitioner who builds as well as directs: agentic pipelines, context and harness engineering, and AI\-enabled automation. * Working command of agentic coding and spec\-driven development practices. * Ability to design structured tool evaluations and make clear adopt / hold / drop decisions. * Ability to set standards and governance that are repeatable and measured, without locking the organization into a single tool. * Credibility with both engineers and program managers. * Ability to translate AI capability into practical planning, forecasting, status reporting and risk management for TPMs. Comfort reporting adoption, cost and delivery outcomes in plain terms, including AI token cost and headcount cost per project. * **Salary Range:** $240,000\-$260,000 **Job Posting Title:** Senior Director Employees currently are eligible to receive an annual discretionary performance bonus, awarded at the sole discretion of the Company and subject to any terms and conditions set by the Company. Employees and/or eligible dependents may be eligible to participate in the following Company\-sponsored employee benefit programs: medical; dental; vision; life/AD\&D insurance; short\- and long\-term disability; fertility and family\-forming assistance; wellbeing allowance; educational assistance; mental health coaching/therapy; tax advantaged accounts such as HSA and healthcare/dependent care FSAs; a 401(k) retirement plan; and time off benefits that include vacation, sick time, and personal days. We Consider Applicants For All Positions On The Basis Of Merit, Qualifications And Business Needs, And Without Regard To Race, Color, National Origin, Religion, Sex, Gender Identity, Age, Disability, Alienage Or Citizenship Status, Ancestry, Marital Status, Creed, Genetic Predisposition Or Carrier Status, Sexual Orientation, Veteran Status, Familial Status, Status As A Victim Of Domestic Violence Or Any Other Status Or Characteristic Protected By Applicable Federal, State, Or Local Law. **About the NBA** The National Basketball Association (NBA) is a global sports and media organization with the mission to inspire and connect people everywhere through the power of basketball. Built around five professional sports leagues: the NBA, WNBA, NBA G League, NBA 2K League and Basketball Africa League, the NBA has established a major international presence with games and programming available in 214 countries and territories in more than 50 languages, and merchandise for sale in more than 200 countries and territories on all seven continents. NBA rosters at the start of the 2026\-27 season featured 125 international players from a record\-tying 43 countries across six continents. The NBA's digital assets include NBA TV, NBA.com, the NBA App and NBA League Pass. The NBA has created one of the largest social media communities in the world, with more than 2\.5 billion likes and followers globally across all leagues, team and player platforms. The NBA's Tap to Watch provides seamless access to local, national and global live game telecasts via the NBA App, NBA.com, third\-party digital platforms and NBA partner platforms. NBA Cares, the NBA's global social impact platform, drives change on issues facing fans and communities in the areas of health and wellness, civic engagement, social justice and inclusion, and sustainability.

jobs.description: **About Net Health** **Belong. Thrive. Make a Difference.** Are you looking for a meaningful and satisfying career where you have endless opportunities to grow and be financially rewarded? Net Health may be the perfect place for you. A high\-growth and profitable company, we help caregivers harness data for human health. We also honor and respect the needs of our Net Health family and staff, which is why we offer a work\-from\-anywhere environment and unlimited PTO. Our welcoming and collaborative culture paired with progressive benefits makes Net Health the ultimate career home! As a leading\-edge SaaS company in healthcare, we deliver solutions that help patients get better, faster, and live more fulfilling lives. Our software and predictive analytics cover the continuum of care, from hospital\-to\-home, across various medical specialties. Come join us and start the next chapter of your exciting career while helping others to live better lives. **World\-Class Benefits That Reflect Our World\-Class Culture.** **Click Here to Learn More!:** \#WorkFromAnywhere \#UnlimitedPTO \#ComprehensiveBenefitsPackage \#EmployeeResourceGroups \#CasualDressCode \#PrioritizedEmployeeWellness \#DiversityAndInclusion \#AVoice \#NewHireSupport \#CareerDevelopment \#EducationalAssistance \#EmployeeReferralBonus \#ProgressiveParentalLeave **JOB OVERVIEW** Lead and support state Medicaid transformation initiatives, with an emphasis on value\-based payment (VBP), delivery system and payment reform, quality The Network Engineer is a hands\-on technical role responsible for designing, building, and operating a secure, highly available network that connects Net Health's data centers, Azure and AWS cloud environments, offices, and pathways for customer integrations. Reporting to Platform Engineering, this role owns the day\-to\-day health of switching, routing, firewall, VPN, and cloud networking; codifies network configuration and change; and partners closely with DevOps, Security, and SRE to keep healthcare workloads fast, segmented, and compliant. You'll troubleshoot complex connectivity issues end\-to\-end, support data center modernization and cloud migration efforts, and contribute to network standards, without formal people management responsibilities. **RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES** * **Network Design \& Engineering** + Design, implement, and maintain LAN/WAN and data center networks, including leaf/spine and top\-of\-rack switching, VLANs, VRFs, link aggregation, and dynamic routing (BGP, OSPF). + Plan and execute hardware lifecycle work, including switch and optics selection, rack and airflow planning, firmware upgrades, and vendor RMA coordination. + Own IP address management, DHCP, and NTP standards across on\-premises and cloud environments. * **Cloud \& Hybrid Connectivity** + Design and operate Azure network foundations (hub/spoke VNets, peering, user\-defined routes, NSGs, Private Link/Private Endpoints, Azure Firewall, Application Gateway/WAF, Front Door, Traffic Manager). + Engineer and support redundant hybrid connectivity, including site\-to\-site VPN and ExpressRoute, plus AWS equivalents such as Transit Gateway and Direct Connect. + Support data center consolidation and cloud migrations by planning cutovers, IP readdressing, rollback paths and assisting with DNS changes. * **Network Security** + Administer next\-generation firewalls, network segmentation policy, and remote access VPN; review and implement rule changes using least privilege principles. + Partner with Security to remediate findings (e.g., exposed management ports, overly permissive firewall/NSG rules) and support vulnerability scans, penetration tests, and audits. + Maintain network controls and audit evidence aligned with frameworks (e.g., SOC2, HIPAA). * **Automation \& Change Management** + Work with the DevOps Central team to codify cloud network infrastructure with Terraform and contribute reusable, versioned modules to the internal platform catalog. + Automate configuration backups, compliance checks, and routine changes using Python, PowerShell, Ansible, or equivalent; replace manual one\-off configuration with repeatable processes. + Plan and execute network changes through the Change Advisory Board (CAB) process with documented implementation, validation, and rollback steps. * **Monitoring, Operations \& Incident Response** + Implement and tune network monitoring and alerting (e.g., New Relic, Azure Network Watcher, Connection Monitor, flow logs, SNMP/syslog) to detect issues before customers do. + Serve as the escalation point for connectivity, latency, packet loss, and DNS issues; perform root cause analysis using packet captures and flow data. + Participate in a shared on\-call rotation and contribute to post\-incident reviews and corrective actions. * **Capacity Management** + Track circuit, bandwidth, and cloud networking usage (data egress, gateways, firewalls, load balancers, Private Endpoints) to identify constraints and recommend remediations or optimizations. + Forecast capacity for circuits, ports, and address space; build business cases for hardware and service procurement. * **Documentation \& Knowledge Management** + Maintain accurate network diagrams, IP plans, circuit inventories, runbooks, and standards; keep them current and searchable. + Mentor DevOps and support teammates on networking fundamentals and troubleshooting practices. **QUALIFICATIONS** * Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, related field or 6\+ years of combined relevant experience * 5\+ years hands\-on network engineering in enterprise, data center, or SaaS environments * Strong routing and switching fundamentals (TCP/IP, subnetting, VLANs, STP, LACP, BGP, OSPF) * 2\+ years designing and supporting Azure networking (VNets, peering, UDRs, NSGs, Private Endpoints, VPN/ExpressRoute gateways); AWS networking experience a plus * Hands\-on experience administering enterprise firewall and VPN platforms * Working knowledge of load balancing, DNS (public and private zones), and TLS/certificate management * Infrastructure\-as\-code and scripting experience (Terraform; Python and/or PowerShell) * Experience operating in regulated, compliance\-driven environments (e.g., SOC2, HIPAA, ISO27001\) * Strong troubleshooting skills using packet capture and flow analysis tools **REQUIRED SOFTWARE EXPERIENCE** * Azure Portal * Azure CLI * Terraform * Enterprise firewall management platform (e.g., Palo Alto Panorama, FortiManager) * Wireshark / tcpdump * New Relic **Note: This job description is not intended to be all\-inclusive. Employee may perform other related duties as requested to meet the ongoing needs of the organization.** **Salary Range: $116,000\.00 \- $145,000\.00 USD** **Candidate Integrity \& Monitoring Notice:** We maintain a zero\-tolerance policy for using AI tools, deepfakes, or impersonation to misrepresent a candidate's identity, skills, or qualifications during hiring. We use screening and identity verification methods to detect this and reserve the right to disqualify and report violations. Company\-issued equipment, systems, and network activity are monitored for security and compliance purposes; details are provided during interviews and in our employee policies. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: AI Forward Engineer 3 (Temporary)
jobs.description: Networking Technologies \+ Support (NTS) is seeking an experienced **AI Forward Deployed Engineer** to support the design, development, integration, modernization, and operational improvement of secure, reliable, scalable, and cost\-effective Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions. The ideal candidate will serve as a hands\-on technical resource, partnering with business stakeholders, engineering teams, and solution architects to translate complex business challenges into practical AI\-powered solutions. This position will focus on developing, enhancing, and supporting enterprise AI applications, including production chatbots, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions, intelligent automation workflows, and agentic AI applications. The successful candidate will bring strong software engineering capabilities, hands\-on experience with generative AI technologies, and the ability to evaluate emerging tools and translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Design, develop, integrate, and enhance enterprise AI applications and solutions. * Build and support production chatbots, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) applications, and intelligent automation workflows. * Develop and implement practices for resource tagging, cost allocation, utilization monitoring, budget visibility, model consumption, API usage, and cost optimization. * Participate in AI discovery sessions, requirements validation, technical workshops, and design sprints to identify business challenges and recommend practical AI solutions. * Collaborate with solution architects and engineering teams to assess technical feasibility, develop solution designs, and define nonfunctional requirements (NFRs). * Design, develop, and evaluate agentic AI workflows, including AI agents, multi\-step automation, orchestration, and secure enterprise integrations. * Evaluate agent\-based solutions against traditional automation approaches, considering security, human oversight, reliability, scalability, and operational costs. * Monitor application performance, resource utilization, service consumption, and associated operating expenses. * Research and evaluate emerging AI technologies, tools, and services through focused, time\-bound proofs of concept (POCs). * Establish measurable objectives, success criteria, cost estimates, and documented outcomes for technical POCs. * Provide recommendations for technology adoption, further evaluation, or discontinuation based on business value, technical feasibility, security, and time\-to\-market considerations. * Develop technical toolkits, architecture diagrams, implementation guides, and technical documentation. * Share technical best practices through demonstrations, knowledge\-sharing sessions, and stakeholder collaboration. **Minimum Qualifications** -------------------------- * Considerable experience designing, developing, integrating, and supporting AI initiatives. * Strong application development experience using Python, REST APIs, and cloud\-based integration technologies. * Hands\-on experience designing or implementing AI and Generative AI solutions, including Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), conversational AI, or comparable AI application architectures. * Experience working with AWS, Microsoft Azure, or comparable cloud\-based AI platforms and services. * Experience evaluating technical requirements and contributing to AI solution architecture and design. * Experience monitoring resource utilization, service consumption, application performance, and associated operating costs. * Understanding of AI model consumption, token economics, and cost optimization. * Experience evaluating emerging technologies, conducting technical proofs of concept, and translating business requirements into practical engineering recommendations. * Strong communication and documentation skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders. * Demonstrated ability to collaborate across engineering, architecture, and business teams. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience developing or integrating AI solutions using Microsoft Azure services, Azure OpenAI, Azure Functions, or comparable technologies. * Experience designing and implementing agentic AI workflows, AI agents, tool orchestration, multi\-step automation, or agent\-based application architectures. * Familiarity with modern data platforms and architectures, including Databricks, Delta Lake, Medallion Architecture, and enterprise Lakehouse concepts. * Experience with vector databases, semantic search, embedding models, and vector indexing. * Experience integrating AI applications with enterprise systems, APIs, and data platforms. * Familiarity with AI governance, security, responsible AI practices, and enterprise data protection. * Experience developing scalable, production\-ready AI solutions in cloud environments. **Ideal Candidate Profile** --------------------------- The ideal candidate is a hands\-on AI engineer who can operate at the intersection of software engineering, AI innovation, cloud architecture, and business problem\-solving. They should be comfortable working through ambiguity, evaluating emerging technologies, developing practical solutions, and taking AI initiatives from concept through production deployment. **NTS is looking for someone who can turn emerging AI capabilities into secure, scalable, and measurable business solutions.**

jobs.title: GVP, AI Applications & Technology
jobs.description: At New Relic, we shape the future of intelligent observability, building technology that helps companies understand and optimize their complex systems. We are a collaborative, global team that values curiosity, mutual support, and solving hard technical challenges together. As we grow, we are looking for thoughtful problem\-solvers ready to make a real impact. That open, forward\-thinking approach extends to how we hire. We actively work with modern AI tools every day and support candidates using them to prepare for interviews. To keep our process authentic and fair, please review our Candidate AI Interview Guide to see our general guidelines, including where AI is encouraged and what practices are prohibited before you apply. **Your opportunity** The Group Vice President of AI Applications \& Technology, reporting into the Chief Technology Officer, is a pivotal executive leader responsible for developing and executing the strategic vision for next\-generation enterprise AI products, systems and platform architectures. This is a foundational builder role, and engineering executive who will be both employing existing AI models as well as building core AI capabilities. You will lead the research, pre\-training/post\-training, customization, and deployment of proprietary models, specialized base architectures, and autonomous agent\-driven skills.You will lead a world\-class team spanning AI engineering, data engineering, and applied research. **What you'll do** * Select and leverage existing AI models as appropriate from a performance and cost perspective to build agentic capabilities for New Relic’s broad observability and remediation capabilities * Develop a model strategy that recognizes the speed of evolution of this important technology and adapts quickly to leverage new technology as it rapidly becomes available * Architect and operationalize high\-performance, agentic\-driven (AE) skills that leverage our custom models for multi\-step reasoning, autonomous planning, and real\-time execution. * Architect, train, and deliver our core base models optimized for our domain workflows, serving as the foundational engine for company\-wide AI applications. * Design and optimize autonomous agentic skills powered by our custom models, ensuring high reasoning capability, tool\-execution fidelity, low latency, and efficient compute cost. * Lead, scale, and mentor a high\-performing organization of AI engineering leaders,data platform engineers, and machine learning engineers and architects. * Foster a culture of technical rigor, scientific experimentation, rapid prototyping,and production\-grade software delivery. * Partner closely with peer executive leaders across the organization to embed AI capabilities into core customer offerings. * Partner with executive peers (People, Finance, Operations, Product) to democratize agentic capabilities internally, championing the transition from passive AI consumption (chatbots) to autonomous, agentic\-first workflow design across the company. * Establish the internal sandbox infrastructure, API/MCP connection schemes, and enterprise agent marketplaces that allow non\-engineering teams to securely build, share, and scale operational agents. * Design agent frameworks that incorporate practical human\-in\-the\-loop gating, multi\-tiered permissioning (read vs. state\-changing write actions), self\-correction, and drift monitoring. * Champion an organizational culture that solves operational bottlenecks through autonomous systems and workflow redesign rather than linear headcount expansion. **This role requires** * 15\+ years of technology leadership experience, with 10\+ years leading teams, and 5\+ years in executive capacity (VP or equivalent) overseeing AI, Machine Learning, or advanced data platform organizations at scale. * Deep expertise with large\-scale distributed systems * Proven track record not merely managing AI as an assistive copilot, but designing end\-to\-end autonomous loops that decouple business throughput from headcount. * Ability to walk through live, production\-grade agentic artifacts they have designed or sponsored\- including prompt architectures, API/tool\-calling schemas, failure handling, and iterative fixes. * Hands\-on experience development autonomous multi\-agent systems, tool\-use execution paradigms, agentic memory frameworks, and protocols. * Deep understanding of enterprise governance frameworks, balancing autonomous retrieval and reasoning with auditable, human\-in\-the\-loop approval thresholds for high\-stakes business actions. * Experience establishing internal AI guilds, hackathons/sprints, or modular workflow marketplaces that elevate workforce technical fluency from passive tooling to applied automation. * Comprehensive understanding of transformer architectures, attention mechanisms, loss formulations, synthetic data generation, and post\-training alignment * Proven ability to translate ambiguous, cutting edge AI breakthroughs into production ready software products that drive business value and technological differentiation. * Outstanding communication and influence skills, and ability to communicate complex model architectures and technical roadmaps to C\-level executives, board members, customers and other cross\-functional leaders. **Bonus points if you have** * Advanced degree (Master’s or Ph.D.) in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative discipline. * Observability experience Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position. \#LI\-*TK1* \#LI\-*Remote* The pay range below represents a reasonable estimate of the salary for the listed position. Pay within this range varies by work location and may also depend on job\-related factors such as an applicant’s skills, qualifications, and experience. New Relic provides a variety of benefits for this role, including healthcare, dental, vision, parental leave and planning, and mental health benefits, a 401(k) plan and match, flex time\-off, 11 paid holidays, volunteer time\-off, and other competitive benefits designed to improve the lives of our employees. Estimated Base Pay Range $338,000 \- $420,000 USD Fostering a diverse, welcoming and inclusive environment is important to us. We work hard to make everyone feel comfortable bringing their best, most authentic selves to work every day. Their experiences and perspectives inspire us to make our products and company the best they can be. We’re looking for people who feel connected to our mission and values, not just candidates who check off all the boxes. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application or recruiting process, please reach out to resume@newrelic.com. We believe in empowering all Relics to achieve professional and business success through a flexible workforce model. jobs.title: Principal Product Development Engineer
jobs.description: **Job ID:** 19873 **Alternate Locations:** **Newell Brands** is a leading consumer products company with a portfolio of iconic brands like Graco®, Coleman®, Oster®, Rubbermaid®, Sharpie® and Yankee Candle® \- and 24,000 talented teammates around the world. Our culture is built on values in action: Integrity, Teamwork, Passion for Winning, Ownership, and Leadership. We work together to win, grow, and make a real impact—supported by a high\-performing, inclusive, and collaborative environment where you can be your best, every day. **The opportunity** =================== Graco Children’s Products is seeking a Principal Product Development Engineer to lead the engineering of new and existing juvenile products for Graco Home. You will own the technical execution of assigned products from concept through production launch, translating consumer needs into measurable requirements and delivering those products to agreed safety, quality, performance, cost, and timing targets. This is a principal\-level individual contributor role with no direct reports. You will lead the engineering work across mechanical, electronics, and supplier teams, partnering with Brand Marketing, Industrial Design, Program Management, Quality, Regulatory, Manufacturing, and Supply Chain. The work includes hands\-on mechanical engineering and integration of electromechanical systems such as powered motion and drive mechanisms. **What you will do** ==================== **Product and program leadership** ---------------------------------- * Own the engineering plan, deliverables, and technical readiness for assigned new product development programs under the Newell Brands Product Development Process. * Evaluate tradeoffs in product performance, quality, cost, margin, and schedule. Recommend a path forward to engineering and cross\-functional leadership. * Build and maintain the engineering timing and action plan with Program Management. Identify dependencies, resource needs, and technical risks early, and drive mitigation and issue closure. * Lead technical reviews and present the requirements, test results, open risks, and recommendations that cross\-functional leaders need to make gate decisions. **Product engineering and validation** -------------------------------------- * Recommend product architecture and define the interfaces among mechanical assemblies, electronics, controls, and other subsystems so they perform as intended in the finished product. * Lead development on both Graco\-engineered and supplier\-engineered programs. Define engineering deliverables and acceptance criteria, review designs and test evidence, and drive closure of technical issues. * Evaluate and integrate technologies that meet product needs, including electromechanical power transmission and motion control. Use prototypes and test data to guide technical decisions. * Partner with Quality and Regulatory to incorporate applicable safety, compliance, and reliability requirements into product specifications and test plans. * Create and review CAD models, drawings, tolerance analyses, and interface definitions as needed. Lead engineering release and change control for specifications, bills of materials, and other product documentation. * Lead the product verification and validation plan from prototypes through production builds. Resolve failures through root\-cause analysis, corrective action, and retesting. * Work with Manufacturing, Quality, and suppliers on design for manufacture and assembly, tooling readiness, pilot builds, and production qualification. Recommend launch readiness based on test and build evidence. * Identify and recommend invention and ideation submissions to Intellectual Property counsel to build a defensible competitive advantage. **Cross\-functional influence** ------------------------------- * Serve as a company subject\-matter expert, providing creative solutions to business\-critical challenges and roadblocks across organizational, cultural, and geographic boundaries. * Translate consumer insights and business needs into measurable product and system specifications. Align with Brand, Industrial Design, and Quality on critical\-to\-quality requirements and verification methods. * Coordinate work across the engineers and suppliers responsible for each subsystem. Communicate technical status, decisions needed, and mitigation plans to program and engineering leaders. * Partner with cross\-functional teams and global suppliers on new products, product derivatives, cost improvements, and post\-launch engineering issues. * Challenge prevailing viewpoints when appropriate, communicate complex technical concepts in clear language, negotiate cross\-functional tradeoffs, and present opportunities in forums that promote ideation and technical sharing. * Set engineering standards and reusable design practices while coaching engineers through technical feedback, design critique, and hands\-on problem solving. **What you bring** ================== * Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering. * 10\+ years of product\-development experience, including a proven record of driving successful durable\-consumer\-goods launches on time, on cost, on budget, and to specification. * Hands\-on proficiency in 3D CAD for parts and assemblies and in reviewing engineering drawings. Creo experience is preferred. * Deep knowledge of GD\&T, tolerance stack\-up, fits, materials, manufacturing processes, and the design of complex mechanical assemblies. * Demonstrated experience developing products that integrate electronics, motors, sensors, wiring, controls, power transmission, motion control, or other electromechanical systems. * Expert problem\-solving skills, including root\-cause analysis, corrective action, and verification that the corrective action resolves the issue. * Experience turning product requirements into verification and validation plans, using prototypes, test results, and production builds to make engineering decisions. * Experience with intellectual property, invention disclosures, patents, and collaboration with IP counsel. * Experience leading cross\-functional engineering work and partnering with domestic and global suppliers from development through production qualification. * Strong working knowledge of PLM/PDM systems, specifications, BOMs, ECO/ECN workflows, and production documentation. * Effective planning and organizational skills, including the ability to manage multiple priorities, risks, schedules, and technical deliverables. * Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills, with a record of leading through influence and aligning diverse stakeholders on difficult technical decisions. * Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, Project, and PowerPoint. **Preferred qualifications** ============================ * Advanced degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related technical discipline. * Experience developing juvenile products or other regulated consumer goods. * Expertise in one or more relevant specialties, such as mechanisms, structural analysis, thermal management, fluids, acoustics, shock and vibration, or precision systems. * Experience with reliability engineering, FMEA, statistical methods, Design for Six Sigma, cost optimization, or high\-volume manufacturing. **How success will be measured** ================================ * Programs launch on time and on budget, meeting agreed product cost, safety, quality, performance, and technical requirements. * Product and platform decisions improve consumer value, reliability, manufacturability, sustainability, margin, and long\-term design consistency. * Technical risks are identified early, and verification, validation, and build results support engineering readiness decisions. * New technologies, intellectual property, and reusable engineering practices create measurable category and enterprise value. * Suppliers and cross\-functional teams meet agreed engineering deliverables and close critical issues before launch. **Working conditions** ====================== This role requires hands\-on work in laboratories, prototype shops, supplier facilities, and manufacturing environments. Some domestic and international travel may be required. Newell Brands (NASDAQ: NWL) is a leading global consumer goods company with a strong portfolio of well\-known brands, including Rubbermaid, Sharpie, Graco, Coleman, Rubbermaid Commercial Products, Yankee Candle, Paper Mate, FoodSaver, Dymo, EXPO, Elmer’s, Oster, NUK, Spontex and Campingaz. We are focused on delighting consumers by lighting up everyday moments. Newell Brands is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. jobs.title: ML Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Opportunity** **About the Institute** Do you want to be part of an exciting new Institute focused on combining human and machine intelligence into working AI solutions? We are building a pioneering research and innovation hub in AI—one that will shape the way humans and machines collaborate for decades to come. Led by Prof. Samuel V. Scarpino, the Institute for Experiential AI is built around the challenges and opportunities made possible by human\-machine collaboration. The Institute provides a framework to design, implement, and scale AI\-driven technologies in ways that make a true difference to society. Our ability to respond to the opportunities afforded to society will depend on training and building a workforce that is AI\-capable and prosperous. Founded in 1898, Northeastern is a global research university and the recognized leader in experience\-driven lifelong learning. Our world\-renowned experiential approach empowers our students, faculty, alumni, and partners to create impact far beyond the confines of discipline, degree, and campus. **The Culture** Here at the Institute for Experiential AI (EAI) we are committed to the highest standards in all we do. Working at the EAI offers opportunities, an environment, and a culture that just isn’t found together anywhere else. This is the right place for you if you’re curious, motivated by the future of technology, and want to be part of a unique and diverse community that works on high\-impact research, educational, business, and societal problems. **Position Summary** Northeastern University's Institute for Experiential AI is opening an ML engineer with special focus on physical AI systems, knowledge aggregation and AI for control and optimization for a DOE Genesis project led by Dr. Ayan Paul. The ML Engineer will be based at the Boston campus, MA, conduct applied research, prepare work for submission to journal/conference publications, and contribute to extramural funding applications. The ML Engineer will work on projects that will include developing AI models for signal processing. Participation in this project will include scientific programming, data analysis, training AI models, manuscript preparation, meeting with collaborators, mentoring graduate students, etc. About the project: CLARA (Cognitive Layered Agentic Reasoning for ARIS) is a three\-year, Genesis Mission Phase II project led by Northeastern University with MSU/FRIB and Gravitate AI. It will build an agentic AI system for operating the Advanced Rare Isotope Separator (ARIS) at FRIB. ARIS operations are limited by the gap between LISE\+\+ simulations and observed beam behavior. As a result, weekly beam development takes 16 to 24 hours, about half of which goes to manual isotope calibration. Planning a new experiment takes about 20 days, and no predictive monitoring exists for roughly 200 time\-correlated machine parameters. CLARA addresses this with three objectives: * **Planning and tuning.** Bayesian optimization uses LISE\+\+ as a physics\-informed prior, alongside paired forward and inverse neural surrogates trained on simulation and EPICS archive data. These power a Planning Agent for non\-experts and an Expert Tuning Agent. * **Calibration.** Diffeomorphic image registration maps simulated particle identification (PID) distributions to measured ones from a single measurement. * **Monitoring and knowledge.** Quickest Change Detection models (classical CuSum and a transformer\-based DeepQCD) and a hazardous\-configuration classifier make up a Safety Agent with gated beam\-interrupt authority. A Critic module commits validated tunes to a knowledge graph built with eGoT. The targets are reducing experiment planning time to 1 to 2 days, beam development time to about 4 hours, and thus facilitating 500 to 800 extra beam hours per year. The project aims to advance from TRL 3 to TRL 6–7 and to validate transfer to at least one non\-ARIS separator. The ML Engineer hired for this position will work with Benjamin Gyori at Khoury College, Deniz Erdogmus at the College of Engineering, and Ayan Paul at EAI and is expected to develop AI algorithms, RAG pipelines and agentic systems for the Genesis project, collaborate with the FRIB experiment at the Michigan State University and Gravitate AI. Qualifications * MS in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, or related fields or currently enrolled in a master’s program. * A minimum of 3\-4 years of experience working with ML/AI (TensorFlow/Pytorch) and ETL pipelines. * Proficiency in Python and R. Experienced with Unix and remote computing clusters. * Having experience in wrangling large datasets, building databases and ETL is preferred. * An ability to write clean and well\-documented code and work with GitHub repositories. * Experience in signal processing in the spaciotemporal domain. * Excellent organizational skills including attention to detail and multitasking. * An ability to troubleshoot and problem\-solve in response to challenges, especially, in an iar domain. Experience with AWS is a plus but not required. Experience with high performance computing is preferred. * Values \& Abilities: * Excellent written and verbal communication skills and ability to communicate effectively with a variety of different stakeholders from various academic backgrounds. * Respect for diversity and the importance of interdisciplinary teams. * Self\-starter and innovative thinker and a team\-player who can collaborate effectively in a university setting. Open\-minded, assertive, and professional when collaborating and working within our team and with other groups within Northeastern University, Harvard Medical School, and University of Virginia. * Key Responsibilities: The Data Science and Machine Learning Engineer will be responsible for a wide variety of data\-oriented tasks, including: * Building data preprocessing pipelines for ML/AI models (TensorFlow/Pytorch) for data from ARIS. * Training machine learning models for signal processing * Documenting the entire process and all the codes generated and maintaining structured and regular commits in a Github repository. * Write reports/prepare slide decks describing work performed. * Contribute to scientific manuscripts and grant proposals where appropriate. **Position Type** Temporary **Additional Information** Northeastern University considers factors such as candidate work experience, education and skills when extending an offer. Northeastern has a comprehensive benefits package for benefit eligible employees. This includes medical, vision, dental, paid time off, tuition assistance, wellness \& life, retirement\- as well as commuting \& transportation. Visit https://hr.northeastern.edu/benefits/ for more information. All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply and will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, age, sex, sexual orientation, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. This job is for a current or anticipated job vacancy. **Pay Rate:** $40/hour

jobs.title: Research Scientist
jobs.description: **About the Opportunity** **About the College of Arts, Media and Design** ----------------------------------------------- We are a vibrant community of creators, designers, technologists, and communicators applying creativity across disciplines and harnessing emerging technologies to advance human potential and solve the challenges of the future. Powered by experience\-driven teaching, learning and research, CAMD demonstrates that the fields of design, communication, media, and the arts are crucial to the human experience, society, and the development of technology. We empower the next generations of students, researchers, and creative practitioners to create the future by sparking their innovative, creative, curious, and entrepreneurial spirit. **Job Summary** --------------- **About the Opportunity** The Digital Civics Initiative in the College of Arts, Media and Design seeks a Research Scientist to serve as the technical lead for a new civic AI platform: a web\- and mobile\-based AI assistant, grounded in local data and local knowledge, that helps residents understand what is happening in their neighborhood and coordinate advocacy, mobilization, and collective action. This is a hands\-on, full\-stack position for someone who wants to build production\-quality software in a research setting. The Research Scientist will architect and implement the research testbed and prototype systems that address a wide range of civic and community data application contexts. In addition to own technical design and implementation for projects in the Digital Civics portfolio, the Research Scientist will also work directly with community partners and the research team, translating community needs and priorities into system requirements, architecture decisions, and reliable running software. The immediate priority for the role is backend design and implementation for a community\-facing AI assistant. We are looking for someone who can deliver a robust, well\-documented data and service layer that the wider team can build against, so that interface and interaction design can move quickly and experimentally on a stable foundation. **About the Digital Civics Initiative** The Digital Civics Initiative is an interdisciplinary platform at Northeastern dedicated to amplifying research concerned with understanding and reshaping the civic dimensions of digital technologies in contemporary life. We define digital civics as the study and practice of how technologies shape—and are shaped by—power, participation, care, and collective responsibility across social, political, and cultural systems. The Initiative brings together scholars, educators, activists, technologists, and artists whose work engages technology and education, labor and automation, governance and public institutions, surveillance and data justice, environmental sustainability, community organizing, and human\-centered approaches to machine learning and artificial intelligence. The research draws on participatory design and action research methods to work alongside community groups, advocates, and municipal partners, and foregrounds equity, accountability, and lived experience. Working systems and research findings across the portfolio of Digital Civics projects are both expected outputs, and the Research Scientist will be central to producing the former. **About the First Project** This position will initially support a project centered in Boston called On the Porch. The project is a collaboration with community advocates and residents of the Talbot\-Norfolk Triangle in South Dorchester, together with partners at Boston University’s Center for Media Innovation and Social Impact and the Boston Project Ministries. Earlier phases of the work produced a neighborhood\-scale chatbot and a set of co\-designed experimental interfaces—data dashboards, geospatial views, and directed chat—grounded in structured municipal data (311 service requests, 911 calls, traffic citations) alongside unstructured local material such as planning documents and transcripts of community meetings. The goal of this next phase is to turn those prototypes into a durable research product – a platform that gives residents access to the same data and analytic capacity as the city, and that supports community sensemaking, advocacy with data, and collaboration with local government. Additional research projects will be introduced in support of the wider Digital Civics Initiative as the project portfolio expands. **Areas of Technical Focus** Backend and data infrastructure (primary focus). Architect and build the ingestion, storage, and retrieval layer that grounds the assistant: * Structured urban data from public sources such as the City of Boston open data portal, along with regional, state, and partner\-supplied datasets, ingested on a schedule with versioning, provenance, and incremental update. * Unstructured textual data from community communication channels—neighborhood newsletters, local newspapers ch as Leaflet or Mapbox GL. * Familiarity with municipal data domains—311, permitting, assessing, zoning, code enforcement, transit—and with the practical quirks of civic data quality. * Experience with participatory design, co\-design, or user research methods, and with community\-based or action research. * Attention to accessibility and to multilingual interface support relevant to Boston neighborhoods. * Experience mentoring students or junior engineers. Prior work on grant\-funded research projects and interest in contributing to publications, technical reports, and public documentation of the work. * **Key Responsibilities \& Accountabilities** -------------------------------------------- Backend and data infrastructure. Architect, build, and maintain the ingestion, storage, and retrieval infrastructure that grounds the AI assistant in local sources: structured municipal and regional datasets, unstructured community text such as newsletters, local news, and planning documents, and historical public meeting transcripts and recordings. Implement and maintain a stable, versioned REST API and MCP toolkit so that user\-facing systems can reliably access data and AI\-supported interaction. * AI system integration and evaluation. Design and implement the model layer, including retrieval and context assembly, prompt and tool interfaces, and integration with commercial frontier LLM providers and self\-hosted open models. Build the evaluation and monitoring needed to keep responses accurate, attributable to local sources, and stable as data and models change. * Front\-end and user experience implementation. Build and maintain a mobile\-friendly web interface supporting anonymous walk\-up use, logged\-in repeat use with preserved history, and a trusted\-user role for contributing content that augments the underlying data sources. Collaborate with the research team on exploratory interface work built on top of the stable backend. * Community partnership and requirements translation. Work with the research team and community partners through user research, community visits, and working meetings. Translate community needs and priorities into system requirements and architecture, communicate technical constraints and options to non\-technical collaborators, and help maintain relationships across university, government, and community organizations. * Documentation, mentoring, and project support. Document code, data pipelines, and architectural decisions clearly enough for others to build on. Supervise and mentor student contributors working through course projects and paid appointments. Contribute technical writing to project reports and publications and support extension of the platform to additional Digital Civics Initiative projects. * **Required Documents** ---------------------- * Resume and Cover Letter **Position Type** Research **Additional Information** Northeastern University considers factors such as candidate work experience, education and skills when extending an offer. Northeastern has a comprehensive benefits package for benefit eligible employees. This includes medical, vision, dental, paid time off, tuition assistance, wellness \& life, retirement\- as well as commuting \& transportation. Visit https://hr.northeastern.edu/benefits/ for more information. All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply and will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, age, sex, sexual orientation, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. **Compensation Grade/Pay Type:** 111S **Expected Hiring Range:** $87,785\.00 \- $123,998\.75 *With the pay range(s) shown above, the starting salary will depend on several factors, which may include your education, experience, location, knowledge and expertise, and skills as well as a pay comparison to similarly\-situated employees already in the role. Salary ranges are reviewed regularly and are subject to change.*
