jobs.title: Quality Assurance Engineer
jobs.description: **Who We Are** ============== OneBridge Benefits was founded in 2013 by members of our current leadership team who set out to build better technology and smarter processes to support account\-based health plans. Today, we’ve grown into a technology\-enabled benefits administrator serving more than 380,000 participants and managing 4\.48 billion dollars in assets. Joining OneBridge means becoming part of a group of bright, driven, and collaborative individuals. We’ve built an environment where people can contribute to meaningful work, grow their skills, and pursue their individual passions. We value idea\-sharing, encourage innovation, and enjoy tackling the challenges that come with achieving our mission. **Your Opportunity with Us** ============================ We are seeking a Quality Assurance Engineer: a hands\-on senior individual contributor who pairs day\-to\-day testing and release support with technical leadership in test strategy, automation, and continuous improvement. As our Quality Assurance subject matter expert, you will help ensure our product releases and customer\-facing systems meet business, data integrity, performance, and reliability expectations, while mentoring QA Analysts along the way. **What You’ll Do** ================== * **Test hands\-on:** design and execute risk\-based functional, regression, integration, exploratory, API, database, and post\-release tests for product releases, integrations, and customer\-facing systems, including scheduled release validation outside normal business hours. * **Own test automation:** build, maintain, and run automated regression, API, and integration tests; help define the automation framework, coding standards, reporting, and CI/CD integration; and train the team to run tests. * **Partner across teams:** work with product designers, developers, and business owners to understand business rules and acceptance criteria, and coordinate regression and user acceptance testing. * **Investigate and improve:** use SQL, API tools, and logs to isolate defects across UI, service, and database layers; lead defect triage and root\-cause analysis; and use escaped\-defect trends to improve coverage. * **Set QA standards:** create test strategies, plans, cases, and documentation; prepare test environments and data; and promote entry and exit criteria and release readiness. * **Mentor and innovate:** guide QA Analyst I and II team members through test reviews and knowledge sharing (no direct people management), and evaluate approved AI tools for test design and analysis. **What You’ll Bring** ===================== * 5\+ years of software quality assurance experience, including complex application or integration testing. * Hands\-on experience building and troubleshooting automated tests with Playwright or a comparable framework. * Strong SQL and relational database skills for data validation and defect investigation. * Experience with Git and CI/CD, including automated test execution in a deployment pipeline, and with developing processes that enable a team to run orchestrated tests. * Advanced test design skills, including risk\-based, boundary\-value, equivalence partitioning, negative, and exploratory testing. * Experience in Agile delivery with a solid understanding of the software development lifecycle. * Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to evaluate risk, manage multiple workstreams, and communicate with technical and non\-technical audiences. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Business, Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent education and work experience. **Helpful, but not required:** experience with Azure DevOps; defining QA metrics, release\-quality reporting, or automated test dashboards; and introducing or significantly improving a test automation framework or regression program in a growing QA organization. **The OneBridge Way** ===================== At OneBridge Benefits, quality is more than testing. It is the foundation that lets our people, products, and clients trust every release. You’ll join a team that values innovation, continuous improvement, accountability, and collaboration while helping drive the next chapter of growth for our organization. This is an opportunity to influence our approach to quality, strengthen our test automation and release practices, mentor talented QA team members, and make a lasting impact on the reliability of the products our participants and clients depend on. We are a Monday\-Friday, in\-office company located in downtown Buffalo, NY.

jobs.title: Junior AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description: Junior AI Engineer – Voice AI \& Generative AI** **Job Location: Sunrise, FL** **Employment Type: Full\-Time** **Experience: Recent College Graduate / 0–2 Years** **About OpenBots** OpenBots is an AI\-driven technology company focused on building intelligent automation solutions that transform business operations. Through our healthcare product, **CoOrdio Health**, we are developing AI\-powered solutions to streamline healthcare Revenue Cycle Management (RCM), patient engagement, and administrative workflows. We are looking for a motivated and technically curious **AI Engineer** to join our growing engineering team and contribute to the development of next\-generation Voice AI and Generative AI solutions. **Position Overview** The AI Engineer will work on Voice AI projects and Generative AI capabilities across OpenBots CoOrdio Health products. This is an excellent opportunity for a recent Computer Science graduate with a concentration in Artificial Intelligence who has hands\-on experience experimenting with AI models, ChatGPT, Claude, and other Large Language Models (LLMs). The ideal candidate should have practical experience through academic projects, independent research, hackathons, or internships and be passionate about building real\-world AI applications. **Key Responsibilities** * Develop and support Voice AI applications and conversational AI solutions. * Work with Large Language Models (LLMs), including OpenAI ChatGPT, Anthropic Claude, and other AI models. * Research, experiment with, and evaluate different Generative AI models and frameworks. * Build AI\-powered conversational workflows, intelligent agents, and automated interactions. * Explore speech\-to\-text (STT), text\-to\-speech (TTS), and real\-time voice processing technologies. * Assist in developing Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) applications and AI agent workflows. * Work with Python to build, test, and integrate AI\-powered applications. * Conduct prompt engineering, model testing, and performance optimization. * Collaborate with senior engineers and product teams to implement AI features in CoOrdio Health. * Stay updated on emerging developments in Generative AI, Agentic AI, and Voice AI technologies. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related technical field. * Specialization or concentration in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or Generative AI is preferred. * Strong programming knowledge of Python. * Hands\-on experience working with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar AI platforms and models. * Understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, and prompt engineering. * Practical exposure to AI/ML projects through university research, personal projects, or independent experimentation. * Understanding of APIs, JSON, and integrating AI models into applications. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and troubleshooting skills. * Ability to learn new AI technologies and apply them to real\-world problems. **Preferred / Good\-to\-Have Qualifications** * Internship experience in AI, Machine Learning, Generative AI, or software development. * Experience with Voice AI, conversational AI, speech recognition, or voice synthesis. * Familiarity with LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or similar AI frameworks. * Exposure to RAG, vector databases, embeddings, and semantic search. * Experience with OpenAI APIs, Anthropic APIs, or other LLM APIs. * Academic research papers, AI competitions, hackathons, or GitHub AI projects. * Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud. **Ideal Candidate Profile** We are particularly interested in candidates who: * Are recent Computer Science graduates with an AI concentration. * Have actively experimented with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI models beyond basic everyday usage. * Have developed AI\-based academic, personal, or research projects. * Can demonstrate their understanding of how LLMs work and how to integrate them into applications. * Are enthusiastic about Voice AI, Agentic AI, and building intelligent healthcare solutions. * Are curious, self\-motivated, and eager to grow in a fast\-evolving AI environment. **What We Offer** * Opportunity to work on real\-world Voice AI and Generative AI projects. * Hands\-on experience developing AI capabilities for CoOrdio Health. * Opportunity to collaborate with experienced AI and engineering professionals. * Exposure to cutting\-edge LLMs, Agentic AI, and conversational AI technologies. * An opportunity to grow professionally in the rapidly evolving healthcare AI industry.

jobs.title: Senior Data Solutions Engineer (Databricks)
jobs.description: **About Opplane** Opplane helps organizations unlock the value of their data in a world increasingly shaped by artificial intelligence, connectivity, and regulation. We work with businesses across complex, data\-intensive industries to turn fragmented or difficult\-to\-use data into trusted, actionable intelligence. Our work spans AI and data solutions for banking and fintech, data governance and modernization, and connectivity technologies. Drawing on years of industry experience at leading companies such as PayPal, Amazon and Xerox PARC, our team combines expertise across data, engineering, AI and business domains to help clients move from technical complexity to practical solutions that support better decisions, stronger governance and real business outcomes. **Why this role matters** Our clients come to us with data platforms that need to do more: scale further, feed analytics and AI, and stand up to governance and security requirements. Many of them are moving to, or building on, Databricks, and they need more than a strong engineer. They need someone who can understand the business problem, design the right platform, and bring technical and executive stakeholders along. In this role, you’ll combine deep Databricks expertise with direct client work. You’ll shape solutions with clients, help us win and scope new work, and make sure what we design can be delivered and adopted by the people who use it. **What you’ll do** * Work directly with clients to understand their data challenges and business goals, and turn them into clear platform designs on Databricks * Design scalable Lakehouse architectures, including medallion layers, ingestion (CDC, streaming, APIs), data quality and governance with Unity Catalog * Lead or guide platform migrations, for example from on\-premise Hadoop or Cloudera to Databricks, with minimal disruption * Support our commercial team in discovery, solution design, proposals and technical presentations, up to the close * Present to and advise senior client stakeholders, including C\-level, on architecture choices, trade\-offs and roadmap * Help clients through the change that comes with a new platform: adoption, ways of working and handover to their teams * Set technical direction for delivery teams and review their work, staying hands\-on where it matters * Bring client insight back to our teams and help shape how we package and deliver our data offering **What you’ll bring** Experience and expertise * 8\+ years in data or software engineering, including senior or lead roles on data platforms * Deep, hands\-on experience with Databricks: Spark/PySpark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, workflows and performance tuning * Experience designing data platforms from scratch, including ingestion, quality, security and access control * Experience leading or advising on platform migrations, ideally from Cloudera/Hadoop to Databricks \[to confirm: must\-have or plus] * Strong Python in production environments, and a solid understanding of distributed systems * A track record of client\-facing work: requirements, solution design, presales or technical advisory * Fluent English, written and spoken How you work * You turn a business problem into a technical solution, and explain the trade\-offs in terms clients understand * You’re comfortable in front of senior and C\-level stakeholders, and you build trust quickly * You take ownership from the first conversation through to a solution that works and gets used * You lead through influence: you set direction, coach engineers and know when to step in hands\-on * You handle ambiguity and competing priorities calmly, with clients and inside the team Nice to have * Databricks certifications (e.g. Data Engineer Professional) * Databricks Asset Bundles or Terraform for infrastructure as code * MLflow, Photon, Databricks SQL Warehouses and serverless compute * Experience in banking, fintech or other regulated industries * Change management or consulting experience **What you’ll have the opportunity to do** * Shape data platforms for clients from the first conversation, not just deliver someone else’s design * Work at the point where engineering, business and leadership meet * Help build Opplane’s Databricks practice as it grows **How we work** Small team, big challenges, real ownership. At Opplane, you’ll work on software and technology across data, AI and connectivity, helping build solutions that address complex technical and business needs. You’ll have access to leadership, opportunities to contribute to technical decisions and room to influence how we approach problems and build our products. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with colleagues, clients and stakeholders across the US, Portugal, Singapore and India. Our work brings together different areas of expertise and perspectives, making it important to stay curious, exchange ideas and understand the challenges others are working to solve. We value people who take initiative, share their knowledge and bring new perspectives to the way we work. Ultimately, it’s about bringing people and technology together to build solutions that meet today’s needs and anticipate tomorrow’s challenges. **Interested?** If this opportunity sounds like a good fit for your experience and the kind of work you want to do, we’d like to hear from you. Apply to learn more about the role and how you could contribute to Opplane. *Opplane is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and to maintaining a workplace free from discrimination and harassment. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, skills, experience, and business needs, without regard to any status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.* *We welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, including protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. Opplane is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the application and recruitment process, as required by applicable law.* *If you require an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, please let us know.*

jobs.title: Senior AI/ML Engineer
jobs.description: Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, and data they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by diversity and inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits, and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health equity on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.** The Optum Health Technology team is seeking a **Senior Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning Engineer** with experience building and deploying production AI/ML solutions. In this role, you will design, develop, validate, and operationalize machine learning models, generative AI solutions, predictive analytics, and intelligent automation that support Environmental, Occupational Health and Safety (EOHS). You will work with software engineers, data scientists, data architects, product managers, and EOHS professionals to translate business needs into secure and scalable AI capabilities. These solutions will use EOHS data to identify risk patterns, predict potential health and safety events, reduce manual work, and provide actionable insights. This role will help EOHS teams move from reactive reporting toward proactive risk prevention. You will also help ensure that AI solutions are secure, explainable, appropriately governed, and monitored for performance, accuracy, drift, and bias. You will have the flexibility to work remotely from anywhere within the United States, subject to applicable company policies. Employees hired in the Minneapolis or Washington, D.C. areas will be required to work in the office at least four days per week. **Primary Responsibilities** * Design, build, validate, and deploy scalable AI/ML, predictive analytics, and generative AI solutions that support EOHS priorities * Develop models and analytical solutions that identify health and safety risk patterns, predict potential events, and support timely human intervention * Build intelligent automation that reduces manual effort and improves EOHS operational efficiency * Partner with EOHS professionals, product managers, data teams, architects, and software engineers to translate business problems into secure, production\-ready AI capabilities * Lead the end\-to\-end machine learning lifecycle, including data exploration, feature engineering, model development, validation, deployment, monitoring, and optimization * Build or integrate batch and real\-time model inference services, data pipelines, APIs, and reusable AI components * Apply responsible AI, privacy, security, explainability, human oversight, and bias\-management practices to solutions involving employee health and safety data * Evaluate and prototype technologies such as large language models, retrieval\-augmented generation, natural language processing, predictive machine learning, and AI agents to identify high\-value EOHS applications * Establish measurable technical and business outcomes to demonstrate the effectiveness, reliability, adoption, and value of deployed solutions * Monitor production solutions for performance degradation, data or model drift, reliability issues, and unintended outcomes * Provide technical guidance and promote sound AI/ML engineering practices across project teams You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in. **Required qualifications:** * 5\+ years of combined experience in software engineering, machine learning engineering, data science, or a related technical discipline in a production environment * 3\+ years of hands\-on experience designing, training, evaluating, deploying, and monitoring machine learning models in production * 3\+ years of experience using Python and relevant AI/ML or data science libraries, such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit\-learn, pandas, NumPy, or SciPy * 2\+ years of experience using SQL and working with large, complex, or multi\-source datasets * 2\+ years of experience with at least one major cloud platform, such as Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services, or Google Cloud Platform, including its AI, ML, or data services * 2\+ years of experience with production MLOps practices, including source control, automated testing, continuous integration and continuous delivery, model versioning, deployment, and monitoring * 2\+ years of experience with containerization technologies such as Docker; experience with container orchestration or comparable cloud deployment services * 2\+ years of experience applying statistical analysis, predictive modeling, model\-evaluation techniques, and advanced data manipulation * 2\+ years of experience communicating technical concepts, model limitations, and analytical findings to technical and nontechnical stakeholders **Preferred qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, data science, statistics, applied mathematics, engineering, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent professional experience; advanced degree preferred * Experience with large language models, generative AI architectures, prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation, vector databases, or AI agents * Experience building model\-serving APIs, batch inference pipelines, feature pipelines, or reusable machine learning platforms * Experience implementing model governance, explainability, drift detection, bias testing, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls * Experience developing technology solutions involving sensitive, regulated, health\-related, or confidential data * Experience in health care, employee health, workplace safety, occupational health, workers' compensation, environmental health, or a related domain * Experience mentoring engineers or providing technical leadership across multidisciplinary teams * All Telecommuters will be required to adhere to UnitedHealth Group's Telecommuter Policy. Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to local labor markets, education, work experience, certifications, etc. In addition to your salary, we offer benefits such as, a comprehensive benefits package, incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase and 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). No matter where or when you begin a career with us, you'll find a far\-reaching choice of benefits and incentives. The salary for this role will range from $120,100 to $214,500 annually based on full\-time employment. We comply with all minimum wage laws as applicable. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. ***Application Deadline:*** *This will be posted for a minimum of 2 business days or until a sufficient candidate pool has been collected. Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.* *At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone\-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location, and income\-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups, and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.* *UnitedHealth Group is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer under applicable law and qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, religion, age, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by local, state, or federal laws, rules, or regulations.* *UnitedHealth Group is a drug \- free workplace. Candidates are required to pass a drug test before beginning employment.* \#RPO \#GREEN

jobs.title: Lead Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: Mentors teams and leads the architecture of highly scalable, interdependent distributed systems. Identifies and removes performance/scalability bottlenecks for hyper‑scale workloads; defines scalability requirements with stakeholders; and designs elastic, high‑impact systems while advancing innovation in data plane platforms. Engineers and oversees fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable designs; optimizes resilience mechanisms (load‑shedding, throttling, rate‑limiting); and sets SLO‑aligned durability and availability standards across dependent services. Establishes KPIs and advanced telemetry; applies formal verification for complex features; and develops robust replication/synchronization strategies. Advises and leads resolution of complex production issues, sets operational readiness and SOP standards, and directs incident response and RCAs. Architects advanced security controls, drives remediation and compliance, and delivers enterprise‑level automation (IaC) and change strategies enabling safe, automated patching, updates, and rollbacks. Key Responsibilities System Design \& Architecture \- System Scalability: –Mentor the team in the architecture and design of highly scalable, interdependent distributed systems, ensuring horizontal and vertical scalability and overall performance, including leveraging distributed state management tools. –Lead the identification of performance and scalability bottlenecks and recommend solutions to optimize code and/or systems for large\-scale data processing and high\-throughput requirements to improve performance for hyper\-scale systems. –Lead collaboration with stakeholders to define system scalability requirements, ensuring the defined requirements meet customer expectations. –Leverage deep expertise to design high\-impact, interdependent systems to scale with elasticity (e.g., effectively scaling both up and down). –Drive innovation in the use of data plane platforms. –Evaluate whether systems are meeting nonfunctional scalability requirements, and proactively anticipate growing business needs within the business unit. System Design \& Architecture \- System Reliability Design: –Design and oversee the implementation of fault\-tolerant, interdependent systems capable of withstanding in\-service updates by implementing sophisticated redundancy, replication, and automatic failover capabilities. –Lead the design and implementation of systems that effectively handle service disruptions (e.g., network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance. –Guide the optimization of advanced mechanisms to handle network unreliability, including load\-shedding, throttling, and rate\-limiting. –Design interdependent systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), driving standards for availability and durability of other computing services within the organization System Design \& Architecture \- System Reliability Performance: –Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify risks, gaps, or cyclical dependencies in running, interdependent systems. –Drive the creation and customization of highly complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms, proactively ensuring system health and reliability. System Design \& Architecture \- Correctness / Availability: –Maintain expertise in industry standards for verifying correctness and apply existing techniques to interdependent systems. –Formally verify complex features (e.g., via TLA\+) to ensure system design correctness for various interdependent systems. –Develop advanced strategies for data replication and synchronization, ensuring robust data integrity and availability Operational Troubleshooting \& Incident Management: –Advise on efforts to diagnose, debug, and resolve complex issues in active, interdependent systems to support ongoing operation. –Develop and implement comprehensive strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues. –Maintain expertise in dependencies, dependents, and owned systems to drive effective troubleshooting and performance. –Set standards for operational readiness and standard operating procedures within the department, and hold third\-party partners accountable for meeting those standards. –Oversee operational support rotations, providing expert guidance in incident response and leading root cause investigations to prevent future occurrences. Compliance \& Security: –Architect advanced security measures to protect data and applications in multi\-tenant environments, and lead initiatives to enhance data and application protection. –Guide the execution of comprehensive remediation plans to address identified security vulnerabilities. –Ensure cloud infrastructure is in compliance with industry standards and regulations, and guide documentation efforts across projects. Automation \& Change Management: –Develop enterprise\-level automation tools and strategies (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) and oversee their implementation. –Drive alignment of change management plans and organizational initiatives for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, and design interdependent systems to allow for automation of these processes. Core Responsibilities Planning \& Execution: –Manages and provides direction on timelines, deliverables, and budgets when applicable for critical high\-impact projects or initiatives that impact the line of business, ensuring timely completion and adherence to requirements. Anticipates and plans for shifts in resources or timelines based on changing business priorities, ensuring optimal outcomes. Collaboration \& Partnership: –Influences cross\-functional leaders and external stakeholders to gain alignment on strategic objectives. Fosters partnerships with key business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers, identifying opportunities for expanding partnerships and promoting long\-term organizational success. Champions transparency and inclusivity by actively seeking, listening to, and incorporating diverse perspectives. Problem Solving: –Leads specialized, advanced problem\-solving efforts, serving as an escalation point for complex issues. Guides others to leverage innovative data\-driven techniques to address ambiguous or novel issues, identify root causes, and drives the implementation of solutions that prevent future issues. Continuous Learning: –Leverages deep industry knowledge and expertise to serve as a thought leader within the organization. Contributes to the advancement of the field or industry through thought leadership (e.g., conference presentations, white papers, research contributions). Maintains and evolves expertise in relevant areas by proactively monitoring emerging trends, technologies, and industry standards, ensuring the organization remains current with best practices. Champions continuous learning and knowledge sharing, promoting professional development across teams. Applies new knowledge to drive advancement and mentors others to do the same. Continuous Improvement: –Develops innovative solutions and drives the implementation of ideas that increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across the organization. Evaluates effectiveness of updated approaches and methods for continued improvement to enhance efficiencies and ensure changes align with organizational goals. Designs and develops metrics to measure success of improvement initiatives. Performance and Development: –Serves as a subject matter expert regarding talent needs and organizational talent strategy. Imparts leadership and expert knowledge throughout the talent development pipeline including candidate interviews, candidate assessment, and hiring decisions, ensuring alignment with organizational talent strategy.

jobs.title: Platform Software Engineer

We are seeking software engineers who combine strong programming fundamentals with hands\-on experience using AI\-powered tools and agents to accelerate and improve the software development lifecycle. As a Platform Software Engineer, you will contribute to the design, development, testing, and deployment of scalable cloud\-based software applications and services. You will translate technical requirements into working solutions, leverage LLMs and AI\-assisted development tools to generate and refine code, and collaborate with experienced engineers to deliver reliable, maintainable software. The ideal candidate brings a solid foundation in Java development, familiarity with cloud technologies, and practical experience incorporating AI tools into software engineering workflows. This role focuses on applying AI to software development rather than developing or training AI models. * Develop, test, deploy, and maintain cloud\-based software applications and services. * Translate defined business and technical requirements into software specifications and working solutions with guidance from senior engineers. * Leverage AI\-powered coding tools, LLMs, and AI agents to generate, refine, test, and maintain code. * Apply AI\-assisted code review, testing, debugging, and validation practices to ensure software quality, security, and reliability. * Contribute to software development activities from implementation and testing through deployment and ongoing maintenance. * Develop and enhance Java\-based applications and services using modern cloud development jobs.title: Senior .NET Software Developer
jobs.description: Orion Innovation is a premier, award\-winning, global business and technology services firm. Orion delivers game\-changing business transformation and product development rooted in digital strategy, experience design, and engineering, with a unique combination of agility, scale, and maturity. We work with a wide range of clients across many industries including financial services, professional services, telecommunications and media, consumer products, automotive, industrial automation, professional sports and entertainment, life sciences, ecommerce, and education. **About the Role** We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer who brings deep engineering instincts, broad technical capability, and a genuine curiosity for solving hard problems. This is not a role defined by a fixed technology stack — it is a role defined by the quality of your thinking, the depth of your foundation, and your ability to operate effectively across the full engineering landscape. You will work on complex, high\-stakes delivery where the tools, platforms, and challenges evolve continuously. The engineers who thrive here do not master a checklist of technologies — they build a strong enough foundation that picking up the next tool is a moderate lift, not a reinvention of themselves. **What You Will Do** * Design and deliver software solutions across the full engineering lifecycle — from architecture and infrastructure through to application logic, integration, testing, and deployment. * Contribute to platform and tooling decisions, not just implementation. * Bring engineering rigour to every layer of the stack: infrastructure, backend services, APIs, front\-end experiences, pipelines, and automation. * Write code that is production\-ready from the start — tested, documented, observable, and maintainable. * Make deliberate use of AI tooling throughout your development workflow, and help raise the standard for how the wider team works with AI. * Mentor and influence peers through code review, pair programming, technical documentation, and architectural input. * Move fluidly between domains as delivery demands it, while going deep where depth is needed. * Act with integrity, professionalism, and personal responsibility to uphold the firm's respectful and courteous work environment. **What You Bring** **Engineering Foundation** This matters more than any individual tool. You think in patterns — not just design patterns in the GoF sense, but in the broader sense established by practitioners like Martin Fowler, Eric Evans, Sam Newman, and others who have codified how to build systems that last. When you encounter a new platform or framework, you are mapping it to concepts you already hold. The learning curve is moderate, not steep, because the foundations are solid. * Strong grasp of enterprise application architecture, distributed systems design, and integration patterns. * Experience applying domain\-driven design, clean architecture, or equivalent structural approaches to real production systems. * Comfort reasoning about trade\-offs — coupling, cohesion, consistency, scalability, operability — and articulating those trade\-offs to stakeholders. **Technical Breadth and Depth** You have a working toolbox built up over years of real delivery. Some tools you know deeply; others you know well enough to be dangerous and to go deeper quickly. The specific tools matter less than the breadth of contexts you have worked in and the depth you have demonstrated in at least several areas. Representative technologies used in this environment include: * Languages and frameworks: .NET / C\#, Python, JavaScript / TypeScript, PowerShell, Angular * Cloud and infrastructure: Microsoft Azure, Terraform, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), cloud\-native architecture patterns * DevOps and delivery: GitHub, GitHub Actions, CI/CD pipeline design and implementation * Cross\-cutting: API design, observability, security practices, dependency management This list is representative, not exhaustive. The environment changes. We expect you to change with it. **Software Engineering Practices** We expect engineering practices to be non\-negotiable, not aspirational: * Developer\-led testing. You write tests as part of development, not after. You understand the testing pyramid, know when to push toward unit coverage and when integration or contract tests are the right tool, and you advocate for testable design from the start. * Documentation as a first\-class output. Code is written once and read many times. You document your reasoning, your interfaces, your runbooks, and your decisions. You understand the difference between documentation that helps and documentation that clutters. Orion is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, citizenship status, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Candidate Privacy Policy Orion Systems Integrators, LLC and its subsidiaries and its affiliates (collectively, "Orion," "we" or "us") are committed to protecting your privacy. This Candidate Privacy Policy (orioninc.com) ("Notice") explains: * What information we collect during our application and recruitment process and why we collect it; * How we handle that information; and * How to access and update that information. Your use of Orion services is governed by any applicable terms in this notice and our general Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, FeedForward 3D/4D Reconstruction
jobs.description: At Parallel Domain, we believe that autonomous systems – from self\-driving cars to contactless delivery drones – have the opportunity to drastically improve the quality of life for billions of people. That is why we love what we do: enabling our customers to develop their technology safely using the Parallel Domain data generation platform. Our platform revolutionizes the way our customers generate sensor data for AI development. We're looking for people like you to join us in pushing the boundaries of artificial intelligence and synthetic data.**About the role** ------------------ Before any physical AI system is trusted in the real world, it has to prove itself in ours. Parallel Domain turns real captured drives into faithful digital replicas — geometry, appearance and motion that perception stacks are trained and validated against. We are hiring a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to push our feed\-forward reconstruction stack forward — from static 3D toward full 4D scenes over time. You will join a small, deep team where your technical judgment carries real weight from day one, and your work will ship in a pipeline customers depend on. ### **What You'll Do** * **Advance our feed\-forward reconstruction models**. Improve how we predict geometry, camera pose and appearance from real capture with transformer\-based models, and extend it from static scenes to dynamic 4D. * **Train at scale**. Run multi\-node GPU training on large multi\-view and video datasets, and decide what to scale, what to ablate and when a result is real. * **Define what "good" means**. Build evaluation the team trusts for reconstruction quality, temporal consistency and geometric accuracy. * **Explore stronger priors**. Investigate where generative models, such as pre\-trained video diffusion, can help fill gaps the capture did not see. * **Land research in the product**. Work with the pipeline engineers to get results into production, and care whether they hold up there. * **Track the field**. This area moves monthly; form a view on where it is heading and argue for it. ### **What we're looking for** * **Hands\-on feed\-forward reconstruction experience**. You have built or trained feedforward 3D reconstruction models (for example in the lineage of DUSt3R, VGGT, π³ or D4RT), and you know where they work and where they break. * **A track record of models others relied on**. We weight demonstrated depth over years served : a recent PhD with the right focus and an experienced research engineer are both credible here. * **Large\-scale trainin**g. Practical experience with multi\-node, multi\-GPU training and telling a promising run from a stalled one early. * **Strong PyTorch skills** in a large shared codebase with real build and CI. * **Research judgment**. You turn an ambiguous direction into experiments that resolve something, and change your mind when the numbers say so. * **Clear communication** with researchers, pipeline engineers and leadership alike. ### **Strong pluses** These are listed in order of how much they matter to us. * **Feed\-forward Gaussian prediction**. Experience predicting 3D Gaussians directly from images in a single pass, rather than fitting them per scene. * **Top\-tier publications in feed\-forward reconstruction**. First\-author or significant work at CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICLR or SIGGRAPH in this area. * **Video diffusion models**. Familiarity with diffusion or flow\-matching video models, especially camera\-conditioned generation. * **Dynamic scenes**. Work on dynamic reconstruction, scene flow or temporal consistency. * **Real\-world capture**. Experience with automotive, robotics or drone data and its mess: imperfect calibration, motion blur, poses you cannot trust. * **Making big models fast, or open\-source contributions** to widely used reconstruction libraries. €120,000 \- €170,000 a year Fully remote within Europe. The team works on Central European hours, with regular overlap with North America. **Why join Parallel Domain?** We are assembling a team of creative, talented visionaries seeking to build a new technology that will change the world. You will be able to learn, build, and scale our team and technology in a collaborative, creative culture that values every team member. To attract and inspire the right talent, we offer:* Competitive compensation (range will be openly discussed early in our interview process) * Employer\-paid supplemental medical, mental health, dental, and vision benefits. * Flexible paid vacation, sick time, winter shutdown, and 11\+ holidays per year * Paid parental leave * Equipment budget to optimize your setup * Annual learning and development stipend Parallel Domain celebrates diversity and is committed to creating a safe and inclusive environment for all our people. We are committed to providing employees with an environment free of discrimination, bullying and harassment. All employment decisions at Parallel Domain are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications. We will maintain our commitment to and support of equal employment opportunity for all individuals without regard to race, national/ethnic origin, colour, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, marital status, family status, genetic characteristics or physical/mental disability. Our commitment extends to any other protected classes which may exist under applicable law. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff (Software Engineer, SPACE - Sandbox Platform)
jobs.description: **About the role** ------------------ SPACE is Perplexity's sandbox platform. It's the isolated execution layer behind Perplexity Computer, the public Sandbox API, and a growing set of agent products. Every time an agent writes code, runs a tool, opens a browser, builds an app, or works on a user's files, it runs inside a SPACE sandbox. We built our own sandbox platform that lets us build the exact platform our products need: real pause and resume, forking, rolling snapshots, credential isolation, fine\-grained network policy, and enterprise\-grade encryption. The work spans low\-level virtualization and networking, distributed state machines, petabyte storage, and careful API design. Reliability, security, and cold\-start latency are all things our customers feel directly. **Key responsibilities** ------------------------ * Design and build core sandbox infrastructure for running untrusted, agent\-generated code safely, quickly, and at scale. * Own sandbox isolation and security end to end, working with Security Engineering on defense in depth for compute, networking, storage, and sensitive information. * Build stateful systems that manage long\-lived execution environments and keep user data durable and correct through failures. * Drive performance and efficiency across the stack, from startup latency and resource density to cost. * Run sandbox infrastructure as an always\-on production service, setting the bar for reliability, observability, capacity planning, and incident response. * Define clear platform interfaces and APIs so internal teams and external developers can build on sandboxes with confidence. * Provide technical leadership: mentor engineers, write clear design docs, and make long\-term architectural decisions that keep the platform simple, secure, and able to evolve. **Qualifications** ------------------ * Experience designing and running production backend or infrastructure systems * Strong distributed systems experience: you've built and operated systems that coordinate state across many nodes, and you're fluent in consistency, consensus or leader election, idempotency, retries, and failure handling at scale. * Strong system design skills for stateful systems where correctness under failure matters. * Hands\-on experience with Linux systems and modern infrastructure (for example AWS, Kubernetes, and container or VM runtimes). * Comfortable with security\-sensitive systems and making pragmatic trade\-offs between isolation, performance, and velocity. * Collaborative mindset and eagerness to work on hard problems with other experienced engineers. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Experience with Firecracker, Cloud Hypervisor, KVM, gVisor, Kata, or other virtualization and sandboxing technology. * Experience with snapshotting, copy\-on\-write filesystems, or block storage. * Experience with Linux networking (namespaces, eBPF, egress filtering) or secrets and key management. * Experience with custom scheduling, multi\-cluster orchestration, or distributed state machines. * Experience building developer\-facing APIs and SDKs, or code execution and agent infrastructure. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't match every qualification listed above.

jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description: * **Candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. without current or future employer sponsorship. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas, including OPT/STEM OPT to H\-1B transitions.** **Position Summary:*** This position is on\-site in Miramar, FL. * We are building automated asset identification and serialization into our equipment — vision systems that read, decode, and verify identifiers on media and drives as they move through the destruction process, and that produce the auditable records our clients rely on for chain\-of\-custody compliance. * This role owns that capability. You will develop and productionize computer vision and machine learning pipelines for label and barcode recognition, integrate them with machine controls and back\-office systems, and serve as the internal technical owner for external engineering vendors contributing to these programs. * This is a hands\-on individual contributor role with real ownership. You will write production code, and you will also be the person who defines scope for outside contractors, reviews what they deliver, and decides whether it is good enough to ship. **Key Responsibilities:****Computer Vision \& Machine Learning:*** Develop, train, and deploy object detection and recognition models for barcode, 2D code, and text identification on industrial asset labels. * Implement rotation\-tolerant detection using oriented bounding box or equivalent approaches; labels arrive at arbitrary orientations, skew, and standoff distances, and the pipeline must handle it without operator intervention. * Solve identifier disambiguation: asset labels routinely carry multiple codes — part numbers, model codes, lot codes, vendor identifiers — with no universal marking standard. Build the detection, classification, and confidence\-scoring logic that determines which code is the correct serial identifier, and define the fallback path when confidence is insufficient. * Integrate OCR for identifiers that are printed as human\-readable text with no machine\-readable code present. * Build and maintain the data pipeline behind the models: capture, annotation standards, augmentation, synthetic data generation, versioned datasets, and reproducible training runs. * Define and track model evaluation criteria — precision, recall, mAP, per\-class failure analysis — and drive measurable improvement release over release. **Embedded \& Systems Integration:*** Deploy inference to edge compute on production equipment; optimize for latency and throughput within the constraints of the hardware (quantization, ONNX/TensorRT, batching). * Specify and integrate machine vision hardware: industrial cameras, optics, lighting, triggering, and mounting geometry. * Interface vision output with machine control systems (PLC/HMI, serial, Modbus, Ethernet/IP) to gate machine behavior on identification results. * Design and build RESTful APIs and services that move serialization data from the machine into back\-office and ERP systems, producing the records that support certificates of destruction and audit trails. * Own reliability in the field: logging, telemetry, error handling, remote diagnostics, and update mechanisms for deployed systems. **Vendor \& Program Ownership:*** Serve as internal technical owner for external engineering vendors and offshore contractors working on vision, firmware, and robotics programs. * Write technical scopes of work, define acceptance criteria and milestone gates, and evaluate deliverables against them. * Review vendor code and architecture; identify where outsourced work is accruing technical debt and correct course. * Run technical cadence with distributed vendor teams across time zones and maintain the internal documentation that keeps knowledge in\-house. * Support adjacent automation programs, including vision\-guided robotic material handling. **Required Qualifications:*** 4\+ years developing production software in embedded, machine vision, or applied ML roles. * Strong Python; working proficiency in C or C\+\+. * Practical computer vision experience with OpenCV and modern detection architectures (YOLO family or equivalent), including training and fine\-tuning your own models rather than only consuming pre\-trained ones. * Experience with PyTorch or TensorFlow, including dataset construction, training, evaluation, and deployment. * Barcode and 2D code decoding experience (Code 128, Code 39, Data Matrix, QR) using libraries such as ZBar, ZXing, or libdmtx — including the cases where they fail. * Experience deploying models to edge or embedded compute (NVIDIA Jetson or similar). * RESTful API design and integration; JSON, authentication, error handling. * Git, code review, and CI practices. * Ability to work onsite in Miramar, FL and directly with equipment on the production floor. **Preferred Qualifications:*** OCR experience (Tesseract, PaddleOCR, TrOCR) applied to low\-quality industrial imagery. * Oriented / rotated object detection specifically (OBB heads, DOTA\-style datasets, or equivalent production experience). * Industrial camera integration — GigE Vision, USB3 Vision — and practical lens and lighting selection. * PLC/controls integration experience in a manufacturing environment. * Firmware experience on ARM/STM32 and RTOS environments. * Vision\-guided robotics: hand\-eye calibration, pick\-and\-place, 3D or depth sensing. * ERP or MES integration experience (NetSuite a plus). * Experience managing or technically overseeing external development contractors. * BS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. **Pay:** $110,000\.00 \- $135,000\.00 per year. **Benefits:*** 401(k). * 401(k) 6% Match. * Dental insurance. * Health insurance. * Paid time off. * Parental leave. * Relocation assistance. **Work Location:** In person.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Infrastructure
jobs.description: **About Pinterest:** Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we're on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product. Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other's unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It's Possible. At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we're looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we'll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI. Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here. **The Team** Pinterest's Infrastructure organization builds and operates the platforms that every engineer at Pinterest uses to build, test, ship and run software. Our CI and deployment platforms handle the journey of every change from commit to production. We're investing heavily in making that journey faster, more efficient and safe by default, especially as AI\-assisted development sharply increases how much we ship. We work closely with engineering teams across Pinterest to make sure the platform scales with the business. **What You'll Do** * Lead cross\-team programs that make production changes safe by default, driving adoption of progressive rollouts, automated canary analysis and fast rollback across code, config, data and ML model deployments. * Drive the CI platform roadmap to reduce build cost and wait times, improve fleet utilization and migrate CI workloads to our next\-generation compute platform. * Define and track the delivery and reliability metrics that measure success, such as change failure rate, recovery time, lead time for change and build performance, and build dashboards that surface regressions early. * Manage dependencies and migrations across CI, artifact, deployment and compute platforms and the many service teams that depend on them. * Influence engineering teams across Pinterest to adopt new standards and paved paths, managing timelines, pushback and risk. * Communicate technical tradeoffs among velocity, safety, cost and reliability clearly to audiences from individual engineers to senior leadership. * Use GenAI as the default operating model for program execution: produce AI\-assisted first drafts of core program artifacts, turn high\-toil workflows into AI\-first mechanisms (for example, intake triage, status synthesis, action and decision extraction, and risk and dependency tracking), and synthesize signals to surface risks, tradeoffs and escalation paths early. * Prototype solutions that improve decisions with data (dashboards, analysis) or simplify processes (workflow helpers, internal tools) using AI coding assistants ("vibe coding"). * Follow Pinterest AI guidance for risk, governance and safety by design: handle sensitive data appropriately, validate AI\-generated outputs, document assumptions and limits, and make sure AI\-assisted workflows meet policy and compliance expectations before broad adoption. **What We're Looking For** * 5\+ years of TPM experience leading complex, cross\-functional technical programs in infrastructure, platform engineering, developer productivity or SRE. * A solid understanding of CI/CD systems, build infrastructure and safe\-deployment practices (canaries, progressive delivery, automated rollback), and the tradeoffs between velocity and safety. * A track record of driving platform or standards adoption across many engineering teams without direct authority. * Strong analytical skills, with experience defining delivery and reliability metrics (for example, DORA metrics) and using data to drive decisions. * Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including giving clear, candid status and risk updates to senior leadership. * Comfort with ambiguity: you can take a broad mandate, define the plan and measures of success, and drive it to outcomes. * Experience with infrastructure efficiency, compute cost or capacity planning is a plus. * Workflow design, AI fluency, and a data\-and\-insights orientation: experience turning repeatable program work into durable, low\-toil mechanisms and improving decisions using GenAI (for example, strong prompting, vibe coding lightweight scripts or tools, dashboards, data analysis and using agents where appropriate). * Safety\-by\-design AI fluency: experience operating within AI governance expectations (risk assessment, data handling, output validation, auditability) and recognizing where AI use isn't appropriate or needs extra controls. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related field or equivalent experience. Join us and help shape the future of Pinterest's infrastructure! **Relocation Statement:** * This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model. **In\-Office Requirement Statement:** * We recognize that the ideal environment for work is situational and may differ across departments. What this looks like day\-to\-day can vary based on the needs of each organization or role. * This role will need to be in the office for in\-person collaboration 1\-2 times every 6 months and therefore can be situated anywhere in the country \#LI\-REMOTE **Our Commitment to Inclusion:** Pinterest is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions on the basis of merit. We want to have the best qualified people in every job. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion or religious creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, status as a protected veteran, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information or characteristics (or those of a family member) or any other consideration made unlawful by applicable federal, state or local laws. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you require a medical or religious accommodation during the job application process, please complete this form for support. *By submitting this application, I certify that all information submitted in my application and throughout the hiring process is true, accurate, and complete to the best of my knowledge. I understand that any false statement, omission, or misrepresentation may disqualify me from employment consideration or result in termination if discovered after hire.*

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description: Reactor is building the inference platform for real\-time world models. Our goal is to democratize access to real\-time intelligence to unlock next\-generation use cases in media, physical AI and omni\-directional models. We already run the largest and fastest catalog of world models on the market, and work closely with all major model labs to run and optimize their world models, including Alibaba, Amazon, and NVIDIA. We've raised $74M led by Lightspeed, with Amplify Partners, WNDR, NVIDIA, Sapphire, and other Tier 1 investors participating. Jeffrey Katzenberg, co\-founder of DreamWorks Animation, sits on our board of directors. We're signing customers faster than we can look after them. You'll be our first Customer Success Manager, the person every signed customer talks to each week once the contract is done. You'll keep those customers happy, find where they can grow with us, and bring what they tell you straight back to product. A lot of what we build next will start with your notes. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Run weekly check\-ins with every signed customer. Know what they're shipping, what's blocking them, and what they'll need from us next quarter. * Get new customers live fast. Work with our forward deployed and inference engineers to take a customer from signed contract to production traffic. * Keep a success plan for every account and run QBRs with customer leadership. Visit customers on\-site to see how they're actually using Reactor. * Spot renewals and expansions early. Find the next model, the next product line, or the next team that should be on Reactor, and close it with BD. * Forecast each account's usage and build the ROI case behind it, so renewals and bigger commits are easy yeses. * Treat it as a two\-way relationship. Ask customers for case studies, references and early access to what they're building. * Be the escalation point when something breaks. Pull in the right engineers, keep the customer posted, and stay on it until it's fixed. * Watch usage and account health, and flag churn risk before it shows up in the numbers. * Bring the customer into the building. Turn what you hear into clear, prioritized asks for product and engineering. * Build our CS function from scratch: onboarding, health tracking, QBRs, playbooks, and the tooling behind them. **Who You Are** --------------- * 5\+ years in customer success or account management at a technical B2B company (AI, infra, robotics, or developer tools is ideal). * You've managed a book of high\-value accounts and grown it. You can point to the expansions you drove. * Technical enough to follow an API integration and talk latency and throughput with an engineer, then explain it plainly to a customer's exec. * You can get engineering, product and sales moving on a customer problem without having authority over any of them. * Organized to a fault. Every commitment from a call lands somewhere and gets done. * You write clearly and follow up without being asked. * You use AI tools every day and automate your own work with them. * Happy to travel to customer sites when it helps. * You like being early. There's no playbook yet, and you'd rather write it than wait for one. **Nice to Have** * Experience with generative video, gaming, robotics, or foundation model customers * Background in technical account management, solutions engineering, or consulting before CS * You were an early CS hire somewhere and built the function * Comfort with usage data (SQL, dashboards) to track account health * Hands\-on with a CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, Attio) **Benefits** ------------ * Competitive SF salary and meaningful equity in an early\-stage company backed by top investors * Direct access to founders and influence over product direction * Visa sponsorship and relocation support * Generous health, dental, and vision coverage

jobs.title: Sr. Field Service Engineer
jobs.description: Roles available in Ohio, Virginia, Nevada, Texas, New Mexico and Minnesota **Sr. Field S****ervice Engineer** The Sr. Field Service Engineer is the technical authority for complex field service, commissioning, and modernization work on low\- and medium\-voltage (and, where applicable, high\-voltage) power systems, including transformers and their protection and control. This role is responsible for ensuring the complete electrical system operates safely and as designed. It provides on\-site leadership, ensures safe work execution, interfaces directly with customers and project teams, and mentors Field Service Engineers and technicians while driving quality, schedule adherence, and continuous improvement. Key Responsibilities Technical Authority \& Commissioning Lead commissioning and startup of complete electrical systems, including acceptance testing and verification of system performance. Serve as the primary technical escalation point for advanced control, protection, and integration issues. Plan and perform advanced diagnostics for equipment and protection/control issues, including intermittent faults and complex system interactions. Perform protection relay commissioning and end\-to\-end verification; validate settings implementation against approved setting files and drawings. Execute and direct acceptance, maintenance, and condition\-based testing (insulation resistance, contact resistance, timing/travel analysis, primary and secondary injection, relay logic verification, SCADA/RTU I/O checks). Transformers Diagnostics \& Condition Assessment Serve as the technical authority for transformer condition assessment and failure investigation. Plan and perform advanced transformer diagnostics including sweep frequency response analysis (SFRA), dielectric frequency response (DFR), leakage reactance / short\-circuit impedance, partial discharge, and advanced insulation power factor testing. Assess transformer condition by trending electrical test data, oil analysis (DGA, moisture, furan), and inspection findings against factory acceptance, commissioning, and historical baselines. Diagnose complex transformer faults including overheating, abnormal gassing, bushing degradation, winding deformation, and load tap changer failures. Lead transformer commissioning and acceptance testing for complete substations, including energization planning and switching sequences. Direct transformer repair, overhaul, refurbishment and retrofit programs, including LTC overhaul and internal inspection. Lead transformer failure investigations, report findings, and recommend repair, refurbishment, retrofit, or replacement. Define transformer test plans, standards, and acceptance criteria for the region and support their inclusion in the Technical Qualification Program. Interface with engineering and OEMs on transformer design limits, loading, and warranty or return material authorization (RMA) determinations. Field \& Program Leadership Provide technical leadership during outages, turnarounds, and critical recovery events; communicate status, risks, and mitigation plans. Direct testing activities and manage multiple work fronts; lead field crews, contractors, and junior engineers. Approve commissioning documentation and close out actions with customer sign\-off. Mentor and supervise Field Service Engineers and technicians at Levels 1 through 4; review work quality and coach troubleshooting approach. Modernization \& System Integration Lead equipment\-level and system\-level modernization, retrofit, and integration projects. Define execution strategies, risk mitigation plans, and field quality standards for complex programs. Interpret retrofit drawings, relay and control information, and confirm field readiness for execution. Direct corrective maintenance and repair activities, including breaker overhaul support, mechanism adjustments, alignment, lubrication, and component replacement. Safety Leadership Lead on\-site safety briefings and enforce LOTO, arc\-flash, energized work restrictions, job hazard analysis, and permit requirements. Lead root cause investigations, including high\-potential safety events, and drive corrective and preventive actions. Standards, Process \& Customer Enablement Develop and standardize field procedures, commissioning standards, and best practices; support development of the Technical Qualification Program. Coordinate with project managers, engineering, factory, and supply chain on parts identification, RMA/warranty, technical escalations, and root cause analysis. Produce high\-quality field service reports, test records, punch lists, commissioning checklists, and nonconformance documentation. Deliver customer training and knowledge transfer on system operation, basic maintenance, and safety considerations. Identify modernization opportunities and communicate leads through the appropriate channels. Qualifications Required 11\+ years of progressively responsible field experience with MV/HV switchgear, b FRA, partial discharge, or other advanced transformer diagnostic methods. Experience leading transformer failure investigations and refurbishment or retrofit programs. Experience interfacing with power system studies (coordination, short circuit, arc\-flash labeling) and validating them in the field. Familiarity with major relay platforms (e.g., SEL, GE/Multilin, ABB/Hitachi, Siemens) and breaker OEMs. ANSI/NETA ETT Level 4 (Certified Senior Technician), NICET Level IV, or OSHA 30 certification. Core Competencies \& Behaviors *Team members are expected to demonstrate safety, quality, continuous improvement, collaboration, accountability, and customer focus. In addition, this role requires:* Expert\-level troubleshooting across switchgear mechanical, electrical, and protection/control domains. Strong customer communication, including explaining findings, constraints, and corrective actions in clear, non\-technical language. Working knowledge of common test instruments and safe test setups, including validation of calibration status. Strong planning and prioritization; able to manage multiple work fronts during outages. Ability to lead incident response and structured problem solving (5\-Why, fishbone, corrective and preventive actions). Mentoring and coaching capability across all technician levels. Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel) and mobile/field reporting tools. Tools \& Technology Breaker test sets (timing/travel, micro\-ohmmeters), insulation resistance testers (e.g., Megger, Fluke), and hipot/VLF sets as applicable. Relay test sets (e.g., Omicron, Doble) and primary and secondary injection systems. Advanced transformer diagnostic equipment SFRA, dielectric frequency response (DFR), leakage reactance, and partial discharge test sets. Transformer test sets TTR, winding resistance, excitation current, and insulation power factor / tan delta; oil processing plant oversight. Digital multimeters, clamp meters, torque tools, mechanical gauges, and alignment tools. Laptop\-based relay configuration and commissioning software; serial/Ethernet communications tools as applicable. Document control/reporting systems and mobile field service applications. Working Conditions \& Travel Primarily field\-based at customer facilities including industrial plants, utilities, data centers, commercial facilities, and substations. Travel typically 5080% depending on region and workload; may include nights, weekends, and emergency call\-outs on short notice. Participation in the regional on\-call rotation is required. On\-call periods include nights, weekends, and holidays, and require the ability to respond to emergency call\-outs. Project assignments may be long\-duration, typically ranging from several weeks to 12\+ months depending on scope and schedule. Assignments outside the home region are typically worked on a field rotation of three consecutive weeks on site followed by one week in the home office. Work may be performed in confined spaces, on elevated platforms, in hot/cold environments, and around rotating machinery and energized equipment in accordance with safety rules. Must be able to wear required PPE including arc\-rated clothing, hard hat, gloves, safety glasses, hearing protection, and fall protection as needed. Physical Requirements Ability to lift and carry up to 50 lbs (23 kg) and move test equipment and tools. Ability to stand, kneel, bend, climb ladders and stairs, and work at heights for extended periods. Ability to differentiate conductor colors and indicator states and to read instruments and displays. Ability to handle transformer test leads, oil hoses, and oil\-handling equipment, including lifting up to 75 lbs (34 kg) with assistance. Offered compensation: $60/hr \- $68/hr ##### **Experience and License Requirements** * ANSI/NETA ETT Level 4 (optional) * MV/HV switchgear, breakers, and protection and control systems * Transformer field testing and condition assessment (optional) * Valid driver's license
