jobs.title: Software Engineer, ML infrastructure
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ San Francisco; Bellevue; New York **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- On\-site **Department** -------------- Software **Compensation** ---------------- * $175K – $280K **About Sesame** Sesame believes in a future where computers are lifelike \- with the ability to see, hear, and collaborate with us in ways that feel natural and human. With this vision, we're designing a new kind of computer, focused on making voice agents part of our daily lives. Our team brings together founders from Oculus and Ubiquity6, alongside proven leaders from Meta, Google, and Apple, with deep expertise spanning hardware and software. Join us in shaping a future where computers truly come alive. ### **About the role** Sesame trains and serves its own speech and conversational models. Our goal for ML infrastructure is to keep pushing back the limits on what the ML team can do: train what they want at the scale they want, and get it into production, without the platform getting in the way. GPUs are always in high demand, our data keeps growing, and the models we serve have to respond in real time, so getting there will take a lot of clever engineering. We also want the tools to be world class. When someone uses the platform, we want them to notice how well it was built. We're looking for an infrastructure engineer to design and build the systems that make that possible, from the clusters we train on to the platform we serve from. Most of the hard problems today are on the training side, so that's where you'd start, but the role covers serving too. Some of our capacity comes with a managed platform around it. The rest is plain Kubernetes, where we have to create that platform layer ourselves. We want someone with strong opinions about how to do that and the ability to do it. It's a broad role, and you'd have a lot of say in the direction we take. ### **Responsibilities:** * Drive the strategy for our GPU infrastructure across training and serving: clusters, scheduling, storage, and the tooling the ML team uses every day * Design and build the platform the ML team runs on. You decide the architecture and you write the software * Get more out of scarce GPUs. Build the scheduling policy that decides which jobs run when there isn't room for all of them, and make interrupted jobs pick up where they left off * Decide where training data and checkpoints are stored and how they get to the GPUs. Our datasets are large enough that moving them around can get very expensive * Pick the right technology and stand behind it. If self\-hosting a parallel filesystem is the best answer because the cloud's built\-in storage isn't fast enough, make that case with numbers and carry it through * Automate everything you can, especially with agents. Build closed\-loop solutions that cut off toil at the source * Find the bottleneck in a slow training run, whichever layer it's in: checkpoint writes, data loading, the network, one bad node. Fix it with data * Go where the problem is. One quarter that's the training scheduler, the next it's storage, data, or serving * Work with the ML team every day. You're the link between what researchers need and what the software and infrastructure teams build ### **Required qualifications:** * Infrastructure is what you do. You care about scale, reliability, and performance, and you judge your work by how fast the ML team can move * 8\+ years of software engineering experience, with significant time in infrastructure, platform, or ML systems roles. * You've designed and built infrastructure other engineers ran their work on: a scheduler, a compute or storage platform, a cluster control plane. You made the design decisions and wrote the code, and you can name a decision you'd undo if you built it again * You're really good at Kubernetes or a similar compute platform, past the point of using it. You've written controllers or operators, extended a scheduler, or debugged your way into the internals * You've worked hands\-on with GPUs. You can debug them, and you can explain why GPU infrastructure is different from everything else you've run. That experience can come from training, serving, or somewhere else * You know how large\-scale multi\-node training jobs behave, how they fail, and what preemption does to them * You have strong storage fundamentals. You can walk through a real decision where you chose block, object, or a parallel filesystem for a workload, with the throughput and cost numbers behind it * You can say when Kubernetes, Ray, or Slurm is the right base for training and for serving, from having used them * You explain complicated things clearly to people who don't share your background ### **Preferred Qualifications:** * Model serving infrastructure at scale (vLLM, Triton, KServe, or similar) * You've built or run a shared training cluster with a batch scheduler (Volcano, Kueue, Slurm, or similar) * You've built or worked on a GPU cloud or an internal training platform at a company that trains its own models * You've run a parallel filesystem in production (Weka, Lustre, VAST, GPFS) * High\-performance networking for training: RDMA over InfiniBand or RoCE, and NCCL * Enough PyTorch distributed training to debug a job alongside the researcher who wrote it * GCP and GKE * You've been a tech lead and still write code every day * You've gone all in on agentic coding and it shows in how you work Sesame is committed to a workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered. We welcome all qualified applicants, embracing diversity in race, gender, identity, orientation, ability, and more. We provide reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. Contact careers@sesame.com for assistance. **Full\-time Employee Benefits:** * 401 (k) max employer match: 3\.5% of compensation * 100% employer\-paid health, vision, and dental benefits for you and your dependents * Unlimited PTO and sick time * Flexible spending account with employer matching up to $1,650/year (medical FSA) * Guardian Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * Opportunity to share in the company's success with competitive stock options Benefits do not apply to contingent/contract workers. Compensation Range: $175K \- $280K

jobs.title: Software Engineer I, Hardware Test - 6647
jobs.description: Shield AI is seeking a Software Engineer II to build software for automated production test stands that functionally test X\-BAT avionics and aircraft electrical assemblies. You will develop Python applications and reusable components for test sequencing, equipment control, device communication, measurement collection, and traceable test results. You will independently deliver defined software components and test capabilities within an established architecture, from implementation and automated testing through hardware integration and controlled release. You will collaborate with electrical engineers and production users to resolve interface details and improve diagnostics. Senior engineers will provide architectural guidance and review for unfamiliar or higher\-risk changes. **What you'll do** * Design and implement defined test\-software components, including test sequences, instrument interfaces, device communication, and result reporting, within established framework conventions. * Translate documented hardware interfaces and approved test requirements into software behavior, confirming unclear assumptions with electrical and embedded\-software engineers. * Build unit and integration tests using simulated devices and representative hardware; exercise communication failures, invalid measurements, interrupted sequences, and recovery behavior. * Integrate software with fixtures, instrumentation, and units under test, verifying units, scaling, timestamps, and result handling against agreed references and procedures. * Record software versions, hardware configurations, device identifiers, and measurement context needed to reproduce and investigate test results. * Release assigned components through established configuration\-control and deployment workflows, including regression evidence, setup documentation, and recovery instructions. * Diagnose failures in your components and participate in hardware/software investigations; use logs and targeted experiments to separate software defects from equipment, fixture, or device issues. * Improve maintainability and reduce recurring failures within your scope, coordinating software changes with electrical engineers, manufacturing users, and other software owners. **Required qualifications** * Proficiency in Python, including modular software design, exception handling, debugging, and automated testing. * Experience independently delivering a defined software component from requirements through integration and release. * Experience integrating software with a device, instrument, embedded system, or comparable external interface, including handling communication errors and unexpected responses. * Experience using Git, code review, automated tests, and repeatable build or deployment workflows. * Ability to investigate failures across software and external interfaces using logs, documentation, and controlled experiments. * Ability to clarify requirements with technical partners and document interfaces, configuration dependencies, and operating behavior. **Preferred qualifications** * Experience developing software for automated hardware test, manufacturing equipment, robotics, or other hardware\-integrated systems. * Familiarity with Linux, Bash, networking, or instrument\-control libraries. * Experience with C or C\+\+, embedded\-device interfaces, register\-level access, or FPGA\-enabled hardware. * Experience with programmable power supplies, electronic loads, data\-acquisition equipment, digital I/O, or custom fixtures. * Experience with test\-result databases, serial\-number tracking, configuration management, or continuous\-integration pipelines.

jobs.title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer-AWS
jobs.description: #### **Cloud Infrastructure Engineer – AWS** We are seeking an experienced Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to help complete our ongoing migration from on\-premises infrastructure to AWS and support the resulting cloud environment. Substantial migration planning and preparation have already been completed, and the work is continuing with an outside AWS partner. This person will work closely with that partner, our infrastructure team, and experienced DevOps engineers. We are looking for someone who can step into the work already underway, contribute directly to the remaining migration, and take increasing responsibility for our AWS environment. #### **Location** This is a full\-time, hybrid position based in our Milwaukee, Wisconsin office, requiring one day per week in the office. #### **Core Responsibilities** * Assess the existing AWS environment, migration plans, and work completed to date. * Help carry the onpremisestoAWS migration through implementation, cutover, stabilization, and completion. * Work closely with our AWS partner, infrastructure team, and experienced DevOps engineers throughout the migration. * Design, build, secure, maintain, and troubleshoot production AWS infrastructure. * Maintain and extend the AWS multiaccount and landingzone environment. * Support the hybrid environment while onpremises and AWS systems operate concurrently. * Implement infrastructure changes through configuration, Infrastructure as Code, and controlled deployment processes. * Identify technical risks, dependencies, and operational requirements before changes are introduced into production. * Document the AWS environment, architectural decisions, operational procedures, and recovery processes. * Build the internal knowledge needed to manage the AWS environment as reliance on the outside partner decreases. * Assume increasing responsibility for the continued operation, security, reliability, and development of the AWS environment. Required Qualifications #### **Core Experience** * Direct, handson responsibility for migrating production systems from onpremises environments to AWS. * Strong handson experience designing, building, securing, and operating production AWS environments. * Experience joining an AWS migration already underway, understanding previous work and architectural decisions, and helping carry the migration through completion. * Experience evaluating workloads and determining appropriate migration approaches, including rehosting, replatforming, refactoring, retaining, or retiring systems. * Experience working effectively with outside AWS or cloud partners during migration and implementation efforts. #### **AWS Infrastructure and Architecture** * Experience with AWS networking, including VPCs, routing, Transit Gateway, VPN, DNS, and network security. * Experience with AWS multiaccount environments, AWS Organizations, organizational units, and landingzone architecture. * Experience with AWS Landing Zone Accelerator, AWS Control Tower, or a comparable landingzone framework. * Experience supporting hybrid onpremises and AWS environments, including networking, identity, DNS, security, and connectivity. * Strong knowledge of AWS compute, storage, databases, monitoring, logging, backup and recovery, high availability, and resiliency. * Ability to evaluate an existing AWS architecture and determine how it should evolve as additional workloads move to the cloud. * Ability to troubleshoot complex infrastructure, configuration, connectivity, and deployment problems. #### **Security** * Strong understanding of AWS security, including IAM, leastprivilege access, permission boundaries, federated access, encryption, logging and monitoring, and network security. * Experience implementing and maintaining AWS security policies and controls across a multiaccount environment. * Strong experience with AWS security services such as AWS Config, GuardDuty, Security Hub, IAM Access Analyzer, Network Firewall, Firewall Manager, or comparable tools. * Ability to incorporate security into infrastructure and architectural decisions while considering operational impact and longterm maintainability. #### **Infrastructure Automation and DevOps** * Strong Infrastructure as Code experience using AWS CloudFormation and AWS CDK * Experience with infrastructure automation, CI/CD pipelines, configuration management, version control, monitoring, and repeatable deployment processes. * Experience validating infrastructure changes through controlled, reviewable deployment processes. * Comfortable working alongside experienced DevOps engineers and complementing their application, deployment, and automation expertise with AWS infrastructure, architecture, security, and operational knowledge. * Handson technically and capable of implementing and troubleshooting infrastructure rather than functioning solely as an architect or advisor. #### **Experience** * Five or more years of progressively responsible cloud or infrastructure engineering experience. * Three or more years of substantial handson AWS experience. * Direct responsibility for production AWS environments. * Ability to explain technical risks, tradeoffs, dependencies, and recommendations clearly. * Effective technical documentation and written and verbal communication skills. Preferred Qualifications #### **AWS Certifications** #### **Relevant AWS certifications preferred, particularly:** * AWS Certified Solutions Architect * AWS Certified Security * AWS Certified DevOps Engineer #### **Comparable experience may include:** * Designing and operating complex production AWS environments. * Serving in a lead technical role on major AWS implementations. * Direct responsibility for production onpremisestoAWS migrations. * Significant AWS consulting or professionalservices experience. * Previous AWS engineering, architecture, or technical consulting experience. #### **Additional Strengths** * Experience working for AWS, an AWS Partner, cloud consultancy, managed service provider, or professionalservices organization involving multiple AWS migrations. * Experience with AWS Application Migration Service, AWS Database Migration Service, AWS Migration Hub, or comparable migration tools. * Experience with Azure DevOps, including CI/CD pipelines and secure integration with AWS. * Experience integrating AWS IAM Identity Center with Microsoft Entra ID or comparable identity platforms. * Experience planning or implementing disaster recovery and multiregion capabilities. * Familiarity with Microsoft/.NET application environments. * Experience with AWS AI services or the implementation of AI workloads. * Experience working in a smaller technical organization where infrastructure responsibilities cross traditional boundaries. #### **What We Offer** This is an opportunity to take an important role in a cloud migration already well underway. You will work with experienced infrastructure and DevOps professionals and an outside AWS partner while helping build the internal capability to support the AWS environment going forward. We offer a competitive compensation package including paid time off, medical benefits, and a 401(k) retirement plan. How to Apply #### **Please submit:** * Resume * Cover letter describing your AWS infrastructure and migration experience Qualified applicants will be asked to discuss the AWS migrations for which they held direct technical responsibility, including their specific role, the environment migrated, and the work they personally performed. #### **About Shoreland Inc** Shoreland, Inc. is the leading global provider of time\-sensitive, decision\-relevant travel and environmental medicine risk information. We specialize in providing analyses and recommendations to health care providers for use during pre\-travel medical consultations. Primary users are medical directors and other clinical personnel responsible for the health, safety, and medical needs of travelers and those posted overseas. Shoreland, Inc. is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, physical or mental disability, or any other characteristic prohibited by state or local law.

jobs.title: Designer III
jobs.description: **Sierra Space Careers:** ========================= At Sierra Space, we build the missions and systems that keep our world secure in the domain above Earth. Sierra Space team members share a spirit of innovation and collaboration and a belief that we can deliver on the boldest missions in space today. Together with our customers, we aim to safeguard our nation, sustain human presence in space, and secure the freedom of operations in low Earth orbit and beyond. Our success is measured by the trust of those who rely on what we build and deliver, and our technologies keep the United States and its allies mission\-ready throughout space. We are mission\-driven, and together, we are an extraordinary team. **About the Role** ================== Designer III is responsible for creating and modifying detailed drawings using CAD software from sketches, layouts, or notes provided by engineering. Responsibilities include performing independent design checks for standard parts or assemblies, proposing corrective actions, and interpreting complex drawings and 3D models. The role requires a comprehensive understanding of engineering principles and practices, creativity to find innovative solutions, advanced CAD and design skills, and effective problem\-solving abilities. In this role, you will effectively use CAD tools to produce and modify complex component and assembly 3D models and detail drawings. You will perform independent design checks for standard parts or assemblies, ensuring accuracy and compliance with engineering standards, and create and maintain an organized structure of all design\-related configuration management items within related PLM systems such as Teamcenter. Collaborating with engineers and other team members, you will contribute to the creation of innovative designs, resolve design issues, and improve design processes. You will demonstrate effective problem\-solving abilities that contribute to the timely evolution of viable and innovative designs. Additionally, you will ensure that 3D models and drawings incorporate all design features and maintain adherence to applicable MBD and GD\&T methods and standards. Interpreting complex drawings and 3D models, you will ensure design integrity and manufacturability while supporting engineering with component and assembly\-level manufacturability assessments and tolerance analyses.**About You** ============= Our mission is driven by an unyielding commitment to advancing space\-based technology in service of our customers and safeguarding national security. We seek individuals who are passionate about innovating beyond boundaries and relentlessly pursuing solutions that protect, preserve and empower – to join us in this critical mission. We’re looking for team members who align with our values, mission and goals – while also meeting the minimum qualifications below. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. **Minimum Qualifications:** --------------------------- * Typically 5\+ years of related experience. * Comprehensive understanding of engineering principles and practices. * Advanced CAD and design skills, proficient in interpreting complex drawings and 3D models. * Experienced with one or more Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems. * Effective problem\-solving abilities. * Experience performing independent design checks for standard parts or assemblies. * A proficient understanding of Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD\&T) principles. **Preferred Qualifications:** ----------------------------- * Proficiency with engineering software tools such as NX and SolidWorks, including advanced understanding of detail drawing standards and GD\&T. * Experience working designs within Teamcenter PLM. * Experience performing design checks of CAD, drawings, and PLM data authored by others to ensure compliance with company and industry standards. * Knowledge of advanced manufacturing techniques, including additive manufacturing and CNC machining. * Experience in the aerospace or defense industry, particularly with design and development of aerospace systems and components. * Strong attention to detail with effective organizational skills. * Excellent technical documentation and report writing skills. * Excellent communication, collaboration, and teamwork abilities. * Working knowledge of material science, including composites and high\-performance alloys. **Compensation****:** --------------------- Pay Range: $75,205\.00 \- $103,405\.75 Your actual base compensation will be determined on a case\-by\-case basis and may vary based on job\-related knowledge and skills, education, experience, internal equity and market competitiveness. **Elevate Your Career** ======================= At Sierra Space, we are committed to your personal and professional development. We empower you to make profound and meaningful contributions and foster a vibrant culture of collaboration, where teamwork ignites breakthrough innovations. We also offer a generous benefit package, including medical, dental, and vision plans, 401(k) with 150% match up to 6%, life insurance, 3 weeks paid time off, and more. Sierra Space is an industry\-leading space and defense technology company providing satellites, spacecraft, and enabling mission systems and components. We deliver mission\-proven technologies to our customers that safeguard our nation, protect space\-based assets and enable space exploration. *Application Deadline: This role will remain posted until a qualified pool of candidates is* *identified.* ***Please note: Sierra Space does not accept unsolicited resumes from contract agencies or search firms. Any unsolicited resumes submitted to our website or to Sierra Space team members not through our approved vendor list or Talent Acquisition will be considered property of Sierra Space, and we will not be obligated to pay any referral fees.*** Sierra Space Corporation is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities. If you need special assistance or a reasonable accommodation related to applying for employment with Sierra Space or at any stage of the recruitment process, please contact us. ### **About Us** **About Sierra Space** ====================== Headquartered in Colorado, Sierra Space is a mission\-proven Defense Tech company delivering satellite platforms, critical subsystems, reusable spaceplanes, hypersonic technologies, propulsion systems, and infrastructure for the nation’s most critical missions. With more than three decades of heritage and a record of flight\-proven success in space, Sierra Space is trusted by U.S. National Security, Civil customers, and global allies. Our technologies safeguard our nation, sustain human exploration in space, and ensure the freedom of operations beyond Earth. Sierra Space is defining the new era of Space Defense, strengthening deterrence today and preserving freedom of action for generations to come.

primarily on\-site** in our Richmond, Virginia, offices, with occasional flexibility for remote work when business needs allow. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with **macOS** and **Windows** Workspace** and **Microsoft 365** administration. * Experience with collaboration tools like **Zoom**, **Google Meet**, and **Slack**. * Knowledge of **Jira Service Desk** and **Jira** for IT service center technology stacks**, including **phone systems**, **CRM software**, and **agent support tools**. * Experience with **live event production** or **collaboration tooling**. **What Values You'll to achieving success. * Lift As We Climb \- Investing in developing others and helping others around us succeed. * Lean \& Nimble \- Working with agility and efficiency to experiment in an often ambiguous environment. **What We Offer** * A mission\- and values\-driven culture and a safe, inclusive environment where you can build, grow and thrive * A comprehensive total rewards package that jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer I, Agent Engineering (Remote Eligible)
jobs.description: For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it's what we show up for every day. Smart Assist is Smartsheet's AI agent for work management, used by enterprise customers to analyze, create, and act on their work. Agent Engineering owns the runtime layer behind it: the orchestrator, core sub\-agents, memory, context management, and the MCP integration that ties it together. We are accountable for how the agent thinks, acts, and remembers in production. We build the agent harness as a reusable platform so other teams can build, integrate, and evaluate agents on a shared foundation. We work four ways: **harness engineering** (tuning the agent loop for quality, latency, and cost), **capability expansion** (core agents, skills, and tools), **platformizing** (shared components and patterns), and **keeping it running** (on\-call, security, cost, and access controls). **The role.** You will own a significant part of the Smart Assist runtime (for example orchestration and agent loops, memory and context, long\-running execution, or model readiness) and shape how agents are built on our harness through design reviews and guilds. You will make architecture calls, raise the bar for the team, and make it possible for other teams to build agents on the platform without us in the critical path. **You Will:** ------------- * Own the design and evolution of an area of the runtime, including trade\-offs between model decisions at runtime and deterministic code, and between prompt/context fixes and structural ones. * Lead harness engineering at depth: long\-running and durable execution, checkpoints and persistent plans, inline and multi\-agent patterns, memory architecture, model swaps, and cost and latency control at scale. * Drive platformization: define the reusable components, shared libraries, intent routing, agent registry and integration patterns that let other teams build and integrate agents quickly, and drive adoption across teams. * Shape the multi\-agent architecture and the convergence of existing and new agents into one experience. * Define how quality is measured and enforced: offline gating, online monitoring, and the prompt\-analysis loop, working with AI Platform on the shared evals platform. * Own operational excellence for Smart Assist: on\-call health, post\-incident reviews, security posture (including prompt injection and permission\-aware access), cost control, and entitlement and access correctness. * Lead through POCs and ambiguity: frame problems, run time\-boxed experiments, write decisions down, and bring the team and partners along. * Mentor SE I and II engineers through design and code review; help hire and onboard. Use AI tools in incident and on\-call work, and show teammates how. * Partner with the EM, PMs, AI Experiences, AI Platform, MCP, and external partners on roadmap and dependencies. **You Have:** ------------- * 5\+ years building and operating production systems, with deep Python and strong system design (distributed systems, durable state and long\-running workflows, APIs, data modeling). * 2\+ years building LLM agent systems in production, with real opinions from experience on context engineering, subagents, memory, tool design, async or deferred tools, and failure recovery. * Track record of designing evals that gate releases and of attributing production failures to the right layer (model, prompt, tool contract, context, environment), using calibrated LLM judges and online behavioral signals. * Experience building shared platforms or libraries that other teams adopt, and of influencing without authority. * Experience with MCP and agent skills or tools at scale; familiarity with agent\-to\-agent and multi\-agent patterns. * Experience operating AI systems in production: observability, cost management, security and safety patterns (prompt injection mitigation, output validation, grounding, permission\-aware retrieval). * Fluency with AI\-assisted development and a point of view on how it changes engineering practice. * Strong written and verbal communication; able to explain trade\-offs to executives and to engineers. * Legally eligible to work in the U.S. on an ongoing basis. * **Strong plus:** model evaluation and swap tooling; Databricks or lakehouse data work; enterprise SaaS, permissions and entitlements; prior mentoring or tech\-lead experience. **What success looks like:** ---------------------------- * *First 90 days:* understand the runtime and its failure modes, ship a meaningful improvement in your area, and publish a design or decision doc the team adopts. * *First 6 months:* deliver a measurable gain in reliability, latency, or cost per task in your area; land a reusable pattern or component adopted by at least one other team; and mentor at least one engineer to a visible growth step. **Why this role:** ------------------ * You own how Smart Assist behaves in production, with real users and a measurable quality bar, not a supporting slot on someone else's roadmap. * The problems are distinctive: enterprise\-grade permissions and security, and one agent experience that works across a broad work\-management product used by thousands of customers. * You build the harness as a platform. Other teams build on what you create, so your work multiplies across the product. * You work on the hard parts of production agents: long\-running work, memory, context, and cost, on a team that values engineering rigor and diverse perspectives. **Get to Know Us:** At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You'll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. jobs.title: Software Engineer II, AI Experience (Remote Eligible)

On the backend, the orchestrator routes each request to the right sub\-agent based on user intent, keeps conversation state across multi\-turn interactions, handles fallbacks when sub\-agents are unavailable, and controls feature\-flagged rollout of new capabilities. We partner closely with Agent Engineering on much of this logic. **The role.** You will own features and components of Smart Assist from prototype to production, across the front end, the orchestrator and back\-end services. You will turn ambiguous product asks into reliable, well\-measured behavior customers can trust, and work with product, design, and AI Experience to ship. **You Will:** ------------- * Own a core piece of the Smartsheet AI experience, or a significant part of one (for example conversational analytics, chart\-to\-dashboard creation, or a new entry point into the assistant) from design through production. * Build full\-stack: user\-facing components, the services behind them, and the contracts between the two, with typed APIs, clear error states, and tests. * Design and ship agent tools, skills, MCP tools, and MCP Apps with contracts the model can use reliably, and decide when an action belongs in a tool, a service, or the model. * Shape how agent output appears to users: streaming responses, loading and failure states, and handling of long or partial results, working with design and product. * Build and evolve the Smart Assist orchestrator: intent\-based routing to sub\-agents, multi\-turn conversation state, fallback and degradation handling, and feature\-flag rollout of new capabilities, partnering closely with Agent Engineering. You would help define the trust model for that experience from real customer learnings and feedback. **You Have:** ------------- * 2–4 years of professional software engineering shipping production systems. * Strong in Python and/or TypeScript/React, with good habits in testing, code review, and debugging. * Experience building and shipping customer\-facing features end to end, including APIs, data modeling, and user\-facing behavior. * 1\+ years building LLM\-powered features in production: tool or function calling, agent loops, prompt and context design, or multi\-step workflows. * Working knowledge of how agents fail (bad tool choice, context overflow, hallucinated arguments, runaway cost) and how to design around it. * Experience designing eval scorers and golden datasets, and using results to make and defend a decision. * Experience with MCP tools and MCP Apps, structured tool calling, or reusable agent skills. * Comfort with production observability and with data\-heavy environments (Databricks or equivalent). * Evidence of using AI coding agents to ship faster without lowering the quality bar. * Clear communication of quality, cost, and reliability findings to technical and non\-technical audiences. * Legally eligible to work in the U.S. on an ongoing basis. **Strong plus:** ---------------- Experience with conversational or chat UI at scale; prompt\-injection mitigation and output validation. **What success looks like:** ---------------------------- * *First 90 days:* ship a feature or improvement to production with eval coverage, and take your first on\-call rotation. * *First 6 months:* own a feature or significant part of a project with measured gains in task success, latency, or user adoption, and contribute at least one reusable component or pattern. **Why this role:** ------------------ * You build the Smart Assist experience used by enterprise customers, with real users and a measurable quality bar. * You work across the stack, from the interface to the agent tools behind it, so you see your work reach customers end to end. * The problems are distinctive: enterprise\-grade permissions and security, and one assistant that works across a broad work\-management product. * You work on the hard parts of production agents, on a team that values engineering rigor and diverse perspectives. **Get to Know Us:** At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: **About Sol** ------------- Sol is an agentic HR system built for how work is changing. We're replacing the traditional HRIS with an AI\-native foundation. We are built for change, designed to scale, and reimagined with AI from the ground up, so HR leaders get a clear view of their workforce instead of a system everyone works around. At Sol, we're guided by three things: **people:** we hire driven, humble people and build to amplify their potential and our customers'; **imagination:** we challenge assumptions about our industry and how software gets built, then move fast once we've decided; and **durability:** we sweat the details to build a company that is meant to last. Day to day, that shows up as a bias toward writing things down over meetings, async communication by default, and flexible hours that respect how differently everyone works. We try new things, kill what isn't working, and hold a high bar without the politics or ego that slow good decisions down. Sol was founded by leaders who spent decades building the modern HR category, and is backed by Sutter Hill Ventures and NEA. Our first customers go live in early 2027 and we need you to make them wildly successful. **The Role** ------------ You'll build Sol's product surface end to end — from backend services and APIs to the modern, AI\-native interfaces our customers use. The product is early and the surface area is wide: you'll regularly ship features that span data model to UI, working closely with the founding team and our domain architects. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Build product features across the stack: Kotlin/JVM backend services, APIs, and the frontend experiences they power * Build dynamic, data\-driven interfaces that adapt to each customer rather than static layouts * Build conversational and agent\-mediated experiences alongside traditional enterprise UI * Contribute to the component and API patterns the product scales on * Move fast with AI\-assisted development as a first\-class part of how we build **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * You have deep backend experience in Kotlin or Java — services, APIs, and data models that hold up in production — and you design for composition, not one\-off use * You understand your tools below the surface: JVM behavior, concurrency, data access patterns, where performance actually goes to die * You're comfortable crossing into the frontend — working TypeScript familiarity and the willingness to ship UI, not just hand off an API * You want breadth — features that run from data model to pixels — and the ambiguity that comes with shaping an early product * You use AI coding tools daily and have developed real fluency with them — this is how we work, not an experiment * You're scrappy, curious, and want the ownership that comes with an early team **Why Now** ----------- The product is at the stage where one engineer's work is visible everywhere: the patterns you establish this year are the ones thousands of enterprise users will live in. jobs.title: Senior QA Engineer, Firmware and Hardware in the Loop
jobs.description: **Senior QA Engineer, Firmware and Hardware in the Loop** ========================================================= Somewear's software platform and satellite\-powered hardware enable commercial and government teams to maintain situational awareness during high\-pressure operations, in any environment. Somewear serves a wide range of customers including helicopter paramedics, backcountry explorers, firefighters, and operators within the US Department of Defense. Our purpose is to build best\-in\-class solutions that keep people in touch, informed, and safe anywhere in the world. We're looking for a Senior QA Engineer to own quality for the firmware that runs on our satellite hardware. Today our firmware and hardware teams have almost no dedicated QA support, which means our embedded engineers spend weeks running manual regression cycles instead of building. You will change that. You will stand up the hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL) test rigs, automate the regression suites that currently eat engineering time, and become the person the firmware team relies on to know whether a build is ready to ship. This is a hands\-on individual contributor role with unusually broad ownership. You will be the first dedicated QA engineer on the hardware side, so you get to define how firmware quality works here rather than inherit someone else's process. **Join us to make an impact** "Recently, the United States Air National Guard 131st Rescue Squadron successfully employed Somewear's unique ATAK integration to coordinate and monitor a civilian rescue operation 1,200 miles off the U.S. Pacific coast. The consistent communications and situational awareness across rescue personnel, medical personnel, aircrafts, and the operations center led to an efficient rescue mission that took half of the expected time to complete." **What you'll do** * Own firmware QA end to end, covering both manual regression and automation * Design, build, and maintain hardware\-in\-the\-loop test rigs that exercise real devices against real firmware * Replace manual regression cycles with automated test suites, freeing embedded engineers to stay on development * Write scripts, primarily in Python, that drive test execution and capture logs from multiple sources * Correlate logs across debug probes and device interfaces, including SEGGER J\-Link and ADB, to isolate root cause on failures that span firmware, radio, and app layers * Partner directly with the firmware and electrical engineering teams on testability, instrumentation, and release criteria * Define and own the release validation gate for firmware builds * Expand coverage over time into our Unmanned (Horizon) product line as that program matures * Build the tooling and process that let firmware QA scale past one person, and help scope and onboard the next QA hire on hardware **Required experience** * 5\+ years in QA or test engineering, with substantial time spent testing embedded firmware on physical hardware * Direct hardware\-in\-the\-loop experience. This is the single most important qualification for this role * Proficiency scripting test automation and log analysis, ideally in Python * Fluency on the command line and with embedded debug tooling such as JTAG or SWD probes and ADB * Track record of building automated test coverage from scratch, not only executing existing test plans * Demonstrated ownership of a test strategy end to end, defined by you rather than handed to you * Ability to reason independently about risk, coverage, and when a build is good enough to ship, and to hold that position under shipping pressure * Clear written communication with engineers, product, and leadership * Comfort working with AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow **Nice to have** * HIL experience on unmanned systems: iron birds, flight simulation, or vehicle\-in\-the\-loop setups * Background at a drone, robotics, or autonomous vehicle company * Experience with satellite communications, LoRa or mesh networking, or low\-power IoT devices * Experience with mission\-critical or regulated software and hardware development * Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and how hardware test stages fit into them * Background in defense or emergency response * Experience working with government customers * Knowledge of ATAK or similar tactical systems **Location** This role is based in our San Francisco office, where the test rigs live and where you will sit alongside our Firmware Engineers. Chicago is a secondary option for an exceptional candidate, with the advantage of closer proximity to bare boards, production samples, and the electrical engineering team. **Growth** You are joining as the first dedicated QA engineer on the hardware side, which means the shape of this function is yours to define. As Somewear scales you will have the option to grow into leading the QA organization, to move deeper into test infrastructure and tooling, or to work directly with customers on the most technically demanding deployments. **What you'll love about Somewear** * A competitive and equitable compensation plan. This is a full\-time, salaried position that includes equity. * Physical well\-being including health, dental and vision benefits. * Focus Days: No meetings every Monday to allow you to focus and operate at your best * Unlimited PTO * Flexible parental leave * Ownership of a quality function that does not exist yet, on hardware that people depend on in emergencies * Work with an ambitious team solving complex technical challenges * Direct access to senior leadership and significant impact on company growth * Opportunity to develop solutions that save lives * An authentic investment in you as a human being and your career as a professional **Salary range** * San Francisco: $150,000 \- $165,000 per year * Chicago: $145,000 \- $160,000 per year **Note: U.S. Citizens or Green Card holders ONLY. Please only if you meet this requirement.**

jobs.title: Founding Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)
jobs.description: **About StackOne** StackOne is the integration infrastructure for AI agents. Backed by GV and Workday Ventures ($24M raised), we make it possible for any AI agent — whether our customers build it into their product or buy it off the shelf — to take real action across the enterprise stack. Our platform gives agents 630\+ connectors and 43,000\+ pre\-built actions, an AI connector builder for everything not covered yet, and the production layer agents actually need: semantic tool discovery that cuts token use by up to 80%, managed authentication and per\-action permissions, the most accurate prompt injection defense on the market, and end\-to\-end observability. Join us on our fast trajectory to build the future of agentic integrations. **About The Role** ------------------ We're hiring our first **Forward Deployed Engineer** to help our customers decide where AI agents will make a measurable difference to their business, and then make sure it happens. You'll sit with executives and their teams, learn how the business runs day to day, and turn that into an AI strategy and rollout plan tied to the number they care about, whether that's hours saved, cost per process or revenue. You'll design the agents, guide our Solutions Engineers as they build them, and stay with the customer until the agreed results are in. We're starting with healthcare, our fastest\-growing vertical. Knowing its systems, its data and its compliance rules will be a big part of the job. You'll report to our CEO \& Co\-Founder, and work from our San Mateo office 1 to 2 days a week, with regular travel to customer sites across the US. **What You’ll Be Doing** ------------------------ * Run discovery with C\-level leaders, managers and their teams: walk through their processes, map workflows and data, and find what AI agents can automate or improve. * Build a strategy and rollout plan for each customer, tied to the metric their business cares about, and present it to their leadership. * Design the agents, skills and plugins that deliver the plan, including inside tools like Microsoft Copilot, Glean and Gemini Enterprise, and steer the Solutions Engineers who build and maintain them. * Track impact once agents are live, with dashboards that show the time saved or the metric agreed with the customer. * Scope and price consulting engagements, and grow each account from the first phase to the next as customers adopt more of StackOne. * Join our most strategic deals before the sale to run consultative workshops, often onsite. * Become our go\-to expert in healthcare: the systems and APIs worth connecting, HIPAA and BAA scope, and where patient data lives. * Bring what you learn back to Product, and decide what should become a connector, feature or template. * Build our reputation in the vertical through talks, white papers, case studies and community work. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * Experience advising clients on strategy, as a consultant, solutions architect or product manager, ideally across several companies adopting AI. The title matters less than the work you've done with customers. * Hands\-on experience building and deploying AI agents (with agent SDKs or via low code platforms), and ways of optimising and measuring accuracy \& efficiency of agentic workflows, enough to judge what's worth building and to review someone else's build. You check what AI\-generated work actually does before anyone relies on it. * Healthcare experience: you understand how providers, payers or labs work, which systems they run on, and the compliance rules around their data. * Executive presence. You present to C\-level with confidence, listen well, and write a proposal a CEO will sign. * A commercial mindset: you tie a technical plan to revenue, savings or growth, and you can price the work. * Strong organisation, with follow\-up that customers and colleagues can count on. * Low ego and high initiative. You come up with ideas, share credit, and help the people around you understand why the work matters. * Comfort working on your own as the first person in a new role, ideally with experience in early\-stage or fast\-growing startups. * Based in the Bay Area, happy to travel to customer sites, and happy to start early some days to overlap with our London team. Nice to have: built agents for customers in an AI agent framework, Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, Glean or Gemini Enterprise or similar; healthcare IT experience such as EHR integrations (Epic, Oracle Health), FHIR, HL7 v2, LIMS, or claims and billing systems; hands\-on API work (REST, webhooks, OAuth) in Python or TypeScript; experience leading a team or a vertical; talks or writing on AI adoption. **Dealbreaker:** no experience advising clients at a senior level, or no hands\-on experience building with AI. **Our Stack** ------------- We're pragmatic about tooling. Today's stack includes: * AI tools our customers roll out: Microsoft Copilot, Glean, Gemini Enterprise, Claude. * Agent frameworks our customers use: OpenAI Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, Pydantic AI, LangChain, CrewAI. * Agent protocols: MCP, A2A and common agent optimisations (code mode, RLM). * Infrastructure \& monitoring: AWS, Cloudflare, Kubernetes, Pydantic, Datadog. * Languages: TypeScript (Node.js) and Python. * How we build: coding agents (Claude Code, Codex etc.), with skills, plugins and agentic automations/internal agents we maintain ourselves. **Benefits** ------------ * Join one of the best\-funded, fastest\-growing startups in the AI infrastructure ecosystem. * Work alongside an experienced team, with backgrounds from Google, Microsoft, Oracle, Coinbase, JP Morgan, and more. * Meaningful share options — share in the company's success as we grow. * 25 days PTO \+ 1 additional day per year of tenure. * Up to 30 days per year working from abroad, with optional co\-working space paid for from your remote setup allowance. * Health insurance. * 401(k). * Remote\-first, with regular in\-person time in the Bay Area. * $1,000 for your home office setup \+ $500/year top\-up. * Annual team offsites to sunny spots (last ones were in Croatia and Portugal ) Ready to help us change the game for SaaS integrations? Get in touch and let's chat! *We believe diversity drives innovation. We encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply. As an equal\-opportunity employer, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.* Compensation Range: $192K \- $240K

As a Bridge Asset Data Management Engineer, you will help maintain and improve the quality of Nebraska's bridge inventory, perform engineering data analysis, and support decisions affecting bridge safety, investment, and asset management. This position plays an important role in federal reporting compliance and provides technical support to bridge engineers, inspectors, local bridge owners, and agency leadership. We are seeking an individual who enjoys solving problems, working with complex information, and identifying opportunities to improve processes and outcomes. The position offers opportunities for professional development, collaboration with industry experts, and participation in the continued advancement of bridge engineering and asset management practices. Depending on qualifications, the position may be filled at the Professional Engineer I or Engineer level. Qualifications for the various levels are listed in the Requirements/ Qualifications section below. Pay range for the Professional Engineer I classification is $36\.443 \- $53\.722 per hour. The pay rate is commensurate with education and/or experience within fiscal constraints, if approved. Pay rate for the Engineer classification is $31\.968 per hour. Employee may be promoted to the Professional Engineer I classification upon acquiring the necessary certifications, to include professional licensure, and demonstration of skills. **Job Duties:** * Maintain and update Nebraska's bridge inventory using inspection reports, construction records, engineering plans, and other technical documentation. * Review and validate bridge inventory data for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and compliance with the National Bridge Inspection Standards (NBIS), Specifications for the National Bridge Inventory (SNBI), and applicable federal reporting requirements. * Apply professional engineering judgment to evaluate bridge inventory information, identify technical inconsistencies, and coordinate appropriate corrections with responsible engineering and inspection personnel. * Research bridge plans, construction records, and rehabilitation documentation to establish and maintain accurate bridge inventory information. * Perform engineering analysis of bridge inventory and condition data to support preservation strategies, bridge management, performance evaluation, and infrastructure investment decisions. * Develop reports, maps, visualizations, and analytical tools using AASHTOWare Bridge Management (BrM), GIS, databases, and other software applications. * Provide bridge inventory data and technical analysis to support load rating evaluations, bridge design, inspection planning, and other Bridge Division functions. * Assist in developing and maintaining bridge inventory procedures, coding guidance, data quality processes, and supporting technical documentation. * Coordinate with NDOT staff, consultants, local bridge owners, and federal partners regarding bridge inventory data, reporting requirements, and quality assurance. * Monitor significant changes to bridge inventory information, maintain appropriate documentation, and communicate changes affecting bridge management and engineering activities. * Identify opportunities to improve data management practices through technology, process improvements, automation, and analytical methods. * Provide technical guidance and training to NDOT personnel and local bridge owners regarding bridge inventory data and associated systems. Perform other duties as assigned. * **Requirements / Qualifications:** **Minimum Qualifications:** Professional Engineer I: Bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline. Must possess a Professional Engineer (P.E.) license at the time of application and be licensed by the Nebraska Board of Engineers and Architects at time of employment or be able to obtain such license within 90 days of employment. Engineer: Bachelor’s degree in an Engineering discipline. Must pass the Fundamentals of Engineering Exam (FE) within one year of employment. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Bachelor's or master's degree in civil engineering, structural engineering, or a related engineering discipline. * Experience in bridge engineering, bridge inspection, infrastructure asset management, or engineering data analysis. * Familiarity with the National Bridge Inspection Standards (NBIS), Specifications for the National Bridge Inventory (SNBI), and bridge inventory coding practices. * Experience using AASHTOWare Bridge Management (BrM), GIS applications, or similar engineering asset management systems. * Experience with data analysis, database management, and programming or analytical tools such as SQL, Python, VBA, or similar applications. * Additional education or experience in data science, statistics, computer science, or information management. * Experience evaluating engineering data to inform infrastructure preservation, planning, and investment decisions. **Other:** * If filling at the Engineer level, degree must be from an EAC/ABET or CEAB(Canada)\-accredited engineering program OR meet the NCEES Engineering Education Standard. * This position is based in Lincoln, Nebraska, at NDOT's Central Headquarters. * Must possess a valid driver's license with a satisfactory driving record or provide authorized independent transportation. Occasional travel, including overnight travel, may be required for meetings, training, and coordination activities. * **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:** * Knowledge of civil and structural engineering principles, bridge construction and maintenance practices, bridge inspection procedures, and infrastructure asset management concepts. * Understanding of engineering data quality, analytical methods, and applicable federal and state bridge inventory requirements. * Ability to interpret engineering plans, inspection reports, and technical documentation; organize and analyze complex data; identify inconsistencies; and develop technically sound conclusions and recommendations. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, attention to detail, and proficiency with computer applications are important. * Ability to work independently and collaboratively, manage competing priorities, communicate technical information effectively, and provide guidance to engineers, inspectors, consultants, and local bridge owners. jobs.title: Data Analytics and Systems Engineer - 61167724
jobs.description: **Job Responsibilities** ------------------------ ***The mission of the South Carolina Department of Education (SCDE) is to serve students, support teachers, empower parents, and engage the community so that every student graduates prepared to reach their full potential.*** **About the Role** SCDE is seeking a data engineer to support Education Scholarship Trust Fund (ESTF) modernization and the agency’s education data systems. The primary responsibility is to build reliable pipelines that connect governed source files, including vendor assessment files, the Ed\-Fi API, and a Snowflake/dbt longitudinal data warehouse. The engineer will use Earthmover, an open\-source Python package, to transform vendor and other CSV files into Ed\-Fi API\-compliant JSON, and Lightbeam to validate and send those records to the API. The role includes writing, testing, and maintaining reusable assessment bundles that bring vendor assessment results into the statewide data system. Reports, dashboards, and visualizations are a required secondary responsibility once the pipeline is established. This position requires familiarity with interoperable data ecosystems, a strong interest in connecting systems, and the ability to work with urgency. A working, tested, and documented end\-to\-end product is expected within eight months of starting. **What You’ll Do** * **Build and maintain data pipelines.** Transform governed CSV and other tabular files into Ed\-Fi\-compliant JSON using Earthmover, and validate and publish records through Lightbeam. * **Analyze vendor assessment files.** Study each vendor’s file layout and data dictionary, decide which fields are required or optional, and build an anonymized sample file for testing. Meet with vendors and program offices to understand assessments and file changes. * **Model assessments in Ed\-Fi.** Decide how a vendor’s tests, sub\-tests, scores, performance levels, grade levels, and subjects map to Ed\-Fi resources and descriptors (Assessment, ObjectiveAssessment, StudentAssessment, StudentObjectiveAssessment). Present the mapping for review under Ed\-Fi assessment governance practices. * **Write assessment bundles.** Start from the template bundle and build the full package: seed files for reference data such as descriptors and objective assessments; the earthmover.yaml configuration (sources, transformations such as joins, date conversion and derived IDs, and destinations); and the JSON templates that produce each Ed\-Fi record. Use SQL, Jinja, and Python (and dbt where appropriate) to make transformations repeatable. * **Match students correctly.** Configure and test student ID crosswalking against the Ed\-Fi roster, review unmatched\-student reports, and work with districts and vendors to resolve ID problems. * **Run, test, and send the data.** Run each bundle on sample and production\-sized files, reconcile record counts, and spot\-check values against the source file. Use Lightbeam to send records to the Ed\-Fi API in dependency order (assessments first, student results last), manage API credentials securely, read rejection logs, find root causes, fix the bundle or data, and resend. * **Keep bundles current.** Update bundles when a vendor changes its file format, when assessments are added, and when the Ed\-Fi data standard version changes. Support safe reruns. * **Document and share.** Write the README, run instructions, parameters, and known issues for every bundle. Submit work for peer review through GitHub and contribute improvements the Ed\-Fi community can reuse. * **Support the longitudinal warehouse.** Develop and maintain Snowflake/dbt models and verify that API records flow correctly into downstream datasets. * **Validate data across systems.** Reconcile source files, API records, and warehouse outputs; resolve identifier mismatches, missing records, duplicates, and load errors. * **Deliver a working product within eight months.** Set milestones, demonstrate progress, coordinate dependencies, and raise blockers early. Deliver a repeatable pipeline and an initial usable ESTF report or analytical view. * **Build reports and dashboards.** Use integrated ESTF data to provide timely insights for state leadership, program analysts, and educational staff, consistent with source availability and refresh schedules. * **Coordinate with program and technical staff.** Work with assessment program staff, vendors, district data contacts, infrastructure teams, and implementation partners on schedules, file specifications, data requirements, business rules, acceptance criteria, and error resolution. Explain technical data decisions to non\-technical staff and vendors. * **Use approved AI coding tools responsibly.** Review, test, debug, and document generated code, and follow agency security, privacy, FERPA, and access\-control requirements. * Communicate progress, track deliverables, and perform other duties as assigned. This position is located in the Office of Information Technology. ** equests, code review, and keeping sensitive data out of repositories. * Experience calling REST APIs with OAuth client credentials and diagnosing HTTP error responses. * Experience with student\-level data governed by the Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act (FERPA). * Experience with automated testing, reconciliation, monitoring, and production pipeline support. * Experience with Snowflake, dbt, and Jinja (or a similar templating language such as Liquid or Mustache). * Experience with Power BI, Preset/Apache Superset, or comparable visualization tools. * Ability to read and write YAML configuration files (indentation\-sensitive syntax, parameters, and environment variables) and JSON, and to reason about nested objects and arrays well enough to tell why a record is invalid. * Comfort using a command line to run tools, pass parameters, and read logs and error output. * Understanding of data pipelines, source\-to\-target mapping, validation, error handling, and repeatable processing. * Ability to document a data mapping so someone else can maintain it, explaining why a source field maps to a target field and not only what the mapping is. * Familiarity with interoperable data ecosystems, templating tools such as Jinja, and Git\-based version control. * Ability to interpret data models and API documentation, troubleshoot across systems, and deliver a working solution within a defined timeline. * Attention to detail: a single misspelled code value or misplaced comma can fail a whole load. * Strong analytical judgment and clear communication, including explaining technical data decisions to non\-technical program staff and vendors; ability to learn a new open\-source toolset mostly from documentation and working examples; and ability to work independently through ambiguous vendor specifications and know when to escalate. Experience may be demonstrated through professional work, academic projects, or substantive personal projects. Candidates do not need prior experience with every tool listed. Strong data engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn and deliver are essential. **Additional Comments** ----------------------- **Skills You Will Develop** * Writing complete Earthmover bundles: sources, transformations, destinations, and project composition. * Modeling a vendor assessment into Ed\-Fi Assessment, ObjectiveAssessment, StudentAssessment, and StudentObjectiveAssessment resources. * Running Lightbeam and resolving rejected records. * Applying Ed\-Fi assessment data\-governance conventions. **How We Work** We value practical solutions that connect systems and reduce manual work. The expectation is a tested, documented pipeline that staff can operate and maintain, not a one\-time prototype. Approved AI tools may support development, but the engineer remains responsible for code quality, data accuracy, and security. **Application Prompt** Describe a data pipeline or integration you built. Explain the source data, transformation logic, destination, your contribution, and how you tested and maintained it. Include any use of Python, SQL, APIs, dbt, Jinja, or AI\-assisted development. Do not submit confidential data or proprietary code. As a part of a generous compensation package, we offer comprehensive benefits that include generous paid time off, preeminent health care benefits, professional development opportunities, pension, a 401(k), and a hybrid work schedule with opportunity for remote work. The South Carolina Department of Education offers an exceptional benefits package that includes: * Health, Dental, Vision, Long Term Disability, and Life Insurance for Employee, Spouse, and Children. * 15 days annual (vacation) leave per year. * 15 days sick leave per year. * 13 paid holidays. * State Retirement Plan and Deferred Compensation Programs. ONLY THOSE APPLICANTS CHOSEN FOR AN INTERVIEW WILL BE NOTIFIED BY LETTER THAT THE POSITION HAS BEEN FILLED. http://www.ed.sc.gov/jobs/human\-resources/title\-ix\-nondiscrimination/

jobs.title: Staff AI Engineer
jobs.description: Staff AI Engineer Remote, USA Series E healthtech company We empower people to improve and prevent chronic metabolic diseases, like type 2 diabetes and obesity, with a new standard of care. We are applying AI Digital Twin technology exclusively toward metabolic health. We start by building a dynamic model of each person’s metabolism, drawing on thousands of data points from CGMs, smartwatches, and meal logs, that maps their personal path to better health. Guided by a dedicated clinical care team, our members have lowered their A1C below the diabetes range, achieved lasting weight loss, and reduced or even eliminated medications, all while living healthier, happier lives. Opportunity We are seeking a Staff AI Engineer to join our Core AI team to shape the technical direction of our AI\-driven product using the latest techniques in Gen AI, AI agents, and deep learning. This is powered by our Digital Twin AI, which combines Predictive and Generative AI to provide individualized insights and recommendations that improve the health of our members every day. This is a senior technical leadership role for someone who wants to solve hard, ambiguous problems at the system level, not just within a single feature, but across the architecture, tooling, and standards that the whole Core AI team relies on. You’ll set technical direction across multiple AI products, mentor senior engineers, and be the person others turn to when a problem doesn’t have an obvious owner. Responsibilities Design and build the core architecture for AI systems spanning multiple product areas, ensuring coherence and reuse across different applications. Set the technical bar for the org: evaluation frameworks, testing philosophy, CI/CD for model behavior, and shared infrastructure used across multiple teams. Identify and resolve systemic engineering gaps before they become team\-wide problems, proactively, not just in response to escalations. Take direct ownership of the hardest, most ambiguous technical problems on the team, the ones without an established playbook, and build the solution end\-to\-end. Build and ship conversational agents, deep learning models, and personalization systems that require novel technical approaches. Improve AI/ML systems and services to drive behavior change and sustained metabolic health improvements across our member base. Raise the technical level of the team through code review and design review, this is IC technical leadership, not people management. You will not have direct reports. Partner with product, engineering leadership, and clinical/research teams to turn ambiguous goals into technical designs you then build. Other duties as assigned. Qualifications 8\+ years of industry experience developing AI and Machine Learning systems in production, with a track record of leading technical initiatives that span multiple teams or systems. Deep software engineering fundamentals: testing, CI/CD, system design, code review, with demonstrated experience designing evaluation infrastructure and shared tooling for LLM\-based systems, not just using it. Proven experience setting technical direction and engineering standards at an organizational level, not just within a single team or codebase. Experience creating and scaling applications leveraging LLMs, Generative AI, advanced Prompt Engineering, RAG, and iterative AI evals in production. Track record of mentoring senior engineers and influencing technical decisions beyond your own project. Experience with Voice AI or specialized Language Models (VLMs, multi\-modal, etc.) is a plus. Proficiency in Python and software engineering best practices at a level where you’re often the one defining what “best practice” means for the team. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field. This remote opportunity based out of the U.S. Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time. Compensation The compensation range for this position is $250,000\-$265,000 annually.

jobs.description: Total Expert is the Customer Operating System for financial services. Our purpose\-built platform combines a system of context with a system of action that enables humans and AI Assistants to engage in the moments that matter and earn customers for life. Since 2016 Total Expert has enabled more than seven trillion dollars of funded loan volume. Total Expert is looking for an experienced engineering leader to join its Engineering organization to expand and support the Total Expert platform and the teams that build it. As a Director of Engineering, you will lead cross\-functional agile software teams to continuously deliver value to our customers while collaborating closely with Product and other stakeholders to create alignment and set technical direction. We are looking for a leader who excels at both coaching and leading technologists, has experience continuously improving teams through retrospectives and a value\-driven focus, and has a genuine passion for leading technologists using cutting\-edge technologies and practices. Agentic software development, where AI coding agents plan, build, test, and review code under engineers’ direction, is a core part of how we build: you’ll lead your teams in using it to deliver value faster, while holding a high bar for the quality of everything that reaches our customers. ***This is a hybrid role based in our Dallas, TX office. We ask that you live within commuting distance or be willing to relocate at your own expense.*** **What you’ll be doing:** * Collaborate with Product and other Engineering leaders to set priorities, manage work in progress, and provide technical direction, including where AI agents can speed up delivery and where work needs closer human oversight * Coach team members on problem analysis, estimating, software design, development, and testing within an Agile software methodology, including turning requirements into clear, well\-scoped specifications that AI agents can execute and verifying the results with automated tests before code is merged * Drive and develop the team’s Agile development processes with a focus on quality and lean principles, adapting planning, code review, and release practices for work that AI agents produce * Champion and support department\-level objectives and process improvements, including AI adoption, across our Engineering teams to increase (tests, linters, security scans, and CI gates) that keep it safe to ship, and make sure customer data and secrets stay protected when teams use AI tools * Measure the impact of agentic development on quality, flow, and developer experience (for example cycle time, escaped defects, AI code review coverage, and accepted AI\-authored code), and use the evidence to decide where to expand it and where to change course * Help engineers grow into higher\-judgment work, such as planning, design, review, and verification, as AI agents take on more of the mechanical work, and lead the change as a a growth mindset, is resilient, adaptable, and curious, especially about how AI is changing the way software is built and how engineering teams work * 10\+ years of experience working within a team\-based SaaS software development environment * 5\+ years of experience managing a software team and providing technical direction to team members * Experience leading groups of software and quality engineering team members using Agile or Lean development practices such as Scrum or Kanban * Demonstrated experience identifying, implementing, and measuring team processes to improve quality, flow, and developer experience, including for teams that build with AI agents * Experience working closely with, or managing, quality\-focused team members on projects and support requests * Experience building and maintaining enterprise web applications in a CI/CD environment * Experience creating or driving best practices around leveraging automated unit testing to improve quality and increase velocity, including using tests to define and verify AI\-generated code * Hands\-on experience using AI coding agents and assistants (such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Codex) in your own work, with the technical depth to evaluate the code and designs they produce * Experience leading teams that use AI coding agents as a regular part of how they plan, build, review, and test software, including multi\-agent loops or orchestration, with measurable results in quality and delivery * Sound judgment about where AI tools excel and where they fall short, and the discipline to hold teams to clear standards for verifying their output through testing, code review, and automated checks * Experience rolling out AI development tools across several teams, building LLM\-powered product features, or moving defined types of work to agents that take it from spec to production behind automated quality gates is a plus **Compensation/Benefits:** The anticipated base salary range
