jobs.title: Senior Principal Architect
jobs.description: At TTEC Digital, we coach clients to ensure their employees feel valued, and fully supported, because an amazing customer experience is an employee first process. Our vision is the same, a place where employees know they can thrive. We are seeking an AI Strategist to provide strategic advisory support for AI initiatives across clients' CCaaS (e.g., CXOne/Cognigy), CRM (e.g., Salesforce), and cloud data platform (e.g., Azure) environments. The ideal candidate combines deep advisory experience across contact center, CRM, and cloud data environments with current, hands\-on fluency in the LLM and Generative AI landscape, and can translate a sponsor's goals into a prioritized, defensible roadmap with a clear ROI framework. This person is comfortable speaking credibly with client IT and delivery teams about platform capability and AI model choices. ### **What You'll Be Doing** Roadmap Strategy \& Use Case Prioritization * Partner with client sponsors to define and refine AI initiative roadmaps across CCaaS, CRM, and cloud data platform investments. * Prioritize which AI use cases to pursue, balancing client business goals against realistic technical and data readiness. * Sequence roadmaps into phases that reflect dependencies, readiness, and each client's capacity to absorb change. * Bring relevant lessons and patterns from other engagements to sharpen roadmap decisions \- functioning as a pattern\-matching advisor, not a general\-purpose consultant. AI \& LLM Technology Judgment * Maintain current, working knowledge of the LLM landscape \- proprietary and open\-source models \- and the evaluation (evals) methods used to assess fit for a given use case. * Advise clients on balancing cost against accuracy, latency, and business need when selecting LLMs or AI services, avoiding both over\-engineering and under\-investment. * Advise on where to leverage AI capabilities already native to CCaaS/CRM platforms (e.g., built\-in copilots, agent assist) versus where to build custom solutions \- including Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) \- leveraging the client's data platform. * Maintain working familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) and similar emerging standards for connecting AI agents and models to enterprise systems and data. Business Case, ROI \& Investment * Define success metrics and an ROI framework for AI initiatives, tying each initiative to a measurable business outcome. * Build or guide the use of ROI calculators and investment\-justification models to support business case development for priority initiatives. * Work with client stakeholders to secure the investment and organizational buy\-in needed to advance the roadmap. * Flag initiatives that are underperforming or no longer justified, and recommend where investment should be redirected. Checkpoint Reviews \& Governance * Review performance of AI initiatives at agreed checkpoints (quarterly reviews, major initiative kickoffs) against the defined success metrics. * Recommend adjustments to scope, sequencing, or investment based on checkpoint findings. * Facilitate structured roadmap workshops and checkpoint review sessions with client sponsors and stakeholders. * jobs.title: Business Lead, AI-Native Discovery Program Intelligence
jobs.description: By clicking the “Apply” button, I understand that my employment application process with Takeda will commence and that the information I provide in my application will be processed in line with Takeda’s Privacy Notice and Terms of Use. I further attest that all information I submit in my employment application is true to the best of my knowledge. **Job Description** ------------------- **Job Description** Takeda is transforming how medicines are discovered by building a new Research engine where AI, advanced data platforms, and laboratory automation are embedded directly into how scientists design and discover molecules, run experiments, and make decisions. Our Labs of Tomorrow vision connects computational science, scientific data, and automated experimental workflows into a closed\-loop discovery engine that will enable us to design smarter studies, shorten learning cycles, and deliver clearer evidence earlier in discovery with the ultimate goal of discovering differentiated medicines for patients. The Business Lead, AI\-Native Discovery Program Intelligence is central to realizing this vision. This leader will be responsible for Takeda's next\-generation Program intelligence and endpoint generation AI\-native capabilities: owning the scientific vision, customer experience, product strategy, roadmap, adoption, and ultimately the value they create for drug discovery. The Business Lead will define what the discovery Program experience should be in a future where AI agents, predictive models, scientific data, and automated experimentation are the basis of how Programs generate evidence and make decisions. Our ambition is for these capabilities to converge into an integrated AI co\-scientist for discovery Program operations — a connected environment that helps Program teams capture structured results, integrate evidence, and determine the next best action across every Program from program start through IND. **Purpose** The Business Lead, AI\-Native Discovery Program Intelligence is a foundational leadership role, acting as the owner of Takeda's Endpoint Generation and Decision Intelligence product family, an integrated family of capabilities spanning how experimental work is designed, commissioned, executed, tracked, and returned, and how the resulting evidence is assembled into a living, decision\-ready Program view. The successful candidate will lead this portfolio as a business owner on the side of the internal customer, combining deep experience in discovery Program operations and nonclinical data generation with computational, data, and technology fluency to ensure that the products built are science\-first, grounded in real discovery workflows, and capable of delivering meaningful value across the portfolio. Your customers will be Takeda's discovery program leads, in vivo pharmacologists, DMPK and safety scientists, assay and screening scientists, study directors, externalization and outsourcing leads, and the discovery Program teams that commission work and make decisions. The role carries sufficient technical fluency to provide informed direction on the strategic technology choices underpinning the product family, at the level of intent and trade\-off rather than detailed evaluation or execution. This is a unique opportunity for an exceptional leader who can combine deep understanding of discovery Program operations, externalized and in vivo experimental data generation, and Program\-level decision\-making with strong computational, data, and technology fluency, and who will ensure that the applications developed are scientifically grounded, technically actionable, adoptable by end users, and aligned with Takeda's business priorities. This role operates at the program leadership level, collaborating directly with Takeda's Labs of Tomorrow leadership team to shape portfolio priorities, resolve strategic tradeoffs, and ensure future\-state Program intelligence and endpoint generation capabilities advance from vision to measurable scientific and business impact. The role provides day\-to\-day direction to the technical leads and development squads working on the product family, and interacts closely with the SME leads. The role will also interface with the other Business Leads to ensure extensibility across the suites of products. **Accountabilities** * Own and refine the strategic vision for the integrated Endpoint Generation and Decision Intelligence product family, articulating the future\-state Program journey redesigned for AI\-native, increasingly automated drug discovery, and breaking it into the underlying capabilities delivered under a single mandate, in alignment with overall Research strategy. * Deliver against that vision by providing business leadership, partnering with technical leads and development squads on scope, sequencing, and priority, and holding product teams accountable for outcomes, adoption, and measurable scientific and business impact. * Define, track, and own KPIs, business v ny modality. * Strong experience in discovery\-stage experimental data generation, ideally including one or more of externalized research, in vitro and in vivo pharmacology, drug metabolism and pharmacokinetics, translational and safety assessment, assay operations, study direction, and/or the management of contract research organizations. * Strong fluency in computational, digital, data, automation, and AI/ML concepts as applied to experimental data generation and Program decision\-making, sufficient to provide informed direction on technology choices and to test technical proposals on business grounds. * Experience working across scientific, digital, data, informatics, automation, software, or product teams. * Strong stakeholder management skills, including the ability to operate as a single point of accountability across multiple stakeholders and synthesize diverse inputs into clear priorities. * Ability to influence without direct authority in a complex matrixed environment. * Strong communication skills with the ability to engage senior leaders, scientific stakeholders, product managers, engineers, data scientists, and external partners. * Experience directing external technology partners and research service providers from the client side, holding them accountable to scope, timeline, quality, and value while working within their product and delivery models. * Preferred experience with scientific software or AI\-driven discovery platforms, including ELN/LIMS, study request and order management, in vivo study management, sample and inventory tracking, external data exchange, or assay data platforms. * Preferred exposure to one or more of the following: AI/ML\-enabled discovery applications, metadata standards, data models, data quality and provenance frameworks for externally generated data, or AI\-ready scientific data. **ADDITIONAL INFORMATION** The position will be based in Cambridge, MA. This position is currently classified as "hybrid" by Takeda's Hybrid and Remote Work policy. **Takeda Compensation and Benefits Summary** We understand compensation is an important factor as you consider the next step in your career. We are committed to equitable pay for all employees, and we strive to be more transparent with our pay practices. **For Location:** Boston, MA**U.S. Base Salary Range:** $212,000\.00 \- $333,190\.00 The estimated salary range reflects an anticipated range for this position. jobs.description: **Office of Information Technology** Annual Salary Range Senior IT Analyst: $104,308 \- $139,079 FLSA Exempt / Union Represented **About the Office** The Office of Information Technology (IT) is responsible for enabling State Bar’s internal and external stakeholders by the management, implementation, and maintenance of an organization's technology to support of State Bar’s mission and goals. This role sets standards for how Power Platform and SharePoint solutions are built and managed, advises business units on how to use them, and helps shape the State Bar's direction for automation and application development. They understand how to balance functionality, usability, and long\-term maintainability, favoring simple, effective solutions that are easy to support and scale. This role will work closely with business partners to design, enhance, and integrate solutions across Microsoft 365 and other enterprise platforms. Experience with Microsoft 365 governance and records management practices, including retention, security, and permissions management, is valuable. Familiarity with Microsoft Purview and experience preparing Microsoft 365 environments for emerging AI capabilities such as Microsoft 365 Copilot are a plus but not required. The ideal candidate is comfortable using PowerShell and other tools to automate administrative tasks and improve platform management. They are confident working independently while also collaborating with technical and non\-technical stakeholders. Most importantly, they are customer\-focused, communicate clearly, enjoy learning new technologies, and seek opportunities to continually improve the tools and services they support. A commitment to ongoing professional growth through training, certifications, and hands\-on learning is highly valued. Examples of Duties * Lead the design and development of Power Platform and SharePoint solutions, and advise business units on how to use these tools to meet operational needs. * Establish and maintain standards, templates, and reusable patterns for how Power Platform and SharePoint solutions are built and managed, including criteria for when automation is appropriate and how solutions are documented, owned, and supported, and develop roadmaps that shape the State Bar's direction for automation and SharePoint development. * Define requirements for and build complex automations and schedules into retention labels, policies, file plans, disposition workflows, and automation across Microsoft 365 using Microsoft Purview and related tools. * Design and maintain sensitivity labels, permissions, and access controls across Microsoft 365 in support of State Bar policies. * Prepare the State Bar's Microsoft 365 environment for AI tools such as Microsoft 365 Copilot by reviewing and remediating oversharing, cleaning up permissions, applying sensitivity labels, and improving information architecture so content is accurate, well organized, and appropriately accessible. * Develop PowerShell scripts to manage, monitor, and audit Power Platform and SharePoint environment vices, concepts, terms, and activities common to a comprehensive, state\-of\-the\-art information systems program. * Principles, methods, and techniques used in designing, developing, testing, and implementing computer hardware and software systems. * Principles and practices of troubleshooting computer hardware, software, and network problems. * Principles and practices of customer service. * Methods and techniques of developing and presenting technical documentation and training materials, recordkeeping, modern office procedures and equipment. * Techniques and practices used in managing, designing, implementing, maintaining, and operating I Network and telephony systems including WAN/LAN, VoIP, Audio/Video systems, and associated network equipment. * Programming tools for Website servers and transaction and ancillary systems for Website support. * A broad range of protocols commonly used in wired and wireless communications networks (e.g., TCP, IP, UDP, SNMP, RADIUS, BGP, OSPF, RIP, Serial, TDM, TFTP, FTP, SSH, SSL, etc.). * Complex applications utilized by the State Bar and associated processes, including civil, juvenile, and traffic court, as well as the associated programming languages. Principles and practices of business operations analysis, complex database design and administration, website management, and enterprise level information technology infrastructures. * Ability to: * Communicate clearly both orally and in writing. * Gather, analyze, and evaluate data and information to reason logically, draw valid conclusions, take appropriate actions and/or make appropriate recommendations. * Research, design, implement and maintain various hardware and software technology solutions, including new technology. * Communicate technical information to a wide variety of users. * Interpret and explain pertinent State Bar and department policies and procedures. * Plan, organize, prioritize, and process work to ensure that deadlines are met. * Learn and utilize specialized terminology, if needed, and interpret and apply technical information pertaining to computer and network systems. * Adapt quickly to changes in policies, procedures, assignments, and work locations. * Communicate effectively, both orally and in writing. * Establish and maintain effective working relationships within and outside the department. * Prepare and maintain documentation for procedures, processes, and tables related to area of assignment. * Identify and resolve system performance and security issues. jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, Platform
jobs.description: ### **About Titan** Titan is building the AI workforce for IT. We deploy AI agents across our portfolio of Managed Service Providers and enterprise customers: agents that monitor, triage, and resolve work across the service desk, infrastructure, security, identity, endpoint, and application operations. The result is faster resolutions, better uptime, and more proactive, personalized support, delivered 24/7\. In under a year we've raised over $100M from General Catalyst, 8VC, and CalPERS, acquired market\-leading MSPs like RFA, and put agents into production in large enterprises. We've automated 100K\+ tickets across 400\+ customers. Our tech team has talent from Scale AI, CoreWeave, Vanta, Dropbox, Meta, Five Rings, Two Sigma, Amazon, Harvard, Stanford, and MIT. Joining Titan means helping redefine how work gets done in IT services, and building a $100B company. ### **About the role** Titan’s agents do real IT work for 400\+ customers. They triage tickets, fix accounts and devices, route work to technicians, and keep customers updated until the job is done. The Platform team builds the systems all of that runs on. You’ll own core pieces end to end: the agent runtime and tool layer, integrations with the PSA, RMM and security platforms our customers depend on, the data that gives agents context, and the controls that decide what an agent can do without a human. When something breaks in production, you find out why and fix it for good. This role is based in San Francisco or New York City, in office. ### **In this role you will** * Build the runtime for long\-running agents that plan, act and recover on their own, from a five\-minute fix to a multi\-day project. * Give agents memory: what they’ve learned about each customer’s environment, people and history, retrieved at the moment it matters. * Let agents write and run their own code in secure sandboxes, so they can solve problems nobody built a tool for. * Route every task across frontier models from multiple labs, trading off quality, speed and cost. * Build the evals and feedback loops that turn every resolved ticket into a better agent. ### **You might thrive in this role if you** * 3\+ years of software engineering experience, with expertise in building and scaling web services. * Strong proficiency in Python, Node.js, or Go, with experience in cloud\-based architectures (AWS, GCP, or Azure). * Familiarity with AI/ML\-driven systems or real\-time data processing is a plus. * User\-focused builder: you care deeply about the customer experience and sweat the details. * Startup mindset: comfortable with ambiguity, eager to take ownership, and ship quickly. * Bonus: experience integrating LLMs, AI\-powered automation, or observability tools. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Applied AI
jobs.description: ### **About the role** As a Forward Deployed Engineer on our Applied AI Inference team, you'll be the hands\-on technical owner for a broad set of fast\-growing customers building products on high\-quality open models at scale. You'll work across several customers and get into the details of how each customer selects and applies models in their workload, from evals and prompts to agents and harness integrations. You'll go deep technically. You'll learn each customer's architecture and use cases well enough to guide their move from closed to open models. That means choosing the right models, benchmarking quality and performance, tuning prompts and pipelines, and integrating models into their systems and workflows. You'll write code most days, alongside customers and in our own tools. You'll own customer outcomes from post\-POC to production. Once a Solutions Architect wins the proof of concept, you take the account into production and help it scale. You drive adoption, remove blockers and proactively make sure the customer gets the value they were promised. You'll bring a product mindset. You'll turn what you learn on each deployment into reusable playbooks, tooling, reference architectures and product feedback so each new deployment is faster and needs less manual work than the last. You'll work across teams constantly. You'll work alongside Solutions Architects, Sales, Engineering, Product, and Research. As one of the early members on this team, you'll also help define how the function runs, including its playbooks, tooling and hiring. Your work will directly affect customer retention, platform adoption and company growth. ### **Responsibilities** * **Opinionated Onboarding:** Plan the path to production with the SA and customer, and make sure the right deployment strategy, model choice, ramp plan and monitoring are in place before the workload goes live. * **Model Selection \& Migration:** Help customers move from closed to open models. Evaluate options on the customer's own data, pick the right model, and handle upgrades and deprecations without regressions. * **Agent Design:** Build and debug agents and multi\-step workflows that hold up in production, including tool calling, planning and retries. * **Harness \& System Integrations:** Get Together working inside the tools customers already use, like coding\-agent harnesses, agent frameworks, OpenAI\-compatible SDKs and data pipelines. Fix what breaks between them: tool\-call formats, streaming, context limits and rate limits. * **Evals \& Prompts:** Build evals that measure what each customer cares about, and use them to tune prompts and catch regressions. * **Customer Touchpoints:** Proactively monitor your accounts, keep a frequent pulse of how things are going, work closely alongside customers to ensure adoption and success. * **Automation \& Tooling:** Write automation, monitoring, scripts and internal tools that turn repeatable work into systems, for customers and for our own team. * **Product Feedback Loop:** Bring what you see in the field to Engineering and Product, contribute product enhancements and documentation, and turn recurring patterns into playbooks the whole team can reuse. ### **Requirements** * **Experience:** 4\+ years in a technical, customer\-facing engineering role such as forward deployed engineering, solutions engineering, applied AI engineering or ML infrastructure, ideally at a fast\-growing company. You can own these accounts from day one. * **Agent Design:** You've built agents with tool use and run them in production, and you can tell which harness or framework fits a given workload. * **Model Selection:** You know today's open models well and have compared open and closed models on a real workload. You can explain your pick in terms of quality, latency and cost. * **Automation \& Coding:** Strong Python. You've built tools and automation that other people use, and you lean on AI tools to get your own work done faster. * **Applied AI \& Integrations:** You've shipped LLM features into existing products, ideally coding or agentic use cases, and debugged what broke between the model, the SDK and the app. * **Prompt Engineering:** You've written and evaluated prompts for production LLM applications. * **Ownership \& Judgment:** You can juggle many accounts, turn vague goals into clear plans, and know when to go deep, when to automate and when to bring in a specialist. * **Communication:** You can explain technical tradeoffs clearly to engineers and business stakeholders.Builder Mindset: You're excited to help build a new team from the ground up. ### **About Together AI** Together AI, the AI Native Cloud, is purpose\-built for AI engineers. AI application developers get high\-performance inference that scales reliably, fine\-tuning and reinforcement learning for creating frontier\-level specialized models, and pre\-training at massive scale for fully custom intelligence, all around a marketplace of leading open models that teams can run, adapt, and own. Trusted by Cursor, Decagon, ElevenLabs, Salesforce, and Zoom, Together serves 400\+ trillion tokens a month. ### **Compensation** We offer competitive compensation, startup equity, health insurance, and other benefits, as well as flexibility in terms of remote work. The US base salary range for this full\-time position is: $270,000 \- $300,000 OTE \+ equity \+ benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by location, level and role. Individual compensation will be determined by experience, skills, and job\-related knowledge. ### **Application Policy** Please read each role carefully and apply to the position best suited to you. Candidates are limited to 6 applications within a 90\-day period, and applications beyond that limit will be automatically rejected. You may apply to additional roles 90 days after your last application. ### **Equal Opportunity** Together AI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and more. Please see our Privacy Policy at https://www.together.ai/privacy

jobs.title: Town Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Overview** The Town of Chapin is seeking a licensed Professional Engineer to serve as Town Engineer for the Utilities Department. This position is the Town's primary technical lead for water distribution, waste water collection, and treatment, and related municipal infrastructure. Chapin Utilities serves more than 6,900 customers in a growing Lake Murray / Midlands community. The system includes purchased potable water from the City of Columbia, a 250,000\- gallon elevated storage tank, approximately 40 miles of water main, a 2\.4 MGD wastewater treatment plant, about 75 sewer lift stations, and roughly 158 miles of gravity and force\- main sewer. The Town Engineer designs, reviews, permits, and oversees capital and development\- related work so that growth is served safely, in compliance with SCDES and EPA requirements, and consistent with Town standards. **Responsibilities** * Plan, design, and manage capital improvement projects for water, sewer, wastewater treatment, and related public infrastructure, including cost estimates, bid documents, construction administration, and close\-out. * Serve as Engineer of Record and seal plans, specifications, reports, and other documents as authorized. * Review private development plans, construction drawings, and as\-builts for water, sewer, pump systems, Letts tanks, and related infrastructure; ensure compliance with Town ordinances, specifications, and SCDES requirements. * Coordinate permitting with SCDES and other agencies as required, including construction permits, capacity certifications, and operating permits. * Support grant applications and administration for infrastructure projects (federal, state, and regional programs). * Provide construction inspection support and coordinate with the Utilities Inspector/GIS staff, locators, and maintenance crews. * Assist with GIS mapping of Town infrastructure and maintain accurate record drawings. * Advise the Director and Deputy Director on system capacity, hydraulic performance, inflow and infiltration, odor and overflow issues, plant upgrades, and long\-range capital needs. * Prepare technical reports, Council briefing materials, and public\-facing project information as requested. * Work with consultants, contractors, developers, SCDOT, neighboring utilities, and the public in a professional, customer\-focused manner. * Participate in emergency response for water main breaks, sewer overflows, and similar events as needed. * Respond to requests for information or commitments on water and sewer connections. * Perform other related engineering and project\-management duties as assigned. **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Environmental Engineering, or a closely related field from an ABET\-accredited program. * Current Professional Engineer (P.E.) license in South Carolina, or the ability to obtain South Carolina licensure within six (6\) months of hire. * Five (5\) or more years of progressively responsible experience in municipal water/wastewater or public\-works engineering, including design and construction of distribution and collection systems. Experience with treatment facilities, lift stations, and development plan review is strongly preferred. * Valid South Carolina driver’s license (or ability to obtain) and acceptable driving record. * Working knowledge of SCDES drinking water and wastewater regulations, EPA requirements applicable to small\-to\-mid\-size systems, and standard municipal construction practices. * Proficiency with engineering design software, Microsoft Office, and the ability to work with GIS (ArcGIS or similar). AutoCAD experience preferred. **Preferred Qualifications** * Prior municipal or special\-purpose district experience in South Carolina. * Experience managing CIP budgets, consultants, and construction contracts. * Familiarity with purchased\-water systems, force\-main networks, and WWTP expansion or upgrade projects. * Grant writing or administration experience (CDBG, SRF, congressional, or similar). **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities** * Strong technical judgment in hydraulics, collection and distribution design, and constructability. * Ability to read, interpret, and produce construction plans and specifications. * Clear written and oral communication with elected officials, staff, contractors, and residents. * Ability to manage multiple projects, meet deadlines, and work independently in a small\-town department. * Commitment to public service, safety, and regulatory compliance. **Compensation and Benefits** Salary is competitive and will be based on qualifications and experience. The Town offers an excellent benefits package, including health insurance, South Carolina Retirement System (SCRS) participation, paid leave, holidays, and support for professional licensure and continuing education. Pay: $90,000\.00 \- $100,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Flexible spending account * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Retirement plan * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior Distinguished Engineer, AI Safety & Security
jobs.description: **About Trellix** Trellix is a global cybersecurity leader helping organizations build cyber resilience for the AI era. Combining AI\-native security, operational threat intelligence, and automated detection and response, Trellix provides defense\-grade protection at machine speed across on\-premises, air\-gapped, operational technology, hybrid, and cloud environments. Trellix helps customers anticipate threats, scale effective security operations, maintain business continuity, and adapt their security posture for the modern threat landscape. Working with a broad partner ecosystem and global intelligence collaborators, Trellix helps strengthen the collective defense against cybercriminals and state\-sponsored attacks. At Trellix, we empower professionals at all career stages to expand their technical expertise, lead strategic initiatives, and make a tangible global impact. Whether you are an industry pioneer or an emerging specialist, Trellix provides the tools and opportunities to enhance and expand your skill set. Join our mission to scale AI\-driven cyber defense alongside an AI\-accelerated threat landscape, and help build a safer, more resilient future. More at https://trellix.com. ***Role Overview:*** Office of the CTO · Reports to the Chief Technology Officer · US Remote Make AI safe to trust at machine speed AI now writes software, triages alerts, and acts inside networks. Attackers have noticed. They plant instructions in public code to hijack AI coding agents, steal AI credentials at scale, and run agents that move through networks faster than any human team. Governments are planning for superintelligence across their missions. Every company that builds with AI now carries this risk, and a security company must carry it best. Trellix is investing to set that standard. We are looking for the engineer who will define how Trellix builds with AI and how our AI earns customer trust. This is one of the most senior technical roles at Trellix. **Why Trellix** * **AI at the core.** Trellix Wise™, our agentic security platform, went from concept to general availability in about three months, and AI\-assisted engineering now runs across our development teams. You will secure both at scale. * **Trust is the product.** Governments and regulated industries run Trellix on\-prem and air\-gapped. They need AI they can audit, contain, and explain. You will make that possible. * **A front\-row view of the adversary.** Our Advanced Research Center tracks the attackers now turning AI against defenders. Your controls will meet real threats, not hypotheticals. **What you will build** **AI\-native engineering, with evidence** * Set the guardrails for AI coding agents: execution boundaries, repository and credential scope, human approval gates, and complete audit trails. * Require validation before trust: evaluation suites every new model or agent must pass before it touches production code. * Govern our own agentic workforce with identity, least privilege, and spending limits for every AI agent we run. * Prove with data that AI makes us faster and better, and retire what does not. **Secure by default** * Make the safe option the default across our build systems, pipelines, and software supply chain. * Shorten release cycles while lowering defect and vulnerability rates. **AI safety and security in Trellix products** * Set the architecture standard for AI in Trellix products, including Trellix Wise™: data handling, purpose limitation, privacy, model isolation, tool\-use controls, and kill switches. * Red\-team our AI before attackers do: prompt injection, tool abuse, data and model poisoning, credential theft, and agent escape. * Keep models swappable, so customers can choose cloud, on\-prem, or air\-gapped without losing protection. * Shape our products for protecting customers' own AI agents and models. **Frontier questions you will own** * How do you prove an AI agent did only what it was allowed to do? * How do you trust a new model before it touches production? * What does least privilege mean for an agent that writes its own tools? * How do controls hold when adversaries run models as capable as ours? * How do we give customers and regulators audit\-grade evidence for decisions an AI made? **How you will work** * Report to the CTO and work alongside the Chief Architect and Trellix's senior distinguished engineers. * Set standards that every engineering team adopts, and build the shared controls that make them easy to follow. * Align Trellix AI governance with emerging standards such as ISO/IEC 42001, and help shape industry and government standards for AI security. * Explain our controls and their results to executives, boards, customers, and external assessors. Patent and publish where it advances the field. **About you** * 15\+ years of engineering, including principal, fellow, or chief architect roles in security, privacy, or large\-scale infrastructure. * Built enforcement controls at scale, such as privacy, purpose limitation, or access control, and proved they work. * Hands\-on with AI coding agents and LLM pipelines, and clear about how they fail. * Working knowledge of AI threat frameworks such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and MITRE ATLAS. * A record of changing how a large engineering organization ships: release cadence, build systems, and secure defaults. * Writes clearly for executives, boards, and assessors. Patents preferred. B.S. in engineering or computer science, or equivalent experience. Base Pay Range: $200K\-250K. Actual base pay within this range will depend on varying circumstances, including the work location, individual qualifications, company budget and other operational business needs. Compensation may also include annual bonuses and long\-term incentives, subject to various metrics and company policy**.** ***Company Benefits and Perks:*** We believe that the best solutions are developed by teams who embrace each other's unique experiences, skills, and abilities. We work hard to create a dynamic workforce where we encourage everyone to bring their authentic selves to work every day. We offer a variety of social programs, flexible work hours and family\-friendly benefits to all of our employees. * Retirement Plans * Medical, Dental and Vision Coverage * Paid Time Off * Paid Parental Leave * Support for Community Involvement We're serious about our commitment to a workplace where everyone can thrive and contribute to our industry\-leading products and customer support, which is why we prohibit discrimination and harassment based on race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation or any other legally protected status. ***Our Commitment to You:*** At Trellix, we are committed to creating a safe and trustworthy experience for our customers, employees, and candidates. Please be aware that fraudulent recruiting activity can occur through fake job postings or impersonated communications. Trellix conducts interviews through professional channels only and does not use text messages, instant messaging, or group chats for interviews. We will never request sensitive personal information—such as your date of birth, Social Security number, or national ID number—during the interview process. Trellix also does not require candidates to pay fees, purchase products or services, or process payments of any kind as part of the recruiting or hiring process. And Trellix will never keep any original work authorization documents that we may be required to review during the hiring process. If you have questions or believe you may have encountered fraudulent activity related to Trellix recruiting, please contact us at **ethics@trellix.com**. Apply Now ##### **Share This Job** Share on Facebook Share on X Share on Linkedin Share on Email

jobs.description: **Description** --------------- We’re looking for an exceptional FPGA Engineer to play a key role in building and scaling our High Frequency Trading (HFT) infrastructure. This is a unique opportunity to join a growing, highly impactful team and help shape the next iteration of our ultra\-low\-latency trading systems. Advanced degrees are a plus, but not required. * Minimum 5 years of professional FPGA development experience in a systematic HFT environment * Strong proficiency in SystemVerilog including synthesis, timing closure, verification, and hardware debugging. * Deep understanding of digital design, computer architecture, pipelining, and hardware\-level performance optimization. * Experience with high\-speed networking protocols, FPGA development tools (Xilinx Vivado, Intel Quartus), and hardware/software integration. **Benefits** * Competitive salary plus performance\-based bonus. * Collaborative, casual, and friendly work environment. * Fully covered PPO health, dental, and vision insurance for employees and dependents. * Pre\-tax commuter benefits. * Weekly company meals. Applications are open for both our Stamford, CT and New York City offices. The base salary range is 175,000–200,000, depending on experience and qualifications. Total compensation may also include a discretionary, performance\-based bonus. This position is classified as overtime\-exempt.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer Req# 793
jobs.description: Posted Monday, November 23, 2026 at 12:00 AM **TRISURA GUARANTEE INSURANCE COMPANY** At **Trisura**, we expect more because we believe it can be done better. We are a young, growth\-oriented team with a commitment to exceptional talent and have been one of the fastest\-growing North American specialty insurance firms since 2006\. Our growth and our entrepreneurial style, niche market position and development opportunities ensure that our people see the results of their commitment reflected in the company’s success. We are currently seeking a driven and collaborative Senior Data Engineer to join our forward\-thinking Data and Analytics team. **SENIOR DATA ENGINEER** **Position is onsite in Oklahoma City – Remote is not available** **Position Overview:** As a Senior Data Engineer on our Data \& Analytics Team, you will be a hands\-on technical leader responsible for designing, building, operating, and continuously improving scalable, secure, and reliable data solutions. The role will help modernize Trisura’ s data platform, enable trusted analytics and reporting, and establish engineering standards across ingestion, transformation, orchestration, deployment, monitoring, data quality, and documentation. Working closely with Data \& Analytics, application teams, architects, analysts, governance, and business stakeholders, the Senior Data Engineer will translate business requirements into reusable data products and production\-grade solutions across Microsoft Fabric, Azure, SQL Server, Power BI, and related technologies. **What you will do:** * Design, build, test, deploy, and support scalable batch and near\-real\-time data pipelines for structured, semi\-structured, and unstructured data using Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, SSIS, SQL Server, Azure SQL, cloud storage, and other enterprise data sources. * Develop modern data engineering solutions using Microsoft Fabric capabilities such as Lakehouse, Warehouse, OneLake, Copy Jobs, Notebooks, Dataflow Gen2, and related services, applying layered bronze/silver/gold architecture patterns where appropriate. * Develop robust, reusable ETL/ELT and data transformation solutions using T\-SQL, Python, PySpark, and Spark SQL, including incremental loading, Change Data Capture (CDC), schema evolution, reconciliation, restart/recovery, idempotency, and error\-handling patterns. * Design dimensional, relational, and Lakehouse data models that support analytics, operational and regulatory reporting, self\-service analytics, and downstream system integrations. * Ensure production reliability by implementing monitoring, alerting, logging, data quality controls, reconciliation, metadata, lineage, auditability, and operational support procedures. * Optimize SQL, Spark, pipeline, and storage workloads for performance, scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency while applying security and privacy best practices, including least\-privilege access, managed identities, service principals, secrets management, secure connectivity, and environment separation. * Implement source control, automated deployment, and CI/CD practices using Git, Azure DevOps, and Microsoft Fabric deployment capabilities, and participate in code reviews, testing, release planning, incident resolution, root\-cause analysis, and post\-implementation reviews. * Develop reusable engineering standards, frameworks, templates, patterns, and technical documentation to improve consistency, maintainability, and operational support across the data platform. * Partner with Power BI developers, analysts, business stakeholders, Data Governance, and other technology teams to translate business requirements into trusted, well\-structured data solutions and clearly communicate dependencies, risks, and technical trade\-offs. * Support the modernization and migration of legacy SSIS, SSRS, Azure Data Factory, SQL\-based, and other data integration workloads to strategic cloud and Microsoft Fabric platforms. **What You Bring:** **Core Skills:** * Strong ownership, accountability, and a focus on delivering reliable, maintainable data solutions. * Ability to lead technical design discussions, mentor other engineers, and promote engineering best practices. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts to technical and non\-technical audiences. * Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced environment, manage competing priorities, and independently drive work from requirements through production support. * A collaborative and customer\-focused mindset when working with business stakeholders, analysts, developers, architects, vendors, and operational teams. * Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with a focus on root\-cause analysis, automation, and continuous improvement. **Technical Expertise:** * Advanced SQL and T\-SQL skills, including complex querying, stored procedures, views, indexing, execution\-plan analysis, performance tuning, and query optimization. * Strong Python skills for data engineering, automation, testing, API integration, and file processing, with hands\-on experience in PySpark and Spark SQL preferred. * Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Fabric and Azure data services, including Lakehouse, Warehouse, OneLake, Delta tables, pipelines, notebooks, Azure Data Factory, Azure SQL Database/Managed Instance, Azure Data Lake Storage, and Key Vault. * Strong understanding of modern data architecture and engineering patterns, including data warehousing, Lakehouse architecture, dimensional modeling, medallion architecture, ETL/ELT, incremental processing, and enterprise data integration. * Experience with Git\-based source control, branching and pull\-request practices, automated testing, CI/CD, and environment\-specific configuration and deployment. * Experience designing secure data solutions using Microsoft Entra ID, managed identities, service principals, role\-based access control, secrets management, and least\-privilege principles. * Knowledge of data observability and governance practices, including logging, monitoring, alerting, pipeline metrics, reconciliation, metadata, lineage, data quality, retention, reference/master data, and audit requirements. * Working knowledge of Power BI and semantic model consumption patterns; experience with DAX is considered an asset. * Experience integrating enterprise databases, REST APIs, JSON, CSV, Parquet, Delta, SFTP, and other file\-based or application data sources. * Experience with PostgreSQL and legacy Microsoft technologies such as SSIS and SSRS is an asset, particularly in modernization and migration initiatives. * Ability to develop clean, modular, testable, maintainable, and well\-documented production\-quality code. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree, college diploma, or equivalent practical experience in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field. * Minimum 5 years of progressive experience in data engineering, data integration, data warehousing, analytics engineering, or related roles, including ownership of production data solutions. * Demonstrated experience designing and delivering end\-to\-end data solutions rather than only developing individual ETL components or reports. * Demonstrated experience troubleshooting complex production data issues and improving platform reliability, performance, and maintainability. * Experience providing technical leadership, mentoring, code review, solution design, or engineering standards is strongly preferred. * Experience in Insurance or another regulated financial\-services environment is strongly preferred. * Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Engineer, Azure, Power BI, or related Microsoft certifications are considered an asset. If you are looking for a career in an exciting and rewarding company, are driven to excel, thrive in a team environment and want to contribute to the success of an organization that values your contribution, we would like to hear from you! *We thank all candidates for their interest however only those selected for an interview will be contacted* We are committed to an inclusive and barrier\-free workplace that reflects the diversity in each of our offices across America. Accommodation will be provided on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of our recruitment and selection process. Trisura offers a comprehensive benefit package that includes medical, dental, and vision insurance, as well as 401(k) with company match and Employee Stock Purchase Plan*.* **Job Details** --------------- Pay Type Salary Oklahoma City, OK, USA

model version management. * Evaluate, benchmark, and recommend new or updated on\-premises models as the technology evolves. * Build and maintain automated pipelines that retrieve documents (PDF, TIFF) from network shares and perform OCR and text extraction. * Design, test, and iteratively refine prompts and structured\-output logic to improve accuracy, consistency, and reliability for each project. * Validate AI output programmatically and write results to SQL Server, ensuring data integrity and traceability. * Compile and deliver results to CQA for audit; analyze CQA findings to determine what should change in prompts, extraction, or model configuration. * Manage multiple concurrent AI projects in collaboration with the PMO, maintaining test sets, accuracy metrics, and version history of prompts and workflows. * Partner with Cybersecurity and Compliance to ensure on\-premises AI systems, data handling, and access controls meet HIPAA, data\-governance, and AI) as needed. * Maintain documentation of architectures, workflows, test results, and configurations. * Stay current with developments in open\-weight language models, OCR/document AI, and model\-serving technology. * Perform other duties as assigned to advance the organization’s AI strategy and innovation initiatives. **KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:** * Strong understanding of large language models, including the practical limits of locally hosted models (context size, quantization, throughput, hardware requirements). * Proficiency in Python for pipeline development, automation, knowledge of SQL Server, including writing and troubleshooting queries and inserts (AI\-assisted proficiency acceptable). * Experience with OCR and document\-processing workflows for scanned or image\-based documents (PDF, TIFF). * Strong prompt\-engineering skills, including structured/JSON output design and systematic accuracy testing. * Ability to measure and communicate model accuracy using test sets, metrics, and reviewer feedback. * Familiarity with HIPAA, data privacy, and security principles related to AI and PHI. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work with clinical, technical, and non\-technical stakeholders. * Ability to manage multiple projects with strong documentation habits and attention to detail. **EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:** jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Distributed Storage (Docstore & TiDB)
jobs.description: **About the role and team** Engineering at Uber means building for real\-world impact under real\-world constraints. As Uber’s core stateful distributed database platform, the team sits at the intersection of extreme scale, multi\-cloud flexibility, and high\-performance transactional data. In this role, you will architect, build, and operate critical capabilities across both **Docstore**—which is one of the largest database engines at Uber and scales to thousands of nodes—and **TiDB**, powering Uber’s most mission\-critical transactional and document workloads. Our vision is to accelerate product feature velocity by delivering a zero\-toil, multi\-cloud distributed database platform that guarantees high performance, zonal resilience, and sub\-linear cost growth at massive scale. The problems here are complex, the stateful infrastructure is massive, and the pace is fast. As a Senior Software Engineer, you’ll make sound architectural tradeoffs with imperfect information and own your work end\-to\-end: from authoring technical design docs to protecting instance stability during unexpected production traffic spikes. We are looking for strong distributed systems builders who stay calm under pressure and care deeply about engineering zero\-friction storage infrastructure across on\-prem and cloud environments. If you’re energized by hard storage problems and motivated by real\-world impact—this is where you’ll grow. **What you’ll do** * Architect, implement, and roll out high\-impact distributed database features across both Docstore and TiDB that reduce operational toil and increase developer velocity across Uber. * Build storage efficiency and elasticity capabilities across massive footprints—including incremental horizontal scaling, scale\-back, storage tiering and compute\-storage separation. * Design and harden defensive resiliency mechanisms that protect cluster stability against sudden traffic spikes, degraded downstream dependencies, and multi\-zone failures. * Automate and agentify developer self\-service workflows for database provisioning, capacity management, and onboarding across on\-prem and multi\-cloud providers. * Collaborate closely with partner infrastructure teams and internal product stakeholders to optimize data locality and safely onboard critical workloads onto Docstore and TiDB. * Raise the engineering bar through rigorous design and code reviews, operational excellence in on\-call rotations, and hands\-on mentorship of fellow engineers on the team. **Basic Qualifications** * 5\+ years of professional experience in distributed systems, database infrastructure, storage systems, or backend software engineering. * Strong proficiency in building, debugging, and operating high\-performance, production\-grade backend or infrastructure systems (e.g., Go, C\+\+, Java, or Rust). * Solid foundation in distributed database concepts, including replication, consensus protocols, partitioning/sharding, transaction isolation, or query execution. * Proven track record of owning complex, multi\-quarter technical projects end\-to\-end—from design documentation and cross\-team alignment to production rollout and operations. * Experience operating mission\-critical, high\-availability production services, participating in incident response, and building automated reliability guardrails. * Demonstrated ability to make pragmatic engineering tradeoffs balancing latency, reliability, and infrastructure cost efficiency. * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. **Preferred Qualifications** * Hands\-on experience developing, operating, or contributing to distributed SQL or NoSQL databases (such as TiDB, CockroachDB, Vitess, Cassandra, or Dynamo\-style architectures) at scale. * Experience building multi\-cloud or hybrid\-cloud stateful infrastructure, including zonal resilience, data locality optimization, or compute\-storage separation. * Familiarity with storage efficiency and elasticity techniques such as automated data tiering, compaction tuning, or dynamic horizontal scaling and scale\-back. * Experience building self\-service automation or AI/agent\-driven workflows for infrastructure provisioning and workload onboarding. * Track record of technical mentorship and driving engineering best practices across a team or adjacent partner groups. For San Francisco, CA\-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $202,000 per year \- USD $224,000 per year. For Seattle, WA\-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $202,000 per year \- USD $224,000 per year. For Sunnyvale, CA\-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $202,000 per year \- USD $224,000 per year. For all US locations, you will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award \& other types of comp. All full\-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits. **Ready to Ride?** This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you. You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits. Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in\-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full\-time in\-office presence. jobs.title: Sr Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About the role and team** Uber Maps Search helps people find the places and destinations they need across Uber experiences. The multi\-disciplinary team builds the backend systems, deep learning models \& user experience components behind location search \- from understanding a query and retrieving relevant places to serving useful results with the speed and reliability people expect. Because location search is the 1\-step of any Go\-Get experience at Uber, the team's contributions meaningfully influence Uber’s business performance, and the team’s work is highly visible to the executive leadership team. As a Senior Backend Engineer, you’ll lead important, multi\-quarter initiatives and help evolve the services and data foundations that power search. You’ll partner closely with machine learning, science, mobile, and other engineering teams to turn customer and business needs into scalable systems. You’ll shape architecture, guide delivery across teams, and raise the quality and reliability of the platform. **What you’ll do** * Lead the architecture and end\-to\-end delivery of high\-impact Maps Search projects, from problem definition and technical strategy through launch and ongoing operation. * Design, build, and evolve scalable backend services for location search, including query handling, autocomplete, retrieval, result aggregation, and recommendation\-serving workflows. * Improve the latency, availability, relevance, and operational health of high\-throughput search systems, jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Role** We are seeking a Staff Software Engineer specializing in AI/ML to lead the architecture and development of next\-generation, LLM\-powered Search systems for Uber Eats. This role will drive the technical direction of Search as an LLM (SaaL), transforming traditional retrieval and ranking systems into an integrated generative Search architecture. In parallel, the engineer will help lead our Whole\-Page Quality initiative, developing scalable AI\-powered evaluation capabilities to detect customer\-visible defects and improve end\-to\-end Search experiences. The role involves highly ambiguous ML challenges spanning large\-scale LLM training, semantic retrieval, generative modeling, and production integration. It requires strong technical leadership to design scalable ML architectures, support expansion into new markets and retail verticals, and drive complex initiatives across engineering organizations. **About the Team** The Uber Eats Delivery Search team builds large\-scale machine learning systems that help consumers discover relevant merchants, products, and items across Uber Eats. We are evolving Search toward an LLM\-native architecture that combines semantic understanding, generative modeling, and whole\-page optimization. Our technical challenges include large\-scale LLM training and optimization (CPT, SFT, RL), semantic grounding, constrained generation, Search generalization across new markets and catalogs, and scalable whole\-page quality evaluation. The team works closely with ML Infrastructure, Backend Engineering, Data Science, and Product teams to deliver reliable Search experiences at Uber scale. **Role \& Responsibilities** As a Staff Machine Learning Engineer on the Delivery Search team, you will provide technical leadership in designing and scaling next\-generation ML systems. Specifically, you will: * Generative Search Architecture: Lead the design of LLM\-powered Search systems, integrating semantic representations, constrained decoding, retrieval, ranking, and production serving while balancing relevance, scalability, latency, and reliability. * LLM Training \& Optimization: Drive technical approaches for continued pretraining (CPT), supervised fine\-tuning (SFT), reinforcement learning (RL), and model optimization to improve Search relevance, grounding, and generation quality. * Search Generalization \& Scalability: Design reusable ML capabilities that generalize across geographic markets, languages, retail verticals, and merchant catalogs, including cold\-start environments with limited engagement data. * Whole\-Page Quality \& Evaluation: Lead the development of scalable evaluation frameworks, LLM\-based quality judges, and reason\-level defect detection to identify systemic Search quality issues and drive measurable customer experience improvements. * Cross\-Organizational Technical Leadership: Drive complex ML initiatives from architecture through production, align technical decisions across engineering teams, mentor engineers, and establish best practices for model development and evaluation. **Basic Qualifications** * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including hands\-on experience designing, * Deep understanding of machine learning, deep learning, and scalable ML architectures, with experience using frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow. * Proven track record of driving complex ML jobs.title: Product Engineer I
jobs.description: **Rapidly Growing Life Sciences Technology Company** Ultima Genomics is a rapidly growing company that is developing ground\-breaking genomics technologies. Our mission is to continuously drive the scale of genomic information to enable unprecedented advances in biology and improvements in human health. We have developed a foundational new approach to sequencing at scale that overcomes limitations due to the high costs of current technologies. We are well\-funded and have raised over $700 million from global top\-tier investors and partners who share our vision. Our team brings together unique and diverse expertise across multiple disciplines, from healthcare and life sciences, to engineering, to technology and software and beyond. We are a collaborative group, including successful entrepreneurs, chemists, hardware and software engineers, genomics and biotechnology experts, molecular and computational biologists, software and algorithm experts, and operations and commercial leaders. Join us to develop and commercialize technologies that unleash the power of genomics at scale and empower the future of human health. We are looking for a highly motivated **Product Engineer I** to join our team! Our Product Engineers play a strategically important role in ensuring the company's business success. The primary responsibilities include, but are not limited to, supporting the Field Service Engineer (FSE) and Field Application Scientist (FAS) groups with technical support, authoring and reviewing Best Known Practices (BKPs) for field deployment, and coordinating the rollout and implementation of Engineering Change Orders (ECOs) in the field. As a Product Engineer (PE), you will train FSEs on best practices and be the point of contact for field escalations. PEs are system experts and sometimes work side by side with R\&D to gain a deep understanding of the system. PEs will help define problem statements, develop mitigations, and contribute to Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) plans. This is a full\-time onsite position at our Fremont, CA location. **How You'll Contribute** * Test and validate software upgrades, process flows, and service procedures prior to release. Understand test matrices, regression checklists, and acceptance criteria used to sign off a release. Present to customer\-facing groups to ensure proper field implementation * Plan and execute full software releases for customer tools to ensure minimal expected downtime. Develop an understanding of version compatibility across components, upgrade and rollback runbooks, pre\- and post\-upgrade verification, and go/no\-go criteria * Identify and drive process improvements in field software deployment and verification * Partner closely with software engineering and data operations teams to build up knowledge and documentation on troubleshooting, integration efforts, and software and Graphical User Interface (GUI) rollout for pipeline management * Develop and maintain troubleshooting tools that let field teams diagnose failures faster, surfacing failure signatures and packaging evidence for escalation * Monitor field issues and escalate trends to R\&D and upper management in the form of dashboards and other high\-level communications * Transfer knowledge from R\&D to customer sites by working side by side with engineering, chemistry, and operations groups during the system operational and performance qualification stages * Provide Abilities** * BS or MS in Computer Science, Engineering, Biomedical, Electrical, Mechanical, Systems Engineering disciplines or core scientific degree * 1\+ year of experience troubleshooting complex systems dealing with electrical, mechanical, and software designs is preferred * Hands\-on scripting experience in Bash and/or Python for troubleshooting and automation, including log parsing, text processing, wrapping repetitive command\-line work, and small diagnostic utilities * Confidence working in Git and GitHub * Previous experience working in Linux systems * Background in teaching or transferring knowledge to others to help them grow their technical and troubleshooting skills * Proficiency in hardware, software, and chemistry integration is highly desired * Some experience in a technical support or customer service role * Highly curious with a self\-starting attitude * Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to write clear technical procedures for a field audience * Experience with containerized applications and reading logs from distributed pipelines is a plus * Ability to travel up to 20% of the time to support customer sites jobs.title: Assistant Professor in Artificial Intelligence + Engineering
jobs.description: **Job no:** 495427 **Work type:** Faculty **Location:** UMBC Campus **Categories:** Computer Engineering **Application Instructions:** Apply via Interfolio at: https://apply.interfolio.com/196803 **Department:** College of Engineering and Information Technology **Anticipated Start Date:** Fall 2027 **About the Position:** **Overview** The University of Maryland, Baltimore County (UMBC) invites applications for a tenure\-track Assistant Professor position in the broad area of Artificial Intelligence (AI) for Mechanical/Chemical/Biochemical/Environmental Engineering Systems. In this context AI denotes all aspects of artificial intelligence, machine learning, and related methods. UMBC is a nationally recognized public research university distinguished by inclusive excellence, innovative teaching, a strong commitment to student success, and research that addresses complex societal challenges. The College of Engineering and Information Technology (COEIT) seeks an innovative scholar whose research advances engineering science and technology through the development, integration, or innovative application of artificial intelligence and machine learning methods. The successful candidate will hold a primary appointment in either the Department of Mechanical Engineering (ME) or the Department of Chemical, Biochemical, and Environmental Engineering (CBEE), based on their research and teaching interests and the strategic needs of the departments, and will join the College during a period of strategic planning and growth. They will be expected to establish an externally funded research program, contribute to undergraduate and graduate education, and foster interdisciplinary collaborations that advance engineering research through AI. The departments are particularly interested in candidates whose research integrates AI methods with fundamental engineering science and applications. Areas of interest include, but are not limited to, the following: **Mechanical Engineering (ME)** ------------------------------- * Embodied AI and Robotics * AI for Engineering Design and Optimization * AI for Advanced Manufacturing * AI for Biomechanical and Biomaterials Engineering **Chemical, Biochemical, and Environmental Engineering (CBEE)** --------------------------------------------------------------- The integration of AI into the following areas is of special interest to the CBEE Department: * Biomanufacturing * Biomedical Engineering * Biomolecular Engineering * Biomaterials * Environmental Engineering and Sustainability Applicants with research and teaching interests in other areas at the intersection of AI and engineering that complement the current research in the CBEE and ME Departments are also encouraged to apply, including applicants whose work has cross\-disciplinary impact. UMBC seeks candidates committed to interdisciplinary research, effective teaching, mentoring students from diverse backgrounds, and embracing equity and inclusion principles in their research, teaching and service contributions. **Qualifications and Details** ------------------------------ Candidates must hold a PhD in mechanical engineering, chemical engineering, biochemical engineering, environmental engineering, or another closely related discipline by the appointment start date. This is a full\-time, nine\-month appointment anticipated to begin in Fall 2027\. The successful candidate’s primary department will be either ME or CBEE. Teaching responsibilities and workload will follow the norms of the home department. Salary Range: $120,000 to $140,000 commensurate with experience. The above salary range represents the University’s good faith and reasonable estimate of the range of possible compensation at the time of posting. Other components of pay are offered when necessary to meet competitive conditions. **Screening of Applications Begins:** Review of application materials will begin January 4, 2027 and will continue until the position is filled. **Background Screening Statement:** A background check will be required. **Benefits:** UMBC offers a rich benefits package. Benefits offered align with type of position and may be prorated based on hours per week. * Paid Leave * Tuition Remission * Medical, Prescription and Dental Insurance * Retirement plans * Life and Disability Insurance * Professional development opportunities * Wellness opportunities \& much more See benefits summary for detailed information. 12 Month Faculty Benefits Summary 9 Month Faculty Benefits Summary **About UMBC:** UMBC, an honors university serving more than 14,000 undergraduates and 2,000 graduate students, is one of two public universities in Maryland to achieve the “doctoral/research university\-extensive” Carnegie classification. Located just outside Baltimore and 45 minutes from Washington, DC, the campus is growing rapidly under dynamic leadership. Our UMBC community redefines excellence in higher education through an inclusive culture that connects innovative teaching and learning, research across disciplines, and civic engagement. We will advance knowledge, economic prosperity, and social justice by welcoming and inspiring inquisitive minds from all backgrounds. The successful candidate will join a department with a strong commitment to diversity and inclusive excellence, and will be expected to contribute actively to these efforts (https://diversity.umbc.edu/). **Equal Opportunity Statement:** **UMBC is an Affirmative Action/Equal Opportunity Employer. Applications from women, minority group members, veterans and individuals with disabilities are encouraged to apply.** **Title IX:** **As an institution that receives federal financial assistance, UMBC adheres to Title IX and does not discriminate on the basis of sex.** **For more information about Title IX and contact information for Title IX Coordinator click here.** **Accommodation:** **If you require a reasonable accommodation for a disability for any part of the employment process, please contact the Human Resources Department at 410\-455\-2337 or MD TTY Relay Service 1\-800\-735\-2258 between 8:30 a.m. and 4:00 p.m. Monday through Friday.** **Advertised:** 23 Nov 2026 09:00 Eastern Standard Time **Applications close:** Open Until Filled

jobs.title: Senior Developer Advocate
jobs.description: At Verda, we're building a full\-stack AI cloud, covering everything from data centers and hardware to our own cloud platform that the world's leading AI teams use to do serious AI work. We strive to make a positive mark on the world through the infrastructure we build and give leading teams a service they can truly depend on. Headquartered in Helsinki, we operate globally with offices in London and San Francisco. Join Verda while it’s still being built \- not once it’s finished. **Why Verda** ------------- * Cash and equity compensation along with local benefits. * 40\+ nationalities, with 6 different ones on the management team. * A real chance to make an impact and work alongside world class engineers, researchers, and partners across the global AI ecosystem. **About the role** ------------------ You will be Verda's public technical voice for AI engineers and researchers in the US. You will create benchmarks, tutorials, walkthroughs and demos, represent Verda at the events where AI developers gather, and bring what you hear back to the teams building the product. This is a senior individual contributor role, reporting to our VP Marketing. **Responsibilities:** * Choose where Verda shows up in the US based on who is actually in the room, and start small formats yourself whether it is a workshop, a hackathon, or a dinner for a handful of engineers working on the same workload * Represent Verda at conferences, meetups, hackathons and community events: speaking, running workshops, and engaging directly with engineers and researchers where they already are. * Build relationships with AI product companies, the maintainers of open\-source serving projects, and the organisers of the events that matter. * Publish honest benchmarks on latency, throughput and cost per million tokens, and build reproducible technical assets (repos, deployment templates, integrations) that developers can clone, run and adapt. * Share day\-zero coverage when significant open\-weight models ship, running a rota across timezones with our existing advocate and HQ marketing so that Verda is usable and documented within hours. * Work closely with our AI Lab, product engineering and go\-to\-market teams to identify high\-impact AI topics and turn new platform capabilities into developer\-facing work. * Be the voice of the US AI developer community inside Verda: unfiltered developer\-experience feedback to engineering and product. **Your key competencies** ------------------------- * A strong technical foundation in AI inference and GPU infrastructure. You have personally shipped inference workloads, and you can discuss batching, latency under load, quantisation trade\-offs and cost per million tokens from your own work rather than from reading. * Standing in the developer community that is yours, not your employer's. Writing, code or talks that people followed because of who you are. Standing travels between jobs; employer reach does not. * You want to be out there, and you can show it. Tell us how many rooms you were in last quarter and what came of each. * The ability to simplify complex systems and infrastructure concepts into practical insight without losing precision **Nice to have** ---------------- * Merged contributions to vLLM, SGLang or similar serving projects * An existing network among US AI product companies, open\-source maintainers and event organisers * Experience at developer\-tool, cloud infrastructure, AI\-native, or fast\-growing engineering\-first companies **Practicalities** ------------------ * **Salary:** $180,000 \- $250,000 * **Work mode:** Hybrid * **Level:** Senior * **Employment type:** Full time and permanent **What's next** --------------- We're building fast and this role needs the right person behind it. There's no artificial deadline, but when we find who we're looking for, we move. If this sounds like your next move, apply now. Please submit your application through our Careers page. We don't accept applications sent by email. By submitting this application, you confirm that the information you provide is accurate. We will process your personal data to assess your application for this role, as described in our Candidate Privacy Policy. Keeping your data to consider you for future roles is optional and only applies if you tick the box below.

VIAVI is also a leader in light management technologies for 3D sensing, anti\-counterfeiting, consumer electronics, industrial, automotive, government and aerospace applications. We are the people behind the products that help keep the world connected at home, school, work, at play, and everywhere in between. VIAVI employees are passionate about supporting customer success and we welcome people who bring their best every day to the company – to question, to collaborate and to push for solutions that will delight our customers.**Duties \& Responsibilities:** Primarily provides pre\-sales technical support for the development and implementation of complex products/applications/solutions.
