demonstrations. * Understand customer business needs and translate them into consultative, value\-driven solutions. * Lead proof\-of\-concept activities, ensuring successful technical evaluations. * Collaboration \& Solution Development * Work with internal and external teams to anticipate, qualify, and respond to customer needs. * Serve as liaison between sales, product marketing, and engineering to communicate customer requirements and feature requests. * Provide post\-sales technical support and ongoing customer training as required. * Collaborate with VIAVI Support and Engineering teams to resolve technical issues quickly and effectively. * Build and maintain trusted technical relationships with strategic customers. * Develop long\-term customer partnerships to support account growth and ongoing success. **Education \& Experience** --------------------------- * Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university in Engineering or related technical field (or equivalent work experience). * Minimum 5 years of experience in technical sales, business development, or pre\-sales in the telecommunications, networking, or test and measurement industry. * Proven track record managing large strategic accounts, preferably Cisco or other major OEMs. **Technical Expertise** ----------------------- * Strong background in networking, network security, and applications. * Hands\-on experience with IP and Ethernet technologies: Data Center Ethernet, 1\.6T/800/400/100/40/10GigEth, L4–L7 technologies, AI/ML, RoCEv2/CCL. * In\-depth knowledge of routing protocols: IPv4/IPv6, RIP, BGP, OSPF, ISIS, VXLAN and EVPN * Familiarity with MPLS protocols: RSVP\-TE, LDP. * Application\-level protocol knowledge: HTTP(S), TCP/IP. * Experience with test platforms such as: TestCenter, CyberFlood, Viavi, Keysight/Ixia, BreakingPoint Systems (preferred). * Programming/scripting experience in Python (a plus). * Cisco certifications (CCNA, CCNP, CCIE) are highly desirable. **Soft Skills** --------------- * + Outstanding interpersonal skills with strong verbal and written communication abilities. + Analytical thinker with strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail. + Service\-oriented, positive, and self\-motivated, with the ability to work independently. + Excellent organizational and time management skills. + Strong commitment to building and maintaining long\-term customer relationships. **Other Requirements** ---------------------- Ability to travel locally in the New England area, North Atlantic and Eastern USA (up to 90%). **Pre\-Requisites / Skills / Experience Requirements:** If you have what it takes to push boundaries and seize opportunities, apply to join our team today. jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: Our mission is to create the Experience of a Lifetime for our employees, so they can, in turn, create the Experience of a Lifetime for our guests. We own and operate the most renowned destination resorts in the world as well as regional and local ski areas outside major cities, and connect them all through one unrivaled network. We are looking for ambitious leaders, innovators and creators to join our talented team. If you’re ready to pursue your fullest potential, we want to get to know you! Candidates for year\-round positions are reviewed on a rolling basis. Applications will be accepted up to 90 days after the posting date, or until the position is filled (whichever is first). **Job Summary:** We are looking for a curious, driven, and innovative **Senior Data Engineer** who proactively takes initiative to solve complex problems and lead the development of data assets that elevate our marketing analytics capabilities. In this role, you will architect cost\-conscious, high\-efficiency data assets and serve as the subject matter expert on production\-ready data streams spanning email, website, app, and paid media source systems. You will drive a tight, cross\-functional partnership with the marketing analytics team to fundamentally enhance reporting and analytics capabilities across our entire digital and marketing landscape. **About the Team** The Data Science \& Data Engineering team within the Enterprise Analytics organization builds foundational data assets, predictive models, analytical applications, and platforms for the entire enterprise. Our team collaborates deeply with business stakeholders, analysts, and technology groups to tackle high\-impact use cases. We leverage modern tools and methodologies to accelerate business growth, optimize infrastructure costs, and continuously improve guest experiences. **Job Specifications:** * Starting Wage: $107,000 \- $140,000 \+ Annual bonus * Employment Type: Year Round * Shift Type: Full Time hours available * Minimum Age: At least 18 years of age * Housing Availability: No **Job Responsibilities:** * **Architect \& Scale Data Pipelines:** Design, build, and maintain robust, scalable ingestion pipelines from a diverse suite of marketing sources (APIs, SFTPs, webhooks etc.), ensuring high availability and data integrity. * **Optimize Core Data Assets:** Develop, maintain, and tune high\-performance dbt models to transform raw marketing data into production\-ready analytic assets for cross\-functional reporting. * **Drive Infrastructure Efficiency:** Audit and refactor existing data infrastructure to uncover cost efficiencies and optimize compute performance across marketing data sets. * **Enable AI\-Ready Data Products:** Develop semantic context and trusted data foundations for AI agents, predictive models, and conversational analytics. Apply AI\-assisted engineering practices while maintaining accountability for production quality * **Advance Governance \& Data Trust:** Author comprehensive data documentation, lineage maps, and artifacts to elevate data literacy and foster a culture of self\-service across the organization. * **Lead Cross\-Functional Partnerships:** Act as the primary engineering partner to the Marketing Analytics team, translating complex business requirements into high\-impact, performant data products. * **Bridge Engineering \& Enterprise Technology:** Collaborate with IT, security, architecture, and platform teams to align solutions with enterprise standards and resolve cross\-system dependencies. * **Serve as a Subject Matter Expert:** Act as a key technical resource for data engineering best practices, scalable architectural design, and marketing data usage. * **Drive Technical Excellence \& Mentorship:** Act as a technical mentor to elevate the team's engineering capabilities, driving continuous skill development and championing modern best practices across analytics and engineering cohorts **Job Requirements:** * **Quantitative Foundation**: B.S. degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Engineering). * **Data Engineering Maturity:** Proven ability to write clean, modular, testable, and maintainable code. Deep understanding of how to architect production\-grade systems over one\-off scripts or notebooks. * **Experience with Databricks,** especially Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, Databricks Workflows, job optimization, and governance. * **Python and SQL Proficiency:** strong in Python and SQL for building data pipelines, automation, model integrations, analytical workflows, and production services. * **Digital Marketing Domain Expertise:** Hands\-on experience managing and processing large\-scale digital marketing datasets (log\-level website, application, and paid media data) efficiently across cloud infrastructure. * **Modern Data Architecture:** Experience implementing Medallion architecture and a solid understanding of data warehouse design and schema structuring. * **Advanced dbt Core:** Expert\-level knowledge of dbt (Core) for modular data modeling, including strict enforcement of schema testing, documentation, and complex dependency management. * **Version Control \& CI/CD:** Proficient with Git workflows (branching strategies, pull requests, code reviews) and integrating pipelines into automated CI/CD deployment workflows. **Soft Skills:** * **Curious**: bring intellectual curiosity, an inquisitive nature, and a desire to deepen your knowledge and continue learning. * **Ownership**: take responsibility to proactively advance projects, contribute to the organization, and develop the best solutions. * **Initiative:** take initiative to understand full scope of business problems and propose solutions ahead of being directly asked * **Communication:** explain technical concepts, risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences. * **Collaboration:** work effectively cross\-functionally with data scientists, data engineers, analysts, application engineers, product partners, and business stakeholders. **Bonus Points if you have:** * A graduate degree (Masters or PhD) in a quantitative field * Experience jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Why VTV:** At Vance Thompson Vision, we take pride in being global leaders in vision correction, driven by our commitment to groundbreaking research, innovative technology, and exceptional patient care. With a reputation for setting the standard of excellence in our field, we continue to transform lives through better vision. We believe that exceptional care begins with an exceptional team. Be part of something greater—join us and discover what it means to create a world\-class culture while making a meaningful impact. Our core values that provide our foundation: * **Caring \-** We are passionate, empathetic, and sensitive to the needs of our teammates, patients, and everyone we touch. * **Fun \-** We choose a positive attitude every day. We use humor as a way to create a less formal, less stressful and more productive work environment. * **Committed \-** We are accountable and 100% committed to the Success of VTV. We are boundaryless; we are willing to take initiative to delight our customers, motivate fellow teammates and improve financial results. * **Egalitarian \-** We play on a team where everyone is equal, where no task is too small for any member to step up and own inside and outside their functional area. * **Excellence \-** We are committed to doing the extra work to be outstanding in customer service, patient care and team happiness. **Job Opportunity:** We are growing and looking for a **Data Engineer** on\-site in Sioux Falls, SD to own our Snowflake environment and the data pipelines that power our clinical, operational, and analytics teams. Working within our established medallion architecture, you will be responsible for ingesting, transforming, and organizing data from internal systems, diagnostic equipment, and external vendors so our AI and KPI teams have clean, reliable, analytics\-ready data. *You Are:* * Ready to live out our core values in every interaction with clinical, technical, and operational teammates * Detail\-oriented, analytical, and proactive about data quality and system reliability * Comfortable partnering with both technical teams (AI, analytics) and non\-technical clinical/operational leaders * Effective at managing multiple projects and shifting priorities in a fast\-moving healthcare environment *You Will Make an Impact By:* * Managing, tuning, and governing our Snowflake instance to ensure data is secure, well\-organized, and performant for downstream analytics and AI workloads. * Building and maintaining automated ETL/ELT pipelines and API/HL7 integrations that move data from internal databases, diagnostic equipment, and external vendor platforms into Snowflake’s medallion architecture. * Partnering closely with our AI team and KPI team to understand their data needs and deliver clean, trusted, well\-documented datasets. * Evaluating existing workflows, troubleshooting pipeline or query bottlenecks, and designing scalable technical solutions that improve clinical and operational efficiency. * Ensuring all data workflows, access controls, and integrations align with healthcare compliance standards and internal security protocols. * Creating clear documentation for schemas, pipelines, and data lineage to help technical and operational teams get the most out of our data platform. *You Have:* * A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). * 3\+ years of experience in data engineering, database administration, or a hybrid data infrastructure role. * Snowflake \& SQL Expertise: Strong hands\-on experience managing, tuning, and modeling data in Snowflake (or a comparable cloud data warehouse) and writing production\-grade SQL. * Pipeline \& Integration Experience:Proven track record building automated ETL/ELT pipelines and working with REST APIs; experience with medallion architecture is a strong plus. * Healthcare Data Familiarity (Preferred): Experience with healthcare data standards and integrations such as HL7, FHIR, DICOM, or EHR/vendor platforms. **Investments in YOU:** Vance Thompson Vision offers a full benefits package and competitive compensation, including: * Medical, dental and vision insurance * Employer paid benefits: paid time off, retirement savings contributions, life insurance and disability insurance * A variety of voluntary benefits for you and your family * $150 shoe allowance for full time staff * Education Allowance * Wellness Program paired with a Lifestyle Spending Account Vance Thompson Vision is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive culture for all employees.

jobs.title: Manager, Technical Account Management
jobs.description: * Field Engineering * Austin, New York City, San Francisco * Full Time **About Vercel:** ----------------- Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience. Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide. **About the Role:** ------------------- As a Manager, Technical Account Management, you’ll lead the Technical Account Managers who serve as the persistent technical advisor embedded in Vercel’s marquee accounts, across AI agent platforms, large\-scale migrations, and greenfield builds. This is an early, still\-forming function: you’ll coach a team of senior technical advisors while helping build the operating model, metrics, and playbooks it runs on. You’ll stay close to the accounts yourself, stepping into P1 and P2 escalations, reviewing architecture, and carrying a small set of strategic logos. In your first year, success looks like a team driving real adoption depth on their accounts, strong retention on the book they cover, and an engagement model repeatable enough to hire into. This is a hybrid role with 3 in\-office days per week in San Francisco, Austin, or New York City. **What You Will Do:** --------------------- * Lead and coach a team of Technical Account Managers, from hiring and ramp through career growth and the quality of their technical, written, and customer work * Own adoption depth and retention across the team’s marquee accounts: proactive architecture reviews, platform health checks, upgrade planning, and expansion surfaced to the Account Executive * Build the function alongside the Head of Professional Services: the engagement model, operating rhythm, QBR standards, and the metrics the team is measured on * Run point with the team on P1 and P2 escalations, review architecture and success plans, and carry a small set of strategic accounts yourself * Partner with Product, Engineering, Support, and Sales as the team’s internal advocate, and feed what the team learns in the field back into the roadmap **About You:** -------------- * 10\+ years in customer\-facing technical roles, including 3\+ years managing technical ICs * Have hired, coached, and grown a post\-sales technical team: TAM, Solutions Architecture, Professional Services, or Customer/Support Engineering * Have personally owned enterprise or marquee accounts post\-sale as the technical lead: run QBRs, managed P1/P2 escalations, and presented to VP and CTO\-level stakeholders * Technical depth in modern web development, cloud infrastructure, or AI/agentic development: can hold an architecture conversation with senior engineers and read code, configs, and usage data * Have built or materially shaped a team, process, or service line, not only run a steady\-state one * Track record of driving platform adoption and expansion on enterprise accounts, partnering jobs.description: ### **When you join Verizon** You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. Join the \#VTeamLife. **What you'll be doing...** We are seeking a hands\-on Software Engineer III (C\+\+) to join our core billing engineering team. In this role, you will serve as a key technical driver behind our high\-volume Unified Tax Engine, designing and implementing critical enhancements while ensuring system accuracy, performance, and stability. Beyond writing robust, scalable code, you will guide architectural design, mentor peers, and collaborate globally to scale our tax infrastructure to meet evolving regulatory and business requirements. **Key Responsibilities** * **Core Engine Development:** Designing, developing, and optimizing new features and enhancements within the core C\+\+ Unified Tax Engine to support high\-volume transaction processing. * **Ecosystem Integration:** Maintaining seamless interoperability between the core tax engine, surrounding RESTful microservices, and enterprise billing applications. * **Operational Excellence \& Support:** Leading month\-end financial close support, execute and validate tax reference refreshes across environments, and manage downtime\-free production deployments. * **Production Escalation:** Serving as a Level 3 escalation point to troubleshoot, debug, and resolve complex production incidents. * **Technical Leadership \& Collaboration:** Partnering with offshore engineering teams, Product Managers, QA, and Tax Domain Experts to translate complex regulatory rules into scalable technical solutions. * **Engineering Standards:** Leading peer code reviews, mentor junior and mid\-level engineers, drive technical debt reduction, and champion improvements in CI/CD pipelines and automated testing frameworks. **What we're looking for...** **You’ll need to have:** * Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience. * Four or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training. * Experience in backend software development experience. * Hands\-on proficiency in C\+\+ (experience with Modern C\+\+14/17/20 standards is strongly preferred). * Hands\-on experience with Java and RESTful microservices is highly desirable to support surrounding financial ecosystem applications. **Even better if you have:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience). * Prior experience with financial billing systems, tax calculation engines, or complex rule\-based architectures is a strong advantage. * Deep understanding of object\-oriented design, data structures, algorithm optimization, database management, and Git version control. * Proven ability to manage multi\-environment deployments, troubleshoot distributed systems, and communicate complex technical concepts clearly across global, cross\-functional teams. If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above. ### **Where you’ll be working** In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.### **Scheduled Weekly Hours** 40### **Equal Employment Opportunity** Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics. ### **Benefits and Compensation** Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD\&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home \& auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award\-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part\-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances. The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job\-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part\-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours. The annual salary range for the location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full\-time schedule is: $81,000\.00 \- $155,000\.00\.

jobs.title: Applications Engineer II - Data Centers
jobs.description: **Job Description** **Application Engineer II – Data Centers** Engineering Technology \| Victaulic World Headquarters – Easton, PA Full\-Time \| Engineering Technology – Application Engineering **ONSITE CORPORATE POSITION** Relocation assistance offered Visa/Immigration sponsorship is not offered for this role **ABOUT VICTAULIC** Victaulic, headquartered in Easton, Pennsylvania, is the global leader in mechanical pipe joining solutions, delivering advanced technologies and engineering services to address complex piping challenges faced by engineers, site owners and contractors. Since 1919, our innovative solutions have improved construction productivity and reduced risks, ensuring projects are completed safely, on time, and within budget. With over 6,000 employees spanning 50\+ locations worldwide, our teams are dedicated to delivering advanced technologies and engineering expertise that address real\-world challenges across a wide range of industries. Our sustainable solutions, made from high quality, graded scrap steel, promote circular construction by making piping systems infinitely reconfigured and minimizing environmental impact. Today, our high\-quality products are used in more than 140 countries, supporting some of the world's most critical and prestigious structures. The Application Engineering team within Engineering Technology is the technical voice of Victaulic for customers, owners, specifiers, code officials, and installers — providing product expertise, troubleshooting, and training, and carrying customer insight back into product development. **AN INDUSTRY LEADER WITH A HEART AS BIG AS ITS AMBITION AND INNOVATION** At Victaulic, we're committed to constructing a better world for and with our people. Let's Build a Better World Together. Our commitment to our people is built on four pillars: * We build from within. * We stand behind our people. * We foster an environment for constant learning. * We engineer change for a more stable and sustainable world. **YOUR IMPACT STARTS HERE** We're looking for an Application Engineer II to join our Application Engineering team at our World Headquarters in Easton, PA. In this role, you'll contribute your technical knowledge, communication skills, and problem\-solving skills to resolve complex problems for customers, with a focus on data center applications. You'll bring working knowledge of mechanical pipe joining systems, mechanical piping applications, and customer interactions, along with a foundation in commercial and national industry standards, codes, and industry organizations. You'll also be exposed to Victaulic processes, Project Management, Product Management, and Product Development. This role includes domestic travel of up to 20–30% of your time, with the possibility of international travel. **WHAT YOU'LL BUILD \& OWN** * Become a knowledgeable resource for Victaulic products and system solutions, including couplings, valves, fittings, catalog components, and devices * Develop solutions to a variety of complex situations that require independent judgment, ingenuity, and a quick response, drawing on your knowledge of commercial mechanical and data center systems and their key components * Apply applicable codes and standards, including ASME, AWWA, API, ASTM, and UL * Address direct customer inquiries regarding Victaulic product features, benefits, and applications * Provide technical and troubleshooting support to customers by phone, email, letters, and supervised job site visits, as well as to customers visiting Victaulic * Use your technical knowledge and investigative skills to complete product investigations and troubleshooting * Evaluate returned product and generate reports for customers detailing root cause analysis * Provide engineering consulting support to the sales organization, addressing technical applications of Victaulic products for customers, owners, specifiers, code officials, and installers — including telephone and written correspondence and investigation of field installations for product usage and performance * Serve as the “customer advocate” for product development engineers, marketing, manufacturing, and executive management on product issues and new product or service opportunities, sharing your product and application experience with the decision makers who shape product development and direction * Conduct training sessions and presentations for domestic and international Victaulic employees, sales personnel, and customers on the features, benefits, and appropriate application of our products and services, and visit customer facilities to address technical inquiries and host training and educational seminars when appropriate * Serve as an internal resource on the industry market space, competitor products, and product issues, capturing competitive intelligence and industry information on an ongoing basis * Identify training opportunities to improve Victaulic products, solutions, and education **WHAT YOU BRING** * Bachelor of Science degree in a relevant engineering discipline or other relevant technical experience * 5–7 years of data center industry experience * Experience problem solving in person or by electronic means (FaceTime, Zoom, etc.) * Aptitude with hand tools (socket sets, screwdrivers, impact wrenches) and precision measurement tools (dial caliper) * Proficiency in Microsoft Office products * Excellent communication, influencing, and presentation skills, with tact and a professional appearance * Experience preparing clear and concise reports, procedures, correspondence, and other written technical materials, and communicating effectively through electronic media as well as written and verbal forms * Experience interpreting drawings, specifications, codes, standards, and regulatory requirements * Ability to work proactively and independently, manage your time effectively, and prioritize, organize, and perform multiple work assignments simultaneously * Customer service orientation * Experience working in a global cross\-functional team environment, with knowledge of and/or experience working with groups of varied cultural backgrounds and learning styles * Willingness to travel up to 20–30% of the time domestically, with the possibility of international travel * Ability to lift within OSHA\-approved safe lifting limits and to climb and work on ladders and scaffolds * Valid driver's license with no driving restrictions **WHAT SETS YOU APART** * Experience working with commercial mechanical industry customers in promotional and troubleshooting activities **WHAT WE OFFER** **Build A Better Career** * Relocation assistance offered for this role * Career development programs and internal promotion pathways — we build from within * Tuition reimbursement and continuous learning opportunities **Build A Better Future** * Comprehensive healthcare coverage * 401(k) with company match * Company\-paid short\-term disability and life insurance **Build A Better You** * Paid time off plans and paid holidays * Company\-paid Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * Adoption assistance * Inclusive, team\-oriented culture where people look out for one another **Build A Better World** Join a company whose products contribute to a safer, more sustainable built environment every day. **COMPENSATION** The base salary range for this position will be determined based on experience, qualifications, skills, and geographic location. This role is also eligible for the full benefits package described above. **EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY** Victaulic is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EOE/M/F/Vets/Disabled) employer and welcomes all qualified applicants. Applicants will receive fair and impartial consideration without regard to race, gender, color, religion, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, genetic data, or other legally protected status. (Background checks may be required as part of our pre\-employment process.) **VICTAULIC STAFFING PARTNER COMMUNICATION POLICY** All staffing agencies are strictly forbidden from directly contacting any Victaulic employees, except those within the Human Resources/Talent Acquisition team. All communications, inquiries and candidate submissions must be routed through Victaulic's Human Resources/Talent Acquisition team. Non\-compliance with this policy may result in the suspension of partnership, cancellation of the current contract, and/or the imposition of a mandatory probation period before any future business can resume. Additionally, non\-compliance may lead to a permanent ban on future business. This policy ensures a streamlined and compliant recruitment process. Let's Build a Better World Together. victaulic.com/careers * \#LI\-JT1 \#LI\-ONSITE \#TOP123

jobs.title: PCL Scientific Software and Data Platform Engineer
jobs.description: * 538613 * Blacksburg, Virginia, United States * Electrical and ComputerEngineering * Engineering * Information Systems / Technology * Research / Scientific * Faculty (Salaried) * Virginia Tech **Job Description** The Scientific Software and Data Platform Engineer contributes to the research objectives of the NSF\-funded Genesis/PCL Node project through the design, development, evaluation, and integration of specialized scientific software and research data infrastructure. The position supports experimental research by developing software tools and computational methods that enable reproducible experiments, traceable scientific data, and interoperability among laboratory instrumentation, modeling, artificial intelligence, and research computing systems. Working under the general supervision of project leadership, the engineer independently manages assigned research software development activities and contributes to the design, implementation, testing, and validation of scientific software solutions. Responsibilities include developing experiment\-record and provenance services, scientific data acquisition and management applications, instrument data pipelines, and application programming interfaces (APIs). The engineer collaborates with research faculty, students, data and AI specialists, automation and technical integration leads, facility personnel, University Libraries, and university research computing and information security teams. The position contributes to scientific software prototypes, technical research documentation, and sponsored research deliverables. The engineer exercises independent technical judgment within the approved project architecture. The position does not independently authorize instrument operations, modify laboratory safety controls, approve scientific conclusions, authorize AI\-generated physical actions, or establish institutional security and compliance policies. **Required Qualifications** * Master's Degree, Bachelor's \+ 3 years post\-degree experience \+ relevant certifications in computer science, software engineering, computer engineering, information technology, data science, or a closely related field. * Experience developing, testing, or maintaining software applications or data\-intensive systems using Python, including experience with APIs, databases, version control, or automated testing. * Experience developing, adapting, or evaluating software solutions supporting scientific research, experimental workflows, or complex technical applications. * Experience translating research, scientific, or technical requirements into software designs, applications, or documented technical solutions. * Experience applying secure software development practices, including authentication, authorization, access control, or least\-privilege principles. * Experience with containerized applications, continuous integration and delivery, configuration management, software monitoring, or application troubleshooting. * Experience preparing technical documentation, software development records, or written technical reports. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience developing scientific software, research software prototypes, or research data infrastructure in a university, national laboratory, or research\-intensive environment. * Experience with scientific data acquisition, research data management, machine\-actionable metadata, provenance tracking, persistent identifiers, or FAIR data principles. * Experience developing, integrating, deploying, or supporting artificial intelligence or machine\-learning applications in scientific computing environments, including GPU\-accelerated computing, model inference, or API\-based integration. * Experience integrating laboratory instrumentation or working with scientific data acquisition and experiment\-control frameworks such as Bluesky, ophyd, or EPICS. * Experience with high\-performance computing, research storage, cloud computing resources, or scientific computing infrastructure. * Experience contributing to research software publications, technical reports, open\-source scientific software, or sponsored research deliverables. **Overtime Status** Exempt: Not eligible for overtime **Appointment Type** Restricted **Salary Information** $85,000\-$110,000, Commensurate with Experience **Hours per week** 40 **Review Date** December 2, 2026 **Additional Information** The successful candidate will be required to have a criminal conviction check. **About Virginia Tech** Dedicated to its motto, *Ut Prosim* (That I May Serve), Virginia Tech pushes the boundaries of knowledge by taking a hands\-on, transdisciplinary approach to preparing scholars to be leaders and problem\-solvers. A comprehensive land\-grant institution that enhances the quality of life in Virginia and throughout the world, Virginia Tech is an inclusive community dedicated to knowledge, discovery, and creativity. The university offers more than 280 majors to a diverse enrollment of more than 36,000 undergraduate, graduate, and professional students in eight undergraduate colleges, a school of medicine, a veterinary medicine college, Graduate School, and Honors College. The university has a significant presence across Virginia, including Blacksburg, the greater Washington, D.C. area, the Health Sciences and Technology Campus in Roanoke, sites in Newport News and Richmond, and numerous Extension offices and research institutes. A leading global research institution, Virginia Tech conducts more than $650 million in research annually. Virginia Tech endorses and encourages participation in professional development opportunities and university shared governance. These valuable contributions to university shared governance provide important representation and perspective, along with opportunities for unique and impactful professional development. Virginia Tech does not discriminate against employees, students, or applicants on the basis of age, color, disability, sex (including pregnancy), gender, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, ethnicity or national origin, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, or military status, or otherwise discriminate against employees or applicants who inquire about, discuss, or disclose their compensation or the compensation of other employees or applicants, or on any other basis protected by law. If you are an individual with a disability and desire an accommodation, please contact Cole Tankersley at cpt19@vt.edu during regular business hours at least 10 business days prior to the event.

jobs.title: Director, Data Platform
jobs.description: **About Us** Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. **Job Description** Visa's Data Trust \& Platform Engineering (DTPE) organization delivers the foundational platforms that power Visa's enterprise data, analytics, AI, and cloud ecosystem. DTPE is responsible for advancing secure, scalable, governed, and resilient data platform capabilities spanning hybrid\-cloud infrastructure, compute, storage, streaming, orchestration, data governance, privacy, quality, and platform engineering services. jobs.description: **Note** : This job will be posted through 11:59 PM of the day **prior** to the end date listed. **Current Washington County Employees:** Please apply through the employee portal to be considered for this opportunity. **Job Type:** Regular **Pay Range:** $124,932\.24 \- $151,816\.92 Salary **Department:** Cooperative Library Services **FLSA Exemption Status:** Exempt **About the Opportunity:** Few public\-sector IT roles offer the chance to steward a complete technology environment. This one does. Washington County Cooperative Library Services (WCCLS) designs and operates its infrastructure separately from the county's central ITS department: a 20\-site metro\-area network with a dedicated internet edge, two data centers, and the services that connect public libraries serving more than 600,000 residents. When a patron applies for a job, finishes homework, or downloads their next book, they're counting on systems you'll keep running and make better. In this hybrid role, you'll be responsible for our network, firewalls, virtualization, storage, identity, and cloud platforms, with real influence over where they go next. You'll work directly with carriers and vendors, take part in the on\-call rotation, lead incident response, and help move our security and compliance work forward. Just as important, you'll lead people. You'll supervise and mentor two client services technicians and work alongside them regularly at our administration building in Hillsboro. You'll also collaborate closely with our database and web administrators and keep improving the service management practices that support more than 500 library staff. We're looking for someone as comfortable reading a packet capture as coaching a technician through a tough problem. This isn't a caretaker role. In your first year, you'll replace our production data center storage, shape the future of our virtualization platform, complete a core network modernization, and manage a countywide rollout of people counters at member libraries. It's an ideal next step for a senior engineer ready to move into supervision, or a supervisor who wants to stay close to the technology. If you're a systems thinker who enjoys balancing strategy with hands\-on work, values autonomy and creative control, and is energized by public service, we'd love to hear from you. **Position Summary** As the IT Infrastructure Supervisor, you'll oversee WCCLS's network, systems, and client services operations. Reporting to the IT Manager, you'll supervise a senior and a junior client services technician and serve on the WCCLS supervisor team, contributing to technology planning, budgets, and operational priorities. In a typical week, you might work with a carrier to resolve a circuit issue, coach a technician through a complex ticket, plan a maintenance window, review a vendor proposal, or coordinate an equipment installation with library IT staff. **Key areas of responsibility include:** * Supervising, coaching, and developing client services staff, guiding endpoint management, and serving as backup to the senior client services technician. * Serving as primary administrator for routing, switching, wireless, and firewalls, including completing a core network modernization. * Maintaining and improving virtualization, storage, backup, directory and identity, and cloud platforms, including replacing our production data center storage and planning the next generation of our virtualization platform. * Leading incident response, participating in the on\-call rotation, and helping shape an upcoming initiative to strengthen security, privacy, and compliance practices. * Managing and continuously improving the IT service management platform and support processes. * Working directly with carriers, ISPs, and vendors on quotes, purchase orders, contract administration, and invoice approval, and contributing to budget planning. * Planning and managing projects in coordination with member library staff, including a countywide rollout of optical people counters, from scoping and sourcing to scheduling installations with local library managers and overseeing implementation. Evaluating emerging technologies and recommending improvements to service delivery. * **Ideal Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities (KSAs)** **Knowledge of:** * Multi\-site metro\-area network design and administration, including dynamic routing (BGP and OSPF), switching, firewalls, wireless, and internet edge connectivity. * Data center infrastructure, including server virtualization, shared storage, backup and recovery, and administration of Windows and Linux servers and the applications they host. * Directory, identity, and access management across on\-premises and cloud platforms, including single sign\-on and multifactor authentication. * Information security practices, incident response, and data protection. * Scripting and automation for system administration, monitoring, and routine tasks. * Principles of supervision, training, perfor al leadership capacity. Leadership of technology projects, software or hardware implementations, or demonstrated technical leadership may be considered in lieu of direct supervisory experience; OR * An Associate degree in computer science, business administration, or related field; AND seven (7\) years of experience in information technology analysis and support, including two (2\) years in a supervisory, lead, or technical leadership capacity. Leadership of technology projects, software or hardware implementations, or demonstrated technical leadership may be considered in lieu of direct supervisory experience; OR * A Bachelor's degree in computer science, business administration, or related field; AND five (5\) years of experience in information technology analysis and support, including two (2\) years in a supervisory, lead, or technical leadership capacity. Leadership of technology projects, software or hardware implementations, or demonstrated technical leadership may be considered in lieu of direct supervisory experience. Additional Requirements * Some positions may be required to possess a valid driver's license and have an acceptable driving record per Washington County policy. Some incumbents may be required to participate in an extensive background check. * **About the Department/Division:** WCCLS is the primary funding source for public libraries in Washington County and provides the infrastructure that connects independently operated libraries into one seamless countywide system. WCCLS is not a library. We are a partnership among Washington County, nine cities, and three nonprofit organizations that operate local libraries. As a county department of 45 employees, we support 16 library locations, a shared collection of more than 1\.5 million items, and the technology, logistics, digital services, and operational systems that make countywide library access possible. **Selection Process:** You can review our standard selection process here . **Our commitment to you:** Washington County is an equal opportunity employer committed to using a merit\-based system in which recruiting, selecting, and advancing employees is based on knowledge, skills, and abilities. Our organization embraces innovation, collaboration, and work\-life harmony. jobs.title: C-BRAIN Technical Product Manager - Neurology
jobs.description: **Location** ============ Remote, US **Scheduled Hours** =================== 40 **Position Summary** ==================== The Consortium for Brain Research and AI in Neurodegeneration (C\-BRAIN) is an academic\-industry consortium directed by Dr. Randall J. Bateman, Washington University School of Medicine in St. Louis. C\-BRAIN brings together academic research institutions, pharmaceutical and biotech companies, technology partners, philanthropic organizations, and government agencies to develop AI\-powered tools to accelerate discovery in Alzheimer's disease and neurodegenerative disorders. Washington University serves as the coordinating center for C\-BRAIN. C\-BRAIN is currently deploying initial versions of the tools and developing plans for benchmarking and evaluation of the tools in addition to platform integration and scaling. C\-BRAIN is also working on development of foundation models for brain aging and neurodegeneration. See www.c\-brain.org. The C\-BRAIN Technical Product Manager connects the scientists who use C\-BRAIN's AI research tools with the teams that build them. Reporting to the C\-BRAIN Senior Technical Product Manager, this role builds an automated evaluation harness and runs benchmarking and evaluation cycles for C\-BRAIN tools and models, operates C\-BRAIN's Scientific Community Program with research labs and data contributors, turns scientist feedback into a prioritized pipeline of feature requests and bugs for the engineering teams, and produces the KPI and compute\-cost reports that show whether the tools are working for researchers. The role also supports hands\-on user workshops, release readiness, backlog triage, roadmap updates, and partner coordination, with room to take on broader product and program ownership. The ideal candidate has run technical programs or products with scientific or technical users, analyzes data in Python or SQL, understands evaluation methods, writes clearly, and follows through without close supervision. C\-BRAIN\-specific context will be provided; product and program management fundamentals will not. A background in neuroscience, data science, software development, AI product delivery, or biomedical research is a plus. **Job Description** =================== **Primary Duties \& Responsibilities:** Benchmarking and Evaluation Operations * Lead development of the automated evaluation harness with data scientists and engineers: golden question sets on capabilities such as literature synthesis, hypothesis generation, and tool orchestration, and scripts that run them for each release. * Run benchmarking cycles for each tool and model release with C\-BRAIN data scientists and engineers: schedule runs, track results across versions, and report regressions before release, including side\-by\-side comparisons of candidate LLMs before the platform changes models, and publish evaluation results with each release. * Recruit, schedule, and manage expert annotators from participating labs for human evaluation of tool outputs, including rubrics, assignments, and checks of agreement between annotators, and use expert ratings to calibrate LLM\-as\-a\-judge scoring. * Maintain benchmark question sets and evaluation records with clear provenance in approved computing environments, and keep the release calendar and evaluation status visible to the team. jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer (Remote)
jobs.description: **Job Summary** --------------- As the largest online distributor of restaurant supplies and equipment, WebstaurantStore offers a catalog of more than 430,000 products supported by fast, reliable shipping. Nearly all our technological design, development, and system management are handled in\-house, allowing us to build custom, innovative solutions in a rapidly evolving e\-commerce landscape. As our business and technology continue to grow, we’re seeking a Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to help improve the reliability, scalability, performance, and recoverability of our business services. In this hands\-on engineering and internal consulting role, you’ll partner with multiple development verticals and the teams that operate shared infrastructure. You’ll bring software development experience to production reliability challenges: learning each team’s services and technology stack, investigating issues across application and infrastructure boundaries, and recommending practical improvements. You’ll help teams establish measurable reliability targets, prepare for failure, and reduce operational toil, without taking ownership of their application code or priorities. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Reduce alerts and manual effort through automation, self\-healing, and scalable services; prevent unplanned disruptions, maintain effective service maps and reliability practices, and provide data\-driven recommendations. * Participate in design reviews and team planning; influence the product roadmap and collaborate with engineering and product teams to improve product resiliency and reliability. * Consult with software development teams to understand their services, code, architecture, dependencies, and risks. * Use development, code\-reading, and debugging skills to investigate production issues and advise. * Identify changes for the product architecture from the reliability, performance, and availability perspectives with a data\-driven approach. * Define and improve SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, dashboards, and alerts for critical services. * Map service and infrastructure dependencies, establish recovery objectives and plans, lead or participate in disaster\-recovery exercises. * Lead the technical response to incidents, including coordinating with NOC, Security Operations, and fault owners while keeping incident command and repair ownership clear. * Proactively work on efficiency and capacity planning to set clear requirements and optimize system resources usage. * Advise teams on the technologies that underpin their services, including application runtimes, GitLab and CI/CD, databases, messaging, search, load balancing, observability, and datacenter infrastructure. **Physical Requirements** ------------------------- * Work is performed while sitting/standing and interfacing with a personal computer. * Requires the ability to communicate effectively using speech, vision, and hearing. * Requires the regular use of hands for simple grasping and fine manipulations. * Requires occasional bending, squatting, crawling, climbing, and reaching. * Requires the ability to occasionally lift, carry, push, or pull medium weights, up to 50lbs. **Remote Work Qualifications** ------------------------------ * Access to a reliable and secure high\-speed internet connection. Cable or fiber internet connections (at least 75mbps download/10mbps upload) are preferred, as satellite connections often cannot support the technologies used to perform day\-to\-day tasks. * Access to a home router and modem. * A dedicated home office space that is noise\- and distraction\-free. The space should have strong wireless connection or a wired Ethernet connection (wired connection is preferred, if possible). * A valid, physical address (apartment, suite, etc.). PO Boxes are not supported, as a physical address is required for you to receive your computer equipment. * The desire and ability to work and communicate with other team members via chat, webcam, etc. * Legal residents of one of the following states: (AK, AL, AR, AZ, CT, DE, FL, GA, IA, ID, IN, KS, KY, LA, MD, ME, MI, MN, MO, MS, MT, NC, ND, NE, NH, NM, NV, OH, OK, PA, SC, SD, TN, TX, UT, VA, VT, WI, WV, or WY). H\-1B Visa Sponsorship Not Available, W2 only. **Experience** -------------- **Required Skills:** * 5\+ years in an SRE or title\-adjacent role * 2\+ years of professional software development experience. * Working knowledge of at least one production application stack or programming language. (.NET, ReactJS) * Proven track record of automating manual processes, preferably with Ansible and/or Terraform. * A developer’s mindset and the ability to consult across teams: ask effective discovery questions, build trust, influence without direct authority, and adapt recommendations to a team’s context. * Proven ability to develop internal applications/tools and contribute code to infrastructure or production systems. * Advanced Linux knowledge and system administration experience. * Strong understanding of distributed systems, service dependencies, failure modes, and production operations. * Experience with observability practices, investigating incidents and communicating technical impact, and follow\-up actions. * Experience with several of the following: SLOs and SLIs, error budgets, disaster recovery, RTO/RPO, capacity planning, load testing, performance analysis, service mapping, or toil automation. **Preferred Skills:** * Application and development: .NET, ColdFusion, Python, Git, GitLab, and GitLab CI/CD. * Messaging, search, and traffic: RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ, Kafka, Elasticsearch, HAProxy, Cloudfare, Redis. * Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry (OTel). * Automation: Terraform and Ansible. * Understanding of web hosting infrastructure and architecture in highly available environments * Datacenter and infrastructure: physical servers, virtualization, storage, networking, DNS, load balancers and firewalls. **Education** ------------- This role does not require a degree. We value relevant skills and experience and alignment with our core values above all else. **Desired Traits \& Skills** ---------------------------- **Hungry:** * Passionate for their work. * Goes above and beyond to get the job done. * Looks for opportunities in all aspects of the company. * Process improvement focus. **Humble:** * Easily admits to mistakes. * Acknowledges his/her weaknesses. * Displays a grounded confidence but not arrogance. **Smart:** * Shows empathy. * Attentive listener. * Adjusts his/her own behavior to fit the nature of a conversation. * Understands what others are thinking. **One Part of the Bigger Picture** WebstaurantStore’s parent company, Clark Associates, has made the *Central Penn Business Journal’s* list of “Top 50 Fastest Growing Companies” in Pennsylvania for 9 years in a row. The base of Clark’s success comes from our key directives: Hiring great people, creating value for customers, and investing in employees and their communities. These pillars drive each of Clark Associates’ multi\-million\-dollar businesses forward, including WebstaurantStore and other industry\-leading names like 11400, Clark Food Service Equipment, The Restaurant Store, and Clark National Accounts. **Are You Ready?** Entrepreneurial Spirit is the driving force behind WebstaurantStore’s work environment. Making things better for our customers is our goal every single day. Achieving that goal means taking risks, accepting failure, and learning from our mistakes. If that sounds like a mission you’re ready to be a part of, we’d love to discuss this role with you further, and we’re excited to meet you! **Never heard of us? That’s okay! We love sharing our stories.** * *WebstaurantStore \| About Us* * *Video Message from Leadership* * *Clark Associates Timeline \[Parent Company]* **Check us out on:** * *LinkedIn* * *Instagram* * *Facebook* * *YouTube* * *TikTok* * *Pinterest* * *X/Twitter* **Working Environment** ----------------------- Participate in a dedicated SRE on\-call rotation every 6 weeks (with a full\-capacity team). Schedule may change based on team needs. **Company Overview** -------------------- The foodservice professional’s premier source for restaurant equipment, supplies, and knowledge online. Our purpose is to empower and equip people to run their businesses more profitably and efficiently. **Benefits** ------------ * Medical * Vision * Dental * PTO * Paid Maternity Leave * Paid Parental Leave * Life Insurance * Disability * Dependent Care FSA * 401(k) matching * Employee Assistance Program * Wellness Incentives * Company Discounts * AT\&T \& Verizon Discount * Bonus Opportunities * Accident Insurance * Critical Illness Insurance * Adoption Assistance ### **Available at HQ Locations Only** * On\-Site Fitness Centers * Dog\-friendly Offices
