With over 230,000 employees and business partners across 65 countries, we deliver on the promise of helping our customers, colleagues, and communities thrive in an ever\-changing world. For additional information, visit us at www.wipro.com. **About the Role** We are seeking an AI Researcher with strong hands\-on experience in **Supervised Fine\-Tuning (SFT)** , **Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF)** , **RL environments (gyms)** , and **model evaluation** . The role focuses on training, aligning, and evaluating models—particularly for **STEM, coding, robotics, reasoning, and real\-world problem\-solving capabilities** . You will help build systems that not only perform well on benchmarks, but also reason effectively, generalize to real\-world scenarios, and align with human intent. **͏** ----- **Key Responsibilities** * Design and implement **SFT pipelines** for training models on **STEM subjects, coding tasks, robotics concepts, logical reasoning, and real\-world problem\-solving** * Develop and execute **RLHF workflows** , including preference data collection, reward modeling, and policy optimization * Create and maintain **RL environments / gyms** for reasoning tasks, coding challenges, robotics simulations, and applied real\-world scenarios * Train models to improve **step\-by\-step reasoning, tool use, and structured problem solving** * Design and run **model evaluation frameworks** covering: * + STEM and mathematical reasoning + Code correctness, efficiency, and robustness + Robotics task success and planning + Real\-world decision\-making and generalization * Perform error analysis to identify reasoning failures, hallucinations, or misalignment * Collaborate with engineers, educators, and domain experts to curate high\-quality training and evaluation datasets * Translate research insights into scalable, production\-ready training and evaluation systems Document experiments, results, and best practices with strong reproducibility standards **͏** ----- **Required Qualifications** * Strong background in **machine learning, reinforcement learning, or AI research** * Hands\-on experience with **SFT and RLHF** , especially for reasoning\-intensive tasks * Experience building or using **RL gyms / environments** , including task\-driven or simulation\-based setups * Solid understanding of **model evaluation** , including automated metrics and human\-in\-the\-loop evaluation * Proficiency in **Python** and ML frameworks such as **PyTorch** * Ability to reason deeply about **model behavior, generalization, and alignment** Experience training or evaluating models on **STEM, coding, or real\-world problem domains** **͏** ----- **Preferred / Nice\-to\-Have** * Experience with **LLMs, multimodal models, or foundation models** * Background in **robotics, simulation environments, or embodied AI** * Familiarity with **program synthesis, code evaluation, or formal reasoning** * Experience with large\-scale or distributed training * Interest or experience in **AI safety, alignment, or robustness** Publications, open\-source contributions, or applied research experience **͏** ----- \[\[custJD]] The expected compensation for this role ranges from $200,000\.00 to $308,000\.00\. Final compensation will depend on various factors, including your geographical location, minimum wage obligations, skills, and relevant experience. Based on the position, the role is also eligible for Wipro’s standard benefits including a full range of medical and dental benefits options, disability insurance, paid time off (inclusive of sick leave), other paid and unpaid leave options. Applicants are advised that employment in some roles may be conditioned on successful completion of a post\-offer drug screening, subject to applicable state law. Wipro provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. Applications from veterans and people with disabilities are explicitly welcome. Reinvent your world. We are building a modern Wipro. We are an end\-to\-end digital transformation partner with the boldest ambitions. To realize them, we need people inspired by reinvention. Of yourself, your career, and your skills. We want to see the constant evolution of our business and our industry. It has always been in our DNA \- as the world around us changes, so do we. Join a business powered by purpose and a place that empowers you to design your own reinvention.

jobs.title: Front End UI/UX Designer
jobs.description: **About Wizard** ================ Wizard is building the AI\-native platform for creative work, starting with professional video. Creative software has barely changed in 25 years, and we're the team that gets to move it. We're building a native C\+\+ editor and a headless media runtime, with AI agents built into the workflow from day one. We are partners with Story from day one: Story's editors cut real projects in Wizard and tell us every week what works and what doesn't. We're a small team in San Francisco that has done this before. **The role** ============ You'll design how people use Wizard: the editor's timeline, panels and viewers, the agent experience inside them, and the web surfaces around the app. You'll own the interface from first sketch to shipped pixels, working side by side with the engineers who build it in C\+\+/Qt and on the web. You'll report to Jack Gardner, Head of Product \& Design, and work most closely with the UI/UX Software Engineer, the Project Manager and the forward deployed engineers. Your most important users are professional editors, starting with Story's team, so you'll spend real time watching them work. **What you'll do** ================== * Design the editor's core workflows: timeline, media browser, inspector, viewers and color and audio panels. * Design how editors work with AI agents: prompting, reviewing an agent's changes, and undoing them. * Build and maintain Wizard's design system, with components the C\+\+/Qt and web engineers can build directly. * Prototype interactions at real speed and test them with Story editors and paid beta customers. * Turn editor feedback into clear specs, edge cases and acceptance criteria with the Project Manager. * Design the web surfaces: signup, onboarding, download, pricing and collaborative review. * Review builds every week and push the details until they feel right on large, real projects. **What you'll bring** ===================== * 5\+ years designing complex desktop or pro software, with a portfolio of shipped work. * Deep interaction design skill for dense, keyboard\-driven tools where speed matters. * Strong visual craft: type, layout, iconography and dark, color\-accurate interfaces. * Fluency in Figma, plus a prototyping tool that can show real timing and motion. * Comfort working directly with engineers and reading enough front\-end code to know what's cheap and what's hard. * A habit of testing with real users and changing your mind when the evidence says to. **Nice to have** ================ * You've edited video, or designed for NLEs, color grading, audio or VFX tools. * You've designed AI or agent\-driven product experiences. * You can build your own prototypes in HTML/CSS/JS or Qt/QML. * You've built a design system from scratch at an early\-stage company. **Compensation** ================ The base salary range for this role is $160,000 – $220,000\. Your final offer will depend on your experience, skills and level.

jobs.title: Associate Software Engineer, Robotics
jobs.description: Within Wonder, the Robotics team is a core pillar of our innovation strategy. We build the automation solutions that help make Wonder’s 'no\-compromise' promise possible at scale. Our mission is to use robotics to enable incredible variety and culinary authenticity. By reimagining the kitchen environment, we improve the daily experience of our team members and ensure every customer receives a perfect meal, every time. The best in the business are coming to Wonder, working every day to make us the destination for every mealtime moment. Join a team of technology, culinary, and logistics pioneers, backed by top\-tier venture capitalists, and help us make great food more accessible. **About The Opportunity** We are seeking a motivated and detail\-oriented Software Engineer, Robotics with a passion for hardware\-adjacent programming to join our engineering team. In this role, you will help design, program, and commission the software that brings our automated machinery to life. You will work closely with senior engineers to implement controls solutions for several cutting\-edge products Wonder is creating. This includes programming PLCs, commissioning motion and I/O systems, and supporting these systems through their entire life cycle. This is a highly hands\-on role where you will see your code translate directly into machine progress, physical movement, and product success. **The Impact You Will Make** * Write, test, and debug control software for automated systems using PLCs (Structured Text, C\+\+) and PC\-based control systems (Python, C/C\+\+). * Assist in integrating sensors and actuators (both pneumatic and motion\-controlled) into fully functioning robotic systems. * Participate in the testing and debugging of physical machinery in our lab space to ensure correct, safe, and reliable machine operation. * Maintain clear documentation of machine specifications and operating guides. Assist the Electrical Controls team with maintaining and updating control system schematics. **What You Bring to the Table** * **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics Engineering, or Computer Science (or a related technical field). * **Experience**: 1\+ years experience in a software engineer role or related field. * **Problem\-Solving**: Strong troubleshooting skills and the patience required to debug complex, real\-time interactions between software and physical hardware. * **Programming Exposure**: Familiarity with at least one automation language (IEC 61131\-3 standards like Structured Text) OR a standard programming language used in hardware interfacing (C, C\+\+, or Python). * **Hardware Curiosity**: A strong interest in working directly with physical hardware, motors, and robotics. You are eager to roll up your sleeves, grab a multimeter, and work right next to an active machine. **Additional Skills** * Academic Projects, extracurriculars (like FIRST Robotics), or internships involving robotics, industrial automation, or customer mechatronic systems. * Prior exposure to B\&R Industrial Automation software (Automation Studio) and hardware. **What We Bring to the Table** * **Mentorship**: Dedicated mentorship from senior controls and software engineers who want to see you grow. * **Hardware Exposure**: Direct, hands\-on experience with cutting\-edge industrial automation and robotic hardware. * **Industry Impact**: The chance to work with a pioneering team leading the restaurant automation industry. * **Career Path**: A flexible career path that allows you to grow into one of several specialized silos on our expanding Software team. This role requires a minimum of 4 days a week in the office, with additional days as needed based on project demands. This role is based in our Boston office in Charlestown, MA Massachusetts: $114,000 \- $121,000 Wonder uses geographic\-specific salary structures, which means the salary offered may vary depending on where the job is located. The final salary offer will take into account various factors, such as the candidate's skills, education, training, credentials, and experience. **Benefits** The benefits applicable to this role include a competitive compensation package with equity and a 401(k). We also offer a choice of medical, dental, and vision plans, company paid short and long term disability coverage, paid time off including flexible time off for exempt employees, paid vacation for non\-exempt employees, and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable law in addition to paid parental leave, discounted meals and exclusive perks across the Wonder family of brands. Eligibility, effective dates, and available plan options vary by employment classification and location. To learn more about benefits for this role, visit our Careers page here. **A Final Note** At Wonder, we build the best teams by hiring with an objective lens — evaluating people for their potential while championing diversity, equity, and inclusion. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, military service eligibility, veteran status, marital status, disability, or any other protected class. As part of our commitment to fair and compliant hiring practices, Wonder participates in the federal government's E\-Verify program to confirm employment eligibility. If you need an accommodation during the interview process, please let your recruiter know. **We look forward to hearing from you! We'll contact you via email or text to schedule interviews and share information about your candidacy**.

jobs.title: Software Engineer Energy Grid Data Platform.
jobs.description: Wood Mackenzie is the global leader in analytics, insights and proprietary data across the entire energy and natural resources landscape. For over 50 years our work has guided the decisions of the world’s most influential energy producers, utilities companies, financial institutions and governments. Now, with the world’s energy system more complex and interconnected than ever before, sector\-specific views are no longer enough. That’s why we’ve redefined what’s possible with Intelligence Connected. By fusing our unparalleled proprietary data with the sharpest analytical minds, all supercharged by Synoptic AI, we deliver a clear, interconnected view of the entire value chain. Our trusted team of 2,700 experts across 30 countries breaks siloes and connects industries, markets and regions across the globe. This empowers our customers to identify risk sooner, spot opportunities faster and recalibrate strategy with confidence – whether planning days, weeks, months or decades ahead. Wood Mackenzie Intelligence Connected **WoodMac.com** **Wood Mackenzie Brand Video** **Wood Mackenzie Values** * Inclusive – we succeed together * Trusting – we choose to trust each other * Customer committed – we put customers at the heart of our decisions * Future Focused – we accelerate change * Curious – we turn knowledge into action **Company** Wood Mackenzie is a global research, analytics and consultancy business serving the natural resources industry. We provide data, analytics and insights that help customers make informed decisions across oil, gas and LNG, power and renewables, chemicals, metals and mining. Our sector teams are located around the world and support customers with intelligence on assets, companies and market indicators. Together, we help customers address complex challenges and support the transition to a more sustainable future. LandGate, a Wood Mackenzie business, is a fast\-growing vertical intelligence platform specialising in energy, infrastructure, and data centre site selection. Through proprietary datasets and market intelligence, it helps customers identify, evaluate, and develop energy and infrastructure opportunities across the United States. **Role Purpose** As a Senior Data Engineer, you will be a key contributor to the core data platform supporting LandGate’s valuation and analytics products. The platform ingests, processes and maintains large\-scale geospatial and energy datasets used across oil and gas, renewables, electrical infrastructure, carbon and land intelligence. This is a backend data engineering position built on engineering fundamentals. We are looking for someone who understands how programming languages, databases and operating systems work, and who can use that understanding to build, tune and debug systems from first principles. It is not a role centred on configuring or integrating third\-party tools and platforms, and it is not an application or front\-end development role. Working under the technical direction of the Principal Engineer, you will take ownership of major pipelines and data domains in Python, PostgreSQL/PostGIS and Linux, delivering them to a high standard with a high degree of autonomy. You will also mentor other engineers and help shape platform improvements through well\-reasoned proposals. You may also contribute to the development of new grid and interconnection analytics products, working with product and domain specialists to turn power\-systems concepts and data into robust, scalable software. **Main Responsibilities** * Lead the design and delivery of Python ETL pipelines for large, heterogeneous geospatial and energy datasets within your area of ownership, in line with the platform architecture. * Write efficient, correct and maintainable code, reasoning carefully about memory use, I/O, concurrency and algorithmic complexity when processing very large datasets. * Own the design and optimisation of PostgreSQL/PostGIS schemas, spatial indexing and query performance for your datasets, using query plans and database internals to guide decisions. * Build ingestion, validation, transformation and promotion workflows that are idempotent, testable and recoverable. **About You** **Essential experience and capabilities** * 6\+ years of professional software or data engineering experience, with a strong track record of delivering and operating production data systems. * Python: deep knowledge of the language and runtime, including data structures, the memory and object model, concurrency and multiprocessing, profiling and performance optimisation. You can solve problems with the standard library and know when a dependency is and isn’t justified. * SQL and PostgreSQL internals: strong command of SQL and a working understanding of how PostgreSQL executes queries, including the query planner, index types, transactions and locking, and maintenance behaviour. You tune from query plans, not guesswork. * Geospatial fundamentals: solid understanding of spatial data concep  operating systems: strong working knowledge of Linux, including processes, memory, filesystems, I/O, permissions and networking basics, and fluency with the shell and scripting for automation and troubleshooting. * Sound computer\-science foundations, including data structures, algorithms and complexity, applied to real data\-processing problems. * Experience designing and operating ETL pipelines at scale, including failure handling, backfills, schema change and data lineage. * Experience designing validation and data\-quality controls for business\-critical datasets. * Experience mentoring other engineers and contributing to technical design discussions, working effectively within an established architectural direction. * Excellent analytical, diagnostic and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts and trade\-offs to varied audiences. **Desirable experience** * Familiarity with power\-systems concepts and data, such as transmission networks, power flow, grid topology, or generator interconnection and the study processes around it. * Experience working with electrical network models or grid datasets, including standard industry file formats for power\-system models, and building tooling to parse, validate or transform them. * Experience building data\-quality and model\-validation checks for complex engineered datasets, where correctness can be verified against physical or topological rules. * Exposure to numerical or scientific computing in Python, such as sparse matrices, solvers or optimisation, and an understanding of convergence and numerical stability. * Experience handling interconnection queue, project pipeline or other regulatory and market filing data from system operators, utilities or developers. * Familiarity with common GIS data formats (Shapefile, GeoJSON) and how they are structured and parsed. * Experience in C or another lower\-level language, or writing PostgreSQL extensions or functions. * Exposure to cloud object storage (such as AWS S3\) from a data\-access perspective. * Exposure to data modelling, statistical analysis or machine learning workflows. * Domain experience in energy, land, mineral rights, oil and gas, renewables, electrical\-grid or carbon/CCUS datasets. We recognise that experience can be gained in different ways. If you meet most of the essential requirements and are interested in the role, we encourage you to apply. **Working Arrangements** We are a hybrid working company and the successful applicant will normally be expected to be physically present in the office at least two days per week to foster and contribute to a collaborative environment. Remote working arrangements will also be considered for this role, subject to the applicable approval process. Due to the global nature of the team, a degree of flexible working will be required to accommodate different time zones. Any out\-of\-hours collaboration should be planned proportionately and shared fairly across the team. **Wood Mackenzie Values** * Inclusive: we succeed together. * Trusting: we choose to trust each other. * Customer committed: we put customers at the heart of our decisions. * Future focused: we accelerate change. * Curious: we turn knowledge into action. The salary range for this position is $130,000 \- $150,000 which represents base pay only and does not include short\-term incentive compensation or commission. When determining base pay, as part of a final compensation package, we consider several factors such as location, experience, qualifications, and training. This base salary maps to the Primary Metropolitan Location. **Equal Opportunities** We are an equal opportunities employer. This means we are committed to recruiting the best people regardless of their race, colour, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), national origin, disability or protected veteran status. You can find out more about your rights under the law at www.eeoc.gov

jobs.title: Principal Software Development Engineer - Database Engineering
jobs.description: **Your work days are brighter here.** We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun\-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too. **About the Team** Do you want to work for a company that works hard, has fun, and continues to experience significant growth? Do you want to be part of an organization where your contributions directly help scale and sustain that growth? **About the Role** At Workday, we are looking for a Principal Software Development Engineer who thrives in a fast\-paced, challenging environment and enjoys solving complex technical problems at scale. The Database Engineering team is a distributed team responsible for ensuring 24/7 availability for customer environments. The team also evaluates, adopts, and deploys new technologies and services into live production environments, ensuring they are reliable, scalable, secure, and production\-ready. In this role, you will support large\-scale MySQL and open\-source database environments across production and development systems, participate in an on\-call rotation for critical production issues, drive automation to improve availability and scalability, and help architect both existing and new database services in our production environment. **About You** **Basic Qualification** * 2\+ years of experience designing, delivering AI‑enabled, analytics‑driven solutions in an enterprise context (e.g., AI agents, intelligent automation, advanced analytics, ML‑powered features) * Strong business acumen, with the ability to define AI‑enabled use cases, and connect AI capabilities to enhance SRE outcomes * 10\+ years of experience managing databases for enterprise cloud applications at scale supporting mission\-critical, high\-availability production environments * 8\+ years with proficiency in Python or Go, with secondary scripting experience (Shell, Rust). * 8\+ of hands\-on experience with containerization (Kubernetes, Docker), CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure\-as\-code tools (Terraform, Ansible, Chef, Git, Jenkins, Argo). * 6\+ years of background as a Database Engineer/Architect/DRE operating Linux\-based, clustered open\-source and NoSQL technologies (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cassandra, Redis). 6\+ years experience with managed cloud databases (AWS Aurora, Google Cloud SQL) and core architecture principles (design, replication, clustering, HA/DR, backup/restore). * **Other Qualification** * Deep knowledge of MySQL GTID, group replication, and Galera HA solutions. Familiarity with ecosystem tools like Orchestrator, Percona (MHA/Galera), Vitess, Ceph, Gluster, and Pure Storage. * Solid understanding of IaaS capacity management principles across AWS, GCP, and private cloud environments. * Proficiency with GitHub, Jira, and Confluence, alongside excellent technical documentation and communication skills. BS/MS in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent experience. * **Workday Pay Transparency Statement** The annualized base salary ranges for the primary location and any additional locations are listed below. Workday pay ranges vary based on work location. As a part of the total compensation package, this role may be eligible for the Workday Bonus Plan or a role\-specific commission/bonus, as well as annual refresh stock grants. Recruiters can share more detail during the hiring process. Each candidate’s compensation offer will be based on multiple factors including, but not limited to, geography, experience, skills, job duties, and business need, among other things. For more information regarding Workday’s comprehensive benefits, please click here . Primary Location: USA.CA.Pleasanton Primary Location Base Pay Range: $206,400 USD \- $309,600 USD Additional US Location(s) Base Pay Range: $173,300 USD \- $309,600 USD **Our Approach to Flexible Work** With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in\-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in\-office each week, we simply **spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field** with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter. Pursuant to applicable Fair Chance law, Workday will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Workday is an Equal Opportunity Employer including individuals with disabilities and protected veterans. Workday is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals during our application process, in order to perform one or more essential functions of their job, as well as regarding the use of AI tools for employment decision\-making to any degree. Please see below for more details including how to request an accommodation as a qualified veteran, due to a disability or for religious reasons, or as otherwise provided under applicable law. Workday prohibits taking adverse action against any candidate or employee for reporting a possible violation of this policy, requesting one or more work accommodations, exercising a privacy right, or cooperating in an investigation in accordance with applicable law. Any employee who retaliates against a candidate or employee for doing so may be subject to disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment, to the fullest extent allowable under applicable law. If you require a reasonable accommodation, you may email accommodations@workday.com , as far in advance as possible. **Are you being referred to one of our roles? If so, ask your connection at Workday about our Employee Referral process!** At Workday, we value our candidates’ privacy and data security. Workday will never ask candidates to apply to jobs through websites that are not Workday Careers. jobs.title: AI/ML Engineer & Applied Researcher, Early Stage Projects
jobs.description: Software EngineeringMountain View, CA (HQ) **About the company** X is Alphabet’s moonshot factory where uncomfortably ambitious, world\-changing ideas are developed and taken out into the world. X projects have the potential to transform the lives of billions of people and make the world a radically better place. For X to be successful, we have to repeatedly turn breakthrough technology ideas into products that solve large problems in the world, and create meaningful businesses for Alphabet. **About the team:** You'll join a team at X that provides world\-class computational support to the many different projects, ideas and experiments at the Moonshot Factory. You'll work directly with teams across X to share expert machine learning expertise, advice and hands\-on implementation; from early concept through launch and supporting prototyping, experimentation, technical development and more. **About the role:** Internally, we call this role the "Generally Awesome Engineer" because the problems we tackle at X rarely respect the boundary between a Research Scientist and a Machine Learning Engineer. One month, you might be designing a multi\-agent reasoning harness that critiques early moonshot hypotheses or automates complex engineering workflows across the factory. Next, you might be embedded with a small team of physicists, biologists, or mechanical engineers, adapting foundation models and reinforcement learning to control lab hardware, simulate molecular interactions, or process sparse sensor telemetry. We are looking for someone earlier in their career, ideally coming out of a technical PhD, an early\-stage startup, or preferably both, who lives and breathes modern AI. You don't just follow the state of the art in foundation models and agentic AI; you internalize how the landscape is shifting week by week and immediately translate new capabilities into working systems. Just as importantly, you use AI proactively in your own day\-to\-day workflow: you build with coding agents, automate your own bottlenecks, and prototype at a speed that previously required a five\-person team. **How You'll Make 10x Impact:** * **Architect and ship agentic AI systems:** Design, build, and deploy multi\-agent workflows, tool\-using harnesses, memory/retrieval pipelines, and human\-in\-the\-loop systems that accelerate both individual moonshot projects and factory\-wide discovery. * **Bridge frontier research and real\-world prototyping:** Take newly published papers, open\-weight models, and frontier Alphabet/Google DeepMind capabilities and adapt them via post\-training, fine\-tuning, RL, test\-time compute, or hybrid neuro\-symbolic architectures to messy, non\-obvious real\-world problems. * **De\-risk early moonshot investigations:** Partner with scientists, hardware engineers, and rapid evaluators on 0\-to\-1 investigations to scope technical feasibility, identify the hardest core assumptions, and build fast, scrappy prototypes that deliver clear kill\-or\-continue signals. * **Model AI\-native engineering across the factory:** Push the frontier of AI\-assisted software and research development \- building reusable skills, plugins, and agentic workflows that help engineers and domain scientists across X move 10x faster. * **Own end\-to\-end execution across the stack:** Move fluidly from curating noisy datasets and training models on our on\-prem GPU cluster or cloud infrastructure to building clean backend services, APIs, and interactive prototypes that partners and teammates can use immediately. * **Act as an AI tastemaker for X:** Stay plugged into the bleeding edge across Alphabet, academia, and the startup ecosystem; separate durable technical breakthroughs from passing hype, and bring the best tools and ideas into X. **Minimum Qualifications:** * PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, a quantitative physical/life science, or a related technical field OR a Master's/Bachelor's degree with equivalent high\-velocity experience in an early\-stage startup or applied AI research lab. * Deep theoretical and hands\-on command of modern foundation models (LLMs, multimodal models, diffusion/flow models) and their post\-training/adaptation lifecycle. * Demonstrated experience designing and building agentic AI systems including multi\-agent orchestration, tool use and environment interaction, code execution harnesses, and complex retrieval/memory architectures. * Fluency in AI\-native software development with strong software engineering chops in Python (and modern ML ecosystems such as PyTorch, JAX, or vLLM) paired with daily mastery of AI coding and research agents to build and ship rapidly. * Track record of taking ambiguous, open\-ended real\-world problems from zero to a working prototype with minimal supervision. **Preferred Qualifications:** * The "PhD \+ Startup" combination: Rigorous research training (e.g., publications at NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, CVPR, or domain journals) combined with experience building at an early\-stage startup where you wore multiple hats and shipped under tight constraints. * Experience applying AI/ML to physical, scientific, or hardware\-coupled domains; such as computational chemistry, materials science, synthetic biology, physics simulation, CAD/mechanical design, robotics, or climate/earth systems. * Full\-stack prototyping capability: comfort spinning up cloud infrastructure (GCP, Docker, Kubernetes), GPU cluster workloads, and lightweight web UIs or developer tools when a project needs them. **How You Know You'll Thrive Here:** * **You are unapologetically AI\-fluent—and grounded in reality.** You test new models, agent harnesses, and workflows the day they drop because you genuinely love seeing what's newly possible, but you care about solving real physical and human problems rather than chasing demos. * **You refuse to say "that's not my job description."** Whether a project needs a custom loss function, a data\-cleaning pipeline, an agentic harness, or a script to talk to lab hardware, you jump in and build what the problem requires. * **You have high agency and low ego.** You love working shoulder to shoulder with domain experts who think differently than you do, and you're just as proud of a rigorous experiment that disproves a flawed idea in two weeks as one that launches a multi\-year project. The US base salary range for this full\-time position is $147,000 \- $221,000 \+ bonus \+ equity \+ benefits. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your location during the hiring process. Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include bonus, equity, or benefits. **An Equal Opportunity Workplace** ---------------------------------- At X, we don't just accept difference \- we celebrate it, we support it, and we thrive on it for the benefit of our employees, our products and our community. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description: ##### **Who We Are** adMarketplace is the largest global marketplace for Native Search advertising. For over 25 years, we’ve connected brands with consumers at the moment they express commercial intent beyond legacy search engines. Today, our Native Search solutions are exclusively integrated across next\-generation platforms where discovery happens, including web browsers, Buy Now Pay Later apps, and AI chat surfaces. Powered by vector search technology, our platform delivers relevant text and product ads that match consumers with the brands, products, and offers they’re actively seeking. Our award\-winning culture is grounded in the principles of Curiosity, Collaboration, Creative Conflict, Commitment, and Competitiveness – our 5Cs. These values drive us to turn complexity into clarity and create measurable value for consumers, advertisers, and publishers alike. ##### **The Role** We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the product surface where advertisers' systems meet ours: shopping feeds (PLAs) and Shopping Ad APIs, conversion APIs (CAPI) and server\-side measurement, Advertiser Event Integrations (AEI), SDKs, real\-time bidding and programmatic connections, and the data passback that lets AI Chat surfaces and advertiser agents exchange intent, product, and conversion signals. You own how advertiser data enters adMarketplace, how it is validated, and how it is returned, across two marketplaces, a platform, and an AI Chat business that was first to market and first to scale. This is a senior, hands\-on role with executive visibility and a 0\-to\-1 mandate. Advertisers increasingly bring intent, catalog, and conversion data through protocols rather than a UI, and our largest partners expect us to meet them in OpenRTB, agentic commerce standards, and their own APIs. You will decide which integrations we build, how they are specified, and what they must prove, then ship them with Engineering, Data Science, and our Demand and Advertiser Success teams. Advertiser\-facing workflows in AMPlify, auction and ranking logic, and the reporting data layer each have their own product owner. Your job is the connective layer in between. ##### **What You'll Do** * Own advertiser\-side integrations end to end: Own the roadmap for the protocols and products through which advertisers connect to adMarketplace: shopping feeds (PLAs) and Shopping Ad APIs, conversion APIs (CAPI), static conversion feeds, SDKs, and real\-time bidding, from ideation through launch, adoption, and iteration. * Bring RTB and programmatic demand into the marketplace: Define how adMarketplace participates in OpenRTB and bidder\-based demand: bid request and response contracts, deal and auction mechanics on our side of the seam, creative and product payloads, and the measurement that proves incremental value against native demand. * Build the AI Chat data exchange: Own the chat\-to\-chat and agent\-to\-agent data passback that lets AI Chat surfaces, advertiser agents, and commerce systems exchange intent, catalog, and conversion signals. Shape adMarketplace's position in emerging agentic advertising and commerce standards. * Grow conversion and intent coverage: Own the roadmap for conversion and first\-party data across advertisers and partners, including CAPI adoption, new conversion pipelines, and the enrichment that improves relevance, pricing, and measurement downstream. * Hold the quality bar at the edge: Own the correctness, validation, and health of what advertisers send us. Build the alerting, triage tooling, and self\-service checks so a feed, pixel, or bid stream problem is caught before it reaches the auction or a client report. * Be the voice of the advertiser's systems: Translate what Demand, Advertiser Success, Business Development, and the largest brand and agency partners need from an integration into specs, contracts, and shipped products. Run partner\-facing technical conversations yourself. * Prototype and technically scope: Write PRDs, read API contracts and schemas, mock request and response payloads, and build lightweight working tools that move conversations with Engineering and partners forward faster than a doc alone. * Measurement by design: Define the experiment design, success metrics, and evaluation plan for every integration launch, with A/B or multi\-armed bandit methods where they fit, so decisions rest on causal lift and not on partner enthusiasm. * Work in the modern stack: Use agentic workflows and AI\-assisted development to draft integrations, mock endpoints, and shorten the cycle between a partner ask and a testable prototype. * Partner across the org: Work daily with Engineering, Data Science, Product Analytics, and the demand, platform, supply, and AI/ML product owners. Write down the seams between integrations, advertiser workflows, auction logic, and the reporting data layer, and hold them. * Bring clarity: Frame integration investments in revenue, client, and competitive terms. Take ambiguous, cro ative and product payloads, and the tradeoffs between programmatic and native demand. * Hands\-on knowledge of shopping and conversion plumbing: product feed specs and Shopping APIs, server\-side conversion APIs, tag and pixel tracking, attribution windows, and the data\-quality failure modes of each. * High technical literacy. You read an API contract and a schema, write SQL without help, reason about data lineage and edge cases, and can tell a pipeline bug from a contract mismatch from a bad upstream feed. * Commercial and marketplace acumen. You understand how a search advertising marketplace makes money, what an advertiser or agency needs to move budget, and how to frame an integration in revenue and competitive terms to an executive. * Cross\-company partnership skill. You have run technical and commercial conversations with external platform, brand, or agency teams and landed decisions that required alignment across both sides. * Strong experimentation instincts: A/B testing, multi\-armed bandit methods, funnel analytics, and the discipline to separate causal lift from correlation. * Hands\-on prototyping and AI\-assisted development. You use modern tooling to mock endpoints and build small working checks, not only to spec them. * Excellent written communication. You can make a tangled, multi\-party integration question legible to an executive in one page, and turn a partner ask into a spec an engineer can build against. * Comfort operating with autonomy in a fast\-moving, ambiguous environment, with the grit to drive decisions when the standard is still being written. ##### **Bonus Points** * Direct experience with AI Chat, generative search, or agentic commerce surfaces, especially intent, retrieval, or conversion data exchange between an assistant and an advertiser system. * Experience with LLM\-powered intent or query understanding applied to shopping and advertising outcomes. * Background integrating against DSPs, SSPs, retail media networks, or product catalog and identity systems, including API versioning and partner certification. * Experience taking integrations to large brand and agency partners, including Fortune 500 or top\-tier agency relationships. * Prior engineering, analytics engineering, or data science role earlier in career, with a shift into product. ##### **Join Us** adMarketplace has been named as one of the best places to work in New York City by Built In and Crain’s\- the latter of which have recognized us the past three years straight! AMP is currently experiencing triple digit growth, and it’s never been a better time to join our team! We offer a robust continuing education program, management training, regular company\-wide lunch and learns, and well\-defined career paths to ensure all our employees have an opportunity to grow. At adMarketplace, we play to win, but we learn from our setbacks. Our commitment to a collaborative environment means no one succeeds alone, and no one fails alone either. We know you’ve come to expect comprehensive healthcare, wellness programs, paid time off, commuter benefits, and 401k matching from any company, so it’s a good thing we offer all of that and so much more. adMarketplace offers Summer Fridays, catered lunches, a fully stocked kitchen, ZogSports teams, happy hours and corporate retreats to encourage a strong work/life balance. No Third Party Recruiters. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. This range represents the low and high end of the base salary someone in this role may earn as an employee of adMarketplace in the New York office. Salaries will vary based on various factors including but not limited to professional and academic experience; training; associated responsibilities; and other business and organizational needs. The range listed is just one component of our total compensation package for employees. Salary decisions are dependent on the circumstances of each hire.
